records.k: control change cc controller mod wheel sustain pedal raw midi knob callback event 控制變化 cc 控制器 調變輪 延音踏板 原始 midi 旋鈕 事件 回呼
records.d: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it for every MIDI control change (a knob, a fader, the mod wheel, the sustain pedal), whether or not the controller is known.
records.x: Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It hears every control, including the ones that are not a knob or a fader, such as the mod wheel and the pedals, which knobMoved() never reports. The latest value of every controller number is also in OAVp5.cc, so a sketch that only wants to look can read OAVp5.cc[1] in draw(). For one incoming message the order is: midiMessage(), then the specific one (noteOn(), controlChange(), pitchBend()), then the friendly one (padPressed(), knobMoved(), notePressed() and their partners). Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, ?oav_hardware=auto), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, OAVp5.input() and other programs reach it too. OAVp5.on('controlChange', fn) does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. cc The controller number, 0 to 127 (1 is the mod wheel, 64 the sustain pedal, 74 the first knob on a MiniLab 3). value Where the control is now, 0 to 1 (MIDI's 0 to 127 divided by 127). channel The MIDI channel, 1 to 16.

records.k: control change cc controller mod wheel sustain pedal raw midi knob callback event 控制變化 cc 控制器 調變輪 延音踏板 原始 midi 旋鈕 事件 回呼
records.d: 你來定義這個函式。每收到一個 MIDI 控制變化（旋鈕、推桿、調變輪、延音踏板），oav-p5 就呼叫它，不管控制器認不認得。
records.x: 用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 每個控制它都聽得到，包括不是旋鈕也不是推桿的那些，像調變輪和踏板，knobMoved() 永遠不會回報它們。每個控制器號碼的最新值也放在 OAVp5.cc，所以只想看一眼的草圖可以在 draw() 裡讀 OAVp5.cc[1]。 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 midiMessage()，再來是對應的那一個（noteOn()、controlChange()、pitchBend()），最後才是比較親切的那一個（padPressed()、knobMoved()、notePressed() 和它們的另一半）。 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，?oav_hardware=auto），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、OAVp5.input() 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。OAVp5.on('controlChange', fn) 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 cc 控制器號碼，0 到 127（1 是調變輪，64 是延音踏板，MiniLab 3 的第一顆旋鈕是 74）。 value 這個控制現在的位置，0 到 1（MIDI 的 0 到 127 除以 127）。 channel MIDI 通道，1 到 16。

records.k: fader slider number index 推桿 滑桿 編號
records.d: Returns the position of fader number n, from 0 to 1: the same as fader1 to fader8, for any n.
records.x: The function form of fader1, for when the fader's number is a variable. n Which fader, counting from 1. The fader's position, 0..1; 0 until it has moved.

records.k: fader slider number index 推桿 滑桿 編號
records.d: 回傳第 n 支推桿的位置，0 到 1：跟 fader1 到 fader8 一樣，但 n 可以是任何數字。
records.x: fader1 的函式版本，推桿的編號是變數的時候用。 n 第幾支推桿，從 1 開始算。 推桿的位置，0..1。還沒推過之前是 0。

records.a: fader1 fader2 fader3 fader4 fader5 fader6 fader7 fader8
records.k: fader slider controller midi 推桿 滑桿 控制器 midi
records.d: The position of a controller fader (slider), from 0 to 1: fader1 is the first fader, up to fader8.
records.x: Works exactly like knob1, for the controller's faders, numbered in the order the controller's profile lists them (as printed on the device). A controller with only four faders, like the MiniLab 3, has fader1 to fader4. Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load, exactly as for a knob (knob1); reading a fader also makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card. Changes when the fader moves; 0 until it has moved.

records.a: fader1 fader2 fader3 fader4 fader5 fader6 fader7 fader8
records.k: fader slider controller midi 推桿 滑桿 控制器 midi
records.d: 控制器上推桿（滑桿）的位置，從 0 到 1：fader1 是第一支推桿，一直到 fader8。
records.x: 用法跟 knob1 完全一樣，只是對應控制器上的推桿，編號依控制器設定檔列出的順序（也就是機器上印的順序）。只有四支推桿的控制器（像 MiniLab 3）就只有 fader1 到 fader4。 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要，跟旋鈕一樣（見 knob1）。讀推桿還會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成一張卡片。 推桿移動的時候才會改變。還沒推過之前是 0。

records.k: fader moved slider callback event 推桿 滑桿 事件 回呼
records.d: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it whenever a fader moves.
records.x: The fader twin of knobMoved(): function faderMoved(n, value) { … }. n Which fader (1 is the first). value Where it is now, 0..1.

records.k: fader moved slider callback event 推桿 滑桿 事件 回呼
records.d: 你來定義這個函式。推桿一移動，oav-p5 就呼叫它。
records.x: knobMoved() 的推桿版本：function faderMoved(n, value) { … }。 n 哪一支推桿（1 是第一支）。 value 現在的位置，0..1。

records.k: knob dial number index controller 旋鈕 編號 控制器
records.d: Returns the position of knob number n, from 0 to 1: the same as knob1 to knob8, for any n.
records.x: Use it when the number of the knob is a variable: for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));. It also works in a sketch that has its own knob1, which oav-p5 then leaves alone. n Which knob, counting from 1 (as printed on the controller). The knob's position, 0..1; 0 until it has been turned.

records.k: knob dial number index controller 旋鈕 編號 控制器
records.d: 回傳第 n 顆旋鈕的位置，0 到 1：跟 knob1 到 knob8 一樣，但 n 可以是任何數字。
records.x: 旋鈕的編號是變數的時候用它：for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));。草圖自己已經有 knob1 的話也可以用，oav-p5 不會去動那個名稱。 n 第幾顆旋鈕，從 1 開始算（照控制器上印的）。 旋鈕的位置，0..1。還沒轉過之前是 0。

records.a: knob1 knob2 knob3 knob4 knob5 knob6 knob7 knob8
records.k: knob dial rotary controller cc control change midi potentiometer 旋鈕 控制器 轉鈕 midi 控制訊號
records.d: The position of a controller knob, from 0 to 1: knob1 is the first knob, knob2 the second, up to knob8.
records.x: Read it in draw() the way you read mouseX: background(knob1 255). Knobs are numbered the way they are printed on the controller, so knob 1 is knob 1 on any controller OAV has a profile for: the MiniLab 3's first knob is CC 74, the LPD8's is CC 70. The sketch never needs to know a CC number. On a controller OAV has no profile for, the first knob you turn becomes knob1, the next one knob2, and so on, in the order you turn them. Past eight, use knob(n). Nothing to call. With the default hardware=auto, oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI as soon as it loads, whatever the sketch reads (Chrome, Edge and Firefox have it; Safari and iPad do not: use 🎹 or a phone there). Reading a knob also tells oav-p5 the sketch plays from MIDI, so when Web MIDI is missing or refused a card beside the 🎹 says so; a sketch that uses none of this never sees that card. ?oav_hardware=click waits for the 🎹 panel instead. A sketch that already has its own knob1 (a let, a function) keeps it, and a card beside the 🎹 says what to read instead (knob(1)). With OP Configurator, knobs also drive the OPC sliders in the order they are declared. A knob the sketch reads itself stays the sketch's: that slider no longer follows it. Changes when the knob moves, not once per frame; the sketch just reads the latest value. 0 until the knob has been turned.

records.a: knob1 knob2 knob3 knob4 knob5 knob6 knob7 knob8
records.k: knob dial rotary controller cc control change midi potentiometer 旋鈕 控制器 轉鈕 midi 控制訊號
records.d: 控制器上旋鈕的位置，從 0 到 1：knob1 是第一顆旋鈕，knob2 是第二顆，一直到 knob8。
records.x: 像讀 mouseX 一樣在 draw() 裡讀：background(knob1 255)。旋鈕的編號照控制器上印的順序，所以在 OAV 有設定檔的任何控制器上，旋鈕 1 就是旋鈕 1：MiniLab 3 的第一顆是 CC 74，LPD8 的是 CC 70。草圖完全不用知道 CC 號碼。 遇到 OAV 沒有設定檔的控制器，你轉的第一顆旋鈕就變成 knob1，下一顆是 knob2，依你轉的順序往下排。超過八顆就用 knob(n)。 不用呼叫任何東西。預設的 hardware=auto 下，oav-p5 一載入就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI，不管草圖有沒有讀東西（Chrome、Edge、Firefox 有。Safari 和 iPad 沒有，那裡改用 🎹 或手機）。讀旋鈕還會讓 oav-p5 知道這份草圖要用 MIDI 玩，所以 Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕的時候，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明。完全沒用到這些的草圖不會看到那張卡片。?oav_hardware=click 則是等你按 🎹 面板裡的按鈕才去要。 草圖如果本來就有自己的 knob1（let、函式都算），就由草圖保留，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明改讀什麼（knob(1)）。 搭配 OP Configurator 時，旋鈕也會依宣告順序推動 OPC 的滑桿。草圖自己有讀的那顆旋鈕就歸草圖：對應的滑桿不再跟著動。 旋鈕轉動的時候才會改變，不是每個畫面一次。草圖只要讀最新的值。旋鈕還沒轉過之前是 0。

records.k: knob moved callback event turn 旋鈕 轉動 事件 回呼
records.d: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it whenever a knob moves.
records.x: Like mouseMoved() for knobs: It is called for every step the knob sends, so many times per second while it turns. To read a knob once a frame, use knob1 instead. n Which knob (1 is the first, as printed on the controller). value Where it is now, 0..1.

records.k: knob moved callback event turn 旋鈕 轉動 事件 回呼
records.d: 你來定義這個函式。旋鈕一轉動，oav-p5 就呼叫它。
records.x: 就像旋鈕版的 mouseMoved()： 旋鈕每送出一格就呼叫一次，轉動的時候每秒會呼叫很多次。想要每個畫面讀一次，就改用 knob1。 n 哪一顆旋鈕（1 是第一顆，照控制器上印的）。 value 現在的位置，0..1。

records.k: last note frameCount frames since key pressed 上一個音 幾格以前 畫面數 按鍵
records.d: The frameCount of the frame that saw the last key go down: frameCount - lastNoteFrameCount is how many frames ago.
records.x: The frame-counting twin of lastNoteTs: 0 in the first frame after the key, then 1, 2, 3 … A frame number, on the same count as frameCount, set with note; -Infinity before any key. Since oav-p5 0.8.3.

records.k: last note frameCount frames since key pressed 上一個音 幾格以前 畫面數 按鍵
records.d: 看到上一個鍵按下的那一格的 frameCount：frameCount - lastNoteFrameCount 就是幾格以前。
records.x: lastNoteTs 的「數格子」版本：按下之後的第一格是 0，接下來 1、2、3…… 畫面的編號，跟 frameCount 同一套數法，跟 note 一起更新。還沒按過任何鍵之前是 -Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.3 起。

records.k: last note timestamp time since millis key pressed 上一個音 時間 多久以前 毫秒 按鍵
records.d: When the last key went down, on the millis() clock: millis() - lastNoteTs is how many ms ago.
records.x: Any key counts: a MIDI keyboard, the 🎹 on screen, a phone. Releasing a key does not change it. Milliseconds on the same clock as millis(), set with note and velocity; -Infinity before any key. Since oav-p5 0.8.2.

records.k: last note timestamp time since millis key pressed 上一個音 時間 多久以前 毫秒 按鍵
records.d: 上一個鍵是什麼時候按下的，用 millis() 的時鐘：millis() - lastNoteTs 就是幾毫秒前。
records.x: 任何鍵都算：MIDI 鍵盤、畫面上的 🎹、手機。放開鍵不會改變它。 毫秒，跟 millis() 同一個時鐘，跟 note、velocity 一起更新。還沒按過任何鍵之前是 -Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.2 起。

records.k: midi message raw midi bytes status byte aftertouch program change any message callback event midi 訊息 原始 midi 位元組 觸後 音色切換 任何訊息 事件 回呼
records.d: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it for every MIDI message it receives, with the raw bytes and where they came from.
records.x: Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It is the widest net: it is called first for every note, control change and pitch bend, and it is the only function that hears the messages oav-p5 has no friendlier name for, such as channel pressure (0xD0), polyphonic aftertouch (0xA0) and program change (0xC0). The OAVp5.last object keeps the latest note, control change or pitch bend, but not those. It does not hear system messages: the MIDI clock, start, stop and song position go to OAVp5.clock, and system-exclusive messages are dropped. A note-on with velocity 0 arrives here as it was sent (a note-on with 0), while noteOff() is the one that treats it as a release. For one incoming message the order is: midiMessage(), then the specific one (noteOn(), controlChange(), pitchBend()), then the friendly one (padPressed(), knobMoved(), notePressed() and their partners). Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, ?oav_hardware=auto), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, OAVp5.input() and other programs reach it too. OAVp5.on('midiMessage', fn) does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. bytes The message as three numbers [status, data1, data2]. The status…

records.k: midi message raw midi bytes status byte aftertouch program change any message callback event midi 訊息 原始 midi 位元組 觸後 音色切換 任何訊息 事件 回呼
records.d: 你來定義這個函式。每收到一則 MIDI 訊息，oav-p5 就呼叫它，帶著原始的位元組和它從哪裡來。
records.x: 用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 它是網子最大的一個：每個音符、控制變化、音高輪訊息都會先呼叫它，而且 oav-p5 沒有比較親切的名字可以叫的訊息，只有它聽得到，像是通道壓力（0xD0）、各鍵觸後（0xA0）、音色切換（0xC0）。OAVp5.last 只留最新的音符、控制變化或音高輪，不留這些。 系統訊息它聽不到：MIDI 時鐘、start、stop、song position 都交給 OAVp5.clock，系統專用（sysex）訊息直接丟掉。力道是 0 的 note-on 在這裡照送出的樣子到達（note-on，力道 0），把它當成放開的是 noteOff()。 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 midiMessage()，再來是對應的那一個（noteOn()、controlChange()、pitchBend()），最後才是比較親切的那一個（padPressed()、knobMoved()、notePressed() 和它們的另一半）。 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，?oav_hardware=auto），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、OAVp5.input() 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。OAVp5.on('midiMessage', fn) 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 bytes 這則訊息，三個數字 [status, data1, data2]。status 位元組的上半是種類，下半是通道（0x90 是通道 1 的 note-on，0x93 是通道 4 的）。資料位元組是 0 到 127，訊息沒有的那個位元組是 0。 source 它從哪裡來：'hardware'（真的控制器）、'screen'（🎹）、'phone'、'virtual-out'（某個程式送進 OAV Virtual MIDI）、'link'（同一個房間的另一頁），或你在 OAVp5.input() 給的標籤。

records.k: note key pitch keyboard midi number 音符 琴鍵 音高 鍵盤 midi 號碼
records.d: The MIDI number (0 to 127) of the last key pressed.
records.x: Middle C is 60, A4 is 69. noteName(note) writes the number as a name (60 → 'C4') and noteFreq(note) as a frequency in Hz. velocity says how hard it was pressed. For every key, not just the last, define notePressed(). Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load (see knob1). Unlike a knob, merely reading note does not tell oav-p5 the sketch plays from MIDI: defining notePressed() or reading a knob or pad does, which is what makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card. 🎹 and a phone always work. A sketch with its own note (a let note, a function) keeps it; read midi.last.note instead. oav-p5 says so in a card the first time. Set when a key goes down and kept after it is released; 0 before any key has been pressed.

records.k: note key pitch keyboard midi number 音符 琴鍵 音高 鍵盤 midi 號碼
records.d: 最後被按下的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼（0 到 127）。
records.x: 中央 C 是 60，A4 是 69。noteName(note) 把號碼寫成音名（60 → 'C4'），noteFreq(note) 換成赫茲。velocity 告訴你按得多用力。想要每個鍵都知道、不只最後一個，就定義 notePressed()。 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要（見 knob1）。跟旋鈕不一樣，單單讀 note 並不會讓 oav-p5 知道草圖要用 MIDI 玩：定義 notePressed()，或讀旋鈕、墊子才會，也才會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成卡片。🎹 和手機隨時都能用。 草圖如果自己有 note（let note、函式都算），就由草圖保留。改讀 midi.last.note。oav-p5 第一次會用卡片告訴你。 鍵按下的時候設定，放開之後也保留。還沒有按過任何鍵之前是 0。

records.k: key down held keyIsDown note name C4 按著 琴鍵 音名 keyIsDown
records.d: True while the key n (a MIDI number or a name like 'C4') is held down.
records.x: The MIDI version of keyIsDown(). noteIsDown('C4') is the same as noteIsDown(60): C4 is middle C. A name that is not a note ('H4', 'C-2') stops the sketch with a one-line card saying how to write it. n The key: a MIDI number (60) or a note name ('C4', 'c#4', 'Db3'). True if that key is down right now.

records.k: key down held keyIsDown note name C4 按著 琴鍵 音名 keyIsDown
records.d: 鍵 n（MIDI 號碼，或像 'C4' 這樣的音名）按著的時候是 true。
records.x: 就是 MIDI 版的 keyIsDown()。noteIsDown('C4') 跟 noteIsDown(60) 一樣：C4 是中央 C。不是音符的名稱（'H4'、'C-2'）會讓草圖停下來，並用一張卡片告訴你怎麼寫。 n 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼（60）或音名（'C4'、'c#4'、'Db3'）。 那個鍵現在按著就是 true。

records.k: key pressed held any key keyIsPressed 按著 任一個鍵 琴鍵
records.d: True while at least one key is held down.
records.x: To ask about one particular key, use noteIsDown(). midi.held lists every key held right now, lowest first. Like keyIsPressed, for MIDI keys. False when nothing is held.

records.d: An array of 128 numbers, one per MIDI controller number: where each control last was, 0 to 1. OAVp5.cc[1] is the mod wheel, OAVp5.cc[64] the sustain pedal.
records.x: The array version of controlChange(): read any controller in draw() without defining a function. It holds every CC, including the ones that are not a knob or a fader, such as the mod wheel (1), the volume (7) and the sustain pedal (64, which counts as down at 0.5 and above). The MIDI channel is ignored: the latest value of that controller number wins, whichever channel it came on. midi.cc is the same array. The friendly names knob1 and fader1 are looked up through the controller's profile and read the same data. The index is the controller (CC) number, 0 to 127; the value is the last one received divided by 127. Changes when a message arrives. 0 before a control has moved, which is not the same as "at 0".

records.k: connect hardware ask for midi web midi permission request midi start midi 連接硬體 要 midi web midi 權限 請求 midi 啟動 midi
records.d: Asks the browser for Web MIDI now, and returns a promise that says whether a real controller can be heard.
records.x: It does what ?oav_hardware=auto does at load, at a moment you pick: from a button, after an intro, or when hardware is click or off. It works whatever the option says. After a refusal you can call it again to retry, but browsers usually remember a refusal and answer at once, so the way out is the lock icon left of the address. A browser with Web MIDI (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), on https or localhost. Some browsers want a click first: call it from mousePressed() or a button handler if setup() is too early. Safari and iPad have none: the promise resolves false and OAVp5.hardware is 'unavailable'. Resolves to true once the browser has allowed Web MIDI (with or without a device plugged in), and to false if it refused or there is no Web MIDI in this browser. Calling it again while it is asking, or after it said yes, gives the same answer.

records.k: connect hardware ask for midi web midi permission request midi start midi 連接硬體 要 midi web midi 權限 請求 midi 啟動 midi
records.d: 現在就向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你聽不聽得到真的控制器。
records.x: 它做的就是 ?oav_hardware=auto 在載入時做的事，只是時間由你挑：從一個按鈕、片頭結束之後，或是 hardware 設成 click 或 off 的時候。不管選項怎麼設它都能用。被拒絕之後可以再呼叫一次重試，但瀏覽器通常會記住拒絕、立刻回答，所以要解決得靠網址列左邊的鎖頭。 要有 Web MIDI 的瀏覽器（Chrome、Edge、Firefox），網頁在 https 或 localhost 底下。有些瀏覽器要先有一次點擊：如果在 setup() 裡太早，就放在 mousePressed() 或按鈕的處理函式裡呼叫。Safari 和 iPad 沒有：promise 會 resolve 成 false，OAVp5.hardware 是 'unavailable'。 瀏覽器允許 Web MIDI 之後 resolve 成 true（不管有沒有插設備），被拒絕或這個瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI 就 resolve 成 false。還在詢問的時候、或是已經答應之後再呼叫，會得到同樣的答案。

records.k: devices connected controllers port names midi inputs what is plugged in 設備 連上的控制器 連接埠名稱 midi 輸入 插了什麼
records.d: The names of the MIDI controllers plugged in, as the browser reports them: an array of text, empty when there is none.
records.x: Use it for a line like "playing: Arturia MiniLab3", or to tell whether a real controller is there. The names are whatever the operating system calls the port, so match them loosely (name.toLowerCase().includes('minilab')). The 🎹 panel uses them to follow the controller that is plugged in. midi.devices is the same array, replaced as a whole, not changed in place: read it again after a change. One entry per connected input port. Replaced whenever a device is plugged in or out. Empty until Web MIDI has been allowed (OAVp5.hardware), and it never lists the on-screen controller or the phone.

records.k: devices connected controllers port names midi inputs what is plugged in 設備 連上的控制器 連接埠名稱 midi 輸入 插了什麼
records.d: 插著的 MIDI 控制器的名稱，照瀏覽器回報的樣子：一個文字陣列，沒有的時候是空的。
records.x: 用來顯示像「正在彈：Arturia MiniLab3」這樣的一行，或判斷有沒有真的控制器。名稱是作業系統給連接埠取的名字，所以比對時要寬鬆一點（name.toLowerCase().includes('minilab')）。🎹 面板就是用它們來跟著插上去的那一台控制器。 midi.devices 是同一個陣列，是整個換掉，不是就地修改：變動之後要重新讀一次。 每個連上的輸入埠一項。每次有設備插上或拔掉都會換成新的。在 Web MIDI 被允許之前是空的（OAVp5.hardware），而且永遠不會列出螢幕上的控制器或手機。

records.k: hardware state web midi permission connected denied no device safari midi 硬體狀態 web midi 權限 已連上 被拒絕 沒有設備 safari midi
records.d: Where Web MIDI stands: 'off', 'asking', 'connected', 'waiting', 'denied' or 'unavailable'.
records.x: 'off': Web MIDI has not been asked for yet (see hardware). 'asking': waiting for the browser's permission answer. 'connected': allowed, and at least one device is plugged in (OAVp5.devices lists them). 'waiting': allowed, but no device yet: plug one in and it becomes 'connected' by itself. 'denied': the permission was refused. 'unavailable': the browser has no Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) or could not open it. It is only about real hardware. The on-screen controller and a phone work in every state. In the 🩺 check-up, waiting is written as "no device found". Changes when the browser answers and whenever a MIDI device is plugged in or out.

records.k: hardware state web midi permission connected denied no device safari midi 硬體狀態 web midi 權限 已連上 被拒絕 沒有設備 safari midi
records.d: Web MIDI 目前的情形：'off'、'asking'、'connected'、'waiting'、'denied' 或 'unavailable'。
records.x: 'off'：還沒有去要過 Web MIDI（見 hardware）。'asking'：等瀏覽器的權限回答。'connected'：允許了，而且至少插著一台設備（OAVp5.devices 列出它們）。'waiting'：允許了，但還沒有設備：插上一台就會自己變成 'connected'。'denied'：權限被拒絕。'unavailable'：這個瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad），或是打不開它。 它只管真的硬體。螢幕上的控制器和手機在每一種狀態下都能用。 在 🩺 體檢裡，waiting 寫成「沒偵測到裝置」。 瀏覽器回答的時候，以及每次有 MIDI 設備插上或拔掉的時候會變。

records.k: held keys chord pressed keys keys down midi.held 按著的鍵 和弦 按下的鍵 琴鍵 midi.held
records.d: A list of the MIDI numbers of the keys that are down right now, lowest first.
records.x: The short version of OAVp5.note: only the keys that are down, so OAVp5.held.length is how many, OAVp5.held[0] is the lowest and OAVp5.held.map((n) => noteName(n)) spells the chord. noteIsPressed is OAVp5.held.length > 0. midi.held is the same array. Read it, do not change it. It is the same array object every time, so copy it ([...OAVp5.held]) if you want to keep a moment of it. Empty when nothing is held. A key is added when its note-on arrives and removed at its note-off, and the list is kept sorted from low to high.

records.k: held keys chord pressed keys keys down midi.held 按著的鍵 和弦 按下的鍵 琴鍵 midi.held
records.d: 現在按著的鍵的 MIDI 號碼清單，由低到高。
records.x: OAVp5.note 的精簡版：只列按著的鍵，所以 OAVp5.held.length 是幾個鍵，OAVp5.held[0] 是最低的那個，OAVp5.held.map((n) => noteName(n)) 把和弦寫出來。noteIsPressed 就是 OAVp5.held.length > 0。 midi.held 是同一個陣列。只讀，不要改它。它每次都是同一個陣列物件，想把某一刻存下來的話要複製一份（[...OAVp5.held]）。 沒有按著任何鍵的時候是空的。note-on 進來時加入，note-off 時移除，清單一直照由低到高排好。

records.k: input send midi fake midi simulate controller raw bytes test without controller midi.input 輸入 送 midi 假的 midi 模擬控制器 原始位元組 沒有控制器也能測 midi.input
records.d: Sends one MIDI message into oav-p5 by hand, as bytes: the whole sketch reacts as if a controller had sent it.
records.x: It is the door every input goes through, and you can knock on it yourself: a sketch can test itself without a controller, drive itself from a timer, or take messages from a WebSocket or another library. The sketch cannot tell the difference: knob1, notePressed(), OAVp5.note, the sound if startSound() is on and the drum cues all react. OAVp5.play() is the friendlier way to send a note. midi.input(…) is the same function. It returns nothing. A message with a source other than 'screen' also lights the keys of the on-screen controller if it is open. bytes One message, [status, data1, data2]: [0x90, 60, 100] is a note-on for key 60 with velocity 100 on channel 1, [0xB0, 74, 127] a control change, [0xE0, 0, 64] a pitch bend in the middle. The status byte sets the kind (top half) and the channel (bottom half). Only the first three numbers are read, and the data bytes are held to 0 to 127. System messages are not for this: the clock bytes (0xF8, 0xFA, 0xFB, 0xFC, 0xF2) go to OAVp5.clock, and anything else from 0xF0 up is ignored. source A label for where it came from, which shows up as OAVp5.last.source and as the second argument of midiMessage(). Any text. 'hardware' and 'virtual-out' are taken as those real sources and are not repeated to a sketch's own Web MIDI code. device A profile id such as 'akai-lpd8': the numbering of knob1, pad1 … follows that controller for this message. Left out, it is the controller on the on-screen panel.

records.k: input send midi fake midi simulate controller raw bytes test without controller midi.input 輸入 送 midi 假的 midi 模擬控制器 原始位元組 沒有控制器也能測 midi.input
records.d: 用位元組手動送一則 MIDI 訊息給 oav-p5：整個草圖的反應就像是控制器送出來的。
records.x: 每一種輸入都從這扇門進來，你也可以自己來敲：草圖可以在沒有控制器的時候測試自己、用計時器自己推動自己，或接收來自 WebSocket 或其他函式庫的訊息。草圖分不出差別：knob1、notePressed()、OAVp5.note、開著 startSound() 時的聲音，還有鼓機的 cue 都會有反應。要送音符的話，OAVp5.play() 是比較親切的方式。 midi.input(…) 是同一個函式。它沒有回傳值。來源不是 'screen' 的訊息，會在螢幕控制器打開的時候也讓它的琴鍵亮起來。 bytes 一則訊息，[status, data1, data2]：[0x90, 60, 100] 是通道 1 上鍵 60、力道 100 的 note-on，[0xB0, 74, 127] 是控制變化，[0xE0, 0, 64] 是在中間的音高輪。status 位元組決定種類（上半）和通道（下半）。只讀前三個數字，資料位元組會被限制在 0 到 127。系統訊息不是給它用的：時鐘位元組（0xF8、0xFA、0xFB、0xFC、0xF2）會交給 OAVp5.clock，從 0xF0 起的其他東西都忽略。 source 一個說明來源的標籤，會出現在 OAVp5.last.source，也是 midiMessage() 的第二個參數。任何文字都行。'hardware' 和 'virtual-out' 會被當作真的那兩種來源，不會再轉給草圖自己的 Web MIDI 程式。 device 設定檔 id，像 'akai-lpd8'：這則訊息裡 knob1、pad1 … 的編號照那一台控制器來對應。不寫的話，就是螢幕面板上的那一台控制器。

records.k: is down key down is key held note name midi.isDown 按著嗎 琴鍵按著 音名 midi.isDown
records.d: True while the key n (a MIDI number or a name like 'C4') is held down: the same as noteIsDown(n).
records.x: It is noteIsDown() under the OAVp5 name, for a sketch that cannot use the plain one: OAVp5.isDown('C4'). A name that is not a note stops the sketch with a card that says how to write one. midi.isDown(…) is the same function. n The key: a MIDI number (60) or a note name ('C4', 'c#4', 'Db3'). True if that key is down right now.

records.k: is down key down is key held note name midi.isDown 按著嗎 琴鍵按著 音名 midi.isDown
records.d: 鍵 n（MIDI 號碼，或像 'C4' 這樣的音名）按著的時候是 true：跟 noteIsDown(n) 一樣。
records.x: 它是用 OAVp5 這個名字呼叫的 noteIsDown()，給不能用一般名稱的草圖：OAVp5.isDown('C4')。不是音符的名稱會讓草圖停下來，並用卡片說明怎麼寫。 midi.isDown(…) 是同一個函式。 n 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼（60）或音名（'C4'、'c#4'、'Db3'）。 那個鍵現在按著就是 true。

records.k: last message latest midi source which knob midi.last channel 最後一則訊息 最新的 midi 來源 哪顆旋鈕 midi.last 通道
records.d: The latest note, control change or pitch bend that arrived: its type, number, value, channel, where it came from and which control it is. null before any.
records.x: A single object that is replaced on every message, so read it, do not keep it. It is how a sketch finds out where a message came from (OAVp5.last.source) or which knob moved (OAVp5.last.control), and what to read when the sketch has its own note or velocity that keeps the plain names: OAVp5.last.note and OAVp5.last.value. It keeps only notes, control changes and pitch bends. Aftertouch and program change reach midiMessage() but are not stored here. midi.last is the same object. Clock messages (tick, start, stop) are not here: see OAVp5.clock. { type, note | cc, value, channel, source, control }. type is 'noteOn', 'noteOff', 'controlChange' or 'pitchBend' (a note-on with velocity 0 is a 'noteOff'). note is there for notes, cc for control changes. value is the velocity 0..1 (0 for a note-off), the control's position 0..1, or the wheel −1..1. channel is 1 to 16. source is 'hardware', 'screen', 'phone', 'virtual-out', 'link' or the label you gave OAVp5.input(). control is 'knob1', 'fader2', 'pad3' … when the controller's profile knows it, otherwise null.

records.k: last message latest midi source which knob midi.last channel 最後一則訊息 最新的 midi 來源 哪顆旋鈕 midi.last 通道
records.d: 最近收到的音符、控制變化或音高輪訊息：它的種類、號碼、值、通道、來自哪裡、是哪個控制。在任何訊息之前是 null。
records.x: 它是每收到一則訊息就整個換掉的單一物件，所以只讀，不要留著。草圖用它知道訊息從哪裡來（OAVp5.last.source）或哪顆旋鈕動了（OAVp5.last.control），草圖自己有 note 或 velocity 而保留了一般名稱的時候，也是改讀它：OAVp5.last.note 和 OAVp5.last.value。 它只留音符、控制變化和音高輪。觸後和音色切換只會到 midiMessage()，這裡不存。 midi.last 是同一個物件。時鐘訊息（tick、start、stop）不在這裡，請看 OAVp5.clock。 { type, note | cc, value, channel, source, control }。type 是 'noteOn'、'noteOff'、'controlChange' 或 'pitchBend'（力道 0 的 note-on 算 'noteOff'）。音符有 note，控制變化有 cc。value 是力道 0 到 1（note-off 是 0）、控制的位置 0 到 1，或輪子的 −1 到 1。channel 是 1 到 16。source 是 'hardware'、'screen'、'phone'、'virtual-out'、'link'，或你在 OAVp5.input() 給的標籤。control 在控制器的設定檔認得它的時候是 'knob1'、'fader2'、'pad3' …，否則是 null。

records.k: note array all keys key velocity piano roll held keys midi.note 音符陣列 所有琴鍵 琴鍵力道 鋼琴捲簾 按著的鍵 midi.note
records.d: An array of 128 numbers, one per MIDI key: how hard that key is held, 0 to 1, and 0 when it is up. OAVp5.note[60] is middle C.
records.x: Read every key at once, in draw(): OAVp5.note[60] for one key, or a loop over a range to draw a piano roll. It is the array version of noteIsDown(), with the velocity in it. It is not the variable note, which is just the number of the last key pressed. OAVp5.held is the same information as a short list of the keys that are down. midi.note is the same array. A note-on with velocity 0 sets the key to 0, like a note-off. The index is the MIDI note number, 0 to 127. A key that is down holds the velocity of its note-on divided by 127, a key that is up (or never pressed) holds 0. Changes when a message arrives, not once per frame.

records.k: note array all keys key velocity piano roll held keys midi.note 音符陣列 所有琴鍵 琴鍵力道 鋼琴捲簾 按著的鍵 midi.note
records.d: 128 個數字的陣列，每個 MIDI 鍵一個：那個鍵被按得多用力，0 到 1，放開就是 0。OAVp5.note[60] 是中央 C。
records.x: 在 draw() 裡一次讀每個鍵：OAVp5.note[60] 讀一個鍵，或用迴圈跑過一個範圍來畫鋼琴捲簾。它是 noteIsDown() 的陣列版，而且裡面有力道。它不是變數 note，那個只是最後按下的鍵的號碼。OAVp5.held 是同樣的資訊，做成只列出按著的鍵的短清單。 midi.note 是同一個陣列。力道是 0 的 note-on 會讓那個鍵變成 0，就像 note-off。 索引是 MIDI 音符號碼，0 到 127。按著的鍵放的是它 note-on 的力道除以 127，放開（或從沒按過）的鍵是 0。訊息進來的時候才會變，不是每個畫面一次。

records.k: subscribe listen event listener unsubscribe off callback without global Hydra 訂閱 監聽 事件監聽 取消訂閱 不用全域函式 Hydra
records.d: Listens to a MIDI event by name without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops listening.
records.x: The event functions (notePressed(), knobMoved(), noteOn() …) are defined once, by name. OAVp5.on('notePressed', fn) is the other way: any number of listeners, added and removed while the sketch runs, with no global names taken. It is how a library, a class or a Hydra sketch listens, and the way to listen for a while and stop. A listener counts as a defined function for the pad rule: once anything listens to 'padPressed', a pad stops calling notePressed(). An error inside fn shows in the console and on a card, and the other listeners still run. For the microphone's events use OAVp5.mic.on(). midi.on(…) is the same function. name The event: 'notePressed', 'noteReleased', 'knobMoved', 'faderMoved', 'padPressed', 'padReleased', 'noteOn', 'noteOff', 'controlChange', 'pitchBend' or 'midiMessage'. 'noteon' and 'noteoff' work in any case. Anything else throws an error that lists the names. fn Called with the same arguments the function of that name would get (notePressed(note, velocity), knobMoved(n, value) …). A function that takes fn off again: const off = OAVp5.on(…); off();.

records.k: subscribe listen event listener unsubscribe off callback without global Hydra 訂閱 監聽 事件監聽 取消訂閱 不用全域函式 Hydra
records.d: 用名字監聽一個 MIDI 事件，不必定義全域函式，並回傳一個停止監聽的函式。
records.x: 事件函式（notePressed()、knobMoved()、noteOn() …）是用名字定義一次的。OAVp5.on('notePressed', fn) 是另一種方式：想要幾個監聽者都行，草圖在跑的時候可以加也可以拿掉，也不占用任何全域名稱。函式庫、類別或 Hydra 草圖就是這樣監聽的，要聽一陣子再停下來也用它。 對打擊墊的規則來說，監聽者就跟定義過的函式一樣：只要有東西在聽 'padPressed'，打擊墊就不再呼叫 notePressed()。fn 裡面出錯會顯示在 console 和卡片上，其他的監聽者照樣執行。麥克風的事件要用 OAVp5.mic.on()。 midi.on(…) 是同一個函式。 name 事件名稱：'notePressed'、'noteReleased'、'knobMoved'、'faderMoved'、'padPressed'、'padReleased'、'noteOn'、'noteOff'、'controlChange'、'pitchBend' 或 'midiMessage'。'noteon' 和 'noteoff' 大小寫隨便。其他的名稱會丟出一個錯誤，並列出可用的名稱。 fn 呼叫它的時候帶的參數跟同名函式會拿到的一樣（notePressed(note, velocity)、knobMoved(n, value) …）。 一個把 fn 取消的函式：const off = OAVp5.on(…); off();。

records.k: panel open the panel show piano panel toggle panel on-screen controller 面板 打開面板 顯示鋼琴面板 切換面板 螢幕控制器
records.d: The 🎹 panel as an object: open(), close() and toggle() show and hide it from code.
records.x: The panel behind the 🎹 button holds the on-screen controller and the buttons for 🎤, 🔊, 🥁, ⏺, 📷, 📱 and 🩺. OAVp5.panel.open(), close() and toggle() do what pressing 🎹 does, from your code: open it on a key, or open it at the start for a workshop (?oav_panel=open does the same at load). With ?oav_panel=off there is no 🎹 and these do nothing.

records.k: panel open the panel show piano panel toggle panel on-screen controller 面板 打開面板 顯示鋼琴面板 切換面板 螢幕控制器
records.d: 把 🎹 面板當成物件：用 open()、close()、toggle() 從程式裡顯示和收起它。
records.x: 🎹 按鈕後面的面板裝著螢幕上的控制器，和 🎤、🔊、🥁、⏺、📷、📱、🩺 的按鈕。OAVp5.panel.open()、close()、toggle() 做的是按 🎹 做的事，只是從你的程式裡：按一個鍵就打開它，或是工作坊一開始就打開（?oav_panel=open 在載入時做同樣的事）。 設了 ?oav_panel=off 就沒有 🎹，這幾個也什麼都不做。

records.a: OAVp5.panel.open OAVp5.panel.close OAVp5.panel.toggle midi.panel.open midi.panel.close midi.panel.toggle
records.k: open panel close panel toggle panel show 🎹 hide 🎹 打開面板 收起面板 切換面板 顯示 🎹 隱藏 🎹
records.d: Opens the 🎹 panel (open()), closes it (close()) or flips it (toggle()).
records.x: Same as pressing the 🎹 button. The first time the panel opens, oav-p5 loads the on-screen controller (a few seconds on a slow connection, which the panel says while it loads), and if hardware is click it asks for Web MIDI then. OAVp5.panel.open() when it is already open does nothing new. The three are listed together here: OAVp5.panel.close and OAVp5.panel.toggle take no arguments either. midi.panel.open() is the same function. A promise. open() (and toggle() when it opens) resolves to the panel's element once the on-screen controller inside it has loaded, and the panel is on screen at once, before that. close() (and toggle() when it closes) resolves to null, and so does everything when the panel option is off.

records.a: OAVp5.panel.open OAVp5.panel.close OAVp5.panel.toggle midi.panel.open midi.panel.close midi.panel.toggle
records.k: open panel close panel toggle panel show 🎹 hide 🎹 打開面板 收起面板 切換面板 顯示 🎹 隱藏 🎹
records.d: 打開 🎹 面板（open()）、收起它（close()），或是切換（toggle()）。
records.x: 就跟按 🎹 按鈕一樣。面板第一次打開的時候，oav-p5 才載入螢幕控制器（連線慢的話要幾秒，載入的時候面板會這麼說），而且 hardware 是 click 的話，就在這時去要 Web MIDI。已經打開的時候再呼叫 OAVp5.panel.open() 不會有新的動作。 這三個放在一起說明：OAVp5.panel.close 和 OAVp5.panel.toggle 也都不帶參數。midi.panel.open() 是同一個函式。 一個 promise。open()（以及 toggle() 打開時）在面板裡的螢幕控制器載好之後 resolve 成面板的元素，面板本身一開始就會顯示，不用等。close()（以及 toggle() 關起來時）resolve 成 null，面板選項是 off 的時候全部都是 null。

records.k: phone qr code play from phone remote mobile controller scan 手機 qr code 用手機彈 遙控 行動控制器 掃描
records.d: Shows the 📱 card: a QR code that sends a phone to the remote page, whose MIDI tab then plays this sketch. Returns the room name.
records.x: The same as the 📱 button in the panel. The card shows a QR code, the room and the link underneath; opening the link on a phone gives that phone an on-screen controller whose MIDI tab plays your sketch over the relay, as one more input (OAVp5.last.source is 'phone'). Calling it again hides the card. The first call connects to the relay and loads a small QR-code library from jsDelivr. A network connection, to the relay (wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay unless you set another) and, for the picture of the QR code, to jsDelivr. Without the library the card shows the link as text. The name of the room the phone joins: the room option, or the link room, or a name made up for this browser (p5-…) and kept in it.

records.k: phone qr code play from phone remote mobile controller scan 手機 qr code 用手機彈 遙控 行動控制器 掃描
records.d: 顯示 📱 卡片：一個 QR code，讓手機打開遙控頁面，手機上的 MIDI 分頁就能彈這個草圖。回傳房間名稱。
records.x: 跟面板裡的 📱 按鈕一樣。卡片上有 QR code、房間，和下面的連結。在手機上打開連結，那支手機就有一個螢幕控制器，它的 MIDI 分頁透過中繼來彈你的草圖，當作多一個輸入（OAVp5.last.source 是 'phone'）。再呼叫一次就把卡片收起來。第一次呼叫會連到 relay，並從 jsDelivr 載入一個很小的 QR code 函式庫。 要有網路，連到中繼（沒另外設的話是 wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay），顯示 QR code 的圖還要連到 jsDelivr。沒有那個函式庫的話，卡片就把連結用文字顯示。 手機要加入的房間名稱：room 選項、link 的房間，或是為這個瀏覽器隨機取、並存在裡面的名字（p5-…）。

records.k: play send note trigger simulate virtual key 彈 送出音符 觸發 模擬 虛擬琴鍵
records.d: Plays a key as if a controller did: midi.play(60, 0.8) presses middle C, midi.play(60, 0) lets it go.
records.x: It sends the same MIDI bytes a keyboard would, with midi.last.source set to 'screen', so everything reacts: notePressed(), noteIsDown(), note, the sound if startSound() is on. midi and OAVp5 are the same object, so OAVp5.play and midi.play are one function. The key stays down until you play it again with velocity 0. note The key: a MIDI number or a name ('C#4'). velocity How hard, 0..1; 0 releases the key. Leave it out for full force.

records.k: play send note trigger simulate virtual key 彈 送出音符 觸發 模擬 虛擬琴鍵
records.d: 像控制器那樣彈一個鍵：midi.play(60, 0.8) 按下中央 C，midi.play(60, 0) 放開。
records.x: 它送出的 MIDI 位元組跟鍵盤送出的一樣，midi.last.source 會是 'screen'，所以所有東西都會有反應：notePressed()、noteIsDown()、note，還有開著 startSound() 時的聲音。midi 和 OAVp5 是同一個物件，所以 OAVp5.play 和 midi.play 是同一個函式。 鍵會一直按著，直到你再用力道 0 彈一次。 note 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼或音名（'C#4'）。 velocity 多用力，0..1。0 表示放開。不給就是最大力道。

records.k: wiring opc op configurator which knob drives what map controller to sliders 接線 opc op configurator 哪顆旋鈕推動什麼 控制器對應滑桿
records.d: Lists which controller knob, fader or pad drives which OpenProcessing OPC variable right now: [{ control: 'knob1', name: 'radius' }, …].
records.x: With OP Configurator, OPC.slider('radius', 10) declares a variable and oav-p5 wires the controller to the OPC variables in order: knob 1 to the first slider, knob 2 to the second, the faders after the knobs, pad 1 to the first toggle or button. This is the list of who drives what, the same one the panel prints under the controller and the console says once. Use it when a knob moves the wrong thing. midi.wiring(…) is the same function. dev Whose numbering to use: 'screen' (the controller shown in the panel) or a profile id such as 'akai-lpd8'. It matters for the faders, which are numbered after the knobs. One { control, name } per wired variable: control is 'knob1', 'fader2', 'pad1' …, name is the OPC variable. A control the sketch reads itself also has sketch: true, and its slider no longer follows it. An empty array when there is no OPC on the page or opc is off.

records.k: wiring opc op configurator which knob drives what map controller to sliders 接線 opc op configurator 哪顆旋鈕推動什麼 控制器對應滑桿
records.d: 列出現在哪一顆旋鈕、推桿或墊子在推動哪一個 OpenProcessing OPC 變數：[{ control: 'knob1', name: 'radius' }, …]。
records.x: 搭配 OP Configurator 時，OPC.slider('radius', 10) 宣告一個變數，oav-p5 會依序把控制器接到 OPC 的變數：旋鈕 1 接第一個滑桿，旋鈕 2 接第二個，推桿接在旋鈕後面，打擊墊 1 接第一個開關或按鈕。這份清單就是誰推動什麼，面板在控制器下面印的、console 說一次的也是同一份。旋鈕推動錯東西的時候就看它。 midi.wiring(…) 是同一個函式。 dev 用誰的編號：'screen'（面板上顯示的那台控制器）或設定檔 id，像 'akai-lpd8'。它會影響推桿，因為推桿的編號接在旋鈕後面。 每個接上線的變數一筆 { control, name }：control 是 'knob1'、'fader2'、'pad1' …，name 是 OPC 的變數。草圖自己有讀的控制還會多一個 sketch: true，對應的滑桿就不再跟著它。頁面上沒有 OPC，或 opc 是 off 的時候是空陣列。

records.k: frequency hz pitch tuning A440 oscillator 頻率 赫茲 音高 調音 振盪器
records.d: Returns the frequency in Hz of a note: noteFreq('A4') is 440.
records.x: For a sketch that makes its own sound (p5.sound, Web Audio): osc.freq(noteFreq(note)). If you just want the sound, startSound() plays every key for you. v A note name or a MIDI number. A number may be fractional (69.5 is a quarter tone above A4) and is not held to 0..127. Hz, equal temperament with A4 = 69 = 440 Hz.

records.k: frequency hz pitch tuning A440 oscillator 頻率 赫茲 音高 調音 振盪器
records.d: 回傳音符的頻率（赫茲）：noteFreq('A4') 是 440。
records.x: 給自己發聲的草圖用（p5.sound、Web Audio）：osc.freq(noteFreq(note))。如果只是想要有聲音，startSound() 會幫你把每個鍵都彈出來。 v 音名或 MIDI 號碼。數字可以有小數（69.5 是比 A4 高四分之一音），而且不會被限制在 0..127。 赫茲，十二平均律，A4 = 69 = 440 Hz。

records.k: note name midi number C4 convert sharp flat display 音名 midi 號碼 轉換 升記號 降記號
records.d: Turns a MIDI number into a note name: noteName(61) is 'C#4'.
records.x: notePressed(note, velocity) hands you the number; noteName(note) writes it back as a name for the screen or a lookup table. The same C4-is-60 convention as noteNumber(). v A MIDI number (or a name, which is normalised). o Options: { flats: true } writes 'Db4' instead of 'C#4'; { octave: false } drops the octave number ('C#'). The name, sharps by default: noteName(60) is 'C4'.

records.k: note name midi number C4 convert sharp flat display 音名 midi 號碼 轉換 升記號 降記號
records.d: 把 MIDI 號碼轉成音名：noteName(61) 是 'C#4'。
records.x: notePressed(note, velocity) 給你的是號碼。noteName(note) 把它寫回音名，拿去顯示在畫面上或查表。跟 noteNumber() 一樣，C4 就是 60。 v MIDI 號碼（給音名的話會被整理成標準寫法）。 o 選項：{ flats: true } 寫成 'Db4' 而不是 'C#4'。{ octave: false } 不寫八度數字（'C#'）。 音名，預設用升記號：noteName(60) 是 'C4'。

records.k: note name midi number C4 convert pitch sharp flat 音名 midi 號碼 轉換 音高 升記號 降記號
records.d: Turns a note name like 'C4' into its MIDI number, 0 to 127.
records.x: A name is a letter A to G (either case), an optional # or b (♯ and ♭ too), and the octave: C4, c#4, Db3, C-1 (0) up to G9 (127). C4 is 60. Anything else, such as 'H4' or 'C-2', throws an error, and a card beside the 🎹 says how to write a note. You rarely call it yourself: every place that takes a note number also takes a name, such as noteIsDown() and midi.play(). v A note name ('C4', 'c#4', 'Db3', 'F♯2') or a number. A number comes back rounded and held to 0..127. The MIDI number: noteNumber('C4') is 60, noteNumber('A4') is 69.

records.k: note name midi number C4 convert pitch sharp flat 音名 midi 號碼 轉換 音高 升記號 降記號
records.d: 把像 'C4' 這樣的音名轉成 MIDI 號碼，0 到 127。
records.x: 音名由一個 A 到 G 的字母（大小寫都可以）、可有可無的 # 或 b（♯、♭ 也行），加上八度數字組成：C4、c#4、Db3，從 C-1（0）到 G9（127）。C4 是 60。 其他寫法（像 'H4'、'C-2'）會丟出錯誤，🎹 旁邊也會有一張卡片告訴你音名怎麼寫。 通常不用自己呼叫：凡是收音符號碼的地方也都收音名，像 noteIsDown() 和 midi.play()。 v 音名（'C4'、'c#4'、'Db3'、'F♯2'）或數字。數字會四捨五入並限制在 0..127。 MIDI 號碼：noteNumber('C4') 是 60，noteNumber('A4') 是 69。

records.k: bass mid treble low high frequency band spectrum equalizer fft 低音 中音 高音 頻段 頻率 頻譜 麥克風
records.d: How much of the microphone's sound is low (bass), middle (mid) or high (treble), each from 0 to 1.
records.x: Use them like micLevel, one number per band: fill(200 + bass 160, 70, 100) pushes the colour with the low end. The three share one entry because they behave the same; only the frequency range differs. Unlike micLevel they are not measured in decibels: each is the average strength of the frequencies in its band, scaled by micSensitivity() and held to 1. A band that is faint in your room can stay close to 0; raise the sensitivity rather than multiplying by a large number. Reading any of them asks for the microphone the first time, exactly like micLevel; until you allow it they are 0. A sketch that already has its own variable, function or library called bass, mid or treble keeps it: oav-p5 leaves that name alone and never starts the microphone for it. Assigning one later turns the name back into a plain variable. The energy in 20–250 Hz (bass), 250–2000 Hz (mid) and 2000–8000 Hz (treble). Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 otherwise.

records.k: bass mid treble low high frequency band spectrum equalizer fft 低音 中音 高音 頻段 頻率 頻譜 麥克風
records.d: 麥克風聽到的聲音裡，低音（bass）、中音（mid）、高音（treble）各佔多少，各自從 0 到 1。
records.x: 用法跟 micLevel 一樣，每個頻段一個數字：fill(200 + bass 160, 70, 100) 讓顏色跟著低音走。三個名稱共用這一條，因為它們的行為完全相同，只有頻率範圍不同。 跟 micLevel 不一樣，它們不是用分貝量的：每一個是該頻段所有頻率的平均強度，乘上 micSensitivity() 之後最多算到 1。如果某個頻段在你的房間裡很微弱，數字會一直貼近 0。這時調高靈敏度，比自己乘一個很大的數字好。 第一次讀其中任何一個，就會跟 micLevel 一樣去要麥克風。在你允許之前都是 0。 如果草圖本來就有自己的 bass、mid 或 treble（變數、函式、函式庫都算），oav-p5 就不動那個名稱，也不會為它去開麥克風。之後自己指定值的話，那個名稱就變回一般變數。 bass 是 20–250 Hz 的能量，mid 是 250–2000 Hz，treble 是 2000–8000 Hz。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次，其他時候是 0。

records.k: beat onset tempo rhythm clap trigger transient 拍子 節拍 節奏 鼓點 觸發 麥克風
records.d: True for one frame each time the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a beat.
records.x: It behaves like mouseIsPressed while a button is down, except the "press" lasts one frame: if (beat) flash = 1; is all it takes to react to the music. A beat is a jump in loudness over what the room has been doing, with at least 100 ms between two beats; two beats between two frames count as one. When the drum machine is playing, beat is also true for a frame on every kick and snare, so a sketch written for the microphone moves over to the machine unchanged. Reading beat asks for the microphone the first time, like micLevel. If you would rather be called, define beatDetected(). True in the first draw() after a beat, and false until the next one. Reading it twice in the same frame gives the same answer.

records.k: beat onset tempo rhythm clap trigger transient 拍子 節拍 節奏 鼓點 觸發 麥克風
records.d: 麥克風（或鼓機）每聽到一個拍子，就在那一個畫面是 true。
records.x: 它的用法像按著滑鼠鍵時的 mouseIsPressed，只是「按下」只持續一個畫面：if (beat) flash = 1; 就能對音樂做出反應。一個拍子是音量比房間一直以來的聲音突然跳高，兩個拍子之間至少隔 100 毫秒。兩個畫面之間發生的兩個拍子只算一次。 鼓機在播的時候，每一下大鼓和小鼓也會讓 beat 在那個畫面是 true，所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成鼓機。 第一次讀 beat 就會跟 micLevel 一樣去要麥克風。如果你比較想被呼叫，就定義 beatDetected()。 拍子之後的第一個 draw() 是 true，到下一個拍子之前都是 false。同一個畫面裡讀兩次，答案一樣。

records.k: beat callback event onset rhythm clap 拍子 事件 回呼 節拍 節奏 麥克風
records.d: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a beat.
records.x: Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It is called once per beat, right when the beat lands, not once per frame. Use beat instead if you would rather ask each frame. A sketch that defines beatDetected() and reads no microphone value starts the microphone on the first click or key. When the drum machine is on, the same function is called for its kicks and snares and the microphone is not opened for it. OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn) hears the same beats without defining a global and returns a function that stops listening, but a listener alone never starts the microphone: read micLevel or call startMic() as well. If your function throws, the sketch keeps running: the error appears in the console and as a card beside the 🎹 with the file and line. level How loud it was at that moment, 0..1 (the value of micLevel).

records.k: beat callback event onset rhythm clap 拍子 事件 回呼 節拍 節奏 麥克風
records.d: 你來定義這個函式。麥克風（或鼓機）每聽到一個拍子，oav-p5 就呼叫它一次。
records.x: 用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 每個拍子呼叫一次，在拍子落下的當下，不是每個畫面一次。如果你比較想每個畫面自己問，改用 beat。 草圖只要定義了 beatDetected() 而沒有讀任何麥克風的值，第一次點擊或按鍵時就會啟動麥克風。鼓機開著的時候，鼓機的大鼓和小鼓也會呼叫同一個函式，而且不會為它去開麥克風。OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn) 聽到的是同樣的拍子，不用定義全域函式，也會回傳一個停止監聽的函式，但只有監聽並不會啟動麥克風：還要讀 micLevel 或呼叫 startMic()。 你的函式如果出錯，草圖會繼續跑：錯誤會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案和行號。 level 那一刻有多大聲，0..1（就是 micLevel 的值）。

records.k: kick snare hat drum callback event percussion 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 鼓 事件 回呼 打擊 麥克風
records.d: You define these; oav-p5 calls them when the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a kick, a snare or a hat.
records.x: The microphone splits what it hears into three drum-like bands and calls the matching function when each band jumps: 20–120 Hz for the kick, 150–800 Hz for the snare, 6–14 kHz for the hat. There is no machine learning in it, just a transient in a frequency band, so a bass voice can trigger a kick. When the drum machine plays, each of its hits calls the same functions: kick for the kick, snare for a snare, clap or rim, hat for a closed, open or pedal hat. A sketch written for the microphone therefore works with startDrums() unchanged. While the drum machine plays, only its hits call these functions (from oav-p5 0.8.1). A microphone that is on at the same time mostly hears the drums coming out of the speakers, so its hits would call the same function twice and hear a kick as a snare. micLevel, bass, mid and treble still follow the microphone; the microphone's hits come back when the drums stop. Defining one of them is not enough to open the microphone once the drum machine has started; reading micLevel (or calling startMic()) is. Without the drum machine, a sketch that defines any of them and reads nothing starts the microphone on the first click or key. level How strong the hit was, 0..1 (for the drum machine, its velocity).

records.k: kick snare hat drum callback event percussion 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 鼓 事件 回呼 打擊 麥克風
records.d: 你來定義這幾個函式。麥克風（或鼓機）聽到大鼓、小鼓或鈸的時候，oav-p5 會呼叫 kickDetected(level)、snareDetected(level)、hatDetected(level)。
records.x: 麥克風把聽到的聲音分成三個像鼓的頻段，哪個頻段突然跳高，就呼叫對應的函式：大鼓是 20–120 Hz，小鼓是 150–800 Hz，鈸是 6–14 kHz。裡面沒有機器學習，只是某個頻段出現瞬間的衝擊，所以低沉的人聲也可能觸發大鼓。 鼓機在播的時候，它的每一下也會呼叫同樣的函式：大鼓呼叫 kick，小鼓、拍手或 rim 呼叫 snare，閉合、開放或腳踏的鈸呼叫 hat。所以為麥克風寫的草圖，不用改就能搭配 startDrums()。 鼓機在打的時候，只有鼓機的每一下會呼叫這幾個函式（oav-p5 0.8.1 起）。這時候如果麥克風也開著，它聽到的多半是喇叭放出來的鼓聲，同一下會被叫兩次，大鼓也可能被聽成小鼓。micLevel、bass、mid、treble 照樣跟著麥克風。鼓機停下來，麥克風的打擊就會回來。 鼓機啟動之後，只定義其中一個函式並不會去開麥克風。要讀 micLevel（或呼叫 startMic()）才會。沒有鼓機的時候，草圖只要定義了其中任何一個、又沒有讀任何值，第一次點擊或按鍵時會啟動麥克風。 level 這一下有多強，0..1（鼓機的話就是力道）。

records.k: kick snare hat is detected this frame flash trigger boolean 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 這一格 閃一下 觸發 瞬間
records.d: True in the one frame after a kick (snare, hat) is heard, from the drum machine or the microphone, like mouseIsPressed for a hit.
records.x: The same hits that call kickDetected(), snareDetected() and hatDetected(), as a value you read in draw() instead of a function you write. Hand it to lag() and it becomes a number that jumps to 1 on the hit and fades: lag(kickIsDetected, 0, 0.3) is 1 on a kick and back near 0 about 0.3 s later, ready for an alpha or a size. lag() takes true as 1. While the drum machine plays, only its hits count. Reading these does not ask for the microphone by itself: with no drums, it counts as wanting the microphone's hits, the way defining kickDetected() does, so the first click on the page opens it. True for exactly one p5 frame per hit, however often that frame reads it; false otherwise. Since oav-p5 0.8.2.

records.k: kick snare hat is detected this frame flash trigger boolean 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 這一格 閃一下 觸發 瞬間
records.d: 聽到一下大鼓（小鼓、鈸）之後的那一格是 true，鼓機或麥克風都算。就像打擊版的 mouseIsPressed。
records.x: 跟呼叫 kickDetected()、snareDetected()、hatDetected() 的是同一批打擊，只是改成在 draw() 裡讀的值，不用寫函式。交給 lag() 就變成一個數字：打到時跳到 1，然後慢慢退回去。lag(kickIsDetected, 0, 0.3) 在大鼓那一下是 1，大約 0.3 秒後回到 0 附近，可以直接拿來控制透明度或大小。lag() 把 true 當成 1。 鼓機在打的時候只算鼓機的。讀這幾個名字本身不會去要麥克風。沒有鼓機的時候，它就跟定義 kickDetected() 一樣，算是想要麥克風的打擊，所以第一次點畫面會開麥克風。 每一下只在一個 p5 畫面裡是 true，那一格讀幾次都一樣。其他時候是 false。oav-p5 0.8.2 起。

records.k: last kick frameCount frames since frames ago last snare last hat last beat 上一下 幾格以前 畫面數 frameCount 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍子
records.d: The frameCount of the frame that saw the last kick (snare, hat, beat): frameCount - lastKickFrameCount is how many frames ago.
records.x: The frame-counting twin of lastKickTs. frameCount - lastKickFrameCount is 0 in the frame where kickIsDetected is true, then 1, 2, 3 …, so a shape can last a fixed number of frames after each hit. Use the Ts version when it should last a fixed time whatever the frame rate. A frame number, on the same count as frameCount; -Infinity before the first hit. Since oav-p5 0.8.3.

records.k: last kick frameCount frames since frames ago last snare last hat last beat 上一下 幾格以前 畫面數 frameCount 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍子
records.d: 看到上一下大鼓（小鼓、鈸、拍子）的那一格的 frameCount：frameCount - lastKickFrameCount 就是幾格以前。
records.x: lastKickTs 的「數格子」版本。在 kickIsDetected 是 true 的那一格，frameCount - lastKickFrameCount 是 0，接下來是 1、2、3……，所以可以讓一個形狀在每一下之後固定留幾格。想要不管幀率都留固定秒數，就用 Ts 那一組。 畫面的編號，跟 frameCount 同一套數法。第一下之前是 -Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.3 起。

records.k: last kick timestamp time since millis ago last snare last hat last beat 上一下 時間 多久以前 毫秒 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍子
records.d: When the last kick (snare, hat, beat) came, on the millis() clock: millis() - lastKickTs is how many ms ago.
records.x: Set by every hit that calls kickDetected(), snareDetected(), hatDetected() or beatDetected(): the drum machine's, or the microphone's when no drums play. Use it for anything that depends on how long ago: exp(-(millis() - lastKickTs) / 200) is 1 on the kick and fades with a 0.2 s time constant. Milliseconds on the same clock as millis(); -Infinity before the first hit, so millis() - lastKickTs is then Infinity. Since oav-p5 0.8.2.

records.k: last kick timestamp time since millis ago last snare last hat last beat 上一下 時間 多久以前 毫秒 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍子
records.d: 上一下大鼓（小鼓、鈸、拍子）是什麼時候來的，用 millis() 的時鐘：millis() - lastKickTs 就是幾毫秒前。
records.x: 每一下會呼叫 kickDetected()、snareDetected()、hatDetected() 或 beatDetected() 的打擊都會更新它：鼓機的，或沒有鼓機時麥克風的。要算「多久以前」就用它，例如 exp(-(millis() - lastKickTs) / 200) 在大鼓那一下是 1，然後以 0.2 秒的時間常數淡掉。 毫秒，跟 millis() 同一個時鐘。第一下之前是 -Infinity，所以那時 millis() - lastKickTs 是 Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.2 起。

records.k: microphone mic on status permission allowed 麥克風 開著 狀態 權限 允許
records.d: Whether the microphone is running right now.
records.x: Use it to show a hint until sound arrives: if (!micIsOn) text("Allow the microphone", 20, 30);. Reading it never starts the microphone (unlike micLevel), so it is safe to check anywhere. The reason behind a false is in OAVp5.mic.state (off, asking, on, denied or unavailable) and, when something failed, OAVp5.mic.error. True once the browser has said yes and sound is coming in; false while the microphone is off, still asking, blocked or missing.

records.k: microphone mic on status permission allowed 麥克風 開著 狀態 權限 允許
records.d: 麥克風現在有沒有在運作。
records.x: 可以用它在聲音進來之前顯示提示：if (!micIsOn) text("請允許麥克風", 20, 30);。讀它不會啟動麥克風（跟 micLevel 不一樣），所以在哪裡檢查都安全。false 的原因看 OAVp5.mic.state（off、asking、on、denied 或 unavailable），失敗的時候還有 OAVp5.mic.error。 瀏覽器答應了、聲音進來之後是 true。麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或不存在的時候是 false。

records.k: microphone mic volume loudness audio sound level input level vu meter decibel 麥克風 音量 聲音大小 聲音 收音 音量表 分貝
records.d: How loud the microphone hears things, from 0 (a quiet room) to 1 (shouting).
records.x: Read it in draw() the way you read mouseX: circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel 300) grows when someone talks. It is a loudness in decibels, which is how an ear hears it, measured from the room itself: the bottom of the scale follows the room's own noise (it settles within a second or two and rises at most 1.5 dB a second, so a voice never becomes the new silence), and −10 dBFS, shouting into a laptop, is 1. In practice a quiet room reads 0, a quiet voice about 0.4 to 0.6, shouting close to 1. If the microphone is quiet or far away, raise it with micSensitivity(). It follows the browser's animation frames rather than draw(), so a sketch running at frameRate(10) still reads the latest value, and the number stops changing while the tab is hidden (browsers pause animation frames there). Nothing to call. The first time a sketch reads micLevel (or bass, mid, treble, beat), oav-p5 asks the browser for the microphone, and every value stays 0 until you allow it. The page needs https or localhost. If the browser kept audio quiet until a click, the first click or key starts it. ?oav_mic=click makes only the 🎤 button and startMic() turn it on; ?oav_mic=off means nothing can. In the 🎹 panel the 🎤 button turns the microphone on and off by hand and shows the level. When the browser blocked it, a card beside the 🎹 says why and what to press: click the lock left of the address, set Microphone to Allow, then click the canvas. On openprocessing.org the sketch frame allows the…

records.k: microphone mic volume loudness audio sound level input level vu meter decibel 麥克風 音量 聲音大小 聲音 收音 音量表 分貝
records.d: 麥克風聽到的聲音有多大聲，從 0（安靜的房間）到 1（大喊）。
records.x: 像讀 mouseX 一樣在 draw() 裡直接讀：circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel 300)，有人說話圓就變大。它是以分貝量的音量，跟耳朵聽起來的感覺一致，而且是從房間本身量起：量表的底部跟著房間的底噪走（一兩秒內安頓下來，每秒最多往上爬 1.5 dB，所以人聲不會變成新的安靜），−10 dBFS（對著筆電大喊）就是 1。 實際上，安靜的房間是 0，小聲說話約 0.4 到 0.6，大喊接近 1。麥克風很小聲或離得很遠的話，用 micSensitivity() 把它調大。 它跟著瀏覽器的動畫畫面更新，不是跟著 draw()，所以用 frameRate(10) 跑的草圖讀到的還是最新的值。分頁被藏起來時數字會停住（瀏覽器在那時會暫停動畫畫面）。 不用呼叫任何東西。草圖第一次讀 micLevel（或 bass、mid、treble、beat）的時候，oav-p5 就會向瀏覽器要麥克風，在你按下允許之前所有的值都是 0。網頁要在 https 或 localhost 底下。如果瀏覽器在你點一下之前不讓聲音出來，第一次點擊或按鍵就會把它啟動。?oav_mic=click 表示只有 🎤 按鈕和 startMic() 能開。?oav_mic=off 表示什麼都開不了。 🎹 面板裡的 🎤 按鈕可以手動開關麥克風，並顯示音量。瀏覽器擋下麥克風的時候，🎹 旁邊會跳出一張卡片說明原因和怎麼處理：點網址列左邊的鎖頭，把麥克風設成允許，再點一下畫布。 在 openprocessing.org 上，草圖的框允許麥克風和 MIDI（2026-10-19 實際檢查過：它的 allow 清單有 microphone 和 midi），而且在那裡第一次讀 micLevel 就會去要麥克風。從 OpenProcessing 複製出來的嵌入碼沒有這個設定：要在那個 加上 allow="microphone"。 它背後的原始數字是 OAVp5.mic.rms（0..1）、OAVp5.mic.db 和 OAVp5.mic.floor（房間本身的底噪，單位 dBFS）。 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次。麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或根本沒有的時候，一直是 0。

records.k: sensitivity gain boost quiet microphone volume threshold 靈敏度 增益 放大 麥克風很小聲 音量
records.d: Makes the microphone more or less sensitive: micSensitivity(2) is twice as sensitive, micSensitivity() says what it is now.
records.x: The number multiplies what the microphone hears. On micLevel, 2 adds 6 dB; on bass, mid and treble it multiplies by 2 (they stay held to 1). Use it for a quiet microphone or a far-away voice: micSensitivity(3) in setup() adds about 9.5 dB. OAVp5.mic.gain is the same knob under the name oav-p5 0.3.0 used. v The new sensitivity, greater than 0 (kept between 0.05 and 20). Leave it out, or pass something that is not greater than 0, to change nothing. The sensitivity now in effect (1 until you change it).

records.k: sensitivity gain boost quiet microphone volume threshold 靈敏度 增益 放大 麥克風很小聲 音量
records.d: 調整麥克風的靈敏度：micSensitivity(2) 是兩倍靈敏，micSensitivity() 會告訴你現在是多少。
records.x: 這個數字乘在麥克風聽到的東西上。對 micLevel 來說，2 等於加 6 dB。對 bass、mid、treble 是乘以 2（最多還是 1）。麥克風很小聲或人離得很遠的時候用它：在 setup() 寫 micSensitivity(3) 大約加 9.5 dB。 OAVp5.mic.gain 是同一個旋鈕，用的是 oav-p5 0.3.0 的舊名字。 v 新的靈敏度，要大於 0（會被限制在 0.05 到 20 之間）。不傳，或傳不大於 0 的值，就什麼都不改。 現在生效的靈敏度（沒改過就是 1）。

records.k: microphone start enable permission getUserMedia promise 麥克風 開啟 啟動 權限 允許
records.d: Turns the microphone on and returns a promise that says whether it worked.
records.x: You rarely need it: reading micLevel and its friends already starts the microphone. Call it when you want to choose the moment (a button, the end of an intro) or know the answer: startMic().then((ok) => { … }). Calling it again while it is on, or while the browser is still asking, returns the same result. Browsers want a click before audio plays: call it from mousePressed() or a button handler if setup() is too early. It works whatever the mic option is, except ?oav_mic=off, where nothing can start the microphone. After stopMic(), only startMic() (or 🎤) turns it back on; reading micLevel does not. Resolves to true once the microphone is on, false if it was blocked, is missing, or the mic option is off.

records.k: microphone start enable permission getUserMedia promise 麥克風 開啟 啟動 權限 允許
records.d: 開啟麥克風，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你有沒有成功。
records.x: 通常用不到：只要讀 micLevel 之類的名稱，麥克風就會自己啟動。想自己決定時機（一個按鈕、片頭結束的時候）或想知道結果時才呼叫：startMic().then((ok) => { … })。已經開著、或瀏覽器還在詢問的時候再呼叫，會回傳同一個結果。 瀏覽器要先有一次點擊才讓聲音出來：如果在 setup() 裡太早，就放在 mousePressed() 或按鈕的處理函式裡呼叫。不管載入選項 mic 是什麼都能用，只有 ?oav_mic=off 例外，那時什麼都開不了麥克風。 呼叫過 stopMic() 之後，只有 startMic()（或 🎤）能再把它打開。讀 micLevel 不會。 麥克風開起來之後 resolve 成 true。被擋下、不存在、或載入選項 mic 是 off 的時候 resolve 成 false。

records.k: microphone stop disable mute off 麥克風 關閉 停止 靜音
records.d: Turns the microphone off and sets every microphone value back to 0.
records.x: It stops the microphone's tracks and closes its audio context, so the browser's "recording" indicator goes away. micLevel, bass, mid, treble and the rest read 0 again, and micIsOn is false. After stopMic(), reading micLevel does not turn the microphone back on: that needs startMic() or the 🎤 button. Resolves to false, the new state of the microphone.

records.k: microphone stop disable mute off 麥克風 關閉 停止 靜音
records.d: 關掉麥克風，所有麥克風的值都歸零。
records.x: 它會停掉麥克風的音軌並關掉它的音訊環境，所以瀏覽器上「正在錄音」的指示會消失。micLevel、bass、mid、treble 等等都回到 0，micIsOn 變成 false。 stopMic() 之後，讀 micLevel 不會再把麥克風打開：要用 startMic() 或 🎤 按鈕。 resolve 成 false，也就是麥克風的新狀態。

records.k: mic object microphone state read without starting raw microphone mic members 麥克風物件 麥克風狀態 讀取但不啟動 原始麥克風 麥克風成員
records.d: The microphone under the plain names: its state, the numbers of micLevel and bass that never turn it on when read, the raw loudness, start, stop and events.
records.x: Everything the microphone names (micLevel, bass, micIsOn, startMic() …) read from here. The difference is that reading OAVp5.mic.level never asks for the microphone: the plain micLevel does, the first time. So OAVp5.mic is for code that must look without waking anything: a status line, a library, a sketch with ?oav_mic=click. The members: state, error, sensitivity (also gain), level, bass (also mid, treble), rms, db, floor, analyzer, start(), stop() and on(). This is advanced. For most sketches the plain names are all you need.

records.k: mic object microphone state read without starting raw microphone mic members 麥克風物件 麥克風狀態 讀取但不啟動 原始麥克風 麥克風成員
records.d: 平常那些名稱底下的麥克風：它的狀態、跟 micLevel 和 bass 一樣的數字（讀它們不會把麥克風打開）、原始的音量，還有 start、stop 和事件。
records.x: 所有麥克風的名稱（micLevel、bass、micIsOn、startMic() …）讀的都是這裡。差別是讀 OAVp5.mic.level 永遠不會去要麥克風，而一般的 micLevel 第一次讀就會。所以 OAVp5.mic 是給「只想看、不想吵醒任何東西」的程式用的：狀態列、函式庫、設了 ?oav_mic=click 的草圖。 成員有：state、error、sensitivity（也叫 gain）、level、bass（還有 mid、treble）、rms、db、floor、analyzer、start()、stop() 和 on()。 這是進階用法。大多數草圖只要用一般的名稱就夠了。

records.k: analyzer spectrum fft AnalyserNode audio context frequency data 分析器 頻譜 fft AnalyserNode 音訊環境 頻率資料
records.d: The AudioAnalyzer from @openav/audio that listens to the microphone, while the microphone is on; null otherwise.
records.x: A way into the audio itself when the 0 to 1 numbers are not enough: read the spectrum of the microphone with the browser's own OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(array), or connect your own Web Audio nodes to it. oav-p5 updates the analyzer once per frame, so do not call its update() yourself. This is advanced. Check it is not null first, and read it again after stopMic() and startMic(): it is a new object each time. Made when the microphone starts and dropped when it stops. It has its own AudioContext (OAVp5.mic.analyzer.ctx) and the Web Audio AnalyserNode it reads from (OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser).

records.k: analyzer spectrum fft AnalyserNode audio context frequency data 分析器 頻譜 fft AnalyserNode 音訊環境 頻率資料
records.d: 麥克風開著的時候，負責聽麥克風的那個 @openav/audio 的 AudioAnalyzer，其他時候是 null。
records.x: 0 到 1 的數字不夠用的時候，直接進到聲音本身的路：用瀏覽器自己的 OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(array) 讀麥克風的頻譜，或把你自己的 Web Audio 節點接上去。oav-p5 每個畫面會更新一次這個分析器，所以不要自己去呼叫它的 update()。 這是進階用法。先確認它不是 null，而且 stopMic() 再 startMic() 之後要重新讀：每次都是新的物件。 麥克風啟動時產生，停止時丟掉。它有自己的 AudioContext（OAVp5.mic.analyzer.ctx），也有它讀取的 Web Audio AnalyserNode（OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser）。

records.a: OAVp5.mic.bass OAVp5.mic.mid OAVp5.mic.treble midi.mic.bass midi.mic.mid midi.mic.treble
records.k: mic bass mic mid mic treble frequency bands low mid high read without starting 麥克風低音 麥克風中音 麥克風高音 頻段 低中高 讀取但不啟動
records.d: The same 0 to 1 low, middle and high energy as bass, mid and treble, read without ever turning the microphone on.
records.x: The plain bass, mid and treble ask for the microphone when first read, and a sketch that already has a variable of that name keeps it. OAVp5.mic.bass, .mid and .treble are the numbers themselves: always there, never starting anything. They are also the answer when the plain names are taken: on strudel.cc, where Strudel owns bass, this is what the card tells you to read. The three share this entry because they behave the same: only the frequency range differs. bass is 20–250 Hz, mid 250–2000 Hz and treble 2000–8000 Hz, scaled by the sensitivity and held to 1. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 otherwise.

records.a: OAVp5.mic.bass OAVp5.mic.mid OAVp5.mic.treble midi.mic.bass midi.mic.mid midi.mic.treble
records.k: mic bass mic mid mic treble frequency bands low mid high read without starting 麥克風低音 麥克風中音 麥克風高音 頻段 低中高 讀取但不啟動
records.d: 跟 bass、mid、treble 一樣的 0 到 1 低音、中音、高音能量，讀它們不會把麥克風打開。
records.x: 一般的 bass、mid、treble 第一次被讀的時候會去要麥克風，而且草圖本來就有同名變數的話就由草圖保留。OAVp5.mic.bass、.mid、.treble 就是數字本身：一直都在，也不會啟動任何東西。一般名稱被占用的時候也要讀它們：在 strudel.cc 上 bass 是 Strudel 的，卡片會告訴你改讀這個。 三個名稱共用這一條，因為它們的行為完全相同，只有頻率範圍不同。 bass 是 20–250 Hz，mid 是 250–2000 Hz，treble 是 2000–8000 Hz，乘上靈敏度、最多算到 1。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次，其他時候是 0。

records.k: db decibel dbfs loudness in decibels sound level 分貝 db dbfs 音量分貝 聲音大小
records.d: The loudness of the microphone in decibels relative to full scale (dBFS): 0 is as loud as it gets, −100 is silence or the microphone being off.
records.x: Decibels are what an ear hears: each 6 dB is twice the amplitude, so a number in dB moves the way loudness feels. micLevel maps it onto 0 to 1 between the room's noise floor (+6 dB) and −10 dBFS. Use db directly when you want your own scale, for example map(OAVp5.mic.db, -60, -10, 0, 1). 20 log10(rms), measured from OAVp5.mic.rms. −100 when the level is below about −100 dB and while the microphone is off. Updated once per display frame.

records.k: db decibel dbfs loudness in decibels sound level 分貝 db dbfs 音量分貝 聲音大小
records.d: 麥克風的音量，單位是相對滿刻度的分貝（dBFS）：0 是最大聲，−100 是無聲或麥克風關著。
records.x: 分貝就是耳朵聽到的樣子：每增加 6 dB 就是振幅兩倍，所以用 dB 的數字，變化的方式就跟聽起來的大小聲一致。micLevel 把它對應到 0 到 1，範圍從房間底噪（再加 6 dB）到 −10 dBFS。想用自己的刻度的話，直接用 db，例如 map(OAVp5.mic.db, -60, -10, 0, 1)。 20 log10(rms)，由 OAVp5.mic.rms 算出來。低於約 −100 dB 和麥克風關著的時候是 −100。每個畫面更新一次。

records.k: mic error NotAllowedError why no microphone permission error getUserMedia error 麥克風錯誤 NotAllowedError 為什麼沒有麥克風 權限錯誤 getUserMedia 錯誤
records.d: Why the microphone did not start, as the browser's error name such as 'NotAllowedError'; null while there is no error.
records.x: For a sketch that wants to say more than a card does: if (OAVp5.mic.error === 'NotAllowedError') …. The card beside the 🎹 already tells the user what to press for each of these, in their language; this is the same fact for your code. null at the start and again once the microphone is on. After a failure: the browser's error name ('NotAllowedError' or 'SecurityError' for a refusal, 'NotFoundError' when there is no microphone, 'NotReadableError' when another program holds it) or 'no getUserMedia' on a page that cannot ask.

records.x: A humming classroom should not read as loud, so micLevel is measured from the room itself: this floor follows the quietest recent readings. Stopping the microphone does not reset it: the next start continues from the last floor. Starts at −60 and is always held between −70 and −45. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on.

records.k: audio microphone analysis fft loudness rms bands onset snare hat 音訊 麥克風 分析 頻譜 音量 低中高音 起音 大鼓 小鼓 鈸
records.d: Listens to the microphone, an audio element or any Web Audio node, and turns it into loudness, three bands, onsets and kick, snare and hat hits.
records.x: An AudioAnalyzer wraps one Web Audio AnalyserNode. You give it a sound (enableMic(), enableElement(el), or connect your own node into input()), call update() once per frame, and it returns a plain object of numbers, which it also publishes as audio/ signals if you gave it a signals bus. This is the analysis under the microphone of a p5 sketch: micLevel is its rms turned into decibels, bass, mid and treble are its low, mid and high, and beat and kickDetected() come from its onset and kick. update() returns null until a source is enabled. After that it returns { rms, peak, low, mid, high, centroid, onset, kick, snare, hat }. rms is the smoothed loudness and peak the loudest sample of the moment, both 0..1 of full scale (from float samples where the browser has them, so a quiet room is measured, not rounded to one 8-bit step). A voice is a small rms: scale it, or map it through a window. low, mid and high are the average strength of the spectrum in 20–250 Hz, 250–2000 Hz and 2000–8000 Hz, 0..1, taken from the analyser's byte spectrum, so they are not decibels and a faint band stays near 0. centroid is the spectrum's centre of mass, 0..1 of the way from 0 Hz to half the sample rate (the brightness). onset is true for the one update() in which the loudness jumped over its adaptive floor, with at least 100 ms between two onsets. kick, snare and hat are { hit, level, env }, found by looking for a sudden rise in one band of the spectrum, with no machine learning: kick 20–120 Hz,…

records.k: audio microphone analysis fft loudness rms bands onset snare hat 音訊 麥克風 分析 頻譜 音量 低中高音 起音 大鼓 小鼓 鈸
records.d: 聽麥克風、audio 元素或任何 Web Audio 節點，把它變成音量、三個頻段、起音，以及大鼓、小鼓、鈸的打點。
records.x: AudioAnalyzer 包著一個 Web Audio 的 AnalyserNode。你給它一個聲音來源（enableMic()、enableElement(el)，或把自己的節點接到 input()），每個畫面呼叫一次 update()，它就回傳一個只有數字的物件，如果你給了 signals 匯流排，也會同時發布成 audio/ 訊號。這就是 p5 草圖的麥克風底下的分析：micLevel 是它的 rms 換成分貝，bass、mid、treble 是它的 low、mid、high，beat 和 kickDetected() 來自它的 onset 和 kick。 來源開起來之前，update() 回傳 null。開起來之後，它回傳 { rms, peak, low, mid, high, centroid, onset, kick, snare, hat }。rms 是平滑後的音量，peak 是這一刻最大的取樣，兩個都是滿刻度的 0..1（瀏覽器有浮點取樣的話就用浮點，所以安靜的房間也量得到，不會被四捨五入到 8 位元的一格）。人聲的 rms 很小，要乘上倍數，或用範圍視窗對應。low、mid、high 是頻譜在 20–250 Hz、250–2000 Hz、2000–8000 Hz 的平均強度，0..1，取自分析器的位元組頻譜，所以不是分貝，微弱的頻段會貼近 0。centroid 是頻譜的重心，從 0 Hz 到取樣率的一半，0..1（亮度）。onset 只在音量跳過它自己適應的底線的那一次 update() 是 true，兩個起音之間至少隔 100 毫秒。 kick、snare、hat 是 { hit, level, env }，做法是在頻譜的某一段找突然的上升，沒有用機器學習：大鼓 20–120 Hz、小鼓 150–800 Hz、鈸 6000–14000 Hz。hit 在找到一下的那次 update() 是 true（互相至少隔 90、90、60 毫秒），level 是那一段現在的強度，env 是 0..1：打到的時候跳到 min(1, level × 2)，之後每次 update() 縮小 12%，每秒 60 個畫面的話大約 120 毫秒。因為它是每次 update() 衰減，所以你呼叫 update() 的頻率越低，它掉得越快。 有 signals 匯流排的話，會發布這些：audio/rms、audio/peak、audio/band/low、audio/band/mid、audio/band/high、audio/centroid、audio/kick/env、audio/snare/env、audio/hat/env（連續值，0..1），以及脈衝 audio/onset { rms }、audio/kick { level }、audio/snare { level }、audio/hat { level }。脈衝只在找到東西的時候才觸發。 瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作之後才讓聲音開始。enableMic() 會去要麥克風，而分析器的 AudioContext 在頁面被點一下或按過鍵之前都是暫停的：update() 每個畫面都會呼叫 resume()，所以第一次點擊之後數字會自己開始動。在那之前全部都是 0。麥克風要求網頁在 https 或 localhost 底下。 它自己建一個 AudioContext，所以 p5.sound 或 Tone.js 可以在旁邊照常跑。要分析在別的 context 裡的聲音，就把 audio.ctx…
