records.d: Makes the keys you play heard through an instrument you name, and returns a promise that says whether sound is on.
records.x: Call it once in setup(): startSound('organ'). From then on every note you play is heard: a MIDI keyboard, the 🎹 on screen, a phone, midi.play(60, 0.8). Your own notePressed() still gets the note, and the sound is made before the sketch is told, so a slow callback never delays it. Pads on MIDI channel 10 (the General MIDI drum channel) play the drum kit instead of the instrument, and the sustain pedal holds notes. The instrument ids are piano, epiano, organ, strings, choir, harp, marimba, vibraphone, xylophone, glockenspiel, music-box and the synth presets synth/pad, synth/saw-lead, synth/square-lead, synth/pluck, synth/supersaw, synth/bass, synth/acid, synth/brass, synth/bell, synth/sub and synth/chip. Calling startSound(id) while sound plays switches the instrument. An id that does not exist is listed in the console together with the real ones: an instrument that is already playing stays, and at the first call the warm pad synth/pad plays. Nothing is loaded before the first call (or before 🔊 in the 🎹 panel): @openav/sound comes from next to oav-p5.js and Tone.js 15 from jsDelivr (the tone option points it somewhere else). Only the piano plays recorded samples, about 2 MB the first time; the electric piano sounds meanwhile (or, when you switch from another instrument, that one keeps sounding), and OAVp5.sound.instrument changes to piano when the samples are in. Every other instrument is made by Tone.js and has no files to load. A browser lets a page make sound only after…

records.k: sound audio instrument piano organ synth play tone speaker hear make noise 聲音 發聲 樂器 鋼琴 風琴 合成器 彈奏 喇叭 出聲 音色
records.d: 讓你彈的鍵都聽得到，用你指定的樂器發聲，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你聲音有沒有開起來。
records.x: 在 setup() 裡呼叫一次：startSound('organ')。從這時候起，你彈的每個音都聽得到：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的 🎹、手機、midi.play(60, 0.8) 都算。你自己寫的 notePressed() 一樣會收到音符，而且是先發聲、再通知草圖，所以 callback 寫得慢也不會拖慢聲音。MIDI 第 10 軌（General MIDI 的鼓軌）的打擊墊打的是鼓組，不是樂器，延音踏板則會讓音延續。 樂器代號有 piano、epiano、organ、strings、choir、harp、marimba、vibraphone、xylophone、glockenspiel、music-box，以及合成器音色 synth/pad、synth/saw-lead、synth/square-lead、synth/pluck、synth/supersaw、synth/bass、synth/acid、synth/brass、synth/bell、synth/sub、synth/chip。聲音在播的時候再呼叫 startSound(id)，就是換樂器。給了不存在的代號，主控台會連同真正的代號清單一起列出來：已經在播的樂器不變，第一次呼叫就給錯的話，會是溫暖的 synth/pad。 在第一次呼叫之前（或按 🎹 面板裡的 🔊 之前）什麼都不會載入：@openav/sound 從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入，Tone.js 15 從 jsDelivr 載入（載入選項 tone 可以改成別的地方）。只有 piano 播的是錄好的取樣，第一次大約 2 MB，載好之前由電鋼琴先頂著（如果是從別的樂器切過來，就由原本那個繼續響），取樣到齊的時候 OAVp5.sound.instrument 會變成 piano。其他樂器都是 Tone.js 即時合成的，沒有檔案要載。 瀏覽器要頁面上先有一次點擊或按鍵才讓頁面出聲，MIDI 鍵盤上的鍵不算。在 setup() 裡呼叫 startSound() 沒有問題：OAVp5.sound.state 會是 'waiting'，🎹 旁邊有一張卡片說「聲音準備好了，還沒響」，第一次點擊或按鍵就會把聲音打開。soundIsOn 會告訴你什麼時候開了。 完全不寫程式也行：在網址後面加 ?oav_sound=piano（任何樂器代號都可以，在 OpenProcessing 上是 ?sketch_oav_sound=piano），任何草圖從第一次點擊起就聽得到，?oav_sound=off 則讓它保持安靜，這時 startSound() 什麼都不做，並 resolve 成 false。🎹 面板裡的 🔊 可以開關聲音，並列出所有樂器讓你挑。 聲音和鼓機是分開的：startDrums() 有自己的鼓組，不用 startSound()，第一次點擊之後就聽得到。 id 樂器的代號，例如 'organ' 或 'synth/pluck'（完整清單在說明裡）。不傳就沿用之前選的樂器，第一次呼叫時就是鋼琴。不是非空字串的值，視同沒傳。 聲音開起來之後 resolve 成 true。瀏覽器要先有一次點擊的話，就是在頁面上第一次點擊或按鍵之後。載入選項 sound 是 off、stopSound() 先被呼叫、或 Tone.js 載入失敗的時候，resolve 成 false。

records.k: sound stop off mute silence audio release notes 聲音 停止 關閉 靜音 關掉聲音 放開
records.d: Turns sound off and lets every ringing note go; the instrument stays loaded, so startSound() brings it back at once.
records.x: It releases every note that is ringing, sets soundIsOn to false and OAVp5.sound.state to 'off'. Notes you play afterwards are not heard (the sketch's notePressed() is still called). Tone.js and the instrument stay loaded: startSound() afterwards is on again at once, without a new download and without waiting for another click. It also works while sound is still loading or waiting for the first click: the pending startSound() then resolves to false. It does not touch the drum machine (use stopDrums()) or the microphone (stopMic()). A promise that is already resolved to false, the new state of the sound.

records.k: sound stop off mute silence audio release notes 聲音 停止 關閉 靜音 關掉聲音 放開
records.d: 關掉聲音，讓正在響的音全部放開，樂器還留在記憶體裡，所以再呼叫 startSound() 馬上就回來。
records.x: 它會放開所有正在響的音，把 soundIsOn 設成 false，OAVp5.sound.state 設成 'off'。之後彈的音聽不到（草圖的 notePressed() 照樣會被呼叫）。Tone.js 和樂器都還載著，所以之後再呼叫 startSound() 會馬上開，不用重新下載，也不用再等一次點擊。 聲音還在載入、或還在等第一次點擊的時候呼叫也可以：還沒結束的 startSound() 會 resolve 成 false。 它不會動到鼓機（要用 stopDrums()），也不會動到麥克風（stopMic()）。 一個已經 resolve 成 false 的 promise，false 就是聲音的新狀態。

records.k: OAVp5.sound sound object midi.sound sound state debug instrument status 聲音物件 聲音狀態 除錯 樂器 載入進度
records.d: The object behind the sound names: the state, the instrument, the error, the loading progress and the loaded parts of @openav/sound.
records.x: OAVp5.sound (also reachable as midi.sound) is what startSound(), stopSound() and soundIsOn are built on. Read state to know where sound is, instrument for what you hear, status for the loading progress and error for a failure. start(id) and stop() are the same as the two global functions. shell, engine and module hand you the loaded @openav/sound parts for the rare case that you need them. For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, the console and debugging: OAVp5.sound.state is the first thing to look at when nothing is heard.

records.k: OAVp5.sound sound object midi.sound sound state debug instrument status 聲音物件 聲音狀態 除錯 樂器 載入進度
records.d: 聲音相關名稱背後的物件：狀態、樂器、錯誤、載入進度，以及載入進來的 @openav/sound 各部分。
records.x: OAVp5.sound（也可以用 midi.sound 取得）是 startSound()、stopSound() 和 soundIsOn 的底層。讀 state 知道聲音在哪個階段，instrument 是你聽到的樂器，status 是載入進度，error 是失敗的原因。start(id) 和 stop() 跟那兩個全域函式一模一樣。shell、engine、module 把載入進來的 @openav/sound 各部分交給你，給少數真的需要的情況。 一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、主控台和除錯用的：聽不到聲音的時候，先看 OAVp5.sound.state。

records.k: sound error failed could not load tone.js network debug 聲音錯誤 載入失敗 連不到 網路 除錯
records.d: The message of the last thing that went wrong while loading sound, or null when nothing has.
records.x: It is the error the browser reported when @openav/sound or Tone.js could not be loaded. A card beside the 🎹 already tells the person at the keyboard what to do (try another network, or point the tone option at another copy of Tone.js); read this value to log it or to show your own message. To know whether sound is failing right now, use OAVp5.sound.state, not this. Set when the state becomes 'error'. It stays until the page is reloaded: a later try that works does not clear it.

records.k: sound error failed could not load tone.js network debug 聲音錯誤 載入失敗 連不到 網路 除錯
records.d: 載入聲音的時候，最近一次出錯的訊息，沒出過錯就是 null。
records.x: 這是 @openav/sound 或 Tone.js 載入失敗的時候，瀏覽器回報的錯誤。🎹 旁邊的卡片已經告訴現場的人該怎麼辦（換一個網路，或把 tone 選項指到另一份 Tone.js）。讀這個值是為了記錄下來，或顯示你自己的訊息。要知道聲音現在是不是在出錯，看 OAVp5.sound.state，不要看這個。 狀態變成 'error' 的時候設定。它會一直留到頁面重新載入：之後重試成功也不會清掉。

records.k: instrument current instrument piano epiano preset sound 樂器 目前樂器 音色 鋼琴 電鋼琴
records.d: The id of the instrument you hear right now, or null before sound has loaded.
records.x: After a first startSound('piano') the piano's samples (about 2 MB) download first, and the electric piano plays meanwhile, so the first key is never silent: instrument says 'epiano' until the piano is ready and 'piano' after. When you switch to the piano from another instrument, that one keeps sounding and instrument names it until the samples are in. How far the loading is, and which instrument it is on, is in OAVp5.sound.status. Changes when the instrument changes, which for a sampled instrument is when its samples are in.

records.k: instrument current instrument piano epiano preset sound 樂器 目前樂器 音色 鋼琴 電鋼琴
records.d: 你現在聽到的樂器代號，聲音還沒載入的時候是 null。
records.x: 第一次呼叫 startSound('piano') 的時候，鋼琴的取樣（約 2 MB）要先下載，這段時間由電鋼琴頂著，所以第一個鍵不會沒聲音：鋼琴準備好之前 instrument 是 'epiano'，之後才是 'piano'。如果是從別的樂器切到鋼琴，取樣到齊之前原本那個樂器繼續響，instrument 也還是它的名字。載到哪裡、載的是哪個樂器，看 OAVp5.sound.status。 樂器換了才會變，取樣型的樂器則是等取樣到齊的時候才換。

records.k: sound state waiting loading error off on status 聲音狀態 等待 載入中 錯誤 開關
records.d: Where sound is: 'off', 'waiting' (for a click), 'loading', 'on' or 'error'.
records.x: 'off' is where it starts and where stopSound() leaves it. startSound() moves it to 'loading' while @openav/sound and Tone.js arrive, to 'waiting' when everything is ready but the browser has not yet had its click, and to 'on' when notes are heard. 'error' means the sound parts could not be loaded (a network, a school firewall or an ad blocker); the message is in OAVp5.sound.error, and calling startSound() again tries once more. soundIsOn is the same thing reduced to state === 'on'. Starts as 'off' and changes whenever the sound moves to another stage.

records.k: sound state waiting loading error off on status 聲音狀態 等待 載入中 錯誤 開關
records.d: 聲音現在在哪個階段：'off'、'waiting'（等點擊）、'loading'、'on' 或 'error'。
records.x: 'off' 是起點，也是 stopSound() 之後的狀態。呼叫 startSound() 之後，@openav/sound 和 Tone.js 還在下載的時候是 'loading'，東西都到齊但瀏覽器還沒等到那次點擊的時候是 'waiting'，聽得到音符的時候是 'on'。'error' 表示聲音的部分載入失敗（網路、學校的防火牆或廣告攔截器）。訊息在 OAVp5.sound.error，再呼叫一次 startSound() 會重試。 soundIsOn 就是把它縮成 state === 'on' 的版本。 一開始是 'off'，聲音換到另一個階段的時候就跟著變。

records.k: loading progress progress samples piano loading status ready 載入進度 進度條 取樣 鋼琴載入 準備好
records.d: How the instrument is loading: { id, state, progress, error }, with progress from 0 to 1.
records.x: It is about the instrument, not about the whole sound: OAVp5.sound.state is the whole sound. Only the piano has files to load, so for every other instrument progress is 1 almost at once. While a sampler loads, OAVp5.sound.instrument is still the one you hear and status.id is the one on its way (at the very first call it may name the electric piano that stands in, and then the piano). A new object on every read. id is the instrument the loader is working on, state is 'idle' before anything loads, 'loading', 'ready' or 'error', and progress is the fraction of the files loaded.

records.k: loading progress progress samples piano loading status ready 載入進度 進度條 取樣 鋼琴載入 準備好
records.d: 樂器載入得怎麼樣了：{ id, state, progress, error }，其中 progress 從 0 到 1。
records.x: 它講的是樂器，不是整個聲音：整個聲音的狀態是 OAVp5.sound.state。只有 piano 有檔案要載，所以其他樂器的 progress 幾乎馬上就是 1。取樣型樂器載入的時候，OAVp5.sound.instrument 仍是你現在聽到的那個，status.id 才是正在路上的那個（第一次呼叫的時候，一開始可能先是頂替用的電鋼琴，之後才是鋼琴）。 每次讀都是一個新的物件。id 是載入器現在處理的樂器，state 在還沒載任何東西時是 'idle'，之後是 'loading'、'ready' 或 'error'，progress 是檔案載入的比例。

records.k: built-in instruments piano organ strings marimba vibraphone choir harp what sounds are there 內建 樂器 鋼琴 風琴 弦樂 馬林巴 顫音琴 合唱 豎琴 有哪些聲音
records.d: The 22 instruments that come with the package, as definitions: a grand piano, mallets, strings, harp, organ, choir and 11 synth presets.
records.x: Loading the package registers all of them, except those whose id you registered first. Each one is a small file in the package's instruments/ folder. The piano loads its samples only when it is picked, and falls back to the electric piano if they cannot be fetched. The organ, the strings, the choir, the electric piano and the vibraphone bring params of their own. An array of 22 instrument definitions, in the order of the table.

records.k: built-in instruments piano organ strings marimba vibraphone choir harp what sounds are there 內建 樂器 鋼琴 風琴 弦樂 馬林巴 顫音琴 合唱 豎琴 有哪些聲音
records.d: 套件內建的 22 個樂器的定義：平台鋼琴、敲擊琴、弦樂、豎琴、風琴、合唱和 11 個合成器預設。
records.x: 載入套件就會登記全部，除非你先登記了同樣 id 的樂器。每一個都是套件的 instruments/ 資料夾裡的一個小檔案。鋼琴只有在被選到的時候才載入取樣，取樣抓不到就退回電鋼琴。風琴、弦樂、合唱、電鋼琴和顫音琴有自己的參數。 一個有 22 個樂器定義的陣列，順序跟下面的表一樣。

records.k: categories groups keys mallets strings synth picker order 類別 分組 鍵盤 敲擊琴 弦樂 合成器 選單順序
records.d: The instrument categories in picker order: keys, mallets, strings, plucked, organ, voice, synth, drums and other.
records.x: The category of an instrument definition picks its group in the picker. A category that is not in this list is allowed: it sorts after these, and its label is its id. Every category also has a Chinese name, which the picker uses on a Chinese page. Nine items { id, name: { en, zh } }, such as { id: 'mallets', name: { en: 'Mallets', zh: … } }.

records.k: categories groups keys mallets strings synth picker order 類別 分組 鍵盤 敲擊琴 弦樂 合成器 選單順序
records.d: 樂器的類別，照選單的順序：keys、mallets、strings、plucked、organ、voice、synth、drums、other。
records.x: 樂器定義的 category 決定它在選單裡的組別。不在這份清單裡的類別也可以，它排在這些後面，標籤就是它的 id。中文名稱是 鍵盤、敲擊琴、弦樂、撥弦、風琴、人聲、合成器、鼓、其他。 九個項目 { id, name: { en, zh } }，例如 { id: 'mallets', name: { en: 'Mallets', zh: '敲擊琴' } }。

records.k: default instrument pad warm pad synth/pad start sound 預設樂器 襯底 溫暖襯底 synth/pad 起始聲音
records.d: The instrument used when none is named: 'synth/pad', the warm three-saw pad that was the framework's first voice.
records.x: toneEngine() starts on it, and falls back to it when you name an instrument that is not registered. Its sound has not changed since the first version. 'synth/pad'.

records.k: default instrument pad warm pad synth/pad start sound 預設樂器 襯底 溫暖襯底 synth/pad 起始聲音
records.d: 沒指定樂器時用的那個：'synth/pad'，由三個鋸齒波組成的溫暖襯底，是這個框架最早的聲音。
records.x: toneEngine() 一開始用它，你指定了沒登記的樂器時也退回它。它的聲音從第一版以來沒有變過。 字串 'synth/pad'。

records.k: get instrument lookup find definition by id credit 取得樂器 查詢 尋找 定義 用 id 出處說明
records.d: Finds a registered instrument definition by its id, or null.
records.x: Use it to check that an id exists before you pass it to toneEngine() or setInstrument(), or to read an instrument's credit, defaults or params. id The id, for example 'piano' or 'synth/pluck'. The definition you registered ({ id, name, category, create, … }), or null.

records.k: get instrument lookup find definition by id credit 取得樂器 查詢 尋找 定義 用 id 出處說明
records.d: 用 id 找出一個登記過的樂器定義，找不到就是 null。
records.x: 在把 id 交給 toneEngine() 或 setInstrument() 之前，用它確認 id 存在，或讀一個樂器的 credit、defaults、params。 id id，例如 'piano' 或 'synth/pluck'。 你登記的那個定義（{ id, name, category, create, … }），或 null。

records.k: groups categories optgroup menu data picker data organize 分組 類別 選單資料 整理
records.d: Groups the instruments by category in picker order: [{ id, label, items }], with empty groups left out.
records.x: It is the data behind the picker, so you can build your own menu, a list or a grid of buttons. A category that is not in CATEGORIES is allowed; it sorts after the known ones and its label is its id. lang The language of the group labels. list The instruments to group. Left out, all the registered ones. [{ id, label, items: [definition…] }]: the groups in the order of CATEGORIES, then any categories of your own, sorted by name.

records.k: groups categories optgroup menu data picker data organize 分組 類別 選單資料 整理
records.d: 把樂器依類別分組，照選單的順序：[{ id, label, items }]，沒有樂器的組會省略。
records.x: 這就是選單背後的資料，所以你可以自己做選單、清單或一排按鈕。不在 CATEGORIES 裡的類別也可以，它排在已知的類別後面，label 就是它的 id。 lang 組別標籤的語言。 list 要分組的樂器。沒給的話，就是所有登記過的。 [{ id, label, items: [定義…] }]：各組依 CATEGORIES 的順序，接著是你自己的類別，依名稱排序。

records.k: name display name translate language localized label 名稱 顯示名稱 翻譯 語言 在地化 標籤
records.d: Gives an instrument's display name in a language, falling back to English.
records.x: Instruments carry name as a string or as { en, zh }. This hides which, so your own menu can just call instrumentName(def, lang). def An instrument definition. null or undefined gives ''. lang 'en', 'zh'… A longer tag such as 'zh-TW' is tried by its first two letters. The name in that language, else the English one. A definition whose name is a plain string gives that string.

records.k: name display name translate language localized label 名稱 顯示名稱 翻譯 語言 在地化 標籤
records.d: 給一個樂器在某種語言下的顯示名稱，沒有就退回英文。
records.x: 樂器的 name 可以是字串，也可以是 { en, zh }。這個函式把差別藏起來，所以你自己的選單只要呼叫 instrumentName(def, lang)。 def 樂器的定義。null 或 undefined 會得到 ''。 lang 'en'、'zh'…。比較長的標記，像 'zh-TW'，會用它前兩個字母去找。 該語言的名稱，沒有就是英文的。name 只是一個字串的定義就回傳那個字串。

records.k: list all instruments category filter registry available sounds 列出 所有樂器 類別 篩選 登記表 有哪些聲音
records.d: Lists every registered instrument, in the order they were registered, or only the ones of one category.
records.x: The 22 built-in instruments are registered when @openav/sound loads, so a fresh page lists those. For a list shaped for a menu, with the groups in order, use instrumentGroups(). category In the options { category }: only the instruments of this category ('mallets'). A new array of instrument definitions.

records.k: list all instruments category filter registry available sounds 列出 所有樂器 類別 篩選 登記表 有哪些聲音
records.d: 列出所有登記過的樂器，照登記的順序，或只列某一個類別的。

records.k: modal synthesis mallet xylophone marimba vibraphone glockenspiel bar partials music box percussion 模態合成 敲擊 木琴 馬林巴 顫音琴 鐵琴 音條 泛音 音樂盒 打擊樂器
records.d: Makes a struck-bar or tine instrument from data: a list of partials that ring and die away, and a short noise for the mallet.
records.x: A xylophone bar, a glockenspiel bar and a music-box tine are the same physics with different numbers: a strike excites a few modes, each rings at its own multiple of the pitch and dies at its own rate. So a mallet instrument here is data, not code. The built-in xylophone is this short: Harder strikes brighten: the upper partials grow faster with velocity, as a real mallet does. The voices are raw Web Audio nodes built for each strike and left to the garbage collector. id The instrument id (see registerInstrument()). name The name: a string, or { en, zh }. category The picker group. credit A credit line, a string or { text, url }. params Params of its own: [{ key, label, min, max, def }]. Handled by the set function. defaults Starting values for the shared params. The default opens the filter, because bars are bright. partials The modes of the bar: [{ ratio, gain, decay }]. ratio is the frequency as a multiple of the note (1 is the note itself, 3 a twelfth above it), gain the level relative to the others and decay the seconds to near silence at middle C. High notes die faster than low ones. A partial above 45% of the sample rate is skipped. Required: without it this throws. strike The mallet, a few milliseconds of band-passed noise: { ratio, q, gain, decay }, where ratio sets its pitch as a multiple of the note, q its width, gain its level and decay its length in seconds. damp Seconds in which letting go of a key mutes the bar. 0 lets the bars ring free (xylophone,…

records.k: modal synthesis mallet xylophone marimba vibraphone glockenspiel bar partials music box percussion 模態合成 敲擊 木琴 馬林巴 顫音琴 鐵琴 音條 泛音 音樂盒 打擊樂器
records.d: 用資料做出敲擊的音條或音叉類樂器：一串會響然後衰減的泛音，加上一小段代表槌子的雜訊。
records.x: 木琴的音條、鐵琴的音條和音樂盒的音叉是同樣的物理，只是數字不同：敲一下激發出幾個振動模式，每個模式以自己的音高倍數響，用自己的速度消失。所以這裡的敲擊類樂器是資料，不是程式。內建的木琴就這麼短： 打得越用力越亮：高的泛音會隨力度長得比較快，真的槌子就是這樣。每個聲部都是每敲一下就建一組的原生 Web Audio 節點，用完交給垃圾回收。 id 樂器的 id（見 registerInstrument()）。 name 名稱：字串，或 { en, zh }。 category 選單的組別。 credit 出處說明，字串或 { text, url }。 params 它自己的參數：[{ key, label, min, max, def }]。由 set 函式處理。 defaults 共用參數的起始值。預設把濾波器打開，因為敲擊的音條聲音是亮的。 partials 音條的各個振動模式：[{ ratio, gain, decay }]。ratio 是頻率相對於音符的倍數（1 是音符本身，3 是高一個十二度），gain 是相對於其他泛音的音量，decay 是在中央 C 衰減到幾乎無聲要幾秒。高音比低音消失得快。高於取樣率 45% 的泛音會被略過。必須給：沒給的話會丟出錯誤。 strike 槌子，幾毫秒的帶通雜訊：{ ratio, q, gain, decay }，ratio 是它的音高相對於音符的倍數，q 是寬度，gain 是音量，decay 是長度，單位是秒。 damp 放開鍵之後幾秒內把音條止音。0 是讓音條自由響完（木琴、鐵琴）。顫音琴有止音器。 pitchDecay 高音比低音消失得快多少。衰減時間會乘上 (261.63 / 頻率) ^ pitchDecay，限制在 0.2 到 3 之間。0 讓每個音一樣長。 transpose 把演奏的音移幾個半音（木琴高一個八度：12）。 gain 樂器的音量，單位是 dB。 attack 泛音達到全音量要幾秒。 tremolo 所有聲部一起的音量起伏，也就是顫音琴的馬達：{ frequency, depth, spread }。 maxVoices 最多能同時響幾個音。超過的時候，最舊的會在 30 毫秒內淡出。 set set({ key, value, tremolo, Tone })，樂器自己的參數改變時呼叫，好讓它改顫音或別的東西。 一個還沒登記的樂器定義：交給 registerInstrument()。tail 設成 min(8, 最長的衰減 × 1.5 + 0.2) 秒。

records.k: picker instrument menu select choose instrument dropdown ui credit loading progress 選單 樂器選單 選擇樂器 下拉 介面 出處說明 載入進度
records.d: Puts an instrument menu on the page: one group per category, a loading bar for samplers and the credit line an instrument asks for.
records.x: A native with one per category (CATEGORIES), so it works with a keyboard and on a phone and needs no styling to be usable. It lists whatever is registered, and it refreshes itself when an instrument is registered or removed (onInstrumentsChange()). Choosing one calls sound.setInstrument(id, { remember: true }). While a sampler loads it shows a bar and a percentage; if the load fails it says so, and says which instrument plays instead. A credit line appears under the menu for an instrument that has one: the Salamander piano is CC-BY, and its credit is always shown. container The element to put the picker in. sound The Sound to control. The menu follows its instrument and its loading. lang The language of the labels and instrument names. The default is 'zh' when the page's starts with zh, else 'en'. className The class of the picker. The parts get -row, -label, -status, -meter and -credit added to it, for your own styling. The picker brings no CSS. label The label in front of the menu. Left out, it is the word "instrument" (in Chinese when lang is 'zh'). enableOnPick Choosing an instrument also calls sound.enable() if the sound is off. A choice is a click, which is the gesture a browser wants before it plays audio. { el, select, refresh(), dispose() }: the element it made, its , a function that rebuilds the list, and a function that takes it away.

records.k: picker instrument menu select choose instrument dropdown ui credit loading progress 選單 樂器選單 選擇樂器 下拉 介面 出處說明 載入進度
records.d: 在頁面上放一個樂器選單：每個類別一組，取樣樂器有載入進度條，也會顯示樂器要求的出處說明。
records.x: 這是原生的 ，每個類別（CATEGORIES）一個 ，所以用鍵盤、在手機上都能用，不用做任何樣式就能用。它列出所有已登記的樂器，而且在有樂器被登記或移除時自動更新（onInstrumentsChange()）。選了一個就呼叫 sound.setInstrument(id, { remember: true })。取樣樂器載入的時候顯示進度條和百分比。載入失敗會說出來，並說明改播哪個樂器。有出處說明的樂器，選單底下會出現一行：Salamander 鋼琴是 CC-BY，它的出處說明一定會顯示。 container 要放選單的元素。 sound 要控制的 Sound。選單會跟著它的樂器和載入狀態走。 lang 標籤和樂器名稱的語言。預設是頁面的 以 zh 開頭就用 'zh'，否則用 'en'。 className 選單的 class。各個部分會在它後面加上 -row、-label、-status、-meter、-credit，讓你自己寫樣式。選單本身不帶 CSS。 label 選單前面的標籤。沒給的話，依語言是 "instrument" 或「樂器」。 enableOnPick 選了樂器之後，如果聲音還沒開，就順便呼叫 sound.enable()。選擇本身就是一次點擊，正是瀏覽器要的那個動作。 { el, select, refresh(), dispose() }：它做出來的元素、裡面的 、重建清單的函式，和把它拆掉的函式。

records.x: mountSoundPicker() listens this way, which is why an instrument registered after the picker was built still shows up. A replacement with { replace: true } also reports register. A call to unregisterInstrument() for an id that is not there reports nothing. cb cb({ type, id }) with type 'register' or 'unregister'. An error inside it is logged and does not stop the others. Call it to stop listening.

records.d: 每當有樂器被登記或移除，就呼叫你的函式，讓選單可以更新。回傳一個停止監聽的函式。
records.x: mountSoundPicker() 就是這樣在聽，所以選單蓋好之後才登記的樂器也會出現。用 { replace: true } 取代也會通報 register。對不存在的 id 呼叫 unregisterInstrument() 不會通報。 cb cb({ type, id })，type 是 'register' 或 'unregister'。裡面出錯只會被記在 console，不會影響其他監聽者。 呼叫它就停止監聽。

records.k: register instrument add a sound custom instrument plugin create definition kalimba extend 登記 樂器 加一個聲音 自訂樂器 外掛 建立 定義 拇指琴 擴充
records.d: Adds a sound to every picker on the page: an id, a name, a category and one create() function that builds the instrument.
records.x: A sound you can pick is plain data plus one factory. Registering it is all it takes: import the file before you start, and every mountSoundPicker() on the page lists it under its category, with no change to the package. The registry lives on globalThis, so two copies of this module on one page share one list. Built-in instruments only fill empty slots: register your own 'piano' first and you keep it. The definition: create(Tone, ctx) runs on enable and on every switch to the instrument, with Tone.js already loaded. ctx is { output, rawOutput, rawContext, baseUrl, options, onProgress }: connect Tone nodes to output (raw Web Audio nodes to rawOutput), baseUrl is where sample folders live, options is what was passed in toneEngine({ instruments: { : … } }), and onProgress(0..1) shows a loading bar. If ready is a promise, the picker shows progress and the old sound keeps playing until it resolves. An instrument that makes mallet sounds from data can use modalInstrument(), and one that is a Tone synth with settings, registerSynthPreset(). def The instrument definition, see the table below. replace In the options { replace }: allow replacing an instrument that has the same id. Without it a duplicate id throws. The definition you gave. It throws a TypeError listing everything wrong if the definition is not valid (see validateInstrument()), and an Error for a duplicate id.

records.k: register instrument add a sound custom instrument plugin create definition kalimba extend 登記 樂器 加一個聲音 自訂樂器 外掛 建立 定義 拇指琴 擴充
records.d: 把一個聲音加到頁面上每個選單：一個 id、一個名字、一個類別，和一個建立樂器的 create() 函式。
records.x: 能選的聲音就是一份資料加一個工廠函式。登記它就夠了：在開始之前匯入那個檔案，頁面上每個 mountSoundPicker() 就會把它列在它的類別底下，不用改套件。登記表放在 globalThis 上，所以同一個頁面上有兩份這個模組也共用同一份清單。內建的樂器只會填空位：先登記你自己的 'piano'，就會保留你的。定義如下： create(Tone, ctx) 在啟用的時候、以及每次切換到這個樂器的時候執行，那時 Tone.js 已經載入。ctx 是 { output, rawOutput, rawContext, baseUrl, options, onProgress }：把 Tone 的節點接到 output（原生 Web Audio 節點接到 rawOutput），baseUrl 是取樣資料夾的位置，options 是 toneEngine({ instruments: { : … } }) 傳進來的東西，onProgress(0..1) 用來顯示載入進度。如果 ready 是 promise，選單會顯示進度，而且在它 resolve 之前舊的聲音繼續播。從資料做敲擊聲的樂器可以用 modalInstrument()，是有設定的 Tone 合成器就用 registerSynthPreset()。 def 樂器的定義，見下面的表。 replace 在選項 { replace } 裡：允許取代同樣 id 的樂器。沒有它的話，重複的 id 會丟出錯誤。 你給的那個定義。定義不合格的話會丟出 TypeError，列出所有的問題（見 validateInstrument())，id 重複則丟出 Error。

records.k: synth preset add a synth fm envelope effects chorus delay custom synth tone.js 合成器預設 加合成器 fm 包絡 效果 合唱效果 延遲 自訂合成器 tone.js
records.d: Adds a synth preset to every picker as synth/ plus its id: describe the voice, the envelope and the effects as data.
records.x: A preset names a voice, its settings in Tone.js's vocabulary, and an optional effects chain, and nothing else. id is lowercase letters, digits and - (it becomes synth/), name is a string or { en, zh }. voice is 'synth' (oscillator and envelope), 'mono' (adds a resonant filter with its own envelope), 'fm' or 'am'. The Tone settings are oscillator, envelope, filter, filterEnvelope, harmonicity, modulationIndex, modulation, modulationEnvelope, detune and portamento. The rest: octave (a whole number of octaves, -1 for a bass), gain (dB, to level it against the others), polyphony, defaults (starting cutoff, space, volume), params, category and credit, as in registerInstrument(). effects is a list of { type, …settings } that the sound passes through in order. The types are chorus, delay, pingpong, distortion, vibrato, tremolo, phaser, autofilter, filter, eq, compressor, chebyshev and widener; the other keys are the effect's own Tone settings, including wet. A preset that is wrong throws a TypeError with the reasons. preset The preset: { id, name, voice, … }, see below. opts The options of registerInstrument(): { replace: true } swaps an existing one. The instrument definition that was registered (synthInstrument() of the preset).

records.d: 把一個合成器預設加到每個選單，名稱是 synth/ 加上它的 id：把聲部、包絡和效果寫成資料就好。
records.x: 一個預設只有這些：一個 voice、用 Tone.js 的詞彙寫的設定，和選用的效果鏈。id 是小寫字母、數字和 -（會變成 synth/），name 是字串或 { en, zh }。voice 是 'synth'（振盪器加包絡）、'mono'（多一個有自己包絡的共振濾波器）、'fm' 或 'am'。Tone 的設定有 oscillator、envelope、filter、filterEnvelope、harmonicity、modulationIndex、modulation、modulationEnvelope、detune、portamento。其他的：octave（整數個八度，貝斯用 -1）、gain（dB，用來跟別的樂器配音量）、polyphony、defaults（起始的 cutoff、space、volume）、params、category、credit，跟 registerInstrument() 一樣。 effects 是一串 { type, …設定 }，聲音依序通過它們。種類有 chorus、delay、pingpong、distortion、vibrato、tremolo、phaser、autofilter、filter、eq、compressor、chebyshev、widener。其他的鍵是那個效果自己的 Tone 設定，包括 wet。不合格的預設會丟出 TypeError 並說明原因。 preset 預設：{ id, name, voice, … }，見下面。 opts registerInstrument() 的選項：{ replace: true } 會換掉現有的。 被登記的那個樂器定義（這個預設的 synthInstrument()）。

records.k: salamander sampled notes a0 c8 minor third piano range salamander 取樣的音 a0 c8 小三度 鋼琴音域
records.d: The 30 notes the Salamander piano has samples for: every minor third from A0 (MIDI 21) to C8 (108).
records.x: The sampler shifts the pitch of the notes in between by at most a semitone and a half, which is inaudible on a piano. There is only one velocity layer, so loud against soft is a gain curve, not a different hammer. [21, 24, 27, …, 108]: 30 MIDI note numbers, three semitones apart (the A, C, D♯ and F♯ of every octave).

records.k: sound audio output play notes instrument synth engine midi to sound tone.js enable sound 聲音 音訊輸出 彈出聲音 樂器 合成器 引擎 midi 變成聲音 tone.js 啟用聲音
records.d: Makes every midi/note/on and midi/note/off on a bus audible through a sound engine, and puts the engine's params on the bus as sound/.
records.x: Sound is the shell that wires an engine into an app. Once await sound.enable() has run, every midi/note/on and midi/note/off on the bus is played, whatever sent it: a MIDI keyboard, the on-screen piano (mountKeys()), a SimPlayer, a TakePlayer or a phone. Notes on a channel in the engine's skipChannels are left out (the Tone engine skips channel 10, which belongs to the drum machine). The engine's params become sound/ params, so a knob, the timeline or a hand can play the filter the same way it plays the visuals: sound is performable state, not a side effect. Every frame, call sound.update(state) with the resolved param values, and the sound/ ones are pushed into the engine. The instrument is a discrete choice (setInstrument() or the picker); what you perform continuously stays a param. sound.enable() from a click: browsers start audio only after a user gesture. With toneEngine() it also loads Tone.js from the network (jsDelivr) the first time. Before enable() nothing is heard, and the bus is not listened to. From a p5 sketch you do not build this: startSound() does it, loading this package only when it is called. signals The Signals bus. Sound listens to midi/note/on { note, vel, ch }, midi/note/off { note, ch } and midi/cc/64 (the sustain pedal, down at 0.5 or more), and pulses sound/instrument { id, name } when the instrument changes. params A Params registry to add the engine's params to, named sound/ (sound/cutoff, sound/space, sound/volume and the instrument's own).…

records.k: sound audio output play notes instrument synth engine midi to sound tone.js enable sound 聲音 音訊輸出 彈出聲音 樂器 合成器 引擎 midi 變成聲音 tone.js 啟用聲音
records.d: 讓匯流排上每個 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off 都透過發聲引擎聽得見，並把引擎的參數放到匯流排上，名稱是 sound/。
records.x: Sound 是把引擎接進應用程式的外殼。await sound.enable() 之後，匯流排上每個 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off 都會被播出來，不管是誰送的：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕鋼琴（mountKeys()）、SimPlayer、TakePlayer 或手機。在引擎的 skipChannels 裡的頻道的音符不會播（Tone 引擎略過頻道 10，那是鼓機的）。 引擎的參數會變成 sound/ 參數，所以旋鈕、時間軸或一隻手可以像操作畫面那樣操作濾波器：聲音是可以演奏的狀態，不是附帶的效果。每個畫面用解析好的參數值呼叫 sound.update(state)，其中 sound/ 的就會被送進引擎。樂器是離散的選擇（setInstrument() 或選單），要連續演奏的東西則維持是參數。 要在點擊裡呼叫 sound.enable()：瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作才讓聲音開始。用 toneEngine() 的話，第一次還會從網路（jsDelivr）載入 Tone.js。enable() 之前什麼都聽不到，匯流排也沒有被聽。 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己建這個：startSound() 會做，而且只在被呼叫的時候才載入這個套件。 signals Signals 匯流排。Sound 聽 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch }、midi/note/off { note, ch } 和 midi/cc/64（延音踏板，0.5 以上算踩下），並在樂器改變時發出 sound/instrument { id, name } 脈衝。 params 要把引擎的參數加進去的 Params，名稱是 sound/（sound/cutoff、sound/space、sound/volume，和樂器自己的）。沒給的話，不註冊任何參數。 engine 發聲引擎，例如 toneEngine() 或 drumEngine()。約定是 { params, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01), noteOff(note), set(key, value), dispose() }，選用的有 setInstrument、instrument、status、subscribe、sustain(down)、skipChannels。 instrument 一開始用哪個樂器，給有樂器的引擎用（'piano'、'synth/pluck'）。不認識的 id 會在 console 警告，並被忽略。 remember 把選單最後選的樂器依頁面記在 localStorage，下一次它會贏過 instrument。給字串就是你自己的儲存鍵。預設的鍵是 openav:sound:。false 是關掉。用程式做的選擇不會被記住，除非你要求（setInstrument(id, { remember: true })）。 picker 控台要不要顯示樂器選單。它被存成 sound.picker，給建介面的人讀。Sound 自己不畫任何東西。

records.k: params cutoff space reverb volume filter shared sound/cutoff 參數 cutoff space 殘響 音量 濾波器 共用 sound/cutoff
records.d: The three params every instrument shares: cutoff (the filter), space (the reverb) and volume.
records.x: cutoff is the low-pass filter's frequency in Hz, space is how much reverb is mixed in (the wet amount, 0..1), volume is the level in dB. They sit after the instrument on the output chain, so the timeline, a knob or a hand keep performing them across instrument switches. In a show they are the params sound/cutoff, sound/space and sound/volume. An instrument may suggest other starting values through its defaults, and automation and overrides always win over a suggestion. An instrument's own params cannot use these keys. [{ key: 'cutoff', min: 100, max: 8000, def: 2500 }, { key: 'space', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.3 }, { key: 'volume', min: -36, max: 0, def: -8 }], each also with a label.

records.k: params cutoff space reverb volume filter shared sound/cutoff 參數 cutoff space 殘響 音量 濾波器 共用 sound/cutoff
records.d: 每個樂器共用的三個參數：cutoff（濾波器）、space（殘響）和 volume（音量）。
records.x: cutoff 是低通濾波器的頻率，單位是 Hz，space 是混進去多少殘響（濕度，0..1），volume 是音量，單位是 dB。它們在輸出鏈上排在樂器之後，所以換樂器的時候，時間軸、旋鈕或一隻手可以繼續演奏它們。在演出裡它們是參數 sound/cutoff、sound/space、sound/volume。樂器可以用它的 defaults 建議不同的起始值，自動化和覆寫永遠贏過建議。樂器自己的 params 不能用這幾個鍵。 [{ key: 'cutoff', min: 100, max: 8000, def: 2500 }, { key: 'space', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.3 }, { key: 'volume', min: -36, max: 0, def: -8 }]，每個還有一個 label。

records.k: createShow modules.sound options normalize config createShow modules.sound 選項 正規化 設定
records.d: Reads the modules.sound option of createShow() (true, an instrument id, or an object) into one normalized object.
records.x: It is how createShow({ modules: { sound: … } }) understands its option, so sound: true, sound: 'piano' and sound: { instrument: 'organ', remember: false, picker: false } all work. You only need it if you write something that takes the same option. value true for the defaults, an instrument id ('piano'), or { instrument, remember, picker, engine, …toneEngine options }. Anything falsy gives null. { engine, instrument, remember, picker, engineOptions } (engine and instrument are null when not given, remember and picker are true), or null for a falsy value. engineOptions holds the rest of an object: baseUrl, cdn, instruments…. An instrument that is not a string, or a value of another kind, throws a TypeError.

records.k: createShow modules.sound options normalize config createShow modules.sound 選項 正規化 設定
records.d: 把 createShow() 的 modules.sound 選項（true、樂器 id 或物件）讀成一個整理好的物件。
records.x: createShow({ modules: { sound: … } }) 就是靠它理解選項，所以 sound: true、sound: 'piano' 和 sound: { instrument: 'organ', remember: false, picker: false } 都行。只有你要寫收同樣選項的東西時才需要它。 value true 是預設，樂器 id（'piano'），或 { instrument, remember, picker, engine, …toneEngine 的選項 }。任何假值會得到 null。 { engine, instrument, remember, picker, engineOptions }（沒給的 engine 和 instrument 是 null，remember 和 picker 是 true），假值則是 null。engineOptions 放物件裡其餘的東西：baseUrl、cdn、instruments…。instrument 不是字串，或給了別種值，會丟出 TypeError。

records.k: synth presets pad lead bass acid supersaw pluck bell chip data 合成器預設 襯底 主奏 貝斯 酸性 超級鋸齒波 撥奏 鐘聲 晶片音 資料
records.d: The 11 synth presets as plain data: pad, saw lead, square lead, pluck, supersaw, bass, acid, brass, bell, sub and chip.
records.x: Each preset is what synthInstrument() turns into an instrument synth/. They are data in Tone.js's own vocabulary (oscillator, envelope, filter, filterEnvelope, harmonicity…), a good place to look when you write a preset of your own for registerSynthPreset(). The pad is the framework's original voice: three detuned sawtooth waves with a quick attack and a long release. An array of 11 presets { id, name: { en, zh }, voice, … }: pad, saw-lead, square-lead, pluck, supersaw, bass, acid, brass, bell, sub, chip.

records.k: synth presets pad lead bass acid supersaw pluck bell chip data 合成器預設 襯底 主奏 貝斯 酸性 超級鋸齒波 撥奏 鐘聲 晶片音 資料
records.d: 11 個合成器預設，是單純的資料：pad、saw lead、square lead、pluck、supersaw、bass、acid、brass、bell、sub、chip。
records.x: 每個預設都會被 synthInstrument() 變成一個樂器 synth/。它們是用 Tone.js 自己的詞彙寫的資料（oscillator、envelope、filter、filterEnvelope、harmonicity…），要為 registerSynthPreset() 寫自己的預設時，是個好的參考。pad 是框架最早的聲音：三個失諧的鋸齒波，起音快、釋放長。 一個有 11 個預設的陣列 { id, name: { en, zh }, voice, … }：pad、saw-lead、square-lead、pluck、supersaw、bass、acid、brass、bell、sub、chip。

records.k: synth preset to instrument polysynth convert definition fm mono 合成器 預設轉樂器 複音合成器 轉換 定義 fm 單音
records.d: Turns a synth preset into an instrument definition whose id is synth/ followed by the preset id, without registering it.
records.x: The definition's create() builds one Tone.PolySynth of the preset's voice (synth, mono, fm or am), with the Tone settings the preset carries, a chain of its effects, and its polyphony (16 voices if left out). Use it when you want the definition for yourself (to adjust it before registering); otherwise registerSynthPreset() does both steps. preset The preset, see registerSynthPreset(). A preset that validateSynthPreset() refuses throws a TypeError. An instrument definition: id is 'synth/' + preset.id, name the preset's (or its id), category the preset's or 'synth', transpose is octave × 12, gain, defaults, params and credit come from the preset, tail is min(8, release × 1.5 + 0.5) seconds and preset is the preset itself.

records.k: synth preset to instrument polysynth convert definition fm mono 合成器 預設轉樂器 複音合成器 轉換 定義 fm 單音
records.d: 把一個合成器預設變成樂器定義，id 是 synth/ 加上預設的 id，但不登記它。
records.x: 這個定義的 create() 會建一個 Tone.PolySynth，聲部是預設的 voice（synth、mono、fm 或 am），帶著預設的 Tone 設定、一串 effects 效果，以及它的 polyphony（沒給就是 16 個聲部）。想自己拿到這個定義（登記前先調整）時才用它。否則 registerSynthPreset() 兩步一起做完。 preset 預設，見 registerSynthPreset()。validateSynthPreset() 不接受的預設會丟出 TypeError。 一個樂器定義：id 是 'synth/' + preset.id，name 用預設的（沒有就用它的 id），category 用預設的或 'synth'，transpose 是 octave × 12，gain、defaults、params、credit 來自預設，tail 是 min(8, release × 1.5 + 0.5) 秒，preset 是預設本身。

records.k: tone.js cdn jsdelivr url version host yourself tone.js cdn jsdelivr 網址 版本 自己放
records.d: The address Tone.js is loaded from when the engine is enabled: Tone 15.0.4 on jsDelivr.
records.x: A module URL that toneEngine() imports on enable(). To host Tone.js yourself, pass your own as the cdn option of toneEngine(). 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm'.

records.k: tone.js cdn jsdelivr url version host yourself tone.js cdn jsdelivr 網址 版本 自己放
records.d: 引擎啟用時載入 Tone.js 的位址：jsDelivr 上的 Tone 15.0.4。
records.x: toneEngine() 在 enable() 時匯入的模組網址。想自己放 Tone.js 的話，把你的網址當作 toneEngine() 的 cdn 選項。 字串 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm'。

records.k: tone.js engine synth instrument player reverb filter limiter samples enable noteOn tone.js 引擎 合成器 樂器播放 殘響 濾波器 限幅器 取樣 啟用 noteOn
records.d: The sound engine that plays the registered instruments with Tone.js through a filter, a reverb and a limiter.
records.x: Tone.js stays a neighbour, not a dependency: it is loaded from the network the first time enable() runs, so an app that never turns the sound on pays nothing. After enable() the instrument's output goes through a low-pass filter (cutoff, starting at 2500 Hz), a reverb (space, the wet amount, starting at 0.3), a volume (volume, in dB, starting at -8) and a limiter at -1 dB, so a loud organ never clips the room. These three are the SOUND_PARAMS shared by every instrument. Their starting values can follow the instrument (a piano wants the filter open), and the instrument may add params of its own. setInstrument(id) switches live and returns a promise of whether it worked. Before enable() it only remembers the choice. Held notes are released on the old instrument and its tail is left to ring for a few seconds. A sampler (the piano) keeps the old sound until its files are in; if they cannot load, the engine plays the instrument's fallback (the piano falls back to the electric piano), so a performance never goes silent because of one failed download. subscribe(cb) tells you about instrument, loading, ready and error events. sustain(down) is the pedal: note-offs wait until it comes up. releaseAll() is a panic button. You usually pass the engine to a Sound, which is what listens to the bus. Used on its own, noteOn(60, 0.8) plays a note. await engine.enable() from a click: it loads Tone.js from the network, then starts its audio. Before that, noteOn() does nothing and…

records.k: tone.js engine synth instrument player reverb filter limiter samples enable noteOn tone.js 引擎 合成器 樂器播放 殘響 濾波器 限幅器 取樣 啟用 noteOn
records.d: 發聲引擎，用 Tone.js 播放登記好的樂器，聲音依序經過濾波器、殘響和限幅器。
records.x: Tone.js 只是鄰居，不是相依套件：第一次 enable() 的時候才從網路載入，所以從不開聲音的應用程式什麼代價都不用付。enable() 之後，樂器的輸出會經過低通濾波器（cutoff，起始 2500 Hz）、殘響（space，濕度，起始 0.3）、音量（volume，單位 dB，起始 -8）和 -1 dB 的限幅器，所以很大聲的風琴也不會把房間削波。這三個就是每個樂器共用的 SOUND_PARAMS。它們的起始值可以跟著樂器走（鋼琴想要濾波器全開），樂器也可以再加自己的參數。 setInstrument(id) 現場換樂器，回傳換成功與否的 promise。在 enable() 之前它只是記住這個選擇。舊樂器按著的音會被放開，它的尾巴讓它再響幾秒。取樣樂器（鋼琴）在檔案進來之前會繼續用舊的聲音。如果載入失敗，引擎會播這個樂器的 fallback（鋼琴退回電鋼琴），所以演出不會因為一次下載失敗就沒聲音。subscribe(cb) 會告訴你 instrument、loading、ready、error 事件。sustain(down) 是踏板：放開音的動作要等到踏板抬起來才做。releaseAll() 是緊急停止鈕。 通常你會把引擎交給 Sound，由它去聽匯流排。單獨使用的話，noteOn(60, 0.8) 就是彈一個音。 要在點擊裡 await engine.enable()：它從網路載入 Tone.js，然後啟動音訊。在那之前 noteOn() 什麼都不做，setInstrument() 只是記住選擇。 cdn 引擎啟用時從哪裡匯入 Tone.js。預設是 TONE_CDN。是一個模組網址，所以你可以放自己的備份。 instrument 一開始用的樂器。不認識的 id 會警告，改用 synth/pad。 baseUrl 放內建取樣組（salamander/…）的資料夾。預設是 SAMPLES_URL。 instruments 給單一樂器的選項，會當作 ctx.options 交給它的 create()：{ piano: { baseUrl: '/my/salamander/' } }。 drumChannel 這個 MIDI 頻道的音符屬於鼓的引擎（鼓機送的是 General MIDI 的頻道 10），這裡不播。null 是全部都播。 一個引擎：{ params, sharedParams, instrument, status, skipChannels, hasInstrument(id), subscribe(cb), setInstrument(id), enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), noteOff(note, time), sustain(down), releaseAll(), set(key, value), dispose() }。

records.k: remove unregister delete instrument hot reload 移除 取消登記 刪除樂器 熱重載
records.d: Removes a registered sound, for tests and hot reload. Returns whether it was there.
records.x: A picker refreshes itself. It does not stop an engine that is playing the instrument: switch away first. id The id of the instrument. True if it existed. The listeners of onInstrumentsChange() hear { type: 'unregister', id } only then.

records.k: remove unregister delete instrument hot reload 移除 取消登記 刪除樂器 熱重載
records.d: 移除一個登記過的聲音，給測試和熱重載用。回傳它原本在不在。
records.x: 選單會自己更新。它不會停掉正在播這個樂器的引擎：要先換掉。 id 樂器的 id。 原本有就是 true。只有這時候，onInstrumentsChange() 的監聽者才會收到 { type: 'unregister', id }。

records.k: validate check definition errors lint instrument rules 驗證 檢查定義 錯誤 樂器規則 問題清單
records.d: Checks an instrument definition and lists everything wrong with it as readable sentences. An empty list means it is valid.
records.x: It checks: id (lowercase letters, digits and -, at most one /), name (a string, or { en, zh } with at least en), category (a string), create (a function), params (each with a word as key, numbers min < max, a def within them, and a key that is not one of the shared three), defaults (only cutoff, space or volume, each within its range), credit (a string, or { text, url }), gain, transpose and tail (numbers) and fallback (another instrument's id). registerInstrument() runs it and throws with these sentences. def The definition to check. Sentences, one per problem. [] when valid. It never throws.

records.k: validate check definition errors lint instrument rules 驗證 檢查定義 錯誤 樂器規則 問題清單
records.d: 檢查一個樂器定義，把有問題的地方都列成看得懂的句子。空的清單表示沒問題。
records.x: 它檢查：id（小寫字母、數字和 -，最多一個 /）、name（字串，或至少有 en 的 { en, zh }）、category（字串）、create（函式）、params（每個的 key 是一個單字，min < max 是數字，def 在兩者之間，而且 key 不是共用的那三個之一）、defaults（只能是 cutoff、space、volume，且各自在範圍內）、credit（字串，或 { text, url }）、gain、transpose、tail（數字），以及 fallback（另一個樂器的 id）。registerInstrument() 會執行它，並用這些句子丟出錯誤。 def 要檢查的定義。 句子，每個問題一句。沒問題就是 []。它不會丟出錯誤。

records.k: validate preset check errors synth rules 驗證預設 檢查 錯誤 合成器規則
records.d: Checks a synth preset and lists what is wrong with it. An empty list means it is valid.
records.x: It checks the id (lowercase letters, digits and -), the voice (synth, mono, fm or am), that every effect has a type the package knows, and that octave is a whole number. It does not check the Tone settings, which are Tone.js's to judge. p The preset to check. Sentences, one per problem. [] when valid.

records.k: validate preset check errors synth rules 驗證預設 檢查 錯誤 合成器規則
records.d: 檢查一個合成器預設，列出有問題的地方。空的清單表示沒問題。
records.x: 它檢查 id（小寫字母、數字和 -）、voice（synth、mono、fm 或 am）、每個效果的 type 是不是套件認得的，以及 octave 是不是整數。Tone 的設定它不檢查，那是 Tone.js 的事。 p 要檢查的預設。 句子，每個問題一句。沒問題就是 []。

records.k: beat phase pulse beat progress quarter note smooth drums 拍子進度 脈動 一拍 平滑 鼓機
records.d: How far through the current beat the drum machine is, smoothly from 0 up to just below 1, four times per bar.
records.x: A beat is a quarter note (four steps). 1 - beatPhase is biggest right on the beat and shrinks until the next one, so circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + (1 - beatPhase) 80) pulses with the tempo, with no callback needed. drumPhase is the same thing across a whole bar. Start the machine with startDrums(); until it plays, beatPhase is 0. Read fresh each time you look at it. 0 on the beat, close to 1 just before the next one, then 0 again. It is 0 before the machine has played and holds still while it is stopped.

records.k: beat phase pulse beat progress quarter note smooth drums 拍子進度 脈動 一拍 平滑 鼓機
records.d: 鼓機走到這一拍的哪裡，從 0 平滑地增加到快要 1，一小節會跑四次。
records.x: 一拍是一個四分音符（四格）。1 - beatPhase 在正拍上最大，然後縮小到下一拍，所以 circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + (1 - beatPhase) 80) 會跟著速度脈動，不用任何 callback。drumPhase 是同樣的東西，範圍是整個小節。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機，在它開始播之前，beatPhase 是 0。 每次讀都是當下的值。正拍上是 0，下一拍之前接近 1，然後回到 0。鼓機還沒播之前是 0，停下來的時候停在原地。

records.k: draw rhythm visualize grid circle spiral playhead drum visual sequencer view recording 畫節奏 視覺化 格子 圓形 螺旋 播放頭 鼓機畫面 錄影
records.d: Draws the rhythm on the canvas as a grid, a circle or a spiral, with a playhead and the hits lighting up, so a recording has it too.
records.x: Call it in draw() after background(): drawRhythm(20, 100, 360, 100). Each row is one drum that plays in the pattern, a hit lights up the moment it is heard (the clock drumPhase reads), and a hit between two steps, such as a triplet, sits where it falls. The grid card is part of the page and a recording never shows it, but the canvas is what a recording takes, so this is how the rhythm gets into the video. With no box it draws a strip along the bottom for 'grid' and a square in the middle for the other two. It draws with p5's own shapes between push() and pop(), so it leaves your styles alone and works in 2D and in WEBGL, in p5 1.x and 2.x. In WEBGL the origin is the middle of the canvas: drawRhythm(-width / 2, -height / 2, width, height, 'circle') fills it. Start the machine with startDrums() first. Before it plays you get an empty four-lane grid. OAVp5.drums.draw(x, y, w, h, style, o) is the same function as a method. x Left edge of the box to draw in. In WEBGL the middle of the canvas is (0, 0). If any of x, y, w, h is left out, the default box is used. y Top edge of the box. w Width of the box. h Height of the box. style 'grid' (the 16 steps with a playhead), 'circle' (a ring of 16 per drum with a hand turned by drumPhase) or 'spiral' (the last few bars wound outwards, now at the tip). An object here is taken as o, with style inside it. o Options: colors ({ kick: '#f66', … }, any p5 colour per drum), color (one colour for all), off (the empty steps), playhead (a colour,…

records.k: draw rhythm visualize grid circle spiral playhead drum visual sequencer view recording 畫節奏 視覺化 格子 圓形 螺旋 播放頭 鼓機畫面 錄影
records.d: 把節奏畫在畫布上，樣式可以是格子、圓或螺旋，有播放頭，打擊的時候會亮起來，所以錄影也錄得到。
records.x: 在 draw() 裡、background() 之後呼叫：drawRhythm(20, 100, 360, 100)。每一列是節奏裡有用到的一種鼓，打擊在你聽到的那一刻亮起來（用的就是 drumPhase 讀的那個時鐘），兩格之間的打擊（例如三連音）會畫在它實際落下的位置。鼓機的卡片是頁面的一部分，錄影錄不到，但錄影錄的是畫布，所以要讓節奏進影片，就用這個。 不給方框的話，'grid' 畫在畫布下方的一條帶子，另外兩種畫在中間的正方形。它用 p5 自己的圖形，包在 push() 和 pop() 之間，所以不會弄亂你設定的樣式，2D 和 WEBGL、p5 1.x 和 2.x 都能用。在 WEBGL 裡原點是畫布中心：drawRhythm(-width / 2, -height / 2, width, height, 'circle') 會鋪滿整個畫布。 要先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機。在它開始播之前，畫出來的是一個空的四軌格子。 OAVp5.drums.draw(x, y, w, h, style, o) 是同一個函式，寫成方法的樣子。 x 要畫的方框的左邊。在 WEBGL 裡，畫布中心是 (0, 0)。x、y、w、h 只要有一個沒傳，就用預設的方框。 y 方框的上邊。 w 方框的寬。 h 方框的高。 style 'grid'（16 格加一條播放頭）、'circle'（每種鼓一圈 16 格，指針照 drumPhase 轉）或 'spiral'（最近幾小節往外繞，現在在最外面的尖端）。這裡如果給的是物件，就當成 o，style 寫在物件裡面。 o 選項：colors（{ kick: '#f66', … }，每種鼓一個 p5 看得懂的顏色）、color（全部同一個顏色）、off（空格子的顏色）、playhead（顏色，或 false 表示不畫）、bg（方框的底色）、bars（只用在螺旋，1 到 16，沒寫就是 4）。 有畫東西就是 true，方框是空的（w 或 h 不大於 0），或沒有 p5 全域模式可以畫的時候是 false。

records.k: bpm tempo speed beats per minute drums drum machine 速度 節拍速度 每分鐘幾拍 鼓機 bpm
records.d: The tempo of the drum machine in beats per minute.
records.x: A beat is a quarter note, four steps, so one step lasts 60 / drumBpm / 4 seconds and one bar 240 / drumBpm: at 120 a bar takes 2 seconds. To change the tempo call startDrums(bpm): startDrums(drumBpm + 5) speeds up by five. Writing to drumBpm yourself changes nothing. startDrums() keeps the tempo between 30 and 300; the slider on the grid goes from 60 to 180. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumBpm keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.bpm instead. 112 until you set another one. It follows startDrums() and the tempo slider on the grid.

records.k: bpm tempo speed beats per minute drums drum machine 速度 節拍速度 每分鐘幾拍 鼓機 bpm
records.d: 鼓機的速度，單位是每分鐘幾拍。
records.x: 一拍是一個四分音符，也就是四格，所以一格長 60 / drumBpm / 4 秒，一小節長 240 / drumBpm 秒：速度 120 的時候一小節是 2 秒。要改速度就呼叫 startDrums(bpm)：startDrums(drumBpm + 5) 就是加快 5。自己對 drumBpm 賦值不會有任何作用。 startDrums() 會把速度限制在 30 到 300 之間，格子上的滑桿則是從 60 到 180。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumBpm 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.bpm。 在你設定別的之前是 112。它會跟著 startDrums() 和格子上的速度滑桿走。

records.k: drum hit hit drum event kick snare hat clap callback velocity trigger 打擊 鼓點 鼓的事件 大鼓 小鼓 力度 觸發 callback
records.d: An event you define: it is called for every hit of the drum machine, with the drum that sounded and how hard.
records.x: Define function drumHit(lane, velocity) { … } and oav-p5 calls it for every hit of every drum, the way it calls notePressed() for a key. It is called in the frame in which the hit is heard, right before draw(). The same hit also calls the microphone's functions, so you can pick the grain you want: kickDetected() for the kick, snareDetected() for snare, clap and rim, hatDetected() for the three hats, and beatDetected() (with beat true for a frame) for kick, snare, clap and rim, once per step. Toms, crash, ride and cowbell reach only drumHit(). On one step the order is: cueFired(), barStarted(), stepStarted(), then the hits. While the tab is hidden nobody sees a frame: the clock keeps counting, but no hit is told, and nothing is told twice when the tab comes back. An error thrown inside drumHit() is printed, with its file and line, and the next hit still comes. lane The drum that sounded: 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' or 'clap' for the grid, and also 'openhat', 'pedalhat', 'rim', 'lowtom', 'tom', 'hightom', 'crash', 'ride' or 'cowbell' for a line of rhythm. velocity How hard, from 0.15 to 1. It varies a little from hit to hit, because the machine plays slightly softer or louder on purpose.

records.k: drum hit hit drum event kick snare hat clap callback velocity trigger 打擊 鼓點 鼓的事件 大鼓 小鼓 力度 觸發 callback
records.d: 一個由你定義的事件函式：鼓機每打一下就會呼叫它，告訴你是哪一種鼓、打得多用力。
records.x: 定義 function drumHit(lane, velocity) { … }，鼓機每打一下、不論哪一種鼓，oav-p5 都會呼叫它，就像按一個鍵會呼叫 notePressed() 一樣。它是在你聽到那一下的那個畫面、draw() 之前被呼叫的。 同一下打擊也會呼叫麥克風用的那些函式，你可以挑想要的粒度：kickDetected() 是大鼓，snareDetected() 是小鼓、拍手和鼓邊，hatDetected() 是三種鈸，beatDetected()（同時 beat 在那個畫面是 true）是大鼓、小鼓、拍手和鼓邊，每一格最多一次。中鼓、碎音鈸、疊音鈸和牛鈴只會呼叫 drumHit()。同一格裡的順序是：cueFired()、barStarted()、stepStarted()，最後才是各個打擊。 分頁被藏起來的時候沒有人看得到畫面：時鐘照樣在數，但不會通知任何一下打擊，分頁回來時也不會把漏掉的補通知一次。drumHit() 裡丟出的錯誤會連同檔案和行號印出來，下一下打擊照樣會來。 lane 發聲的鼓：格子上是 'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'clap'，一行字寫的節奏還會有 'openhat'、'pedalhat'、'rim'、'lowtom'、'tom'、'hightom'、'crash'、'ride'、'cowbell'。 velocity 打得多用力，從 0.15 到 1。每一下會有一點點不同，因為鼓機故意打得時輕時重。

records.k: phase bar phase progress smooth rotate cycle drums position in bar 相位 小節進度 平滑 轉一圈 週期 鼓機 走到哪
records.d: How far through the current bar the drum machine is, smoothly from 0 up to just below 1, as it is heard.
records.x: Use it for anything that should move continuously with the music: rotate(drumPhase TWO_PI) turns once per bar. drumStep says the same thing in 16 jumps; drumPhase is the smooth version. The value is what the listener hears, which is the machine's position corrected for the latency of the speakers, so a drawing driven by it lands on the beat you hear. A bar has four beats; beatPhase is the same idea for one beat. Start the machine with startDrums(); until it plays, drumPhase is 0. A sketch that declares its own drumPhase keeps it, and oav-p5 does not write that name. OAVp5.drums.phase is the same number under a name nothing else can take. Read fresh each time you look at it, so it is never a frame old. 0 at the start of a bar, close to 1 at its end, then 0 again. It is 0 before the machine has played and holds still while it is stopped.

records.k: phase bar phase progress smooth rotate cycle drums position in bar 相位 小節進度 平滑 轉一圈 週期 鼓機 走到哪
records.d: 鼓機走到這一小節的哪裡，從 0 平滑地增加到快要 1，是你耳朵聽到的位置。
records.x: 任何要跟著音樂連續移動的東西都用它：rotate(drumPhase TWO_PI) 一小節轉一圈。drumStep 講的是同一件事，只是分成 16 次跳動，drumPhase 是平滑的版本。它的值是聽的人聽到的位置，也就是鼓機的位置再扣掉喇叭的延遲，所以用它驅動的畫面會落在你聽到的拍子上。 一小節有四拍，beatPhase 是同樣的概念，單位是一拍。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機，在它開始播之前，drumPhase 是 0。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumPhase，就用你的，oav-p5 不會去寫這個名稱。OAVp5.drums.phase 是同一個數字，用一個不會跟別人衝突的名字。 每次讀都是當下的值，不會慢一個畫面。小節開頭是 0，結尾接近 1，然後回到 0。鼓機還沒播之前是 0，停下來的時候停在原地。

records.k: drums on playing status running drum machine 鼓機 開著 播放中 狀態 有沒有在播
records.d: Whether the drum machine is playing right now.
records.x: Use it to tell "the drums are not running" from "the drums are at step 0": drumStep is 0 in both cases. if (drumsAreOn) { … } is also the right guard before you read drumPhase. It changes only when the machine starts or stops, and reading it never starts anything. For the reason behind a false read OAVp5.drums.state: 'loading' while the module arrives, 'stopped' when the grid is up but not playing, 'error' when it could not load. It becomes true after startDrums() (or 🥁 in the 🎹 panel) has loaded the machine, usually within a fraction of a second. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumsAreOn keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.state === 'on' instead. True while the machine plays, false at the start, after stopDrums(), after an error and while the grid's own checkbox is unticked.

records.k: drums on playing status running drum machine 鼓機 開著 播放中 狀態 有沒有在播
records.d: 鼓機現在有沒有在播。
records.x: 用它來分辨「鼓機沒在跑」和「鼓機剛好在第 0 格」：這兩種情況下 drumStep 都是 0。在讀 drumPhase 之前用 if (drumsAreOn) { … } 把關也很合適。它只有在鼓機開始或停止的時候才會變，讀它不會啟動任何東西。 false 的原因看 OAVp5.drums.state：模組還在下載是 'loading'，格子在但沒在播是 'stopped'，載入失敗是 'error'。 要先呼叫 startDrums()（或按 🎹 面板的 🥁），等鼓機載入完才會變成 true，通常不到一秒。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumsAreOn 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.state === 'on'。 鼓機在播的時候是 true，一開始、呼叫 stopDrums() 之後、出錯的時候、以及格子上自己的勾選框取消勾選的時候是 false。

records.k: rhythm changed line of rhythm edit callback event undo strudel pattern changed 節奏改變 一行節奏 編輯 事件 復原 節奏型改變
records.d: An event you define: it is called with the new line of rhythm every time the rhythm changes.
records.x: The line over the grid and the cells edit each other, so the rhythm can change without your code: a click on a cell, a line typed into the card, ↶. rhythmChanged(src, how) tells the sketch, so it can show the line on the canvas (where a recording has it) or store it. It is also called once after startDrums(), a moment after the rhythm module has loaded, with how equal to 'code'. src The line of rhythm that plays now, for example 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'. A preset or a grid you drew comes as the line it is written as. how What changed it: 'code' (startDrums()), 'cell' (a click on a cell of the grid), 'type' (typed into the line on the card, or OAVp5.drums.edit()), 'undo' (↶ or OAVp5.drums.undo()) or 'menu' (a preset picked on the card).

records.k: rhythm changed line of rhythm edit callback event undo strudel pattern changed 節奏改變 一行節奏 編輯 事件 復原 節奏型改變
records.d: 一個由你定義的事件函式：節奏每次改變，就會帶著新的那一行節奏被呼叫。
records.x: 格子上方的那一行字和格子本身會互相改寫，所以節奏可以在你的程式碼之外改變：點格子、在卡片上打字、按 ↶。rhythmChanged(src, how) 把這件事告訴草圖，讓它可以把那一行字畫在畫布上（錄影就錄得到），或是存起來。startDrums() 之後，節奏模組載入完的那一刻也會呼叫一次，這時 how 是 'code'。 src 現在播的那一行節奏，例如 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'。預設節奏或你自己畫的格子，會以它對應的那一行字給你。 how 是什麼改變了它：'code'（startDrums()）、'cell'（點了格子上的一格）、'type'（在卡片的那行字上打字，或用 OAVp5.drums.edit()）、'undo'（↶ 或 OAVp5.drums.undo()）、'menu'（在卡片上挑了一個預設節奏）。

records.k: drums drum machine rhythm beat tempo bpm pattern sequencer strudel tidal kick snare hi-hat metronome clock 鼓機 鼓 節奏 拍子 速度 節拍器 節奏型 大鼓 小鼓 時鐘 一行節奏
records.d: Starts a drum machine: a 16-step grid on the page that plays a preset, your own grid or one line of rhythm, and counts the bars for your sketch.
records.x: Call it once in setup(): startDrums('breakbeat', 120). A grid of 16 steps by 4 lanes (kick, snare, hat, clap) appears at the top of the page, with the tempo and the bar it is in, and plays a synthesized drum kit (no sample files). The grid is part of the page, not of the canvas: a recording never shows it, so use drawRhythm() to draw the rhythm on the canvas. A click on a cell changes the beat, and 🥁 in the 🎹 panel starts and stops the machine with no code at all. The machine is also a clock and a source of events. Every hit calls drumHit() and the microphone's own functions (kickDetected(), snareDetected(), hatDetected(), beatDetected()), so a sketch written for the microphone moves over unchanged. drumStep, drumBar, drumPhase and beatPhase say where the machine is, and cue() lets you plan what happens at which bar. Calling it again while it plays changes the pattern or the tempo without restarting: startDrums(90) only changes the tempo, startDrums('latin') only the pattern. A line of rhythm is any text that is not a preset name. A word is a drum (bd kick, sd snare, hh hat, oh open hat, cp clap, rim, lt mt ht toms, cr crash, rd ride, cb cowbell), ~ is a rest, words separated by spaces share the bar evenly, [ ] groups, 4 repeats, , puts another line on top, takes one per bar and bd(3,8) spreads 3 hits over 8 steps. A mistake shows a card that points at the character and says how to fix it, and 'four on floor' plays meanwhile. A line copied from strudel.cc works too:…

records.k: drums drum machine rhythm beat tempo bpm pattern sequencer strudel tidal kick snare hi-hat metronome clock 鼓機 鼓 節奏 拍子 速度 節拍器 節奏型 大鼓 小鼓 時鐘 一行節奏
records.d: 啟動鼓機：頁面上出現一個 16 格的鼓機，播放預設節奏、你自己畫的格子或一行字寫的節奏，並替草圖數小節。
records.x: 在 setup() 裡呼叫一次：startDrums('breakbeat', 120)。頁面上方會出現 16 格 × 4 軌（大鼓、小鼓、鈸、拍手）的鼓機，旁邊有速度和目前的小節，用合成的鼓組發聲（沒有取樣檔）。這個鼓機是頁面的一部分，不在畫布上，所以錄影錄不到它，要把節奏畫進畫布請用 drawRhythm()。點格子可以改節奏，🎹 面板裡的 🥁 不用寫程式就能開關鼓機。 鼓機同時也是時鐘和事件的來源。每一下打擊都會呼叫 drumHit() 和麥克風用的那幾個函式（kickDetected()、snareDetected()、hatDetected()、beatDetected()），所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成鼓機。drumStep、drumBar、drumPhase、beatPhase 告訴你鼓機走到哪，cue() 讓你事先安排哪一小節發生什麼。 機器播的時候再呼叫，是換節奏或換速度，不會重新開始：startDrums(90) 只改速度，startDrums('latin') 只換節奏。不是預設節奏名字的文字，都當成一行節奏來讀。一個字就是一種鼓（bd 大鼓、sd 小鼓、hh 鈸、oh 開鈸、cp 拍手、rim 鼓邊、lt mt ht 三種中鼓、cr 碎音鈸、rd 疊音鈸、cb 牛鈴），~ 是休息，用空白隔開的字平分一小節，[ ] 是一組，4 是重複四次，, 是疊上另一行， 是每小節輪流一個，bd(3,8) 是把 3 下打擊平均分在 8 格裡。寫錯的話會跳出一張卡片，指出是哪個字、怎麼改，這時先播 'four on floor'。 從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式也可以：startDrums('s("bd4, [~ sd]2").fast(2)')。s("…") 和 sound("…") 加上 .fast(n)、.slow(n) 會被讀進來，沒給速度的話 setcpm(110/4) 會設定速度，.bank(…) 會略過（oav-p5 用自己的鼓組），鏈裡其他的呼叫會跳一張卡片說目前還不支援，其餘照播。 呼叫之前不用準備什麼。計數、drumHit() 和其他 callback 馬上就開始，但瀏覽器要頁面上先有一次點擊或按鍵才讓頁面出聲，所以在那之前鼓是沒聲音的，過一會兒上方會出現卡片提醒你。 鼓的聲音不需要 startSound()：鼓機有自己的鼓組。MIDI 第 10 軌的打擊墊，在 startSound() 開著的時候打的就是同一組鼓。 卡片上的 – 可以把格子收起來，× 會停掉鼓機。分頁在背景的時候，鼓機照樣數、照樣播。載入選項 drums（lookahead 或 frame）和 drumlatency 可以調整時鐘。 pattern 要播什麼。預設節奏的名字（'four on floor'、'breakbeat'、'half time'、'latin'、'sparse'）。一行字寫的節奏，例如 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'，或從 strudel.cc 複製來的。你自己畫的格子 { kick: 'x...x...x...x...', snare, hat, clap }（x 或 1 是打擊，沒寫的軌道是靜音，{} 是只走時間、不出聲的時鐘）。只給一個數字，那個數字就是速度。不傳就維持現在播的（一開始是 'four on floor'）。 bpm 速度，單位是每分鐘幾拍（一拍是四格）。會被限制在 30 到 300 之間。不傳就維持現在的速度：一開始是 112，或是複製來的 Strudel 程式用…

records.k: drums stop off halt silence drum machine 鼓機 停止 關閉 停掉 靜音
records.d: Stops the drum machine and hides its card.
records.x: The machine stops playing, the grid disappears and drumsAreOn becomes false. The numbers keep the last value they had: drumStep, drumBar and cueName stay where they were, and drumPhase and beatPhase hold still. startDrums() afterwards begins again from bar 1. It also works while the machine is still loading: the pending startDrums() then resolves to false. The × on the card does the same thing. A promise that is already resolved to false, the new state of the machine.

records.k: drums stop off halt silence drum machine 鼓機 停止 關閉 停掉 靜音
records.d: 停掉鼓機，並把它的卡片收起來。
records.x: 鼓機停止播放，格子消失，drumsAreOn 變成 false。各個數字停在最後的值：drumStep、drumBar 和 cueName 留在原來的地方，drumPhase 和 beatPhase 也停住不動。之後再呼叫 startDrums() 會從第 1 小節重新開始。 機器還在載入的時候呼叫也可以：還沒結束的 startDrums() 會 resolve 成 false。卡片上的 × 做的是同一件事。 一個已經 resolve 成 false 的 promise，false 就是鼓機的新狀態。

records.k: OAVp5.drums drums object midi.drums drum state debug drum machine 鼓機物件 鼓機狀態 除錯 midi.drums
records.d: The object behind the drum names: the state of the machine, its counters, the line of rhythm, its history and the loaded machine.
records.x: OAVp5.drums (also reachable as midi.drums) is what startDrums(), drumStep and the rest are built on. It holds the numbers (state, step, bar, count, bpm, phase, beatPhase), the rhythm (pattern, src, copyText, strudelUrl, history, edit(), undo()), the cues (cue(), cues, lastCue), a way to listen (on()), what the machine hears right now (now) and handles for the curious (machine, clock). start, stop and draw are the same as startDrums(), stopDrums() and drawRhythm(). For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, libraries (Hydra, for one), the console and debugging.

records.k: OAVp5.drums drums object midi.drums drum state debug drum machine 鼓機物件 鼓機狀態 除錯 midi.drums
records.d: 鼓機相關名稱背後的物件：機器的狀態、各種計數、那一行節奏、它的歷史，以及載入進來的鼓機。
records.x: OAVp5.drums（也可以用 midi.drums 取得）是 startDrums()、drumStep 這些名稱的底層。它裡面有數字（state、step、bar、count、bpm、phase、beatPhase）、節奏（pattern、src、copyText、strudelUrl、history、edit()、undo()）、cue（cue()、cues、lastCue）、監聽的方法（on()）、鼓機此刻聽到的樣子（now），以及給好奇的人用的把手（machine、clock）。 start、stop、draw 跟 startDrums()、stopDrums()、drawRhythm() 是同一回事。一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、函式庫（例如 Hydra）、主控台和除錯用的。

records.k: copy clipboard copy code startDrums call save rhythm 複製 剪貼簿 複製程式碼 存下節奏
records.d: The text the Copy button on the card puts on the clipboard: the rhythm that plays now as a ready startDrums("…", bpm) call.
records.x: Click cells, type a line, find a rhythm you like, and paste this into setup() to keep it. The tempo is the current one, rounded to two decimals. For example startDrums("bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8", 110). Read fresh each time; '' before the machine has loaded.

records.k: copy clipboard copy code startDrums call save rhythm 複製 剪貼簿 複製程式碼 存下節奏
records.d: 卡片上「複製」按鈕放進剪貼簿的文字：把現在播的節奏寫成可以直接貼上的 startDrums("…", bpm)。
records.x: 點格子、打字，找到喜歡的節奏之後，把這一行貼進 setup() 就能留住它。速度是現在的速度，四捨五入到小數點後兩位。 例如 startDrums("bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8", 110)。每次讀都是當下的值，鼓機載入之前是 ''。

records.k: edit type a line live coding change rhythm error message mistake drums 編輯 改節奏 即時編碼 錯誤訊息 打字 鼓機
records.d: Plays a line of rhythm as if it was typed on the card, and returns whether it worked and, if not, what is wrong with it.
records.x: Unlike startDrums(text), which plays 'four on floor' when the line has a mistake, edit() keeps the line that was playing and tells you why the new one failed, so a live-coding sketch can show the message. The line goes into OAVp5.drums.history and rhythmChanged() is called with how equal to 'type'. A mistake also shows the card that points at the character. The machine and the rhythm module must have loaded: call startDrums() first and give it a moment. text The line of rhythm, for example 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8', or a line copied from strudel.cc. { ok: true, error: null, text } when the line plays. { ok: false, error, text } when it has a mistake: error has code, index and length (where the bad word is in text), a message and a hint, and the last line that worked keeps playing. Before the machine has loaded: { ok: false, error: null }.

records.k: edit type a line live coding change rhythm error message mistake drums 編輯 改節奏 即時編碼 錯誤訊息 打字 鼓機
records.d: 把一行節奏當成在卡片上打的字來播，並回傳有沒有成功，不成功的話告訴你哪裡有問題。
records.x: 跟 startDrums(text) 不同：那一行有錯的時候，startDrums 會改播 'four on floor'，而 edit() 會讓原本那一行繼續播，並告訴你新的為什麼失敗，所以即時編碼的草圖可以把訊息顯示出來。這一行會進到 OAVp5.drums.history，rhythmChanged() 也會被呼叫，how 是 'type'。有錯的時候也會跳出卡片，指出是哪個字。 鼓機和節奏模組必須已經載入完成：先呼叫 startDrums()，再等一下。 text 一行節奏，例如 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'，或是從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式。 這行節奏播起來了就回傳 { ok: true, error: null, text }。有錯的話回傳 { ok: false, error, text }：error 裡有 code、index 和 length（錯的那個字在 text 的位置）、message 和 hint，這時上一行能播的節奏繼續播。鼓機還沒載入的時候回傳 { ok: false, error: null }。

records.k: history undo list earlier rhythms previous lines 歷史 復原清單 之前的節奏 上一行
records.d: The earlier lines of rhythm, oldest first: every click on a cell, typed line or menu pick leaves the line before it here.
records.x: OAVp5.drums.undo() takes the last line off this list and plays it. Changes made by startDrums() are not recorded here, only the ones made on the card or with OAVp5.drums.edit(). The array is the machine's own, so treat it as read-only. Empty at the start, and at most 50 lines long. The line that plays now is not in it: that is OAVp5.drums.src.

records.k: history undo list earlier rhythms previous lines 歷史 復原清單 之前的節奏 上一行
records.d: 之前播過的節奏，最舊的在最前面：每點一次格子、每改一次文字、每從選單挑一次，前一行就會存到這裡。
records.x: OAVp5.drums.undo() 會把這份清單最後一行拿出來播。用 startDrums() 做的改變不會記在這裡，只有在卡片上做的，或用 OAVp5.drums.edit() 做的才會。這個陣列是鼓機自己的，請當成唯讀。 一開始是空的，最多保留 50 行。現在在播的那一行不在裡面，那一行是 OAVp5.drums.src。

records.k: now snapshot current state tokens lit words highlight drums 現在 快照 目前狀態 亮著的字 標示 鼓機
records.d: A snapshot of what the machine hears right now: the bar, the step, both phases and which words of the line are lit.
records.x: It is what the card uses to light the word that sounds. Read it when you want the line and its lit words in one go, for example to draw the line on the canvas with the sounding word marked. Before the machine has loaded it answers with zeros and an empty text. A new object on every read. phase and beatPhase are drumPhase and beatPhase. tokens is a list of { start, end }: the places in text of the words that sound now. mode is 'string' for a line of rhythm and 'grid' for a preset or a grid you drew. text is the line.

records.k: now snapshot current state tokens lit words highlight drums 現在 快照 目前狀態 亮著的字 標示 鼓機
records.d: 鼓機此刻聽到的樣子，一次拿齊：小節、格、兩個相位，以及那一行字裡哪些字亮著。
records.x: 卡片就是用它讓正在響的字亮起來。想一次拿到那一行字和亮著的字的時候讀它，例如把那一行字畫在畫布上，並標出正在響的字。鼓機載入之前，它給的是零和空的 text。 每次讀都是一個新的物件。phase 和 beatPhase 就是 drumPhase 和 beatPhase。tokens 是 { start, end } 的清單，標出 text 裡現在正在響的那幾個字的位置。mode 在播一行節奏時是 'string'，預設節奏或你自己畫的格子是 'grid'。text 是那一行字。

records.k: listen subscribe event listener on hydra drums off 監聽 訂閱 事件 聽事件 取消監聽 鼓機
records.d: Listens to the drum machine from anywhere: OAVp5.drums.on('hit', fn) calls fn like drumHit does, and returns a function that stops listening.
records.x: The functions you define (drumHit, barStarted …) are one listener each. on() is for the cases where that does not fit: several listeners for one event, a library or a Hydra sketch that has no drumHit() of its own, a listener you want to remove again. It is the same idea as midi.on(). An error thrown inside fn is printed and the other listeners still run. name What to listen to: 'hit' (like drumHit()), 'step' (like stepStarted()), 'bar' (like barStarted()), 'cue' (like cueFired()) or 'rhythm' (like rhythmChanged()). Any other name throws an error that lists them. fn Called with the same arguments as the function it matches: (lane, velocity), (step, bar), (bar), (name, bar) or (src, how). A function: call it to stop listening.

records.k: listen subscribe event listener on hydra drums off 監聽 訂閱 事件 聽事件 取消監聽 鼓機
records.d: 在任何地方監聽鼓機：OAVp5.drums.on('hit', fn) 會像 drumHit 一樣呼叫 fn，並回傳一個可以取消監聽的函式。
records.x: 你定義的函式（drumHit、barStarted ……）每種事件只能有一個。on() 是給不適用的情況：同一個事件要有好幾個監聽者、函式庫或 Hydra 草圖沒有自己的 drumHit()、或是想把監聽者再拿掉。概念跟 midi.on() 一樣。fn 裡丟出的錯誤會被印出來，其他監聽者照樣執行。 name 要監聽什麼：'hit'（像 drumHit()）、'step'（像 stepStarted()）、'bar'（像 barStarted()）、'cue'（像 cueFired()）、'rhythm'（像 rhythmChanged()）。其他的名字會丟出錯誤，並列出這幾個。 fn 被呼叫的時候帶的參數跟對應的函式一樣：(lane, velocity)、(step, bar)、(bar)、(name, bar) 或 (src, how)。 一個函式，呼叫它就停止監聽。

records.k: pattern preset current pattern custom rhythm name drums 節奏型 預設節奏 目前節奏 自訂 鼓機
records.d: What the drum machine plays, as a name: the preset's name, 'custom' for a grid, or the line of rhythm itself.
records.x: After startDrums('breakbeat') it is 'breakbeat', after startDrums({ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' }) it is 'custom', and after startDrums('bd4, hh8') it is that line. A click on a cell of a preset makes it 'custom'. To get the line of rhythm in every case, read OAVp5.drums.src: a preset also has one. 'four on floor' until you choose another. It follows what plays, including clicks on the grid.

records.k: pattern preset current pattern custom rhythm name drums 節奏型 預設節奏 目前節奏 自訂 鼓機
records.d: 鼓機正在播的東西，用名字表示：預設節奏的名字、自己畫的格子是 'custom'，一行節奏就是那一行字本身。
records.x: startDrums('breakbeat') 之後是 'breakbeat'，startDrums({ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' }) 之後是 'custom'，startDrums('bd4, hh8') 之後就是那一行字。在預設節奏的格子上點一下，它就變成 'custom'。想在每一種情況下都拿到那一行節奏，請讀 OAVp5.drums.src：預設節奏也有對應的那一行。 在你選別的之前是 'four on floor'。它跟著正在播的東西走，包括在格子上點的修改。

records.k: line of rhythm source rhythm string current line mini notation drums 一行節奏 節奏文字 目前這一行 鼓機 寫法
records.d: The line of rhythm that plays now, such as 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'; an empty string until the machine has loaded.
records.x: Show it on the canvas so a recording has it (text(OAVp5.drums.src, 20, 30)), or keep it to come back to the rhythm later with startDrums(src). rhythmChanged() tells you when it changes, and OAVp5.drums.copyText is the same line wrapped in a startDrums("…") call. It is '' until startDrums() has loaded the machine and the rhythm module, a fraction of a second. Read fresh each time. A preset or a grid you drew shows as the line it is written as, and it changes with every click on a cell and every typed edit.

records.k: line of rhythm source rhythm string current line mini notation drums 一行節奏 節奏文字 目前這一行 鼓機 寫法
records.d: 現在播的那一行節奏，例如 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'。鼓機載入之前是空字串。
records.x: 把它畫在畫布上，錄影就錄得到（text(OAVp5.drums.src, 20, 30)），或是存起來，之後用 startDrums(src) 回到這個節奏。它改變的時候 rhythmChanged() 會通知你，OAVp5.drums.copyText 則是同一行字外面包上 startDrums("…")。 在 startDrums() 載入鼓機和節奏模組之前都是 ''，大約不到一秒。 每次讀都是當下的值。預設節奏或你自己畫的格子，會顯示成它對應的那一行字，每點一次格子、每改一次文字，它就跟著變。

records.k: drum state status loading stopped drums machine state 鼓機狀態 載入中 已停止 狀態
records.d: Where the drum machine is: 'off', 'loading', 'on', 'stopped' or 'error'.
records.x: 'loading' is the moment after startDrums() while the module arrives, 'on' is playing, 'stopped' is a grid that is up but not playing (its checkbox is unticked), 'off' is where it starts and where stopDrums() leaves it, and 'error' means @openav/drums could not be loaded. drumsAreOn is state === 'on'. Starts as 'off' and changes when the machine loads, plays, is stopped or fails.

records.k: drum state status loading stopped drums machine state 鼓機狀態 載入中 已停止 狀態
records.d: 鼓機現在在哪個階段：'off'、'loading'、'on'、'stopped' 或 'error'。
records.x: 'loading' 是呼叫 startDrums() 之後，模組還在下載的那段時間，'on' 是正在播，'stopped' 是格子還在但沒在播（它的勾選框取消勾選了），'off' 是起點，也是 stopDrums() 之後的狀態，'error' 表示 @openav/drums 載入失敗。drumsAreOn 就是 state === 'on'。 一開始是 'off'，鼓機載入、播放、停止或失敗的時候就跟著變。

records.k: strudel strudel.cc open in strudel link url live coding Strudel 連結 網址 在 Strudel 打開 即時編碼
records.d: The rhythm that plays now as a link that opens it at strudel.cc, or an empty string when there is none.
records.x: It holds the line as s("…") with setcpm(bpm/4) (one bar here is one Strudel cycle of four beats), the same thing the "Open in Strudel" link on the card opens. Open it in a new tab: window.open(OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl) from a click handler. A https://strudel.cc/#… address, read fresh each time. '' before the machine has loaded.

records.k: strudel strudel.cc open in strudel link url live coding Strudel 連結 網址 在 Strudel 打開 即時編碼
records.d: 現在播的節奏做成的連結，打開就會在 strudel.cc 裡開啟同一個節奏，沒有的時候是空字串。
records.x: 裡面是那一行節奏，寫成 s("…")，再加上 setcpm(bpm/4)（這裡的一小節就是 Strudel 的一個週期，四拍），跟卡片上「在 Strudel 打開」連結開啟的是同一個東西。用新分頁打開它：在點擊的處理函式裡寫 window.open(OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl)。 一個 https://strudel.cc/#… 的網址，每次讀都是當下的。鼓機載入之前是 ''。

records.k: undo back revert previous rhythm drums 復原 上一步 回上一行 鼓機
records.d: Goes back one line of rhythm, like ↶ on the card; returns true if there was an earlier line.
records.x: The line before the current one is played again and removed from the history. rhythmChanged() is called with how equal to 'undo'. On the card the same thing is ⌘Z or Ctrl+Z after touching it. true if it went back one line, false if OAVp5.drums.history was empty or the machine is not loaded.

records.k: undo back revert previous rhythm drums 復原 上一步 回上一行 鼓機
records.d: 回到上一行節奏，跟卡片上的 ↶ 一樣，如果有上一行就回傳 true。
records.x: 上一行會再播一次，並從歷史清單裡拿掉。rhythmChanged() 會被呼叫，how 是 'undo'。在卡片上，點一下卡片之後按 ⌘Z 或 Ctrl+Z 也是同樣的事。 回到上一行就是 true，OAVp5.drums.history 是空的、或鼓機還沒載入就是 false。

records.k: drum kit drum sounds synth drums web audio engine noteOn kick snare general midi samples 鼓組 鼓聲 合成鼓 引擎 大鼓 小鼓 取樣 音量 general midi
records.d: A drum kit made of Web Audio synthesis, with no sample files: General MIDI drum notes go in, drum sounds come out.
records.x: It follows the small engine contract of @openav/sound, so the same shell and the same signals drive it: enable() makes the AudioContext, noteOn(note, vel01, time) plays a drum, set(key, value) sets a param. The kit has thirteen voices (see GM): kick, rim, snare, clap, low tom, hat, pedal hat, tom, open hat, high tom, crash, ride and cowbell. A note the kit does not know (any melodic note) plays nothing and returns null. noteOn(note, vel01, time) returns { time, cancel() }, or null before enable() or for a note it does not play. time is on the kit's own clock (engine.context.currentTime); left out, or already past, the hit sounds now. cancel() silences a hit that has not started, which is how DrumTransport takes back what it scheduled when the tempo changes. hit('crash', 0.9) plays a voice by name (or a note number) for code that is not a MIDI pad. There is one param, kitVolume, from −30 to 0 dB (default −6). Once enabled, engine.context is its AudioContext and engine.output is the node that goes to the speakers, which a recorder can tap. Before that both are null. noteOff() does nothing (drums ring out) and dispose() closes the context. await kit.enable() from a click: browsers start audio only after a user gesture. mountDrums() and DrumTransport with autoEnable do that for you on the first hit. samples Play audio files instead of the synthesis: { 36: 'kick.wav', 38: 'snare.wav' }, MIDI note number to URL. They are fetched and decoded by enable(); a file that fails to load…

records.k: drum kit drum sounds synth drums web audio engine noteOn kick snare general midi samples 鼓組 鼓聲 合成鼓 引擎 大鼓 小鼓 取樣 音量 general midi
records.d: 一組用 Web Audio 合成的鼓組，沒有取樣檔：送進 General MIDI 的鼓音符，就打出鼓聲。
records.x: 它遵守 @openav/sound 的小小引擎約定，所以同一個外殼、同樣的訊號都能驅動它：enable() 建立 AudioContext，noteOn(note, vel01, time) 打一下鼓，set(key, value) 設定參數。鼓組有十三種鼓聲（見 GM）：大鼓、鼓邊、小鼓、拍手、落地鼓、鈸、踩鈸、中鼓、開鈸、高音中鼓、碎音鈸、疊音鈸、牛鈴。鼓組不認得的音符（任何旋律音符）不會發聲，並回傳 null。 noteOn(note, vel01, time) 回傳 { time, cancel() }，在 enable() 之前，或遇到它不打的音符時回傳 null。time 是鼓組自己的時鐘（engine.context.currentTime）上的時間。沒給，或已經過了，這一下就馬上響。cancel() 能讓還沒開始的鼓靜音，DrumTransport 在速度改變時就是用它把排好的收回來。hit('crash', 0.9) 用名字（或音符號碼）打一種鼓，給不是 MIDI 墊子的程式用。它有一個參數 kitVolume，從 −30 到 0 dB（預設 −6）。 啟用之後，engine.context 是它的 AudioContext，engine.output 是接到喇叭的節點，錄音器可以從這裡接。在那之前兩個都是 null。noteOff() 什麼都不做（鼓聲自己響完），dispose() 會關掉 context。 要在點擊裡 await kit.enable()：瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作才讓聲音開始。mountDrums() 和 autoEnable 的 DrumTransport 會在第一下鼓的時候替你做。 samples 用音檔取代合成：{ 36: 'kick.wav', 38: 'snare.wav' }，MIDI 音符號碼對應網址。enable() 會去下載並解碼。載入失敗的檔案會被略過、不報錯，屬於鼓組的音符就改用合成的聲音打。 一個引擎：{ params, context, output, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), hit(what, vel01, time), noteOff(), set(key, value), dispose() }。

records.k: drum names labels translate chinese display name localization 鼓的名字 標籤 翻譯 中文 顯示名稱 在地化
records.d: The name of a drum for the screen, in English or in Chinese: drumName('lowtom') is 'low tom'.
records.x: The drum names inside code stay English everywhere ('kick', 'snare'), and this is for the screen: the row labels of the drum machine card use it, and with 'zh' they are written in Chinese. voice The drum: kick, snare, hat, clap, openhat, pedalhat, rim, lowtom, tom, hightom, crash, ride or cowbell. lang 'zh' for Chinese; anything else is English. The name, or voice itself if it is not a drum of the kit.

records.k: drum names labels translate chinese display name localization 鼓的名字 標籤 翻譯 中文 顯示名稱 在地化
records.d: 給人讀的鼓的名字，英文或中文：drumName('lowtom', 'zh') 是 '落地鼓'。
records.x: 程式裡的鼓的名字到處都保持英文（'kick'、'snare'），這個函式是給畫面顯示用的：鼓機卡的列標籤就是用它，中文的瀏覽器裡是 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍手。 voice 哪種鼓：kick、snare、hat、clap、openhat、pedalhat、rim、lowtom、tom、hightom、crash、ride、cowbell。 lang 'zh' 是中文。其他都是英文。 名字。如果 voice 不是鼓組的鼓，就原樣回傳 voice。

records.k: scheduler schedule lookahead events fake clock tempo map bar position swing humanize 排程器 預讀 事件 假時鐘 速度 小節 位置 搖擺 擬人化 佇列
records.d: Pure drum logic with no timers and no audio: a grid or a line of rhythm goes in, timed events come out, ahead of time, on any clock you pass.
records.x: A DrumScheduler knows what plays in which bar, and when a bar happens, but it owns no clock: every time you give it is in seconds on one clock of your choosing, so it runs the same under a fake clock in a test as under the audio clock in a page. DrumTransport is the runtime that feeds it the real one. Use the scheduler on its own when you want drum events as data, for your own sound engine or a test. The loop is: start(at) puts the downbeat of bar 1 at time at. Then, again and again, advance(now) schedules everything up to now + lookahead and returns the new events, in order. due(t) hands out the events whose time has come (they stay in queue until then). Two kinds of event come out: a step { kind: 'step', i, n, bar, pos, time } for every 16th, and a hit { kind: 'hit', voice, vel, pos, n, bar, token, word, layer, dur, time }. pos counts bars from the start (0 is the downbeat of bar 1, 1.5 is half way through bar 2), time is in your seconds, i is the step 0..15 and n counts steps since the start. For a grid, the step comes before its hits. token, word, layer and dur come from a line of rhythm and are null or undefined for a grid. Positions turn into seconds by multiplication from the last tempo anchor, never by adding up frame times, so a thousand bars later nothing has drifted (the test measures under a microsecond). A tempo change adds an anchor, so the past keeps the tempo it had. bpm The tempo, in beats per minute. A value that is not above 0 becomes 112. swing 0 to 0.5:…
