records.d: 純粹的鼓的邏輯，沒有計時器也沒有聲音：放進一張格子圖或一行節奏，就提前吐出有時間的事件，時鐘由你傳進來。
records.x: DrumScheduler 知道哪個小節要打什麼，也知道一個小節在什麼時候發生，但它沒有自己的時鐘：你給它的每個時間，都是你選的某一個時鐘上的秒數，所以它在測試裡用假時鐘跑、在頁面裡用音訊時鐘跑，結果一樣。DrumTransport 是把真的時鐘餵給它的執行環境。想把鼓的事件當資料用，例如給自己的發聲引擎或測試，就單獨用排程器。 流程是這樣：start(at) 讓第 1 小節的強拍落在時間 at。然後一再地呼叫 advance(now)，它排好直到 now + lookahead 的全部，並依序回傳新的事件。due(t) 把時間到了的事件交出來（在那之前它們留在 queue 裡）。事件有兩種：每個十六分音符一個步 { kind: 'step', i, n, bar, pos, time }，和一下鼓 { kind: 'hit', voice, vel, pos, n, bar, token, word, layer, dur, time }。pos 從開始算起以小節為單位（0 是第 1 小節的強拍，1.5 是第 2 小節的一半），time 是你的時鐘的秒數，i 是步 0..15，n 是從開始算起的步數。格子圖的話，步在它的鼓之前。token、word、layer、dur 來自一行節奏，格子圖的話是 null 或 undefined。 位置是從最近一個速度錨點用乘法換成秒的，不是把畫面時間加起來，所以一千個小節之後也沒有漂移（測試量到的誤差不到一微秒）。速度改變會多加一個錨點，所以過去保持它當時的速度。 bpm 速度，每分鐘幾拍。不大於 0 的值會變成 112。 swing 0 到 0.5：每個奇數的十六分音符晚那麼多個十六分音符。0 是直的。 humanize 0..1：晚幾毫秒、力道有一點大小變化，讓它有律動而不是機械的滴答。要精準、可重複的時間就用 0。 lookahead advance() 在 now 之後多排幾秒。 pattern PATTERNS 裡的預設名稱、你自己的格子圖，或編譯過的一行節奏（見 setPattern()）。 seed 當作 eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) 交給那一行節奏，讓每個 ? 每次都做同樣的決定。 random humanize 的隨機從哪裡來：回傳 0 到 1 之間數字的函式。傳自己的就能得到可重複的結果。

records.k: sequencer step sequencer 16 steps pattern clock tempo swing humanize lanes kick snare 音序器 步進音序器 16 步 節奏時鐘 速度 搖擺 擬人化 軌道 大鼓 小鼓
records.d: A 16-step, four-lane drum pattern clock that you move forward with update(dt) every frame and that calls your function for each hit.
records.x: It is the simplest clock: no audio, no timers, no DOM. Make it with an onHit that does something, call toggle(true), then call update(dt) once per frame with the seconds since the last frame. It walks through the 16 steps of a bar (a 16th lasts 60 / bpm / 4 seconds) and calls onHit(lane, velocity) for each hit in the four lanes kick, snare, hat and clap. A hit is told in the frame in which it is due, so it can be late by up to a frame, and nothing happens in a hidden tab. For a steady beat under a heavy frame, use DrumTransport. The grid is seq.grid: { kick: [0|1 × 16], snare, hat, clap }. seq.pattern is the preset name, or 'custom' once you changed a cell or gave your own grid. seq.playing, seq.bpm, seq.swing and seq.humanize are plain properties you can read and set. onHit onHit(lane, velocity) for every hit: lane is 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' or 'clap', velocity is 0.15 to 1. You decide what a hit does: play a sound, draw, publish a signal. onStep onStep(i, n) for every 16th step: i is 0..15, n counts steps since the start. It comes before that step's hits. A timeline counts bars on it. bpm The tempo, in beats per minute. It can be changed later: seq.bpm = 90. swing 0 to 0.5: every odd 16th is that share of a 16th late. 0 is straight. humanize 0..1: some hits a few milliseconds late and a little softer or louder. Use 0 for exact, repeatable velocities (0.9 on the beat, 0.6 between). pattern A preset name from PATTERNS or your own grid.

records.d: 一個 16 步、四條軌道的鼓節奏時鐘，每個畫面用 update(dt) 往前推，每一下鼓就呼叫你的函式。
records.x: 這是最簡單的時鐘：沒有聲音、沒有計時器、沒有 DOM。做一個會做事的 onHit，呼叫 toggle(true)，然後每個畫面用距離上一個畫面過了幾秒呼叫 update(dt)。它會走過一個小節的 16 步（一個十六分音符是 60 / bpm / 4 秒），每一下 kick、snare、hat、clap 四條軌道上的鼓就呼叫 onHit(lane, velocity)。鼓是在到時間的那個畫面才被告知，所以最多會晚一個畫面，分頁被藏起來的時候什麼都不會發生。要在畫面很重的時候也有穩的節拍，用 DrumTransport。 格子圖是 seq.grid：{ kick: [0|1 × 16], snare, hat, clap }。seq.pattern 是預設的名稱，改過格子或給了自己的格子圖之後就是 'custom'。seq.playing、seq.bpm、seq.swing、seq.humanize 都是可以直接讀和設的普通屬性。 onHit 每一下鼓呼叫 onHit(lane, velocity)：lane 是 'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'clap'，velocity 是 0.15 到 1。一下鼓要做什麼由你決定：發聲、畫圖、發布訊號。 onStep 每個十六分音符步呼叫 onStep(i, n)：i 是 0..15，n 是從開始算起的步數。它在那一步的鼓之前。時間軸靠它數小節。 bpm 速度，每分鐘幾拍。之後可以改：seq.bpm = 90。 swing 0 到 0.5：每個奇數的十六分音符晚那麼多個十六分音符。0 是直的。 humanize 0..1：有些鼓晚幾毫秒、力道有一點大小。要精準、可重複的力道就用 0（拍點上 0.9，其他 0.6）。 pattern PATTERNS 裡的預設名稱，或你自己的格子圖。

records.k: transport lookahead audio clock heartbeat scheduling steady tempo web worker hidden tab latency follow 傳輸控制 預讀 音訊時鐘 心跳 排程 穩定速度 分頁被藏起來 延遲 跟隨 外部時鐘
records.d: The runtime around a DrumScheduler: it hands every hit to the kit ahead of time on its audio clock, and tells the page each step and hit when it is heard.
records.x: A page that plays a hit in the frame it is due is late by up to a frame, and silent when its tab is hidden. DrumTransport fixes both. A timer (the heartbeat, from a Web Worker, 25 ms by default) looks 0.1 seconds ahead on the kit's own audio clock and hands the kit every hit with its exact start time. The page is told separately, in the frame in which each step and hit is heard: its time plus the output latency the browser reports. So the beat stays steady under a heavy draw() and in a hidden tab, and the callbacks still arrive in order: a step before its hits, hits in time order. Call start(), then frame() once per animation frame. The heartbeat calls pump() for you. Tempo and pattern changes (setBpm(), setPattern(), toggleCell()) take back what was already handed over after now and make it again, so no hit is doubled or lost. Before the kit's AudioContext runs (no click yet) the clock runs on now() and the callbacks run but nothing sounds; once it runs, the hits from then on sound, and none from before. A hidden page, or a frame loop that catches up more than stale seconds late, tells its steps quietly: ev.quiet is true, the clock moves and cues fire, but onHit is not called, and of several bar starts at once only the last has ev.announce. Nothing floods the page when the tab comes back. If a draw() ever holds the thread longer than the lookahead, the lookahead grows to 0.3 seconds (info().extended). It has the getters playing, pattern, grid, mode, text, bpm, swing,…

records.d: 包在 DrumScheduler 外面的執行環境：它用鼓組的音訊時鐘，把每一下鼓提前交給鼓組，並在聽到的時候才告訴頁面每一步和每一下。
records.x: 在到時間的那個畫面才打的鼓，最多會晚一個畫面，分頁被藏起來的時候還會停。DrumTransport 兩個都解決。一個計時器（心跳，預設用 Web Worker，每 25 毫秒一次）在鼓組自己的音訊時鐘上往前看 0.1 秒，把每一下鼓連同確切的開始時間交給鼓組。頁面則是另外被通知，在每一步、每一下被聽到的那個畫面：它的時間加上瀏覽器回報的輸出延遲。所以畫面很重或分頁被藏起來，節拍還是穩的，回呼也依然按順序到：一步在它的鼓之前，鼓依時間排序。 呼叫 start()，然後每個動畫畫面呼叫一次 frame()。心跳會替你呼叫 pump()。速度和節奏的改變（setBpm()、setPattern()、toggleCell()）會把現在之後已經交出去的收回來重做，所以不會有鼓重複或漏掉。鼓組的 AudioContext 還沒跑（還沒點擊）的時候，時鐘用 now() 跑，回呼照常執行但沒有聲音。開始跑之後，從那之後的鼓才會響，之前的不補。 頁面被藏起來，或畫面迴圈追趕時已經晚了超過 stale 秒的時候，步會被安靜地告知：ev.quiet 是 true，時鐘照走、cue 照發，但 onHit 不會被呼叫，而且同時到的好幾個小節開頭，只有最後一個有 ev.announce。分頁回來的時候不會一下子湧進一大堆。如果某個 draw() 佔住執行緒的時間比預讀還長，預讀會增加到 0.3 秒（info().extended）。 它有它的排程器的 getter：playing、pattern、grid、mode、text、bpm、swing、humanize、lookahead。bpm、swing、humanize 也可以設定。通常是透過 clock: 'lookahead' 的 mountDrums() 拿到一個。想要時鐘而不要卡片的時候再自己建。 scheduler 決定什麼時候打什麼的 DrumScheduler。 engine 發聲的引擎，通常是 drumEngine()。它有 context 這個屬性（一個 AudioContext，啟用之前是 null）的話，鼓點就用那個時鐘提前排程。沒有的話，每一下鼓就在聽到的那一刻呼叫 engine.noteOn(note, vel) 來打。 onStep onStep(i, n, ev)，每個十六分音符步在聽到的時候呼叫。ev.quiet 和 ev.announce 說明它是不是被安靜地告知（見下面）。 onHit onHit(voice, vel, ev)，每一下鼓在聽到的時候呼叫。 onLate onLate(margin, transport)：因為頁面佔住主執行緒的時間比預讀還長，有一下鼓交給鼓組的時候已經過了它的時間。margin 是它早了幾秒（負的或很小）。 autoEnable 引擎還沒有 AudioContext 的話，在 start() 時呼叫 engine.enable()。 now 回傳目前時間（秒）的函式。測試時傳自己的，就能用假的時鐘帶動傳輸控制。 hidden 沒有人看得到頁面時回傳 true 的函式。 heartbeat 誰來呼叫 pump()：'auto' 是 Web Worker 的計時器（被藏起來的分頁不會讓 worker 變慢），不行就退回 setInterval。'interval' 一律用 setInterval。false（或 'none'）是沒人叫，你自己呼叫 pump() 或 frame()。 tick 兩次心跳之間隔幾秒。 latency…

records.d: The General MIDI drum note each drum of the kit plays: GM.kick is 36, GM.snare is 38.
records.x: Drum pads and drum machines send these notes on MIDI channel 10. The drum machine sends them as midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 } for every hit, so anything that listens to MIDI hears the drums. The reverse, from a note to a drum, is voiceForNote(), which also knows the neighbouring General MIDI notes (35 is also a kick, 40 is also a snare). { kick: 36, rim: 37, snare: 38, clap: 39, lowtom: 41, hat: 42, pedalhat: 44, tom: 45, openhat: 46, hightom: 48, crash: 49, ride: 51, cowbell: 56 }: drum name to MIDI note number.

records.x: 打擊墊和鼓機在 MIDI 頻道 10 送這些音符。鼓機每打一下就送一個 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 }，所以任何聽 MIDI 的東西都聽得到鼓。從音符反查是哪種鼓用 voiceForNote()，它也認得 General MIDI 相鄰的音符（35 也是大鼓，40 也是小鼓）。 { kick: 36, rim: 37, snare: 38, clap: 39, lowtom: 41, hat: 42, pedalhat: 44, tom: 45, openhat: 46, hightom: 48, crash: 49, ride: 51, cowbell: 56 }：鼓的名字對應 MIDI 音符號碼。

records.d: Turns a lane written as text, like 'x...x...x...x...', or as a list into 16 steps of 0 and 1.
records.x: It is how every grid you write is read: { kick: 'x...x...x...x...' } in DrumSequencer, DrumScheduler and startDrums(). 'x... x... x... x...' and '1000100010001000' are the same lane. Note that the dot is a rest here, and only here: in a line of rhythm (see compile()) a rest is ~. v The lane. In text, x, X and 1 are hits and everything else is a rest; spaces and | are ignored, so they can help the eye. In a list, 1 and true are hits. An array of 16 numbers, 1 for a hit and 0 for a rest. A short lane is padded with rests, a long one is cut at 16.

records.d: 把寫成文字的軌道，像 'x...x...x...x...'，或寫成陣列的軌道，變成 16 格 0 和 1。

records.d: Puts a drum machine on the page: a step grid, a transport and a line of rhythm you can type into. It publishes every hit as drum/ signals.
records.x: mountDrums(el, { signals }) builds a drum machine card inside el: a play checkbox, a preset menu, a tempo slider, the bar it is in, and a grid with a lane per drum (kick, snare, hat, clap, and a row of their own for the crash, ride, toms and open hat that a line of rhythm uses). A click on a cell toggles it. The returned object lets you do from code what the card does with the mouse: play(true), setPattern('breakbeat'), setBpm(96). You must call drums.update(dt) every frame, with the seconds since the last one. It moves the machine (with the frame clock), tells your onStep and onHit what is heard, paints the grid and lets the drum//env signals decay. A machine that is never updated does not move. Hits travel the same road as a drummer heard through the microphone, so a sketch written for the microphone moves over unchanged: drum/kick, drum/snare, drum/hat, drum/clap as pulses with { level }, drum//env as continuous 0..1 values, and midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 } with the General MIDI drum note (see GM). A voice a line of rhythm adds, like drum/crash, is defined the first time it is hit. Give it the pattern module (rhythm) and the line of rhythm is always shown over the grid: a preset shows the line its grid is ('four on floor' is bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8), and the word that sounds lights up. Then the two edit each other. A click on a cell rewrites the line (with fromGrid()). Typing in the line changes the cells: Enter, or 400 ms without a key, plays what was typed. A mistake…

records.d: 在頁面上放一台鼓機：步進格子、播放控制，和一行可以直接打字修改的節奏。它把每一下鼓發布成 drum/ 訊號。
records.x: mountDrums(el, { signals }) 在 el 裡蓋一張鼓機卡：播放勾選框、預設選單、速度滑桿、現在在第幾小節，和一個每種鼓一條軌道的格子（大鼓、小鼓、鈸、拍手，一行節奏用到的碎音鈸、疊音鈸、中鼓、開鈸各有自己的一列）。點一個格子就切換它。回傳的物件讓你用程式做卡片上用滑鼠做的事：play(true)、setPattern('breakbeat')、setBpm(96)。 每個畫面都要呼叫 drums.update(dt)，參數是距離上一個畫面過了幾秒。它讓鼓機前進（用 frame 時鐘的時候）、把聽到的事告訴你的 onStep 和 onHit、畫格子，並讓 drum//env 訊號衰減。從來不更新的鼓機不會動。 鼓點走的路跟麥克風聽到的鼓手一樣，所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成它：drum/kick、drum/snare、drum/hat、drum/clap 是帶 { level } 的脈衝，drum//env 是 0..1 的連續值，還有 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 }，音符是 General MIDI 的鼓音符（見 GM）。一行節奏多出來的鼓，像 drum/crash，會在第一次被打到的時候才定義。 把鼓的模組（rhythm）交給它，格子上面就一直有那一行節奏：預設會顯示它的格子圖是哪一行（'four on floor' 就是 bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8），正在響的字會亮起來。接著兩邊互相修改。點一個格子會改寫那一行（用 fromGrid()）。在那一行打字會改變格子：按 Enter，或停手 400 毫秒，就播放打進去的內容。有錯的地方標紅、通知 onEditError，上一行能用的繼續打。按 Escape 丟掉還沒播的。每次改動都存在 history。卡上的 ↶，或碰過卡片之後按 Cmd/Ctrl+Z，退一步。Copy 把那一行放進剪貼簿，Open in Strudel 在新分頁的 strudel.cc 打開它（strudelUrl()）。 回傳的物件提供這些： 需要有 DOM 的頁面，而且每個畫面都要呼叫 update(dt)。聲音要等瀏覽器：鼓組的 AudioContext 在第一下鼓（用 lookahead 時鐘的話是 play()）的時候才建立，頁面被點一下之前它都是暫停的。回呼和訊號從一開始就會跑。聲音在第一次點擊之後才進來，點擊之前的鼓不會補打。 用 clock: 'frame' 的時候，編譯過的一行只有第一小節會在四條軌道、十六格的格子上打：落在格子之間的鼓點會移到最近的一格，沒有軌道的鼓（碎音鈸、疊音鈸、中鼓、開鈸）會被略過，console 會說一聲。clock: 'lookahead' 則照寫的樣子打。 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己呼叫：startDrums() 會替你蓋這張卡，用 lookahead 時鐘，並且每個畫面幫你呼叫 update()。 container 要放鼓機卡的元素。dispose() 會把它拆掉。 signals 一個 Signals 匯流排。每一下鼓都會發布成 drum/（脈衝 { level }）、drum//env（0..1，會衰減）和 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 }。沒給的話鼓機照樣會打、會呼叫你的函式，但什麼都不發布。 engine 發聲的引擎。沒給的話，鼓機自己做一個 drumEngine()。任何有 enable() 和 noteOn(note, vel01, time)…

records.d: The five preset grids of the drum machine: 'four on floor', breakbeat, 'half time', latin and sparse.
records.x: The preset names are what startDrums(), DrumSequencer and mountDrums() accept as a pattern. A preset is just data, so you can start from one: { ...PATTERNS.latin, clap: 'x...x...x...x...' } is latin with a clap on every beat. The five presets as text, one lane per column: Five presets, each { kick, snare, hat, clap } as 16-character strings of 1 and 0.

records.k: presets patterns four on floor breakbeat half time latin sparse beats grids 預設 節奏 four on floor breakbeat half time latin sparse 格子圖
records.d: 鼓機內建的五個預設格子圖：'four on floor'、breakbeat、'half time'、latin、sparse。
records.x: 預設的名稱就是 startDrums()、DrumSequencer、mountDrums() 的 pattern 收的值。預設就只是資料，所以你可以從其中一個開始改：{ ...PATTERNS.latin, clap: 'x...x...x...x...' } 就是在 latin 上每一拍加一下拍手。 五個預設的內容，一欄一條軌道： 五個預設，每個都是 { kick, snare, hat, clap }，各是 16 個字的 1 和 0。

records.k: general midi note to drum channel 10 pad drum map reverse lookup general midi 音符對應鼓 頻道 10 打擊墊 鼓對照表 反查
records.d: Tells which drum of the kit a General MIDI drum note plays, or null for a note it does not play.
records.x: Pads and drum machines send notes on channel 10, and several notes map to the same drum: 35 and 36 are kicks, 38 and 40 snares, 41 and 43 low toms, 45 and 47 toms, 48 and 50 high toms, 49, 52, 55 and 57 crashes, 51, 53 and 59 rides. A note that is not in the table, such as a melodic 60, gives null: the kit stays silent instead of guessing, because a wrong cymbal on a kick pad is worse than nothing. note A MIDI note number. The drum name ('kick', 'crash'…), or null.

records.k: general midi note to drum channel 10 pad drum map reverse lookup general midi 音符對應鼓 頻道 10 打擊墊 鼓對照表 反查
records.d: 告訴你一個 General MIDI 鼓音符會打鼓組裡的哪一種鼓，不打的音符回傳 null。
records.x: 打擊墊和鼓機在頻道 10 送音符，好幾個音符會對到同一種鼓：35 和 36 是大鼓，38 和 40 是小鼓，41 和 43 是落地鼓，45 和 47 是中鼓，48 和 50 是高音中鼓，49、52、55、57 是碎音鈸，51、53、59 是疊音鈸。不在表裡的音符，像旋律用的 60，會回傳 null：鼓組寧可不出聲也不亂猜，因為大鼓的打擊墊打出錯的鈸，比沒聲音還糟。 note MIDI 音符號碼。 鼓的名字（'kick'、'crash'…），或 null。

records.k: rhythm mini-notation tidal strudel pattern drum parse events bar eventsInBar 節奏 一行節奏 鼓點 小節 編譯 解析 strudel 歐幾里得 鼓機
records.d: Reads one line of rhythm text, like 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8', and gives back the drum hits of any bar you ask for. It never throws.
records.x: compile() is the one function you need to turn a line of rhythm into hits. compile('bd sd hh').eventsInBar(1) answers "what happens in bar 1?" with a list of hits, sorted by pos. Bars count from 1, and one bar is one cycle of the line: the words share the bar equally, so bd sd hh puts a kick at 0, a snare at 1/3 and a hat at 2/3. Each hit from eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) is { word, voice, n, pos, dur, vel, layer, token }. word is what was written, voice the drum it plays ('kick'), pos where in the bar, 0 up to (not including) 1. dur is how long it lasts, in bars, and may run past the bar (bd/2 lasts two). vel is always 1. layer is the index of the comma part it came from. token is { start, end }, the character range of the word in src, so you can light the word while it sounds. n is the sample number from bd:2, or null. n is kept for you but does not change the sound. It never throws. A line it cannot read comes back as { ok: false, error }, and eventsInBar() returns [] for every bar, so check ok before you trust the hits. error.index and error.length mark the characters that are wrong, error.message and error.hint are English sentences, and error.code is one of empty, unclosed, unexpected, bad-number, bad-euclid, unknown-word or unsupported. An unknown-word error also carries suggestion, the closest word or null. The words and the symbols you can write are listed below. Modifiers chain in the order written (bd(3,8)2, hh8?). Word case does not matter (BD is bd). ? is decided…

records.k: rhythm mini-notation tidal strudel pattern drum parse events bar eventsInBar 節奏 一行節奏 鼓點 小節 編譯 解析 strudel 歐幾里得 鼓機
records.d: 把一行節奏文字，像 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'，讀成任何一個小節要打哪些鼓。它不會丟出錯誤。
records.x: 要把一行節奏變成鼓點，用 compile() 就夠了。compile('bd sd hh').eventsInBar(1) 回答「第 1 小節發生什麼事」，給你一串按 pos 排好的鼓點。小節從 1 開始數，一個小節就是這一行的一個循環：字平分這個小節，所以 bd sd hh 是大鼓在 0、小鼓在 1/3、鈸在 2/3。 eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) 給的每個鼓點是 { word, voice, n, pos, dur, vel, layer, token }。word 是寫的字，voice 是它打的鼓（'kick'），pos 是在小節的哪裡，從 0 到（不含）1。dur 是持續多久，單位是小節，可以超過這個小節（bd/2 長兩個小節）。vel 永遠是 1。layer 是它來自第幾個逗號層。token 是 { start, end }，這個字在 src 裡的字元範圍，字在響的時候可以拿來點亮它。n 是 bd:2 的取樣編號，沒寫就是 null。n 會保留給你，但不會改變聲音。 它不會丟出錯誤。讀不懂的一行會回傳 { ok: false, error }，而且每個小節的 eventsInBar() 都回傳 []，所以相信鼓點之前先檢查 ok。error.index 和 error.length 標出錯的字元，error.message 和 error.hint 是英文句子，error.code 是 empty、unclosed、unexpected、bad-number、bad-euclid、unknown-word、unsupported 其中之一。unknown-word 錯誤還會帶 suggestion，也就是最接近的字，沒有就是 null。可以寫的字和符號列在下面。 修飾符號照寫的順序一個接一個（bd(3,8)2、hh8?）。字的大小寫不影響（BD 就是 bd）。? 由 seed 和鼓點的時間決定，所以同一個 seed、同一個小節永遠打出一樣的鼓點，換一個小節或換一個 seed 就不同。不支援，並會用 unsupported 錯誤和提示拒絕的有：.（Strudel 的分組）、|、{ }、%、..、^。其中最重要的是點：像 'x...x...' 這種軌道字串不是一行節奏，休止要寫 ~。 內部的時間用精確的分數，每個小節各自計算。[bd sd sn]3 的第 1 000 000 小節跟第 1 小節落在一模一樣的九分之幾，問第 500 小節跟問第 2 小節一樣便宜。 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己呼叫：startDrums() 收下這一行，會替你編譯。想把鼓點當資料用，例如畫譜、畫圖或寫測試的時候，才自己呼叫 compile()。 這種寫法來自 TidalCycles 和 Strudel，這個套件是依他們的公開文件獨立實作的。刻意跟 strudel.cc 不同的地方（旋轉 n 格以上會繞回來、0 和 (9,8) 是錯誤、不認識的字是錯誤），套件的 README 都有寫。 src 一行節奏，例如 'bd sd hh'。不是字串的東西會被轉成字串（null 和 undefined 變成空的一行，那是錯誤）。 words 哪個字代表哪一種鼓：{ 字: 鼓聲 }。預設是 WORDS。要多加一個字，就把預設展開：{ ...WORDS, boom: 'kick' }。鼓聲要是鼓組會打的，見 GM。 { ok, error, src, voices, layers, period, eventsInBar(bar, { seed })…

records.k: euclidean euclid bjorklund toussaint tresillo cinquillo spread hits rhythm generator polyrhythm 歐幾里得 歐氏節奏 bjorklund 平均分配 節奏產生器 旋轉 tresillo
records.d: Spreads a number of hits as evenly as possible over a number of steps, the Euclidean rhythm. euclid(3, 8) is the tresillo.
records.x: It is the function behind bd(3,8) in a line of rhythm: compile() calls it for every (k,n). Use it on its own when you want the pattern as data, for a drawing or your own sequencer. euclid(3, 8) is x..x..x., and euclid(5, 8) is x.xx.xx.. It follows Bjorklund's procedure as Toussaint (2005) describes it. rotate moves the pattern later, the direction strudel.cc plays: euclid(3, 8, 2) is x.x..x.., the hits of euclid(3, 8) moved two steps to the right. pulses How many hits. A negative number plays the gaps instead: euclid(-3, 8) is the five steps euclid(3, 8) leaves out. More hits than steps fills every step. The number is cut to a whole number. steps How many steps. Fewer than 1 gives an empty array. rotate Start the pattern this many steps later. Negative starts earlier, and a number of steps or more wraps around. An array of steps booleans, true where there is a hit.

records.k: euclidean euclid bjorklund toussaint tresillo cinquillo spread hits rhythm generator polyrhythm 歐幾里得 歐氏節奏 bjorklund 平均分配 節奏產生器 旋轉 tresillo
records.d: 把一些鼓點盡量平均地分在一些格子上，也就是歐幾里得節奏。euclid(3, 8) 就是 tresillo。
records.x: 一行節奏裡的 bd(3,8) 就是靠它：compile() 每遇到一個 (k,n) 就會呼叫它。想把這個節奏當資料用，例如畫圖或接到自己的音序器，就單獨呼叫它。euclid(3, 8) 是 x..x..x.，euclid(5, 8) 是 x.xx.xx.。 它照 Toussaint（2005）說明的 Bjorklund 方法做。rotate 把節奏往後移，方向跟 strudel.cc 一樣：euclid(3, 8, 2) 是 x.x..x..，也就是 euclid(3, 8) 的鼓點往右移兩格。 pulses 有幾下。負數會打空隙：euclid(-3, 8) 是 euclid(3, 8) 沒打的那五格。比格數多的話，每一格都會打。小數會被去掉。 steps 有幾格。小於 1 會得到空陣列。 rotate 讓節奏晚這麼多格開始。負數是提早，steps 以上的數字會繞回來。 一個長度 steps 的布林陣列，有鼓點的地方是 true。

records.k: grid steps step sequencer cells lanes to text write rhythm drum machine card 格子 步進 步進音序器 軌道 轉成文字 鼓機卡 一行節奏
records.d: Turns a grid of steps, like the drum machine card, into the one line of rhythm a person would write for it.
records.x: It is what happens when you click a cell of the drum machine card: the grid has to come back as text. Each lane becomes one layer, joined with , , and it picks the shortest honest spelling. Steady hits become bd4 or hh8, one hit per group [~ sd]2, a Euclidean rhythm bd(3,8), and anything else is written beat by beat, like bd [~ ~ ~ bd] bd2 ~. It never throws. The line is exact: compile() of the result lands on the same steps, in every bar. The rules are in the package README, and the tests check a thousand random grids. grid The steps: { lane: 'x...x...' } or { lane: [1, 0, 0, 0, …] }. A lane is named by its drum (kick) or its word (bd). x, X, 1 and true are hits, | and spaces are ignored. A lane with no name the kit knows is left out. steps How many steps each lane has. words Keep your own spelling: { kick: 'kick' } writes kick4 instead of bd4. order Drums to put first, in this order, for example ['kick', 'snare']. The rest follow in the order of the grid's keys. One line of rhythm that plays exactly the grid. A grid with no hit anywhere gives '~'.

records.k: grid steps step sequencer cells lanes to text write rhythm drum machine card 格子 步進 步進音序器 軌道 轉成文字 鼓機卡 一行節奏
records.d: 把一張格子圖，像鼓機卡上的那種，轉成一個人會為它寫的那一行節奏。
records.x: 按下鼓機卡上的一個格子，就是在做這件事：格子圖要變回文字。每條軌道變成一層，用 , 接起來，並選最短又準確的寫法。平穩的鼓點寫成 bd4 或 hh8，每組一下寫成 [~ sd]2，歐幾里得節奏寫成 bd(3,8)，其他的一拍一拍寫，像 bd [~ ~ ~ bd] bd2 ~。它不會丟出錯誤。 這一行是精確的：把結果交給 compile()，每個小節都會落在同樣的格子上。規則寫在套件的 README，測試用一千張隨機的格子圖驗證過。 grid 格子：{ 軌道: 'x...x...' } 或 { 軌道: [1, 0, 0, 0, …] }。軌道可以用鼓的名字（kick）或字（bd）命名。x、X、1、true 是鼓點，| 和空白會被忽略。名字不是鼓組認得的軌道會被丟掉。 steps 每條軌道有幾格。 words 保留你自己的寫法：{ kick: 'kick' } 會寫成 kick4 而不是 bd4。 order 要放在最前面的鼓，照這個順序，例如 ['kick', 'snare']。其他的接在後面，照格子圖的鍵的順序。 一行剛好打出這張格子圖的節奏。完全沒有鼓點的格子圖會得到 '~'。

records.k: strudel strudel.cc import paste tidal live coding setcpm fast slow strudel 匯入 貼上 直播編碼 live coding 速度 setcpm
records.d: Reads code copied from strudel.cc, like s("bd4").fast(2), into the line of rhythm OAV plays, plus the tempo it found.
records.x: It lets someone paste what they made in Strudel. It reads s("…") and sound("…") with ", ' or backtick quotes. Several of them (also with a label like $: or name: in front) become layers. A .fast(n) or .slow(n) is folded into the line as […]n or […]/n. setcpm(x) gives bpm as x times 4, setcps(x) as x times 240. .bank(…) goes to ignored, because OAV plays its own kit. Any other call or statement goes to unsupported, and the rest still plays. It never throws. It only reshapes text: it does not check the words. fromStrudel('s("bd kik")') gives ok: true with src: 'bd kik', so pass src to compile() and look at its ok. startDrums() accepts Strudel code directly and does all of this for you. code The Strudel code, as copied from the strudel.cc editor. { strudel, ok, src, bpm, ignored, unsupported }. strudel is false when the text has no s(…) or sound(…) in it. ok is true when there is a line of rhythm in src. bpm is the tempo from setcpm() or setcps(), else null. ignored lists what was left out on purpose (.bank(…)), unsupported what OAV does not do (.jux(rev), .gain(…)).

records.k: strudel strudel.cc import paste tidal live coding setcpm fast slow strudel 匯入 貼上 直播編碼 live coding 速度 setcpm
records.d: 把從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式碼，像 s("bd4").fast(2)，讀成 OAV 會打的那一行節奏，並附上找到的速度。
records.x: 它讓人可以貼上自己在 Strudel 做的東西。它讀 s("…") 和 sound("…")，引號可以是 "、' 或反引號。好幾個（前面也可以有 $: 或 name: 這種標籤）會變成好幾層。.fast(n) 或 .slow(n) 會折進那一行，變成 […]n 或 […]/n。setcpm(x) 的 bpm 是 x 乘 4，setcps(x) 是 x 乘 240。.bank(…) 進 ignored，因為 OAV 打的是自己的鼓組。其他的呼叫或敘述都進 unsupported，剩下的照樣會打。它不會丟出錯誤。 它只是把文字重新整理，不會檢查字。fromStrudel('s("bd kik")') 會回 ok: true 和 src: 'bd kik'，所以要把 src 交給 compile()，看它的 ok。startDrums() 可以直接收 Strudel 程式碼，這些事都替你做了。 code 從 strudel.cc 編輯器複製來的 Strudel 程式碼。 { strudel, ok, src, bpm, ignored, unsupported }。文字裡沒有 s(…) 或 sound(…) 的話，strudel 是 false。src 裡有一行節奏的話，ok 是 true。bpm 是 setcpm() 或 setcps() 給的速度，沒有就是 null。ignored 列出刻意略過的（.bank(…)），unsupported 列出 OAV 不做的（.jux(rev)、.gain(…)）。

records.k: parse tree syntax grammar ast mini-notation nodes tokens 解析 語法樹 文法 節點 一行節奏 字元範圍
records.d: Reads a line of rhythm into a tree of nodes, each with its character range. It does not look words up in the drum kit.
records.x: parse() is the first half of compile(): it checks the grammar and builds the tree, and stops there. Use it when you want to look at the structure of a line, for example to colour its words or find a mistake. For the hits, call compile(). The root is always a layer whose layers are the top-level comma parts, and each of those is a seq. The node types are step { word, n }, rest, seq { steps: [{ node, weight }] }, layer { layers }, alt { steps } (one per bar), fast and slow { factor, node }, euclid { pulses, slots, rotate, node } and maybe { chance, id, node }. Every node has start and end, its character range in src. Weights and factors are fractions [numerator, denominator], so bd1.5 has the factor [3, 2]. Because parse() never looks at the drum kit, parse('kik') succeeds while compile('kik') fails with unknown-word. Everything else (an unclosed bracket, 0, (9,8)) fails in both. src The line of rhythm, for example 'bd [sd sd]'. { ok: true, tree, error: null }, or { ok: false, tree: null, error } with the same { code, index, length, message, hint } error as compile().

records.k: parse tree syntax grammar ast mini-notation nodes tokens 解析 語法樹 文法 節點 一行節奏 字元範圍
records.d: 把一行節奏讀成一棵節點樹，每個節點都帶著它的字元範圍。它不會去查鼓組有沒有這個字。
records.x: parse() 是 compile() 的前半段：只檢查文法、建出樹，到此為止。想看一行的結構，例如幫字上色或找錯誤的時候用它。要鼓點的話，呼叫 compile()。 樹根永遠是 layer，它的 layers 是最上層用逗號分開的幾部分，每一部分是一個 seq。節點的種類有 step { word, n }、rest、seq { steps: [{ node, weight }] }、layer { layers }、alt { steps }（每小節一個）、fast 和 slow { factor, node }、euclid { pulses, slots, rotate, node }、maybe { chance, id, node }。每個節點都有 start 和 end，也就是它在 src 裡的字元範圍。權重和倍數是分數 [分子, 分母]，所以 bd1.5 的倍數是 [3, 2]。 因為 parse() 不看鼓組，parse('kik') 會成功，compile('kik') 卻會失敗，錯誤是 unknown-word。其他的錯（括號沒關、0、(9,8)）兩個都會失敗。 src 一行節奏，例如 'bd [sd sd]'。 { ok: true, tree, error: null }，或 { ok: false, tree: null, error }，error 跟 compile() 的一樣，是 { code, index, length, message, hint }。

records.k: short names bd sd hh reverse words voice to word 短字 縮寫 鼓的名字 反查 bd sd hh
records.d: The short word Tidal and Strudel write for each drum: kick is bd, snare is sd. The other direction from WORDS.
records.x: fromGrid() writes with these words when you do not give it your own spelling, and toStrudel() uses them (with hh for pedalhat) to speak Strudel. A frozen object of 13 { voice: word } pairs, one per drum of the kit. pedalhat has no short word, so it maps to 'pedalhat', OAV's own.

records.k: short names bd sd hh reverse words voice to word 短字 縮寫 鼓的名字 反查 bd sd hh
records.d: Tidal 和 Strudel 為每種鼓寫的短字：kick 是 bd，snare 是 sd。跟 WORDS 方向相反。
records.x: fromGrid() 沒給你自己的寫法時，就是用這些字寫。toStrudel() 也用它們（pedalhat 用 hh）來說 Strudel 的話。 一個凍結的物件，有 13 組 { 鼓聲: 字 }，鼓組每種鼓一組。pedalhat 沒有短字，所以對到 OAV 自己的 'pedalhat'。

records.k: strudel link url open share strudel.cc base64 strudel 連結 網址 打開 分享 base64
records.d: Makes a strudel.cc link that opens the line of rhythm in the Strudel editor.
records.x: The format is the one strudel.cc shows in its own address bar. It is what the drum machine card's Open in Strudel link uses. Open it in a new tab: a strudel.cc tab that is already open does not read a changed #. OAV only builds the link. No Strudel code runs in, or ships with, OAV. src The line of rhythm. opts The options of toStrudel(): { bpm, comment, words }. A URL: 'https://strudel.cc/#' and the code from toStrudel(), as UTF-8 base64, URL-encoded.

records.k: strudel link url open share strudel.cc base64 strudel 連結 網址 打開 分享 base64
records.d: 做出一個 strudel.cc 的連結，打開後 Strudel 編輯器裡就是這一行節奏。
records.x: 格式就是 strudel.cc 自己的網址列顯示的那種，鼓機卡上的 在 Strudel 打開 連結用的就是它。要在新分頁打開：已經開著的 strudel.cc 分頁不會重讀改變過的 #。 OAV 只是做出連結，沒有任何 Strudel 的程式碼在 OAV 裡執行，也沒有隨 OAV 一起發佈。 src 一行節奏。 opts toStrudel() 的選項：{ bpm, comment, words }。 一個網址：'https://strudel.cc/#' 加上 toStrudel() 的程式碼，轉成 UTF-8 的 base64，再做網址編碼。

records.k: grid steps cells to grid step sequencer quantize triplet off grid lossy 格子 步進 轉成格子 三連音 對齊格子 鼓機卡 放不下
records.d: Shows one bar of a line of rhythm on a grid of steps, and tells you what the grid cannot hold.
records.x: It is the way back from fromGrid(), and what the drum machine card uses to draw the cells of a line. Each hit goes to the step it is nearest to. The lost fields say what that cost: offGrid is the number of hits that sit between steps (triplets) and were moved to the nearest one. stacked counts two hits of one drum on one step. varies is true when other bars differ (, /2). random is true when the line has a ?. samples is true when it has a sample number like bd:2. exact is true only when none of these happened. A line that fails to compile does not throw: you get ok: false. p A line of rhythm, or the result of compile(). bar Which bar to show, counting from 1. steps How many steps the grid has. seed Decides each ?, the same way as in eventsInBar(). bars How many bars to look through to find out whether the other bars differ (lost.varies). At most the line's period, and never more than 64. words Which words mean which drum, the same as in compile(). { ok, grid, words, voices, exact, lost }. grid is { voice: [0 or 1 × steps] }. words is the word the line used for each drum. voices lists the drums. exact is true when the grid holds the bar completely. lost counts what it cannot: { offGrid, stacked, varies, random, samples }. If the line cannot be read, ok is false and the rest is empty.

records.k: grid steps cells to grid step sequencer quantize triplet off grid lossy 格子 步進 轉成格子 三連音 對齊格子 鼓機卡 放不下
records.d: 把一行節奏的某一個小節畫成格子圖，並告訴你格子放不下哪些東西。
records.x: 它是 fromGrid() 的反方向，鼓機卡就是用它畫出一行節奏的格子。每個鼓點會放到離它最近的那一格。lost 的欄位告訴你這樣損失了什麼：offGrid 是落在格子之間（三連音）而被移到最近一格的鼓點數量。stacked 是同一種鼓在同一格有兩下。varies 為 true 表示其他小節不一樣（、/2）。random 為 true 表示這一行有 ?。samples 為 true 表示有像 bd:2 的取樣編號。只有這些都沒發生，exact 才是 true。 編譯失敗的一行不會丟出錯誤，你會得到 ok: false。 p 一行節奏，或 compile() 的結果。 bar 要看哪個小節，從 1 開始數。 steps 格子有幾格。 seed 決定每一個 ?，跟 eventsInBar() 裡的用法一樣。 bars 要看幾個小節，用來判斷其他小節有沒有不同（lost.varies）。最多看到這一行的 period，而且不會超過 64。 words 哪個字代表哪一種鼓，跟 compile() 一樣。 { ok, grid, words, voices, exact, lost }。grid 是 { 鼓聲: [0 或 1，共 steps 個] }。words 是這一行為每種鼓用的字。voices 列出鼓。exact 是 true 表示格子完整放得下這個小節。lost 數出放不下的東西：{ offGrid, stacked, varies, random, samples }。這一行讀不懂的話，ok 是 false，其他都是空的。

records.k: strudel export strudel.cc open in strudel setcpm bd convert strudel 匯出 轉成 strudel 速度 setcpm 轉換
records.d: Turns a line of rhythm into Strudel code: OAV's drum words become Strudel's, with a tempo line and a comment if you give them.
records.x: The words become the names Strudel's drum sounds use: kick becomes bd, pedalhat becomes hh. A rotation of n steps or more in a Euclidean part, like bd(3,8,10), is written as the rotation OAV plays (bd(3,8,2)), because strudel.cc would play it unrotated. A line that does not read is passed through unchanged, so the result may not play in Strudel: check it with compile() first. It never throws. To open the result in the Strudel editor, use strudelUrl(). src The line of rhythm. bpm The tempo. When it is above 0 a setcpm(bpm/4) line is written, because one OAV bar is one Strudel cycle of four beats. comment A line to put first as a // comment. words Which words mean which drum, the same as in compile(). The Strudel code, one to three lines, ending in s("…").

records.k: strudel export strudel.cc open in strudel setcpm bd convert strudel 匯出 轉成 strudel 速度 setcpm 轉換
records.d: 把一行節奏轉成 Strudel 程式碼：OAV 的鼓的字換成 Strudel 的字，有給的話還會加上速度那行和註解。
records.x: 字會換成 Strudel 的鼓的名字：kick 變 bd，pedalhat 變 hh。歐幾里得的旋轉在 n 格以上的，像 bd(3,8,10)，會寫成 OAV 實際打的旋轉（bd(3,8,2)），因為 strudel.cc 會把它當作沒旋轉。讀不懂的一行會原樣放過去，所以結果在 Strudel 裡可能打不出來，先用 compile() 檢查。它不會丟出錯誤。 要在 Strudel 編輯器裡打開結果，用 strudelUrl()。 src 一行節奏。 bpm 速度。大於 0 的話會寫一行 setcpm(bpm/4)，因為 OAV 的一個小節就是 Strudel 的一個四拍的循環。 comment 要放在最前面的一行 // 註解。 words 哪個字代表哪一種鼓，跟 compile() 一樣。 Strudel 程式碼，一到三行，最後一行是 s("…")。

records.k: words drum names bd sd hh vocabulary kick snare hat sound names 字 鼓的名字 詞彙 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 bd sd hh
records.d: The drum words a line of rhythm may use and the drum each one plays: bd is kick, sd is snare, hh is hat.
records.x: The short words are the ones TidalCycles and Strudel use: bd kick, sd and sn snare, hh hat, oh open hat, cp clap, rim and rs rim, lt low tom, mt tom, ht high tom, cr crash, rd ride, cb cowbell. Each drum's own name works too: kick, snare, hat, openhat, pedalhat, clap, lowtom, tom, hightom, crash, ride, cowbell. The values are the drum names of GM. It is the default of the words option of compile(), toGrid() and toStrudel(). To teach a line a new word, pass a copy with your word added. A frozen object of 26 { word: voice } pairs. Keys are lowercase, and compile() ignores the case of what you write.

records.k: words drum names bd sd hh vocabulary kick snare hat sound names 字 鼓的名字 詞彙 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 bd sd hh
records.d: 一行節奏可以用的鼓的字，以及每個字打哪一種鼓：bd 是 kick，sd 是 snare，hh 是 hat。
records.x: 短的字是 TidalCycles 和 Strudel 用的：bd 大鼓、sd 和 sn 小鼓、hh 鈸、oh 開鈸、cp 拍手、rim 和 rs 鼓邊、lt 落地鼓、mt 中鼓、ht 高音中鼓、cr 碎音鈸、rd 疊音鈸、cb 牛鈴。每種鼓自己的名字也能用：kick、snare、hat、openhat、pedalhat、clap、lowtom、tom、hightom、crash、ride、cowbell。值就是 GM 裡的鼓的名字。 它是 compile()、toGrid()、toStrudel() 的 words 選項的預設值。要讓一行節奏認得新的字，就傳一份加了你的字的複本。 一個凍結的物件，有 26 組 { 字: 鼓聲 }。鍵是小寫，compile() 不管你寫的大小寫。

records.k: bar started new bar bar event downbeat measure callback 小節開始 新的一小節 小節事件 強拍 callback
records.d: An event you define: it is called at the first step of every bar of the drum machine, with the bar number.
records.x: Define function barStarted(bar) { … } to do something once per bar: function barStarted(bar) { drift += 9; }. It is called in the frame where the first step of the bar is heard, right before draw(), and the first call is barStarted(1) when the machine starts. Within a step, cueFired() comes before it and stepStarted() after. While the tab is hidden it is still called once per bar, but nothing is told twice when the tab comes back. stepStarted() and the hits are not told in that time. bar The bar that starts, counted from 1.

records.k: bar started new bar bar event downbeat measure callback 小節開始 新的一小節 小節事件 強拍 callback
records.d: 一個由你定義的事件函式：鼓機每一小節的第一格就會呼叫它，帶著小節的號碼。
records.x: 定義 function barStarted(bar) { … }，就可以每小節做一次事：function barStarted(bar) { drift += 9; }。它是在你聽到那一小節第一格的那個畫面、draw() 之前被呼叫的，鼓機啟動時的第一次呼叫是 barStarted(1)。在同一格裡，cueFired() 在它之前，stepStarted() 在它之後。 分頁被藏起來的時候，每一小節仍然會呼叫一次，分頁回來的時候也不會補呼叫漏掉的。這段時間不會呼叫 stepStarted()，也不會通知打擊。 bar 剛開始的小節，從 1 算起。

records.k: cue schedule timeline scene at bar plan automation sections repeat cue 時間軸 場景 排程 第幾小節 安排 段落 重複
records.d: Plans something for a bar: at bar bar the function cueFired(name, bar) is called and cueName becomes name; with every, again every that many bars.
records.x: The drum machine counts the bars, so it can run a plan: cue(1, 'calm', 12); cue(5, 'bloom', 12); cue(9, 'storm', 12); in setup() makes three scenes that come round every 12 bars. When a cue is due, cueFired(name, bar) is called and cueName holds the name; read it in draw() if you prefer that to a callback. Several cues on one step fire in the order you declared them, before barStarted(), stepStarted() and the hits of that step. Calling cue() twice with the same values adds nothing, so it is safe in draw() too. Counting starts with startDrums(), and a cue only fires when the machine passes its place: declare the cues right after startDrums() in setup() so that a cue at bar 1 is not missed. After the machine is stopped and started again, the cues fire again from bar 1. A cue declared after its bar has passed fires at its next repeat if it has an every, otherwise never until the machine is started again. Without a running machine no cue fires at all. bar The bar, counted from 1 (the first bar). A fraction is a place inside a bar: 4.5 is halfway through bar 4 (the nearest of the 16 steps is used). A value below 1, or one that is not a number, prints a warning in the console and adds nothing. name What to call it, usually a string. It is passed to cueFired() and becomes cueName. every Repeat every this many bars after the first time (fractions work, at least one step). 0 or left out: only once. Nothing. OAVp5.drums.cue() is the same function and returns the cue it made.

records.k: cue schedule timeline scene at bar plan automation sections repeat cue 時間軸 場景 排程 第幾小節 安排 段落 重複
records.d: 替某一小節安排事情：到了第 bar 小節，就呼叫 cueFired(name, bar)，cueName 變成 name，給了 every，之後每隔那麼多小節再來一次。
records.x: 鼓機會數小節，所以可以照著計畫走：在 setup() 裡寫 cue(1, 'calm', 12); cue(5, 'bloom', 12); cue(9, 'storm', 12);，就是三個場景，每 12 小節輪一圈。cue 到的時候會呼叫 cueFired(name, bar)，cueName 裡也會是它的名字，不想用 callback 的話，在 draw() 裡讀它就好。同一格有好幾個 cue 的時候，會依你宣告的順序發動，並且在 barStarted()、stepStarted() 和那一格的打擊之前。 用同樣的值呼叫兩次 cue() 不會重複加，所以放在 draw() 裡也安全。計數從 startDrums() 開始，cue 只在鼓機走過它的位置時才發動：請在 setup() 裡緊接著 startDrums() 宣告，第 1 小節的 cue 才不會漏掉。鼓機停止再啟動之後，cue 會從第 1 小節重新發動。 如果 cue 是在它的那一小節已經過了之後才宣告的，有 every 就會在下一次重複時發動，沒有的話，要等到鼓機重新啟動才會發動。鼓機沒在跑的時候，任何 cue 都不會發動。 bar 第幾小節，第一小節是 1。小數表示小節裡的位置：4.5 是第 4 小節的一半（會取最接近的那一格，共 16 格）。小於 1 或不是數字的值，會在主控台印一個警告，什麼都不會加。 name 給它取的名字，通常是字串。會傳給 cueFired()，並成為 cueName。 every 第一次之後，每隔這麼多小節再來一次（小數可以，至少一格）。0 或不傳：只發動一次。 沒有回傳值。OAVp5.drums.cue() 是同一個函式，它會回傳建立出來的 cue。

records.k: cue fired cue event scene change callback timeline event cue 發動 cue 事件 換場景 callback 時間軸事件
records.d: An event you define: it is called when the bar of a cue declared with cue() has come, with the cue's name and the bar.
records.x: Define function cueFired(name, bar) { … } and it is called at the step where a cue is due, before barStarted(), stepStarted() and the hits of that step. A good place to change a scene: function cueFired(name) { look = SCENES[name]; }. If you only need the latest name, read cueName in draw() instead. Cues keep firing while the tab is hidden, so the scene is right when you come back. Several cues on one step call it once each, in the order they were declared. name The name you gave to cue(). bar The bar the cue fired in, counted from 1. For a cue in the middle of a bar (4.5) it is the whole bar it falls in (4).

records.k: cue fired cue event scene change callback timeline event cue 發動 cue 事件 換場景 callback 時間軸事件
records.d: 一個由你定義的事件函式：用 cue() 宣告的 cue，到了它的那一小節就會呼叫它，帶著 cue 的名字和小節。
records.x: 定義 function cueFired(name, bar) { … }，cue 該發動的那一格就會呼叫它，順序在 barStarted()、stepStarted() 和那一格的打擊之前。很適合用來換場景：function cueFired(name) { look = SCENES[name]; }。如果你只需要最近的名字，在 draw() 裡讀 cueName 就好。 分頁被藏起來的時候，cue 照樣會發動，所以回來的時候場景是對的。同一格有好幾個 cue，會依宣告的順序各呼叫一次。 name 你給 cue() 的名字。 bar cue 發動時所在的小節，從 1 算起。小節中間的 cue（4.5）給的是它落在的那一整小節（4）。

records.k: cue name scene current scene last cue section name cue 名字 場景 目前場景 最近的 cue 段落名稱
records.d: The name of the last cue that fired, or an empty string before the first one.
records.x: Read it in draw() instead of waiting for cueFired(): look = SCENES[cueName];. It is the name of the last cue only, so it is the right thing for "which scene am I in", and cueFired() is the right thing for "something just began". Cues are declared with cue(). A sketch that declares its own variable called cueName keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.lastCue instead. Changes when a cue fires, and keeps the name until the next one. It is '' at the start.

records.k: cue name scene current scene last cue section name cue 名字 場景 目前場景 最近的 cue 段落名稱
records.d: 最近一個發動的 cue 的名字，第一個發動之前是空字串。
records.x: 可以在 draw() 裡直接讀，不用等 cueFired()：look = SCENES[cueName];。它只是最近一個 cue 的名字，所以回答「我現在在哪個場景」用它最適合，「某件事剛剛開始」則適合用 cueFired()。cue 用 cue() 宣告。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 cueName 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.lastCue。 cue 發動的時候改變，之後一直是那個名字，直到下一個。一開始是 ''。

records.k: bar measure bar number section count bars timeline drums 小節 第幾小節 段落 計數小節 時間軸 鼓機
records.d: Which bar the drum machine is in, counted from 1 when it started.
records.x: A bar is 16 steps, four beats. Use it to give a piece a shape: floor((drumBar - 1) / 4) % 3 is the section number when you change every four bars. To make something happen at an exact bar, cue() is neater than testing drumBar in draw(). barStarted() is the function that is called at the start of each bar. Start the machine with startDrums(). Stopping and starting again counts from bar 1 again. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumBar keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.bar instead. 0 before the machine has played its first step, then 1, 2, 3 … with no upper limit. It keeps its last value when the machine stops.

records.k: bar measure bar number section count bars timeline drums 小節 第幾小節 段落 計數小節 時間軸 鼓機
records.d: 鼓機現在在第幾小節，從啟動的時候起算，第一小節是 1。
records.x: 一小節是 16 格、四拍。用它替作品安排結構：每四小節換一段的話，floor((drumBar - 1) / 4) % 3 就是現在是第幾段。要讓某件事剛好發生在某一小節，cue() 比在 draw() 裡判斷 drumBar 更簡潔。barStarted() 則是每小節開頭會被呼叫的函式。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機。停止之後再啟動，會從第 1 小節重新算起。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumBar 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.bar。 鼓機播第一格之前是 0，之後是 1、2、3 ……，沒有上限。鼓機停止之後停在最後的值。

records.k: step drum step sixteenth 16 steps sequencer step current step counter beat 格 第幾格 十六分音符 16 格 目前這一格 計數 鼓機
records.d: Which of the 16 steps of the bar the drum machine just played, from 0 to 15.
records.x: A bar has 16 steps (sixteenth notes) and a beat has 4, so drumStep % 4 === 0 is a beat and drumStep === 0 the start of a bar. At 120 bpm a step lasts 125 ms. Use it to light a cell or pick a frame: fill(i === drumStep ? 255 : 80). If you would rather be called on each step, define stepStarted(). For something that moves smoothly instead of in 16 jumps, use drumPhase. Start the machine with startDrums(). Before that, and when the machine is stopped, the value is 0 or the last one, so check drumsAreOn if the difference matters. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumStep keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.step instead. While the tab is hidden the clock keeps counting but nothing else is told. Changes in the frame in which a step is heard, right before draw(). 0 at the start, and it keeps its last value when the machine stops.

records.k: step drum step sixteenth 16 steps sequencer step current step counter beat 格 第幾格 十六分音符 16 格 目前這一格 計數 鼓機
records.d: 鼓機剛剛播到這一小節 16 格裡的第幾格，從 0 到 15。
records.x: 一小節有 16 格（十六分音符），一拍有 4 格，所以 drumStep % 4 === 0 就是正拍，drumStep === 0 是小節的開頭。速度 120 的時候一格是 125 毫秒。可以用它讓某一格亮起來或挑選畫面：fill(i === drumStep ? 255 : 80)。如果你比較想在每一格被呼叫，就定義 stepStarted()。想要平滑移動，不要 16 次跳動的話，用 drumPhase。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機。在那之前、以及鼓機停止之後，值是 0 或最後的值，這個差別重要的話，要檢查 drumsAreOn。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumStep 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.step。分頁被藏起來的時候，時鐘照樣在數，但不會通知任何事件。 在你聽到那一格的那個畫面、draw() 之前改變。一開始是 0，鼓機停止之後停在最後的值。

records.k: step started step event every step sixteenth tick callback beat 每一格 格開始 步進事件 十六分音符 callback 拍子
records.d: An event you define: it is called at every one of the 16 steps of the drum machine, with the step and the bar.
records.x: Define function stepStarted(step, bar) { … } for something on every step: if (step % 4 === 0) ping = 1; is a pulse on the beat. It is called in the frame where the step is heard, right before draw(), after barStarted() and before the hits of that step. drumStep holds the same number if you would rather read than be called. It is not called while the tab is hidden, so a sketch that adds a particle per step does not burst when you come back. step The step that starts, 0 to 15. Every 4 steps is a beat. bar The bar it is in, counted from 1.

records.k: step started step event every step sixteenth tick callback beat 每一格 格開始 步進事件 十六分音符 callback 拍子
records.d: 一個由你定義的事件函式：鼓機 16 格裡的每一格都會呼叫它，帶著這一格和小節。
records.x: 定義 function stepStarted(step, bar) { … }，每一格都能做事：if (step % 4 === 0) ping = 1; 就是每一拍脈動一下。它是在你聽到那一格的那個畫面、draw() 之前被呼叫的，在 barStarted() 之後、那一格的打擊之前。如果你比較想讀值而不是被呼叫，drumStep 裡是同一個數字。 分頁被藏起來的時候不會呼叫它，所以每一格就加一個粒子的草圖，在你回來的時候不會一口氣冒出一大堆。 step 剛開始的那一格，0 到 15。每 4 格是一拍。 bar 它所在的小節，從 1 算起。

records.k: count step count running count total steps ticks timeline position 計數 累計格數 總格數 時間軸位置
records.d: How many steps the drum machine has played since it started, from 0; -1 before the first one.
records.x: It is the single clock the others are cut from: drumBar is floor(count / 16) + 1, drumStep is count % 16, and cue() fires when count reaches the step of its bar. It is handy when you want one number that only grows: a position on a very long timeline, or an index into a list. Start the machine with startDrums(); it is -1 until the first step has played. Goes up by one at every step and never goes back to 0 at a new bar. It starts again from 0 when the machine is started again.

records.k: count step count running count total steps ticks timeline position 計數 累計格數 總格數 時間軸位置
records.d: 鼓機從啟動到現在一共播了幾格，從 0 開始算，第一格之前是 -1。
records.x: 其他的數字都是從它切出來的：drumBar 是 floor(count / 16) + 1，drumStep 是 count % 16，cue() 是在 count 走到它那一小節的位置時發動。想要一個只會一直變大的數字的時候很好用，例如很長的時間軸上的位置，或是清單的索引。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機，第一格播出來之前都是 -1。 每一格加一，到了新的小節也不會歸零。機器重新啟動的時候，才會從 0 重新算。

records.k: cue cue object schedule timeline return value cue 回傳 cue 時間軸 排程
records.d: The same as cue(bar, name, every), but it returns the cue it made (or the one that was already there), and null when bar is not valid.
records.x: Use it when you want to hold on to the cue, for example to find out which step it fires at. For a plain plan, cue() is shorter. The list of every cue is OAVp5.drums.cues. bar The bar, counted from 1; 4.5 is halfway through bar 4. See cue(). name What to call the cue. every Repeat every this many bars; 0 or left out: once. The cue: { bar, name, every, at, period, key } with at and period counted in steps. null if bar is below 1 or not a number. A repeat of an earlier call gives back the cue that exists.

records.k: cue cue object schedule timeline return value cue 回傳 cue 時間軸 排程
records.d: 跟 cue(bar, name, every) 一樣，但會回傳建立出來的 cue（或原本就有的那個），bar 無效的時候回傳 null。
records.x: 想拿著這個 cue 的時候用它，例如想知道它在第幾格發動。只是安排計畫的話，cue() 比較短。所有 cue 的清單在 OAVp5.drums.cues。 bar 第幾小節，從 1 算起，4.5 是第 4 小節的一半。見 cue()。 name 這個 cue 的名字。 every 每隔幾小節再來一次，0 或不傳：只一次。 這個 cue：{ bar, name, every, at, period, key }，其中 at 和 period 以格為單位。bar 小於 1 或不是數字就是 null。重複前面呼叫過的，會回傳已經存在的那個 cue。

records.k: cues cue list plan all cues timeline cue 清單 所有 cue 計畫 時間軸
records.d: The list of every cue declared so far, in the order they were declared.
records.x: Read it to show a plan on screen or to check what is declared. It is the machine's own list, so treat it as read-only; declare cues with cue(). Each item is { bar, name, every, at, period, key }: the values you passed, and at and period counted in steps. An empty list at the start.

records.k: cues cue list plan all cues timeline cue 清單 所有 cue 計畫 時間軸
records.d: 到目前為止宣告過的所有 cue，照宣告的順序排。
records.x: 想把計畫顯示在畫面上，或檢查宣告了哪些 cue 的時候讀它。它是鼓機自己的清單，請當成唯讀，要宣告 cue 請用 cue()。 每一項是 { bar, name, every, at, period, key }：你傳進去的值，以及以格為單位的 at 和 period。一開始是空的。

records.k: director segment module module enter exit update cue linger hold param layer crash status score player 導演 段落模組 模組 進場 退場 cue 餘韻 hold 參數圖層 崩潰 狀態
records.d: Runs a score's segment modules: enters each once, updates it every frame, exits it once, fires cues, and switches off a module that crashes without stopping the show.
records.x: A segment module is the code that performs one segment (the dawn, the storm, the finale). The director calls its hooks as the show moves through the score: Every hook gets a ctx: p (progress through the segment, 0 to 1; above 1 during linger; exactly 1 while holding), t (seconds into the segment), dt, dur, T (show time), segment, cue(name) and cueT(name) (where a cue sits, as a progress and in show seconds), phase ('active', 'linger', or 'failed' inside exit() after a crash), holding, held (seconds waited at a hold: a clock for ambient motion while T is frozen), playing and api. A module is entered once and exited once, however the show got there: a seek into the middle of a segment calls enter with the right p, so a module must be able to start from the middle. A module that throws is switched off alone: the director calls its exit() once with phase: 'failed', logs one console.error, and never calls it again; the other modules and the show carry on. Reset brings it back. In a show, createShow() builds the director from its score option and calls update() every frame after the timeline has advanced; the director's param() plugs into timeline.layer. Without createShow() you do that wiring yourself: director.update(timeline.t, dt, { holding: timeline.holding, playing: timeline.playing }). The last segment is never exited by time: while the show sits at its end (or past it), the last module stays entered. It exits on a seek that leaves it, or on reset(). A new segment's module…

records.k: director segment module module enter exit update cue linger hold param layer crash status score player 導演 段落模組 模組 進場 退場 cue 餘韻 hold 參數圖層 崩潰 狀態
records.d: 執行總譜的段落模組：每個模組進場一次、每個畫面更新、退場一次，觸發 cue，而且某個模組當掉時只關掉它，不會讓演出停下來。
records.x: 段落模組就是負責表演一個段落（黎明、暴風雨、終曲）的程式碼。演出走過總譜的時候，導演會呼叫它的掛鉤： 每個掛鉤都會收到一個 ctx：p（這一段走了多少，0 到 1，餘韻期間大於 1，hold 的時候剛好是 1）、t（段內第幾秒）、dt、dur、T（演出時間）、segment、cue(name) 和 cueT(name)（cue 的位置，一個是進度、一個是演出秒數）、phase（'active'、'linger'，崩潰後的 exit() 裡是 'failed'）、holding、held（在 hold 上等了幾秒，演出時間 T 凍結時可以拿它當環境動態的時鐘）、playing 和 api。 一個模組只進場一次、只退場一次，不管演出是怎麼走到那裡的：seek 到段落中間，會用正確的 p 呼叫 enter，所以模組必須能從中間開始。丟出錯誤的模組只有它自己會被關掉：導演用 phase: 'failed' 呼叫一次它的 exit()，印出一行 console.error，之後不再呼叫它，其他模組和演出照常進行。reset 可以把它請回來。 在演出裡，createShow() 依 score 選項建好導演，每個畫面在時間軸前進之後呼叫 update()，導演的 param() 接到 timeline.layer 上。不用 createShow() 的話，這些接線要自己做：director.update(timeline.t, dt, { holding: timeline.holding, playing: timeline.playing })。 最後一個段落不會因為時間而退場：演出停在尾端（或超過尾端）時，最後一個模組仍維持進場狀態。它只在 seek 離開或 reset() 時退場。 新段落的模組會先進場、舊的才退場，在 linger 期間兩個會同時在跑。 module 或 id 對不到任何段落的模組，或段落指定了沒人登記的模組（會列在 status().missing），都只是不被表演，演出照常進行。 score 要表演的 Score。必填，沒有的話建構函式會丟出 "Director needs a score"。 modules 段落模組：一個陣列（依每個模組的 id 對應到段落），或以段落 id 為 key 的物件。沒有模組的段落就單純不被表演。 api 每個模組的掛鉤收到的第一個參數（也是 ctx.api）。如果是函式，會在第一次需要時呼叫一次，然後使用它回傳的結果。 onStatus 當段落、hold 的狀態或被關掉的模組清單改變的時候，以 status() 呼叫，不是每個畫面都呼叫。 onCue 播放頭每經過一個 cue 就呼叫一次：{ name, cue, T, n, segment }。 maxStep 兩次 update() 之間跳超過這麼多秒，就算是 seek，中間的 cue 不會觸發。如果你用很高的 timeline.rate 排練，把它調大。

records.k: score cut cuts segment segments cue cues hold linger dur duration structure version show structure 總譜 樂譜 cut 段落 版本 cue 長度 結構 倒數 場景 hold
records.d: A show written as segments with lengths, never as absolute seconds: it works out every start, end, cue and countdown, for every version (cut) of the show.
records.x: A timeline written as a table of absolute seconds cannot grow: make one scene longer and every later cue, curve and if (t > 466) is wrong. In a score you write only how long each segment is, and Score computes every start, end, cue time, countdown and scene from those lengths. Change one dur and everything after it moves; a second version of the show is a few lines of data. A cut is one version of the show; a segment is one stretch of it: dur is the only time a segment has. cues are named moments (a ratio 0 in the page address picks the cut. Plain fields: cut (the id being performed), title, segments (each with start, end, dur, index, cues …), total (the length of the show), startT (where reset goes), scale and base. Segment and cue ids must not contain a dot: the dot is how cueTime('dusk.glow') separates a segment from its cue. A cue cannot be called end. If two cuts differ in structure and not only in length, do not share automation between them. Drive the params from the segment modules instead, where ctx.p already scales for free. cuts The cuts this show can be performed as: an array of cuts, or an object keyed by cut id. A cut is { id, title?, start?, segments: [...] }, or a derived one, { id, title?, from, scale }. Required: without a cut it throws. cut The id of the cut to perform. Defaults to the first one; an id that is not in cuts is an error.

records.k: score cut cuts segment segments cue cues hold linger dur duration structure version show structure 總譜 樂譜 cut 段落 版本 cue 長度 結構 倒數 場景 hold
records.d: 把一場演出寫成「每一段有多長」，而不是絕對秒數：每個起點、終點、cue 和倒數，以及每一個版本（cut）的時間，都由它算出來。
records.x: 把時間軸寫成一張絕對秒數的表，它就長不大：某個場景拉長一點，後面每個 cue、曲線和 if (t > 466) 全都錯了。在總譜裡你只寫每一段「多長」，Score 從這些長度算出每個起點、終點、cue 的時間、倒數和場景。改一個 dur，它後面的一切都跟著挪。第二個版本只是幾行資料。 一個 cut 是演出的一個版本，一個 segment（段落）是其中的一段： dur 是一個段落唯一擁有的時間。cues 是有名字的時刻（比例 0 可以選 cut。 普通欄位：cut（正在表演的 id）、title、segments（每一段都有 start、end、dur、index、cues ……）、total（演出總長）、startT（reset 回到哪裡）、scale 和 base。 段落和 cue 的 id 不能含有句點：cueTime('dusk.glow') 就是靠句點把段落和它的 cue 分開。cue 也不能叫 end。 如果兩個 cut 不只是長度不同、連結構都不同，就不要讓它們共用自動化曲線，改由段落模組來驅動參數，那裡的 ctx.p 本來就會跟著縮放。 cuts 這場演出可以表演成哪些 cut：一個 cut 的陣列，或以 cut id 為 key 的物件。一個 cut 是 { id, title?, start?, segments: [...] }，或衍生的 { id, title?, from, scale }。必填，沒有 cut 就會丟出錯誤。 cut 要表演的 cut 的 id。預設是第一個，不在 cuts 裡的 id 是錯誤。

records.k: score error ScoreError validation invalid score problems error throws 總譜錯誤 驗證 檢查 錯誤 問題清單 例外
records.d: The error a Score throws when it cannot be built: its problems array lists every reason at once, and its message lists them too.
records.x: You rarely build one yourself: new Score() throws it. error.problems is an array of strings and error.message is the same list as one text, headed "Score is invalid (3 problems)". error.name is 'ScoreError', and it is a normal Error, so instanceof ScoreError and instanceof Error both work. It lists every problem it found, not only the first, so one run of the show shows you everything to fix. Nothing half-valid can reach the stage. problems The reasons, one string each. Each one names the cut, the segment and what is wrong.

records.k: score error ScoreError validation invalid score problems error throws 總譜錯誤 驗證 檢查 錯誤 問題清單 例外
records.d: 總譜建不起來的時候丟出的錯誤：它的 problems 陣列一次列出所有原因，錯誤訊息裡也會一起列出來。
records.x: 通常不用自己建：new Score() 會丟出它。error.problems 是字串陣列，error.message 是同一份清單串成的文字，開頭是「Score is invalid (3 problems)」。error.name 是 'ScoreError'，它是一般的 Error，所以 instanceof ScoreError 和 instanceof Error 都成立。 它會列出找到的所有問題，不是只列第一個，所以跑一次就能看到所有要修的地方。有問題的總譜上不了台。 problems 所有原因，每個一個字串。每一個都會指出是哪個 cut、哪個段落、哪裡不對。

records.k: curve curves easing ease ease in ease out step linear interpolation smoothstep keyframe 曲線 緩動 緩入 緩出 階梯 內插 關鍵影格 線性
records.d: The curve names a keyframe can use to say how its segment gets there: linear, ease, in, out, step, each a function from 0..1 to 0..1.
records.x: In a Timeline, the third item of a keyframe names the curve of the segment that ends at that keyframe: [30, 320, 'ease'] means "arrive at 320 at second 30 the ease way". linear is the default, and an unknown name or a typo also falls back to linear, so a mistake never stops a show. You can pass your own function instead of a name. linear goes straight. ease is a smoothstep: slow, fast, slow. in starts slowly (f²). out starts fast and lands softly (1 − (1 − f)²). step is special: the segment holds the old value until the keyframe, then jumps. The step function stored here returns 0 and is never called to interpolate; it is listed so that the object is the whole vocabulary. A param declared with step in its Params schema holds each keyframe whatever curve you name.

records.k: curve curves easing ease ease in ease out step linear interpolation smoothstep keyframe 曲線 緩動 緩入 緩出 階梯 內插 關鍵影格 線性
records.d: 關鍵影格可以用來說明「這一段怎麼抵達」的曲線名稱：linear、ease、in、out、step，每個都是 0..1 對應到 0..1 的函式。
records.x: 在 Timeline 裡，關鍵影格的第三項是「抵達這個影格的那一段」的曲線名稱：[30, 320, 'ease'] 的意思是「用 ease 的方式，在第 30 秒抵達 320」。預設是 linear，名稱不認得或打錯也會退回 linear，所以打錯字不會讓演出停下來。你也可以傳自己的函式，不用名稱。 linear 走直線。ease 是 smoothstep：慢、快、慢。in 起頭慢（f²）。out 起頭快、輕輕落地（1 − (1 − f)²）。step 比較特別：這一段會一直守著舊值，到了關鍵影格才跳過去。放在這裡的 step 函式永遠回傳 0，內插的時候不會用它來算，列在這裡只是為了讓這個物件涵蓋整套名稱。 在 Params 的 schema 裡宣告了 step 的參數，不管你寫哪種曲線，都會停在每個關鍵影格。

records.k: hold eps epsilon park standby boundary release hold 停住 待機 邊界 放行 微秒
records.d: How far before the boundary the playhead parks when a hold stops the show: one microsecond, so it still belongs to the scene that is waiting.
records.x: A scene with hold: true stops playback at its end. The Timeline parks HOLD_EPS (0.000001 seconds) before the boundary rather than on it, so sceneIndexAt(t) and the director still say "the held scene", timeline.t reads 5.999999 for a hold at 6, and the next scene has not started. release() then moves the playhead onto the boundary itself. You only need it when you compare the playhead with a boundary yourself: while holding, timeline.t is boundary - HOLD_EPS, not exactly boundary.

records.k: hold eps epsilon park standby boundary release hold 停住 待機 邊界 放行 微秒
records.d: hold 讓演出停住的時候，播放頭停在邊界前多遠的地方：一微秒，這樣它仍然屬於正在等候的那個場景。
records.x: hold: true 的場景會在尾端讓播放停住。Timeline 把播放頭停在邊界前面 HOLD_EPS（0.000001 秒）的地方，而不是正好停在邊界上，所以 sceneIndexAt(t) 和導演仍然說「現在是被 hold 的那個場景」，在 6 秒的 hold 上 timeline.t 讀到的是 5.999999，下一個場景還沒開始。之後 release() 才把播放頭移到邊界本身。 只有在你自己拿播放頭跟邊界做比較的時候才會用到：hold 的時候，timeline.t 是 邊界 - HOLD_EPS，不是剛好等於邊界。

records.k: timeline automation keyframe keyframes scene scenes cue hold loop seek play transport record state playhead 時間軸 自動化 關鍵影格 場景 cue hold 循環 跳轉 播放 播放頭 錄製 曲線
records.d: Answers "what is every param at time t?" from keyframes, and runs the transport around it: play, seek, scenes, holds, loops, cues and recording.
records.x: timeline.state(t) returns { key: value } for every param at time t, interpolated from automation. That is the whole job: the timeline owns time, and a world never reads the clock. In a show, createShow() builds the timeline from its timeline option, Loop calls advance(dt) every frame, and what state() returns goes into params.resolve(), where a hand or a knob that has overridden a param still wins. Between two keyframes the value moves in a straight line. The optional third item of a keyframe says how the segment that ends at that keyframe gets there: 'linear', 'ease', 'in', 'out', 'step', or your own function of 0..1 (see CURVES). Before the first keyframe the value is the first one, after the last it is the last one, and a param with no keyframes stays at its def. A param declared with step holds each keyframe instead of interpolating. Scenes give the show its shape: { id: 'storm', t: 90, title: 'Storm', note: 'clusters welcome' }. onSceneChange is the hook to fire sound, lights or prompts, and the console shows the title and note to the performer. A scene with hold: true stops playback at its end until someone calls release(). Scene cues are { name, t } with t in show seconds (not seconds into the scene), and they fire only when playback passes them: a seek, a jump or a reset never does. Time only moves when you call play() and then advance(dt) every frame (a show does this for you). state(t) and valueAt(key, t) work at any moment, playing or not. The callbacks do not…

records.k: timeline automation keyframe keyframes scene scenes cue hold loop seek play transport record state playhead 時間軸 自動化 關鍵影格 場景 cue hold 循環 跳轉 播放 播放頭 錄製 曲線
records.d: 用關鍵影格回答「時間 t 的時候，每個參數是多少？」，並在外面包一層播放控制：播放、跳轉、場景、hold、循環、cue 和錄製。
records.x: timeline.state(t) 回傳時間 t 的時候每個參數的 { key: value }，由 automation 內插得來。它的工作就這一件：時間歸時間軸管，世界從來不讀時鐘。在演出裡，createShow() 依 timeline 選項建好時間軸，Loop 每個畫面呼叫 advance(dt)，state() 的結果再交給 params.resolve()，被手或旋鈕覆寫的參數仍然以覆寫為準。 兩個關鍵影格之間，值走直線。關鍵影格選填的第三項，說的是「抵達這個影格的那一段」怎麼走：'linear'、'ease'、'in'、'out'、'step'，或你自己寫的 0..1 函式（見 CURVES）。第一個影格之前，值就是第一個影格的值。最後一個影格之後，就是最後一個的值。沒有任何關鍵影格的參數維持在 def。宣告了 step 的參數會停在每個關鍵影格，不做內插。 場景給了演出一個結構：{ id: 'storm', t: 90, title: 'Storm', note: 'clusters welcome' }。onSceneChange 是用來觸發聲音、燈光或提詞的掛鉤，主控台會把標題和備註顯示給表演者。hold: true 的場景，播放到它的尾端就停住，直到有人呼叫 release()。場景的 cues 是 { name, t }，t 是演出秒數（不是場景內的第幾秒），而且只有播放經過它們的時候才會觸發：seek、跳轉或 reset 都不會。 時間只在你呼叫 play()、並且每個畫面呼叫 advance(dt) 的時候才會往前走（演出會替你做）。state(t) 和 valueAt(key, t) 隨時都能用，不論有沒有在播放。起始場景的回呼，要等到第一次 advance() 或 seek() 才會觸發。 這些是可以直接讀、也可以直接設定的普通欄位：t、playing、holding、rate（1 是真實速度，4 是四倍速排練）、total、start、scenes、automation、score、loop、loops（上次 reset 以來繞了幾圈）和 layer。 layer 是 (key, value, t) => value。Director 會接在這裡，讓段落模組可以改動參數，表演者的覆寫之後才套用，所以仍然以覆寫為準。 有 score 的時候，你傳的 scenes 和 total 都會被忽略，reset() 回到的是總譜的起點。 params 演出的 Params，或一個單純的 schema 陣列。時間軸讀 schema 來知道要解析哪些參數。必填。 automation 每個參數的關鍵影格：{ hue: [[0, 200], [30, 320, 'ease'], [60, 40]] }。一個關鍵影格是 [秒數, 值, 曲線?]，依時間排序。 scenes 場景：{ id, t, title?, note?, acts?, hold?, cues? }，依 t 排序。t 是負的就是開演前的待機。有給 score 的時候會被忽略。 total 演出的長度，單位是秒。播放到這裡會自己停下來。（createShow() 沒特別指定的時候傳 120。）有給 score 的時候會被忽略。 score 一份 Score：場景、總長和起點都改從它來，自動化曲線讀的是 score.baseTime(t)，所以衍生的 cut 會把曲線一起拉伸。 start reset() 要回到哪裡，播放頭一開始也在這裡：一個秒數，或…

records.d: Counts how often on has turned on, or how many 'kick' (or any other event) have happened; with a limit it loops 0, 1, … limit − 1.
records.x: A counter you do not have to keep yourself: count(mouseIsPressed) is the number of clicks so far, count(beat, 4) walks 0 1 2 3 0 1 … on the beat, and count('kick') counts the kicks of the drum machine. A switch has to go off and on again to be counted twice. Event counts start when count('kick') is first called, so earlier kicks are not counted. An event of your own fired with trigger() is counted from its first firing, whenever count() is first called. The event names work like env(): 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' and 'beat' come from the microphone, or from the drum machine once startDrums() has been called, and the first count('kick') asks for the microphone if the drum machine is not on. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. A sketch with its own variable or function called count keeps it. OAVp5.chop.count(…) is this function under another name. on A switch: a boolean, or a number above 0.5, and each time it goes from off to on counts one. Or an event name ('kick', 'beat', 'note', or one of your own fired with trigger()): how many of…

records.k: count counter tally loop modulo step sequence Count CHOP TouchDesigner 計數 計數器 次數 循環 步進 序列 TouchDesigner
records.d: 數 on 打開過幾次，或某個事件（像 'kick'）發生過幾次。給了上限就會循環：0、1、…、上限 − 1（TouchDesigner 的 Count CHOP）。
records.x: 不用自己維護的計數器：count(mouseIsPressed) 是到現在的點擊次數，count(beat, 4) 跟著拍子數 0 1 2 3 0 1 …，count('kick') 數鼓機的大鼓。開關要關掉再打開，才會算第二次。 事件的計數從第一次呼叫 count('kick') 才開始，之前的大鼓不算。你自己用 trigger() 發出的事件，從它第一次發出就開始算，不管 count() 什麼時候第一次被呼叫。 事件名字的規則跟 env() 一樣：'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'beat' 來自麥克風，或是呼叫過 startDrums() 之後來自鼓機，而鼓機沒開的時候，第一次 count('kick') 會去要麥克風。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 草圖如果自己有叫 count 的變數或函式，就由草圖保留。OAVp5.chop.count(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 on 可以是開關：布林值，或大於 0.5 的數字，每次從關變成開就算一次。也可以是事件名字（'kick'、'beat'、'note'，或你自己用 trigger() 發出的）：那種事件到現在發生了幾次。 limit 數到這個數字就繞回去：4 會得到 0 1 2 3 0 1 …。不寫、或是 0 以下，就一直往上數。 name 只用在開關的寫法（count(beat, 4, 'a')）：給它的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。事件名字的寫法不需要。 計數，從 0 開始的整數。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的開關，都回傳 0。

records.x: The picture scope() shows in the corner, but drawn on the canvas: stroke(255); drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 0, height - 100, width, 100). The line is one shape in the sketch's own stroke() colour and weight (white while noStroke() is in effect), with no fill, and the style you had before is put back afterwards. The oldest value is at the left edge x, the newest at x + w. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.drawTrail(…) is this function under another name. values An array such as the one trail() returns. Or a single number: then drawTrail keeps its own trail of the last 2 seconds. x Left edge of the box. y Top edge of the box. w Width of the box. Left out, it is the canvas width. h Height of the box. Left out, it is the canvas height. lo The value drawn at the bottom of the box. hi The value…

records.d: 在畫布上畫一條穿過 values 的線，所以它會在作品裡、也會被錄進影片：最舊的在 x，lo 在方框底，hi 在方框頂。

records.k: envelope env trigger pulse attack decay flash kick beat Trigger CHOP TouchDesigner 包絡 脈衝 觸發 起音 衰減 閃一下 大鼓 拍子 TouchDesigner
records.d: A 0..1 pulse that jumps up after each event (a kick, a beat, a key, a press) and then fades out: TouchDesigner's Trigger CHOP.
records.x: Call it every frame and use the number like a size or a brightness: circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + env('kick', 0.01, 0.3) 200) swells on every kick. The number rises to 1 in attack seconds after an event and falls back to 0 in decay seconds, quick at first and landing softly, the way a bass drum's swell looks right. An event that arrives while the last pulse is still sounding restarts from where the pulse is, never from zero, so fast hits pile up into a plateau instead of flickering. The attack is measured from 0: a retrigger from halfway up takes half the attack. The events: 'kick', 'snare' and 'hat' are the hits kickDetected() hears (from the microphone, or from the drum machine when it plays), 'beat' is beat, 'note' is any key going down, 'bar' and 'step' come from the drum machine, a cue's name fires when cue() does, and any other name is yours to fire with trigger(). The switch form, env(mouseIsPressed, 0.02, 0.5), fires on every press. 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' and 'beat' need something that makes them. If the sketch has not started the drum machine (startDrums()), the first env('kick') asks for the microphone, like reading micLevel, and ?oav_mic=off means nothing ever fires. Once the drum machine is started, the microphone is not opened for it. 'note' needs a key: play one, press 🎹, or call OAVp5.play(). A name of your own needs trigger(): if nothing fires it within 4 seconds, a card says so. A named event needs no place in draw(): env('kick') works in setup() or…

records.k: envelope env trigger pulse attack decay flash kick beat Trigger CHOP TouchDesigner 包絡 脈衝 觸發 起音 衰減 閃一下 大鼓 拍子 TouchDesigner
records.d: 一個 0 到 1 的脈衝：每次事件（大鼓、拍子、琴鍵、按下）之後就跳起來，然後慢慢退下去（TouchDesigner 的 Trigger CHOP）。

records.x: Wrap any number that jumps: circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) 300) is a VU meter. It opens within 0.03 seconds when someone speaks and takes 0.4 seconds to close. up is the time to follow a rise, down the time to follow a fall. Leave down out and both are up. Leave both out and they are 0.1. The seconds are TouchDesigner's: lag(x, 0.1) moves like a Lag CHOP set to 0.1, so the numbers you learn here carry over. That is about the time the output takes to cover 90% of a jump (underneath, a one-pole lag whose time constant is the seconds divided by 2.3). The curve is the same at 30 and at 144 frames per second. The first value it sees is taken as it is, so nothing glides in from 0. A boolean counts as 0 or 1: lag(mouseIsPressed, 0.2) is a soft switch. Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop from next to oav-p5.js, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. A sketch with its own variable or function called lag keeps it. OAVp5.chop.lag(…) is this function under another name. value The number to follow. A…

records.d: 讓數值平順地跟上 value，不要跳：上升花 up 秒，下降花 down 秒（TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP）。
records.x: 包住任何會跳的數字：circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) 300) 就是一個音量表。有人說話時 0.03 秒內張開，要 0.4 秒才收回去。up 是跟上升的時間，down 是跟下降的時間。不寫 down，兩個都是 up。兩個都不寫，就都是 0.1。 這裡的秒數跟 TouchDesigner 一樣：lag(x, 0.1) 的動法就像把 Lag CHOP 設成 0.1，所以在這裡學的數字可以直接帶到 TouchDesigner。意思大約是輸出走完一次跳動的 90% 所花的時間（底層是一階的 lag，時間常數是秒數除以 2.3）。每秒 30 格和每秒 144 格畫出來的曲線一樣。 它看到的第一個值照單全收，所以不會從 0 慢慢滑進來。布林值算成 0 或 1：lag(mouseIsPressed, 0.2) 就是一個柔軟的開關。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫時會從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 草圖如果自己有叫 lag 的變數或函式，就由草圖保留。OAVp5.chop.lag(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 value 要跟隨的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西（字串、NaN）會直接穿過去，lag 保留原來的狀態。 up 跟上升的秒數：輸出大約花這麼久走完往上跳的 90%。負數算 0。 down 跟下降的秒數。不寫的話跟 up 一樣。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 平順過的數值。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，原樣回傳 value。

records.d: Shows value in a small oscilloscope in the corner of the page and gives it back, so you can wrap any expression to watch it.
records.x: It is a CHOP's viewer: each label is one line in a small plot across the page from the 🎹, with the last 4 seconds of the value and its number now. Call it twice in a frame with two labels and you get two lines to compare, raw against smoothed. The scale is at least 0 to 1 and grows to hold whatever the values reach. It lives on the page, not on the canvas: never in a recording or in 📷, and it never takes a click from the sketch. To draw the same line inside the work, use drawTrail(). Only inside draw(): anywhere else it just returns value. ?oav_scope=off hides it, and so does ?oav_hints=off, which is the one thing to know if it does not appear. See scope. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.scope(…) is this function under another name. The lines keep coming from the last second: stop calling it for a second and its line leaves the plot. value The number to watch. A boolean is drawn as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number is returned as it is and not drawn. label The name of this line in the legend. Each label…

records.k: scope oscilloscope plot graph debug watch a value monitor viewer 示波器 圖表 除錯 觀察數值 監看 檢視器 scope
records.d: 把 value 顯示在網頁角落的小示波器上，並原樣還給你，所以可以包住任何運算式來觀察它。
records.x: 它就是 CHOP 的檢視器：每個標籤是一條線，畫在跟 🎹 對角的網頁角落一個小圖上，顯示這個值最近 4 秒的樣子和現在的數字。在一個畫面裡用兩個標籤呼叫兩次，就有兩條線可以比較，例如原始的和平滑過的。刻度至少是 0 到 1，值跑出去就跟著放大。 它在網頁上，不在畫布上：不會錄進影片，也不會進 📷，而且不會搶走草圖的點擊。要把同樣的線畫進作品裡，用 drawTrail()。 只在 draw() 裡有作用：其他地方它只會原樣回傳 value。?oav_scope=off 會把它藏起來，?oav_hints=off 也會，這是它沒出現時唯一要知道的事。見 scope。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 OAVp5.chop.scope(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。線條只保留最近一秒內還有呼叫的：停止呼叫一秒之後，那條線就會從圖上消失。 value 要觀察的數字。布林值畫成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西原樣回傳，也不會畫。 label 這條線在圖例上的名字。每個標籤是一條線，超過 9 個字元的標籤在圖例上會被截短。不寫的話，這條線用編號。 原封不動的 value，所以 circle(x, y, scope(lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4), 'lag') 300) 這樣寫就行。

records.d: How fast value is changing, per second: positive while it rises, negative while it falls, 0 while it holds still (TouchDesigner's Slope CHOP).
records.x: Ask how hard something is moving rather than where it is: abs(slope(mouseX)) is the mouse speed in pixels per second, and slope(micLevel) jumps up at the start of a word. It is as noisy as its input, so smooth it when it flickers: lag(abs(slope(x)), 0.05, 0.3). Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.slope(…) is this function under another name. value The number to watch. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number keeps the last slope. name A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in draw(); with one, the call is the same wherever it is made. The change per second, in the units of value (pixels per second for a pixel position). 0 on the first call, and 0 until @openav/chop has loaded or for an unnamed call outside draw().

records.k: slope derivative velocity rate of change how fast delta Slope CHOP TouchDesigner 斜率 變化率 速度 微分 動得多快 TouchDesigner
records.d: value 每秒變化多快：上升時是正的，下降時是負的，靜止時是 0（TouchDesigner 的 Slope CHOP）。
records.x: 問的是東西動得多用力，而不是在哪裡：abs(slope(mouseX)) 是滑鼠每秒移動幾像素，slope(micLevel) 在一個字開頭的時候會往上衝。它的雜訊跟輸入一樣多，閃爍的時候先平滑一下：lag(abs(slope(x)), 0.05, 0.3)。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 OAVp5.chop.slope(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 value 要觀察的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西，就保留上一個斜率。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 每秒的變化量，單位跟 value 一樣（像素位置就是每秒幾像素）。第一次呼叫是 0。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前，以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，也是 0。

records.d: Adds rate to a running total every second, so rotate(speed(TWO_PI)) turns once a second and the rate can change without the total ever jumping.
records.x: Use the total to turn or move something: rotate(speed(TWO_PI)) is one turn a second, x = speed(60) % width slides 60 pixels a second and wraps around. You pass the rate, not the position, so the rate can follow a knob or the microphone (speed(micLevel TWO_PI) spins faster the louder it gets) and the angle never jumps, which frameCount rate would do. Time is in seconds, the same at any frame rate. One frame counts for at most a quarter of a second, so coming back to a hidden tab does not make the shape leap. Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. Plenty of sketches have a variable called speed. If yours does, it keeps the name, and OAVp5.chop.speed(…) is this function under another name (third example). rate How much to add per second, in the unit you use the result in (radians for rotate(), pixels for a position). It may change every frame. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. name A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by…

records.k: speed rotate spin integrate accumulate rate angle Speed CHOP TouchDesigner 速度 旋轉 轉動 累計 積分 角度 TouchDesigner
records.d: 每秒把 rate 加進一個累計值，所以 rotate(speed(TWO_PI)) 每秒轉一圈，而且速率隨時可以變，累計值不會跳（TouchDesigner 的 Speed CHOP）。
records.x: 用累計值來轉或移動東西：rotate(speed(TWO_PI)) 是每秒轉一圈，x = speed(60) % width 是每秒滑 60 像素，到邊界再繞回來。你傳的是速率，不是位置，所以速率可以跟著旋鈕或麥克風走（speed(micLevel TWO_PI) 越大聲轉越快），角度也不會跳，換成 frameCount rate 就會跳。 時間是以秒計，任何畫面更新率都一樣。一個畫面最多只算四分之一秒，所以從被藏起來的分頁回來時，圖形不會一下子衝出去。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 很多草圖都有一個叫 speed 的變數。你的草圖有的話，名稱就歸你的草圖，而 OAVp5.chop.speed(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字（第三個範例）。 rate 每秒要加多少，單位看你怎麼用結果（給 rotate() 就是弧度，給位置就是像素）。每個畫面都可以不一樣。布林值算成 0 或 1。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 累計值，一開始是 0。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，都回傳 0。

records.d: Follows value like a mass on a spring: it overshoots, bounces and settles (TouchDesigner's Spring CHOP).
records.x: Wrap a target that jumps: circle(width / 2, height / 2, spring(mouseIsPressed ? 300 : 100, 100, 6)). The size does not just glide to the new target (that is lag()): it swings past it, comes back and settles. Stiffness and damping are the two knobs. A stiff, lightly damped spring rings like a ruler on a table. A soft, heavily damped one just eases. A big jump or a low frame rate does not break it: the motion is the same at any frame rate. Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.spring(…) is this function under another name. value The target the spring is pulled toward. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. stiffness How fast it swings: 100 swings about 1.6 times a second. Higher is snappier. Negative numbers count as 0. damping How soon it settles: 6 gives two or three bounces, 20 and up none. The edge where it stops bouncing is 2 sqrt(stiffness). name A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in draw();…

Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in draw(); with one,…

records.k: trigger fire event custom event emit signal Trigger CHOP 觸發 事件 自訂事件 發出 訊號 TouchDesigner
records.d: Fires an event of your own, by name, for env() and count() to react to.
records.x: Call it where the thing happens: function mousePressed() { trigger('boom'); }. Then read it anywhere in draw() with env('boom', 0.01, 0.6) (a pulse that fades) or count('boom') (how many times so far). It returns nothing. It works anywhere, not only in draw(), and each call is one event, remembered with the time it happened. You can fire the built-in names by hand as well: trigger('kick') pulses env('kick') as a real kick would. OAVp5.chop.trigger(…) is this function under another name. name The name of the event. Anything is fine except the built-in meanings: 'kick', 'snare', 'hat', 'beat', 'note', 'bar' and 'step' are also fired by the microphone, the keys and the drum machine. Left out: 'trigger'.

records.k: trigger fire event custom event emit signal Trigger CHOP 觸發 事件 自訂事件 發出 訊號 TouchDesigner
records.d: 用名字發出一個你自己的事件，讓 env() 和 count() 去對它起反應。
records.x: 在事情發生的地方呼叫它：function mousePressed() { trigger('boom'); }。然後在 draw() 的任何地方，用 env('boom', 0.01, 0.6)（會退下去的脈衝）或 count('boom')（到現在發生幾次）去讀它。它沒有回傳值。 它在哪裡都能用，不只是 draw()，每呼叫一次就是一個事件，連同發生的時間一起被記下來。內建的名字也可以用手發出：trigger('kick') 會讓 env('kick') 跳一下，就像真的大鼓一樣。 OAVp5.chop.trigger(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 name 事件的名字。隨便取，只是要留意內建的意思：'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'beat'、'note'、'bar'、'step' 也會被麥克風、琴鍵和鼓機發出。不寫就是 'trigger'。

records.d: The CHOP functions under one roof, plus the state of the module behind them: OAVp5.chop.lag(…), .state, .slots(), .reset().
records.x: Every function of this group is also here: OAVp5.chop.lag, .env, .trigger, .speed, .spring, .trail, .slope, .count, .scope and .drawTrail are the same functions as the plain names, for a sketch whose own speed or count keeps the plain name. The rest is for looking inside: state says whether the module is loaded, module is the module itself, slots() lists every memory in use and reset() forgets them. This is advanced: a sketch that only calls lag() and friends never needs it.
