records.d: CHOP 函式放在同一個地方，加上它們背後模組的狀態：OAVp5.chop.lag(…)、.state、.slots()、.reset()。
records.x: 這一組的每個函式這裡都有：OAVp5.chop.lag、.env、.trigger、.speed、.spring、.trail、.slope、.count、.scope、.drawTrail 跟一般的名稱是同一批函式，給那些自己的 speed 或 count 保留了一般名稱的草圖用。 其餘的是用來看裡面的：state 說模組載好了沒，module 就是模組本身，slots() 列出正在用的每一個記憶，reset() 把它們忘掉。 這是進階用法：只呼叫 lag() 這些函式的草圖用不到它。

records.x: For reaching below the p5-style calls: OAVp5.chop.module.DEFAULTS lists the defaults the functions use, and new OAVp5.chop.module.Lag({ up: 0.1 }) makes a lag you keep yourself. Check it is not null first. This is advanced. The module is also published as @openav/chop for sketches and shows that do not go through oav-p5. null until the first CHOP function has been called and the module has arrived, then the module (Lag, Spring, Trail, envelope(), DEFAULTS and the rest).

records.x: 要用到比 p5 風格呼叫更底層的東西時才需要：OAVp5.chop.module.DEFAULTS 列出這些函式用的預設值，new OAVp5.chop.module.Lag({ up: 0.1 }) 做出一個你自己保管的 lag。先確認它不是 null。 這是進階用法。這個模組也以 @openav/chop 發布，給不經過 oav-p5 的草圖和演出使用。 第一次呼叫 CHOP 函式、而且模組載好之前是 null，之後就是那個模組（Lag、Spring、Trail、envelope()、DEFAULTS 等等）。

records.k: reset restart forget clear memory start over 重設 重新開始 忘掉 清除記憶 歸零
records.d: Forgets the memory named name (a lag, a speed total, a count …), or every memory when you give no name: the next call starts fresh.
records.x: The call that follows starts from nothing, as if it were the first one: a speed() total is 0 again, a lag() takes its input as it is, a count() is back at 0. Use it to restart a named effect, for example on a key press. Calling it with no name also drops the unnamed memories. They are made again by order on the next frame, so nothing breaks, but every unnamed value starts over too. Event counts from trigger() are not memories of a call and are not touched. name The name you gave a call as its last argument ('spin' in speed(1, 'spin')). The memory of that name is forgotten in every function that has one. Left out, every memory is forgotten, named or not.

records.k: reset restart forget clear memory start over 重設 重新開始 忘掉 清除記憶 歸零
records.d: 忘掉叫 name 的那個記憶（lag、speed 的累計、計數…），不給名字就全部忘掉：下一次呼叫會重新開始。
records.x: 接下來的那次呼叫會從零開始，就像是第一次：speed() 的累計值回到 0，lag() 照單全收輸入，count() 回到 0。想讓某個有名字的效果重新開始時用，例如按一個鍵的時候。 不給名字的時候，沒有名字的記憶也一起丟掉。下一個畫面會重新照順序建立，所以不會壞掉，但每一個沒有名字的值也都重新開始。trigger() 的事件次數不是某個呼叫的記憶，不受影響。 name 你在呼叫的最後一個參數給的名字（speed(1, 'spin') 裡的 'spin'）。每個函式裡那個名字的記憶都會被忘掉。不寫的話，不管有沒有名字，全部忘掉。

records.k: chop slots memory list debug inspect chop 記憶 列出 除錯 檢查
records.d: Lists every memory the CHOP functions are using right now: its kind, how it is found, and its latest value.
records.x: For finding out why two calls seem to share a memory, or whether a loop made hundreds: OAVp5.chop.slots().length is how many there are. It reads the state and changes nothing. This is advanced. 🩺 and tests use it; a sketch rarely needs to. One { kind, key, mode, value } per memory. kind is the function ('lag', 'spring', …). key is '#1', '#2' for calls found by order, a name for named ones, or the line of code for calls matched by line. mode says which: 'order', 'name' or 'site'. value is its latest output (missing for a trail).

records.k: chop slots memory list debug inspect chop 記憶 列出 除錯 檢查
records.d: 列出 CHOP 函式現在用的每一個記憶：是哪一種、怎麼找到它、最新的值是多少。
records.x: 用來查為什麼兩個呼叫好像共用同一個記憶，或迴圈是不是做出了好幾百個：OAVp5.chop.slots().length 就是現在有幾個。它只讀取狀態，不會改任何東西。 這是進階用法。🩺 和測試會用到，草圖很少需要。 每一個記憶一筆 { kind, key, mode, value }。kind 是哪個函式（'lag'、'spring' …）。key 是靠順序找到的呼叫的 '#1'、'#2'，有名字的就是名字，靠行號對應的就是那一行程式。mode 說明是哪一種：'order'、'name' 或 'site'。value 是它最近一次的輸出（trail 沒有）。

records.k: chop state loaded loading module ready chop 狀態 載入 載好了沒 模組
records.d: Where the @openav/chop module is: 'off', 'loading', 'on' or 'error'.
records.x: off until one of these functions is first called, loading while @openav/chop arrives (a few frames), on once it is in, error if it could not be loaded: a card says so and every function then passes its input through. trigger() on its own never loads it, because it only records that something happened. Changes the first time a CHOP function is called and once more when the module has arrived. off before any call.

records.k: chop state loaded loading module ready chop 狀態 載入 載好了沒 模組
records.d: @openav/chop 模組目前的狀態：'off'、'loading'、'on' 或 'error'。
records.x: 在任何一個函式第一次被呼叫之前是 off，@openav/chop 在載入的時候（幾個畫面）是 loading，載好之後是 on，載不到是 error：這時會跳出卡片，所有函式也都改成把輸入直接穿過去。單獨呼叫 trigger() 不會載入它，因為它只記錄「發生了一件事」。 第一次呼叫 CHOP 函式的時候會變，模組載好時再變一次。在任何呼叫之前是 off。

records.k: lag smooth smoothing ease easing time constant one-pole low-pass follow chase exponential 平滑 緩動 跟隨 時間常數 低通 延遲 追趕
records.d: One step of a one-pole lag: moves current toward target, closing 63% of the gap after seconds.
records.x: The smallest piece of smoothing. Call it once per frame, value = approach(value, target, 0.2, dt), and value chases target: 63% of the way after seconds, 90% after 2.3 × seconds, 99% after 4.6 × seconds. It is exact for any dt, so a sketch at 30 fps and one at 144 fps draw the same curve. seconds here is a time constant, which is shorter than the "seconds" of TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP. Lag takes the TouchDesigner kind and divides it by TD_LAG_RATIO before calling this function. @openav/mapping's smooth steps with approach and means the time constant too. Nothing. It is pure arithmetic with no memory: you keep current yourself and pass in the seconds since the last call. For a value with its own memory use Lag. current Where the value is now. target Where it is heading. seconds The time constant: after this many seconds the gap to target has closed by 63% (1 − 1/e). 0, a negative number or NaN jumps straight to target, whatever dt is. dt Seconds since the last step. 0, a negative number or NaN leaves current where it is. The new value, between current and target.

records.k: lag smooth smoothing ease easing time constant one-pole low-pass follow chase exponential 平滑 緩動 跟隨 時間常數 低通 延遲 追趕
records.d: 一階低通跟隨的一步：把 current 往 target 推近，經過 seconds 秒走完 63% 的差距。
records.x: 平滑裡最小的一塊。每個畫面呼叫一次，value = approach(value, target, 0.2, dt)，value 就會追著 target 跑：經過 seconds 走完 63%，2.3 × seconds 走完 90%，4.6 × seconds 走完 99%。不管 dt 多大都是精確解，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 畫出同一條曲線。 這裡的 seconds 是時間常數，比 TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 的「秒數」短。Lag 收的是 TouchDesigner 那種秒數，會先除以 TD_LAG_RATIO 再呼叫這個函式。@openav/mapping 的 smooth 也是用 approach 一步一步走，意思同樣是時間常數。 不需要先做什麼。它只是算術，沒有記憶：current 由你自己保管，並把距離上次呼叫的秒數傳進來。想要自帶記憶的版本，用 Lag。 current 數值現在的位置。 target 它要去的地方。 seconds 時間常數：經過這麼多秒，與 target 的差距縮小 63%（1 − 1/e）。0、負數或 NaN 會直接跳到 target，不管 dt 是多少。 dt 距離上一步過了幾秒。0、負數或 NaN 時 current 原地不動。 新的數值，落在 current 與 target 之間。

records.k: count count chop counter beat counter rising edge loop modulo bar step sequencer 計數 count chop 計數器 拍子 上升緣 循環 取餘數
records.d: Counts how many times its input turned on (true, or a number above threshold); with a limit it loops 0 … limit − 1. The Count CHOP.
records.x: count.step(input, limit) counts a rising edge, the moment the input goes from off to on, not the time it stays on. Hold a button for ten seconds and that is one. With limit 4 the result walks 0 1 2 3 0 1 …, which is how a beat becomes "beat 1 of 4". The counter keeps counting underneath even when you pass a limit, so you can change the limit later without losing your place. A value that is not a number counts as off. In a p5 sketch use count(): count(beat, 4), or count('kick') to count the drum machine's kicks. Nothing to load. Call step every frame, even while the input is off: it has to see the "off" to notice the next "on". It has no dt, because a count does not depend on time. Public fields: threshold, on (is the input on right now) and total (the count before looping). threshold A number counts as "on" when it is above this. A boolean true is 1, false is 0.

records.k: count count chop counter beat counter rising edge loop modulo bar step sequencer 計數 count chop 計數器 拍子 上升緣 循環 取餘數
records.d: 數輸入打開了幾次（true，或超過 threshold 的數字），給上限就會在 0 … 上限 − 1 之間循環。就是 Count CHOP。
records.x: count.step(input, limit) 數的是上升的那一下，也就是輸入從關變成開的瞬間，不是開著的時間。按住按鈕十秒也只算一次。給 limit 4，結果會是 0 1 2 3 0 1 …，一個拍子就這樣變成「四拍裡的第幾拍」。 就算給了上限，底下的計數器還是一直累加，所以之後改上限也不會失去進度。不是數字的值算成關。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 count()：count(beat, 4)，或用 count('kick') 數鼓機的大鼓。 不用載入任何東西。每個畫面都呼叫 step，連輸入關著的時候也要：它得看到「關」，才認得出下一次的「開」。它沒有 dt，因為計數跟時間無關。 公開的欄位有 threshold、on（輸入現在是不是開著）和 total（循環之前的計數）。 threshold 數字超過這個值才算「打開」。布林值 true 是 1，false 是 0。

records.k: defaults default values settings constants options 預設值 預設 設定 常數 選項
records.d: The default settings of every CHOP in the package, as one frozen object: lag, envelope, spring, trail and count.
records.x: For documentation and for interfaces that show the defaults, such as the placeholder text of a field. The classes and envelope() have these same numbers written in their own signatures; changing this object changes nothing about how they behave. { lag: { up: 0.1, down: 0.1 }, envelope: { attack: 0.01, decay: 0.3 }, spring: { stiffness: 100, damping: 6 }, trail: { seconds: 2, rate: 60 }, count: { threshold: 0.5 } }. Frozen: assigning to it does nothing.

records.k: defaults default values settings constants options 預設值 預設 設定 常數 選項
records.d: 這個套件裡每個 CHOP 的預設設定，收在一個凍結的物件裡：lag、envelope、spring、trail 和 count。
records.x: 給文件和要顯示預設值的介面用，例如輸入欄的提示文字。這些類別和 envelope() 在自己的簽名裡已經寫了同樣的數字。改這個物件不會改變它們的行為。 { lag: { up: 0.1, down: 0.1 }, envelope: { attack: 0.01, decay: 0.3 }, spring: { stiffness: 100, damping: 6 }, trail: { seconds: 2, rate: 60 }, count: { threshold: 0.5 } }。已凍結：指定新值不會有作用。

records.k: envelope trigger trigger chop attack decay kick pulse swell adsr on every beat 包絡 觸發 trigger 起音 衰減 大鼓 脈衝 每個拍子
records.d: The level, 0 to peak, of an attack-and-decay envelope at time t, for events that happened at the given times; the Trigger CHOP.
records.x: Keep a list of the times something happened (a kick, a key press, a cue) and ask for the level at the time you are drawing: scale(1 + envelope(kicks, now, 0.01, 0.3)). It rises in a straight line to 1 in attack seconds, then falls to 0 in decay seconds, quick at first and landing softly. It is a pure function of the times and of t: ask twice, or at 30 fps and at 144 fps, and the same moment gives the same level; attack and decay may change every frame (a knob on the decay). A new event while the last one still sounds restarts from where the envelope is, never from 0, so fast hits pile up into a plateau instead of flickering. The attack counts from 0 to the peak, so a retrigger from halfway up takes half the attack. In a p5 sketch you do not import it: env() and trigger() keep the event list for you and read the drum machine and the microphone. Nothing to load. You record the event times yourself (for example kicks.push(performance.now() / 1000) when a kick arrives) and pass the same clock as t. times When the events happened, in seconds on any clock you like, oldest first. An empty array (or none) gives 0. Events later than t have not happened yet and are ignored. Only the last few matter, so you can trim the list. t The moment to read, on the same clock as times. attack Seconds to rise from 0 to the peak. 0 starts at the peak at once. decay Seconds to fall back to 0 after the peak: it is exactly 0 from attack + decay seconds after an event. peak The top of the envelope. 0…

records.k: envelope trigger trigger chop attack decay kick pulse swell adsr on every beat 包絡 觸發 trigger 起音 衰減 大鼓 脈衝 每個拍子
records.d: 給定事件發生的時間 times，算出起音加衰減的包絡在時間 t 的高度（0 到 peak），就是 Trigger CHOP。
records.x: 把某件事發生的時間（大鼓、按鍵、cue）存成一個清單，畫的時候問它「現在多高」：scale(1 + envelope(kicks, now, 0.01, 0.3))。它在 attack 秒內直線升到 1，再用 decay 秒落回 0，一開始快、收尾柔。 它是 times 和 t 的純函式：問兩次、或在 30 fps 與 144 fps 問同一個時間點，答案一樣。attack 和 decay 每個畫面都可以改（例如用旋鈕調 decay）。上一個事件還沒消散時又來一個，包絡從目前的高度重新出發，不會先掉到 0，所以快速的連擊會堆成一個高原，不會閃爍。起音以 0 到峰值計算，所以從一半高度重新觸發只要一半的起音時間。 在 p5 草圖裡不用 import：env() 和 trigger() 會替你保管事件清單，也會讀鼓機和麥克風。 不用載入任何東西。事件的時間由你自己記（例如大鼓來的時候 kicks.push(performance.now() / 1000)），t 要用同一個時鐘。 times 事件發生的時間，單位是秒，用哪個時鐘都行，最舊的排前面。空陣列（或沒給）回傳 0。比 t 晚的事件還沒發生，會被忽略。只有最後幾筆有影響，所以可以把舊的剪掉。 t 要讀取的時間點，跟 times 用同一個時鐘。 attack 從 0 升到峰值要幾秒。0 就一開始直接在峰值。 decay 到達峰值後落回 0 要幾秒：事件之後 attack + decay 秒起正好是 0。 peak 包絡的最高點。 0 到 peak：事件剛發生時是 peak，消散之後是 0。

records.k: envelope attack decay trigger adsr kick pulse swell 包絡 起音 衰減 觸發 大鼓 脈衝
records.d: The level of one envelope elapsed seconds after its trigger: a straight rise to peak, then a fall to 0 in decay seconds.
records.x: The building block of envelope(), which strings several of these together for a list of events. On its own it answers: "how high is a kick that happened elapsed seconds ago?" With the defaults of envelope() (attack 0.01, decay 0.3) it is 0.5 at 5 ms, 1 at 10 ms, 0.49 at 100 ms and 0 from 310 ms on. The fall is quick at first and lands softly: that is the shape a kick drum swell looks right with. It reaches 0 in exactly decay seconds, not asymptotically. Advanced. Most sketches never call it: use envelope(), or env() in p5. elapsed Seconds since the trigger. Below 0 (or NaN) gives from. attack Seconds to rise from 0 to peak. 0 or less starts at the peak at once. decay Seconds to fall from peak to 0, along (1 − u)² where u runs 0 to 1. 0 or less drops to 0 right after the attack. from The level at the moment of the trigger. The attack still counts from 0 to the peak, so starting from halfway up takes half the attack. peak The top of the envelope. The level, from 0 to peak.

records.k: envelope attack decay trigger adsr kick pulse swell 包絡 起音 衰減 觸發 大鼓 脈衝
records.d: 一個包絡在被觸發 elapsed 秒之後的高度：先直線升到 peak，再用 decay 秒落回 0。
records.x: envelope() 的基本零件，它把好幾個這樣的片段串起來處理一串事件。單獨使用時，它回答的是：「elapsed 秒前發生的一次大鼓，現在有多高？」用 envelope() 的預設值（attack 0.01、decay 0.3），5 毫秒時是 0.5，10 毫秒是 1，100 毫秒是 0.49，310 毫秒起是 0。 下降一開始很快、收尾很柔：大鼓的律動配這個形狀看起來最對。它剛好在 decay 秒落到 0，不是無限接近。 進階用法。大部分草圖不會直接呼叫它：請用 envelope()，p5 裡用 env()。 elapsed 觸發之後過了幾秒。小於 0（或 NaN）時回傳 from。 attack 從 0 升到 peak 要幾秒。0 或更小就一開始直接在峰值。 decay 從 peak 落到 0 要幾秒，走 (1 − u)² 的曲線（u 從 0 跑到 1）。0 或更小就在起音結束後立刻變 0。 from 觸發當下的高度。起音仍然以 0 到峰值計算，所以從一半高度開始只要一半的起音時間。 peak 包絡的最高點。 高度，從 0 到 peak。

records.k: lag smooth smoothing follow vu meter attack release ease low-pass touchdesigner lag chop up down 平滑 緩動 跟隨 音量表 延遲 低通 touchdesigner 上升下降
records.d: Follows its input with one speed while the input is above the output and another while it is below; the TouchDesigner Lag CHOP.
records.x: Make one Lag per value you want to smooth, then call step(input, dt) once per frame. new Lag({ up: 0.03, down: 0.4 }) is a VU meter: it opens almost at once and closes slowly. up and down are in TouchDesigner's seconds: with up: 1, a jump from 0 to 1 is at 0.9 one second later, at 30, 60 or 144 fps alike. Each step is the exact answer for an input held at its new value over dt seconds, so the frame rate does not change the curve. A boolean counts as 0 or 1 (lag.step(mouseIsPressed, dt) is a soft switch). A value that is not a number, such as NaN, comes back untouched and leaves the memory as it was. In a p5 sketch you do not import this: lag() keeps one Lag per call for you. Nothing to load or start. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt (in a browser: the difference of two performance.now() / 1000). The first step only stores the input, so the output equals the input on frame one. Public fields: up, down and value, the last output (null until the first step). You can change up and down any time. The time constant underneath is seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO (see TD_LAG_RATIO), not seconds. If you want the plain 63% kind, call approach(). up Seconds to follow a rise, while the input is above the output. TouchDesigner's seconds: about the time to cover 90% of a jump. 0 follows at once. down Seconds to follow a fall, while the input is below the output. Leave it out and it is the same as up. value A starting value. Leave it out and the first input is taken as it is, so…

records.k: lag smooth smoothing follow vu meter attack release ease low-pass touchdesigner lag chop up down 平滑 緩動 跟隨 音量表 延遲 低通 touchdesigner 上升下降
records.d: 輸入比輸出高的時候用一種速度跟上去，比輸出低的時候用另一種速度，就是 TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP。
records.x: 每一個要平滑的數值做一個 Lag，每個畫面呼叫一次 step(input, dt)。new Lag({ up: 0.03, down: 0.4 }) 就是音量表：幾乎立刻張開，慢慢收回。up 和 down 用 TouchDesigner 的秒數：up: 1 的話，從 0 跳到 1 之後一秒是 0.9，30、60 或 144 fps 都一樣。 每一步都是「輸入在這 dt 秒內維持新值」的精確解，所以影格率不會改變曲線。布林值算成 0 或 1（lag.step(mouseIsPressed, dt) 是柔和的開關）。不是數字的值（像 NaN）原樣傳回，記憶不受影響。 在 p5 草圖裡不用 import 它：lag() 會替每一個呼叫保管一個 Lag。 不用載入或啟動任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來（瀏覽器裡：兩次 performance.now() / 1000 的差）。第一次 step 只是把輸入記下來，所以第一個畫面輸出等於輸入。 公開的欄位有 up、down 和 value（最後一次的輸出，第一次 step 之前是 null）。up、down 隨時可以改。 底層的時間常數是 seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO（見 TD_LAG_RATIO），不是 seconds。想要單純 63% 那一種，直接呼叫 approach()。 up 追上升高的輸入要幾秒（輸入比輸出高的時候）。用 TouchDesigner 的秒數：大約是走完 90% 跳躍的時間。0 表示立刻跟上。 down 追上降低的輸入要幾秒（輸入比輸出低的時候）。不給就跟 up 一樣。 value 起始值。不給的話，第一個輸入原樣當作輸出，所以不會從 0 慢慢滑進來。

records.k: slope slope chop derivative rate of change velocity how fast delta per second 斜率 slope chop 微分 變化率 速度 多快 每秒變化
records.d: How fast the input is changing, in units per second; 0 on the first step. The Slope CHOP.
records.x: slope.step(value, dt) returns (value − previous value) / dt. A value rising by 3 every second gives 3 at any frame rate; a value that stands still gives 0; a falling one gives a negative number. Use it for "how hard did the knob just move": scale(1 + abs(slope.step(knob, dt))). It has no smoothing: a single jump of the input is one big spike for one step. Put the result through a Lag if you want it to fade. A dt of 0 or less changes nothing and returns the last slope, and a value that is not a number returns the last slope too. In a p5 sketch use slope(). Nothing to load. The first step only stores the value and returns 0, because there is no earlier value to compare with. The last slope is the public field value.

records.k: slope slope chop derivative rate of change velocity how fast delta per second 斜率 slope chop 微分 變化率 速度 多快 每秒變化
records.d: 輸入變化得多快，單位是每秒多少，第一步是 0。就是 Slope CHOP。
records.x: slope.step(value, dt) 回傳 (value − 上一個值) / dt。每秒升 3 的數值，在任何影格率下都回傳 3，沒動的數值是 0，往下掉的是負數。用來表達「旋鈕剛剛轉得多用力」：scale(1 + abs(slope.step(knob, dt)))。 它不做任何平滑：輸入跳一下，就是一步裡的一根大尖峰。想讓它淡出，把結果交給 Lag。dt 是 0 或更小，什麼都不改，回傳上一次的斜率。值不是數字時也回傳上一次的斜率。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 slope()。 不用載入任何東西。第一次 step 只是把值記下來並回傳 0，因為沒有更早的值可以比。 最近一次的斜率是公開欄位 value。

records.k: speed speed chop integrate rate per second rotate accumulate position from velocity 速度 speed chop 積分 速率 每秒 旋轉 累計
records.d: Adds rate every second to a running total: a rate in units per second becomes a position; the Speed CHOP.
records.x: speed.step(rate, dt) adds rate dt to the total and returns it. With rate 1 the total grows by 1 every second; rotate(speed.step(TWO_PI, dt)) is one turn a second. Feed it a rate that changes (a knob, micLevel) and the motion speeds up and slows down smoothly, without the jump you get from multiplying frameCount by it. It is the integral of the rate, so it is the same at any frame rate. A boolean rate counts as 1 per second while true. A rate that is not a number, or a dt of 0 or less, adds nothing. In a p5 sketch use speed(), which keeps one for each call. Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt. The total is the public field value. value The starting total. Anything that is not a finite number starts at 0.

records.k: speed speed chop integrate rate per second rotate accumulate position from velocity 速度 speed chop 積分 速率 每秒 旋轉 累計
records.d: 每秒把 rate 加進一個累計值：每秒多少單位的速率變成位置，就是 Speed CHOP。
records.x: speed.step(rate, dt) 把 rate dt 加到累計值裡並回傳。rate 是 1 的話，累計值每秒增加 1。rotate(speed.step(TWO_PI, dt)) 就是每秒轉一圈。餵給它會變動的速率（旋鈕、micLevel），動作會平順地變快變慢，不會像把 frameCount 乘上速率那樣一跳一跳。 它是速率的積分，所以不論影格率都一樣。布林值的速率在 true 的時候算每秒 1。速率不是數字、或 dt 是 0 或更小，就什麼都不加。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 speed()，它會替每個呼叫保管一個。 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來。 累計值就是公開欄位 value。 value 累計值的起點。不是有限數字的話就從 0 開始。

records.k: spring spring chop overshoot bounce wobble elastic damping stiffness physics follow 彈簧 spring chop 過衝 彈跳 晃動 彈性 阻尼 勁度
records.d: Follows its input like a mass on a spring: it overshoots, swings back and settles; the Spring CHOP with the input as position.
records.x: Make one Spring per value, call step(target, dt) once per frame and draw what it returns. With the defaults (stiffness 100, damping 6), a jump of the input from 0 to 1 sends the output to 1.37 after a third of a second, and it is within 1% of 1 from about 1.4 s on. Raise the damping to 20 and it glides to the target without overshooting. Each step is the exact answer from springStep(), so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same motion and a long frame cannot blow it up. The input is the position it is pulled toward; a boolean counts as 0 or 1; a value that is not a number is returned as it is and changes nothing. In a p5 sketch use spring(). Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt. The first step only stores the input (the spring starts at rest on it). Public fields: stiffness, damping, value (the position; null before the first step) and velocity. stiffness How hard the spring pulls, so how fast it swings. With nothing damping it, it swings about √stiffness / 2π times a second (100 is about 1.6). damping How soon it settles. 6 with a stiffness of 100 bounces a few times; 2 √stiffness (20 for 100) and above never bounces. value A starting position. Leave it out and the first input is taken as it is, so it does not swing in from 0.

records.k: spring spring chop overshoot bounce wobble elastic damping stiffness physics follow 彈簧 spring chop 過衝 彈跳 晃動 彈性 阻尼 勁度
records.d: 像吊在彈簧上的重物一樣追著輸入：會衝過頭、彈回來、再安定下來，就是輸入當作位置的 Spring CHOP。
records.x: 每個數值做一個 Spring，每個畫面呼叫一次 step(target, dt)，畫它回傳的值。用預設值（stiffness 100、damping 6）的話，輸入從 0 跳到 1，輸出在約三分之一秒時衝到 1.37，大約 1.4 秒之後就落在 1 的 1% 以內。把 damping 調到 20，它就會滑到目標上，不衝過頭。 每一步都是 springStep() 的精確解，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 動得一樣，一個很長的畫面也不會讓它發散。輸入是它被拉向的位置，布林值算成 0 或 1，不是數字的值原樣傳回，什麼都不改。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 spring()。 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來。第一次 step 只是把輸入記下來（彈簧就靜止在那裡開始）。 公開的欄位有 stiffness、damping、value（位置，第一次 step 之前是 null）和 velocity。 stiffness 彈簧拉得多用力，也就是擺動多快。沒有阻尼的時候，每秒大約擺 √stiffness / 2π 次（100 大約是 1.6 次）。 damping 多快安定下來。stiffness 100 配 damping 6 會彈幾下。2 √stiffness（100 的話是 20）以上就完全不彈。 value 起始位置。不給的話，第一個輸入原樣當作位置，所以不會從 0 擺進來。

records.k: spring damped oscillator physics bounce overshoot integrator step 彈簧 阻尼 振盪 物理 彈跳 過衝
records.d: One exact step of a damped spring of mass 1 pulled toward target; returns [position, velocity].
records.x: Solves x'' = −stiffness·(x − target) − damping·x' exactly over dt for a target that stays still during the step. It handles all three cases (under-damped: it bounces; critically damped; over-damped: it creeps) and a huge dt never blows up, which is why a sketch can fall behind for a whole second and the spring just lands on the target. damping = 2 Math.sqrt(stiffness) is the edge where it stops bouncing: with stiffness 100 that is a damping of 20. With no spring (stiffness 0) only the damping acts and the velocity just fades. Advanced. The Spring class holds the position and the velocity for you and calls this. x The position now. v The velocity now, in units per second. target Where the other end of the spring is held. stiffness How hard it pulls. Negative counts as 0. damping How much friction slows it. Negative counts as 0. dt Seconds to advance. 0 or less (or NaN) returns [x, v] unchanged. The new position and velocity.

records.k: spring damped oscillator physics bounce overshoot integrator step 彈簧 阻尼 振盪 物理 彈跳 過衝
records.d: 質量為 1 的阻尼彈簧朝 target 被拉的一個精確步驟，回傳 [位置, 速度]。
records.x: 對 dt 這段時間內 target 不動的情況，精確解 x'' = −stiffness·(x − target) − damping·x'。欠阻尼（會彈）、臨界阻尼、過阻尼（慢慢爬）三種情況都處理，而且 dt 再大也不會發散，所以草圖卡了一整秒，彈簧也只是落在目標上。 damping = 2 Math.sqrt(stiffness) 是剛好不再彈的臨界點：stiffness 是 100 的話，就是 damping 20。沒有彈簧（stiffness 為 0）的時候只剩阻尼作用，速度慢慢消失。 進階用法。Spring 類別會替你保管位置與速度，並呼叫這個函式。 x 現在的位置。 v 現在的速度，單位是每秒多少單位。 target 彈簧另一端固定的位置。 stiffness 拉得多用力。負數當作 0。 damping 摩擦力多大。負數當作 0。 dt 要前進幾秒。0 或更小（或 NaN）原樣回傳 [x, v]。 新的位置與速度。

records.k: ln 10 touchdesigner lag chop seconds time constant 90% ratio convert 時間常數 touchdesigner lag chop 秒數 換算 比例 90%
records.d: Math.LN10, about 2.303: how many time constants a lag needs to cover 90% of a jump, which is what TouchDesigner's Lag seconds mean.
records.x: TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP quotes its seconds as roughly the time the output takes to follow 90% of a change. A one-pole lag reaches 90% after ln 10 time constants, so seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO is the time constant to hand to approach(). Lag does exactly that, which is why lag(x, 0.1) in a p5 sketch moves like a Lag CHOP set to 0.1. You only need it when you mix the two kinds of seconds: a time constant tau is tdSeconds / TD_LAG_RATIO, and tdSeconds is tau TD_LAG_RATIO. Attack and decay of an envelope() are plain lengths and are not converted. Exactly Math.LN10, 2.302585092994046. A fixed number: it never changes.

records.k: ln 10 touchdesigner lag chop seconds time constant 90% ratio convert 時間常數 touchdesigner lag chop 秒數 換算 比例 90%
records.d: Math.LN10，約 2.303：一個 lag 走完 90% 要幾個時間常數，也就是 TouchDesigner 的 Lag 秒數的意思。
records.x: TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 把秒數定義成大約是輸出追上 90% 變化所花的時間。一階低通要走 ln 10 個時間常數才到 90%，所以 seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO 就是該交給 approach() 的時間常數。Lag 做的正是這件事，所以 p5 草圖裡的 lag(x, 0.1) 動起來就像把 Lag CHOP 設成 0.1。 只有在兩種秒數混著用的時候才會用到它：時間常數 tau 等於 tdSeconds / TD_LAG_RATIO，tdSeconds 等於 tau TD_LAG_RATIO。envelope() 的 attack 和 decay 是單純的長度，不用換算。 就是 Math.LN10，2.302585092994046。固定的數字，不會變。

records.k: trail trail chop history buffer scope oscilloscope last seconds ring buffer plot 軌跡 trail chop 歷史 緩衝 示波器 最近幾秒 繪圖
records.d: Remembers the input over the last few seconds as a list of values, oldest first, at a fixed 60 values a second; the Trail CHOP.
records.x: trail.step(value, dt) returns an array of seconds rate past values followed by this step's input at the end, so the array is seconds rate + 1 long (121 for the defaults). Draw it across the canvas as a line: that is a scope of the value. The length is fixed from the first step, filled with the first value, so a sketch can draw the whole line from frame one. The values are interpolated between steps, so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same line. A gap longer than the whole window (a tab that was hidden) restarts it filled with the new value. In a p5 sketch use trail() and drawTrail(). Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt. A value that is not a number leaves the history as it is and returns the current list. seconds How many seconds of history to keep. 0 or less falls back to 2. rate Values per second in the list. 0 or less falls back to 60.

records.k: trail trail chop history buffer scope oscilloscope last seconds ring buffer plot 軌跡 trail chop 歷史 緩衝 示波器 最近幾秒 繪圖
records.d: 把輸入最近幾秒的變化記成一串數值，最舊的在前，固定每秒 60 個，就是 Trail CHOP。
records.x: trail.step(value, dt) 回傳一個陣列：seconds rate 個過去的值，最後接上這一步的輸入，所以長度是 seconds rate + 1（預設是 121）。把它橫跨畫布畫成一條線，就是這個數值的示波器。 長度從第一步就固定，用第一個值填滿，所以草圖從第一個畫面就能畫出整條線。步與步之間會內插，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 得到同一條線。如果有一段空檔比整個視窗還長（例如分頁被藏起來），就用新的值填滿重新開始。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 trail() 和 drawTrail()。 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來。不是數字的值不會改動歷史，只是回傳目前的清單。 seconds 要保留幾秒的歷史。0 或更小的話改用 2。 rate 清單裡每秒幾個值。0 或更小的話改用 60。

records.k: wrap modulo mod loop cycle wrap around step number 循環 取餘數 包裹 繞回來 步序
records.d: Loops a count to 0 … limit − 1: wrapCount(5, 4) is 1. A limit of 0 or less leaves the count as it is.
records.x: The modulo that Count uses, made safe for negative numbers: wrapCount(-1, 4) is 3, where -1 % 4 is -1. It is useful on its own for anything that loops, such as a step number: wrapCount(frameCount, 16). total The count so far. limit How many values to loop through. A fraction is rounded down. 0, a negative number, or no value at all returns total unchanged. total looped into 0 … limit − 1 (never negative, even for a negative total).

records.k: wrap modulo mod loop cycle wrap around step number 循環 取餘數 包裹 繞回來 步序
records.d: 把計數循環到 0 … 上限 − 1：wrapCount(5, 4) 是 1。上限是 0 或更小就維持原樣。
records.x: Count 使用的取餘數，並且對負數也安全：wrapCount(-1, 4) 是 3，而 -1 % 4 是 -1。拿來處理任何要循環的東西也很方便，例如步序編號：wrapCount(frameCount, 16)。 total 目前累計的次數。 limit 要循環幾個值。小數會無條件捨去。0、負數或沒給，就原樣回傳 total。 循環到 0 … limit − 1 的 total（就算 total 是負的，結果也不會是負的）。

records.k: recording is recording status record state on 錄影中 有沒有在錄 狀態 錄影狀態
records.d: Whether a recording is running right now.
records.x: Use it to keep things out of the video: if (!recordingIsOn) text('press r to record', 20, 30);, because everything on the canvas is recorded. Use it for a key that toggles: recordingIsOn ? stopRecording() : startRecording(). It changes when a take starts and when it ends, and reading it never starts anything. For the other stages (starting, saving) read OAVp5.record.state. A sketch that declares its own variable called recordingIsOn keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.record.state === 'on' instead. True while a take runs. It is false at the start, while the recorder is still loading, from the moment stopRecording() is called (the file is then being made) and after the take.

records.k: recording is recording status record state on 錄影中 有沒有在錄 狀態 錄影狀態
records.d: 現在有沒有在錄影。
records.x: 用它把東西留在影片之外：if (!recordingIsOn) text('press r to record', 20, 30);，因為畫布上的所有東西都會被錄進去。也可以用在開關鍵上：recordingIsOn ? stopRecording() : startRecording()。它只在錄影開始和結束的時候改變，讀它不會啟動任何東西。想知道其他階段（starting、saving），請讀 OAVp5.record.state。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 recordingIsOn 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.record.state === 'on'。 錄影進行中是 true。一開始、錄影程式還在載入、從呼叫 stopRecording() 的那一刻起（檔案這時還在製作）、以及錄完之後，都是 false。

records.k: recording saved file saved recording done info callback blob download file name 錄影存好 檔案完成 錄完 檔案資訊 callback 檔名
records.d: An event you define: it is called when a recording has been saved and checked, with an info object about the file.
records.x: Define function recordingSaved(info) { … } to know when the file is done: stopRecording() or the end of seconds leads to it. By then the file has already been handed to the browser to download. The same info is given to the promise of stopRecording() and to OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn), and stays in OAVp5.record.last. info.url works as a link to the file (createA(info.url, 'play') or a ) until a minute after the next take is saved. warnings is what the card after the take says in words; an empty list means nothing looked wrong. info name (the file name), format ('mp4' or 'webm'), type (the exact MIME type), seconds (length, to a tenth), bytes, width and height (even numbers for MP4), fps, audio (the video has a sound track), heard (something sounded), sources (which sounds were in it: 'sound', 'drums', 'mic', 'p5sound'), warnings (what looked wrong: 'recEmpty', 'recWebm', 'recNoAudio', 'recSilent', 'recBlack', usually an empty list), blob (the file) and url (an address for the blob).

records.k: recording saved file saved recording done info callback blob download file name 錄影存好 檔案完成 錄完 檔案資訊 callback 檔名
records.d: 一個由你定義的事件函式：錄影存好、檢查完之後呼叫它，帶著一個說明這支檔案的 info 物件。
records.x: 定義 function recordingSaved(info) { … }，就知道檔案什麼時候好了：stopRecording() 或 seconds 時間到之後會走到這裡。那時檔案已經交給瀏覽器下載了。同一份 info 也會交給 stopRecording() 回傳的 promise 和 OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn)，並且留在 OAVp5.record.last。 info.url 可以當成檔案的連結用（createA(info.url, 'play') 或 ），直到下一支錄好之後一分鐘為止。warnings 是錄完之後卡片用文字說的那些事，空的清單表示沒有哪裡不對。 info name（檔名）、format（'mp4' 或 'webm'）、type（精確的 MIME 類型）、seconds（長度，精確到 0.1 秒）、bytes、width 和 height（MP4 會是偶數）、fps、audio（影片有沒有音軌）、heard（有沒有真的出過聲）、sources（錄進去的聲音來源：'sound'、'drums'、'mic'、'p5sound'）、warnings（看起來哪裡不對：'recEmpty'、'recWebm'、'recNoAudio'、'recSilent'、'recBlack'，通常是空的）、blob（檔案本身）、url（blob 的位址）。

records.k: record recording video capture mp4 webm screen recording export video instagram canvas mediarecorder 錄影 錄製 影片 輸出影片 擷取 mp4 存成影片 畫布 作品影片
records.d: Records the canvas and the sound your sketch makes into one video file, and returns a promise that says whether the recording began.
records.x: Start it from a key or a click: if (key === 'r') startRecording();. What goes into the video is the canvas alone, at its own pixel size (a retina screen doubles it), and everything your sketch sounds like: the instrument of startSound(), the drum machine, the pads, the microphone while it is on, and p5.sound 1.x, mixed into one track while the speakers play as before. The 🎹, the drum grid and the cards are part of the page, not of the canvas, so they are never in the video. A sound that comes on during the take joins it. The file is MP4 (H.264 + AAC, which Instagram, YouTube and every editor take) where the browser can write it, and WebM where not; a card says Instagram will not take a WebM. It is named oav-20261015-183005.mp4, with name in the middle when you give one. When the take is done it is downloaded, and on a phone that can share files a Share button appears on the card. After stopRecording(), or when seconds has run out, recordingSaved(info) is called with the details. Without seconds a take stops by itself at the longest length (300 seconds unless the reclimit option says otherwise). Without bitrate the quality follows the canvas: 0.16 bits per pixel per frame, kept between 4 and 16 megabits a second (24 above 30 frames a second). Calling startRecording() while a take is running starts nothing new. After every take a card says what was recorded and, when something looks wrong, what and why: nothing reached the sound track although a sound was on, WebM, a file…

records.k: record recording video capture mp4 webm screen recording export video instagram canvas mediarecorder 錄影 錄製 影片 輸出影片 擷取 mp4 存成影片 畫布 作品影片
records.d: 把畫布和草圖發出的聲音錄成一支影片檔，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你錄影有沒有開始。
records.x: 從按鍵或點擊啟動：if (key === 'r') startRecording();。進影片的只有畫布本身（用畫布自己的像素大小，視網膜螢幕會是兩倍），加上你的草圖發出的所有聲音：startSound() 的樂器、鼓機、打擊墊、開著的麥克風、p5.sound 1.x，混成一條音軌，喇叭照常播放。🎹、鼓機格子和提示卡片是頁面的一部分，不在畫布上，所以不會出現在影片裡。錄到一半才開起來的聲音也會加入。 瀏覽器寫得出 MP4 的話，檔案就是 MP4（H.264 + AAC，Instagram、YouTube 和所有剪輯軟體都吃），不然就是 WebM，這時會有卡片說 Instagram 不收 WebM。檔名像 oav-20261015-183005.mp4，有給 name 的話會放在中間。錄完會自動下載，在能分享檔案的手機上，卡片會出現「分享」按鈕。呼叫 stopRecording() 之後，或 seconds 時間到了，會呼叫 recordingSaved(info) 並把細節交給它。沒給 seconds 的話，錄到最長長度就會自己停（預設 300 秒，載入選項 reclimit 可以改）。 沒給 bitrate 的話，畫質跟著畫布大小走：每個像素、每一格 0.16 位元，限制在每秒 4 到 16 百萬位元之間（每秒超過 30 格時是 24）。已經在錄的時候再呼叫 startRecording()，不會開新的一支。每支錄完之後，卡片會說錄了什麼，有地方不對的話還會說是什麼、為什麼：有聲音開著、卻沒有任何東西進到音軌、WebM、幾乎是空的檔案、畫布明明不是黑的、影片卻是黑的。 瀏覽器要有 MediaRecorder，沒有的話會跳出卡片說明，promise 也會 resolve 成 false。畫面馬上就錄，但頁面要有一次點擊或按鍵之後才能發聲，所以在第一次點擊之前開始的錄影，一開始是沒有聲音可錄的。畫布上如果有別的網站來的圖片（沒有 CORS），就錄不了，卡片會告訴你。 在 🎹 面板裡，⏺ 不用寫程式就能開始和停止錄影，📷 把畫布存成 PNG（見 OAVp5.record.shot()）。錄影的時候，🎹 按鈕上會有紅點和時間。載入選項 record（on、nomic 或 off）、recfps、reclimit、title 可以設定預設值。 麥克風開著的時候會錄進影片：請戴耳機，不然喇叭的聲音會被錄兩次。p5 2.x 用的 p5.sound 把每個聲音直接接到喇叭，沒辦法錄（卡片會說明），請改用 p5 1.11，或用 startSound() 和 startDrums()。草圖自己用 Tone.js 或 Web Audio 程式發出的聲音，同樣不會被錄進去。 畫在畫布上的東西都會進影片，所以提示文字只在 recordingIsOn 是 false 的時候畫。 o 給數字就是秒數：startRecording(10) 錄十秒後自己停。給物件的話，可以放 seconds（同樣是秒數，不會超過一支影片的長度上限，預設 300）、fps（每秒幾格，最多 60，預設 30）、mic（false 就不把麥克風錄進影片）、name（檔名裡的一個詞）、canvas（要錄的畫布：、p5 畫布或 createGraphics() 的緩衝區，預設是頁面上最大的那張 p5 畫布）和 bitrate（每秒幾位元）。不傳就一直錄到呼叫 stopRecording()。 錄影開始之後 resolve 成 true（已經在錄的話也是 true）。載入選項 record 是…

records.k: stop recording finish end recording save video download 停止錄影 結束錄影 存成影片 下載
records.d: Stops the recording; the video is finished, downloaded, and handed to recordingSaved(info) and to the returned promise.
records.x: It ends a take that has no seconds, or ends one early. recordingIsOn turns false at once, while the file is made (OAVp5.record.state is 'saving' until then), so the promise or recordingSaved() is how you know the file is ready. Both come after a fraction of a second, a little more for a long take. Resolves, once the file is saved and checked, to the same info that recordingSaved(info) gets. Resolves to null at once when nothing is recording, or when the recording was still starting (nothing was recorded then).

records.k: stop recording finish end recording save video download 停止錄影 結束錄影 存成影片 下載
records.d: 停止錄影，影片完成後會下載，並交給 recordingSaved(info) 和回傳的 promise。
records.x: 用來結束沒有給 seconds 的錄影，或是提早結束。recordingIsOn 馬上變成 false，檔案這時還在製作（OAVp5.record.state 在那之前是 'saving'），所以要用 promise 或 recordingSaved() 才知道檔案好了。兩者都在不到一秒之後，很長的一支會再久一點。 檔案存好、檢查完之後，resolve 成跟 recordingSaved(info) 拿到的同一份 info。沒有在錄、或錄影還在啟動中（那時還沒錄到東西）的時候，馬上 resolve 成 null。

records.k: OAVp5.record record object midi.record recording state debug 錄影物件 錄影狀態 除錯 midi.record
records.d: The object behind the recording names: the state, the time, the last file, the formats this browser can write and the screenshot function.
records.x: OAVp5.record (also reachable as midi.record) is what startRecording(), stopRecording() and recordingIsOn are built on. It holds the state of the recording, how many seconds it has run, the last file's info, the sources in the take, and the fps and limit in force. formats() says what the browser can write, shot() saves a PNG of the canvas and on() listens to 'start' and 'saved'. start and stop are the same as the two global functions. For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, the console and debugging.

records.k: OAVp5.record record object midi.record recording state debug 錄影物件 錄影狀態 除錯 midi.record
records.d: 錄影相關名稱背後的物件：狀態、時間、最後一支檔案、這個瀏覽器能寫的格式，以及存圖的函式。
records.x: OAVp5.record（也可以用 midi.record 取得）是 startRecording()、stopRecording() 和 recordingIsOn 的底層。裡面有錄影的 state、已經錄了多少 seconds、last 最後一支檔案的 info、這一支裡有哪些聲音來源 sources，以及生效的 fps 和 limit。formats() 說明瀏覽器能寫什麼格式，shot() 把畫布存成 PNG，on() 監聽 'start' 和 'saved'。start 和 stop 跟那兩個全域函式一模一樣。 一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、主控台和除錯用的。

records.k: formats mp4 webm mime supported mediarecorder browser support 格式 mp4 webm 支援 瀏覽器支援 MIME
records.d: Says what this browser can record: { recorder, mp4, webm, mime }.
records.x: Use it before you offer a recording button, or to tell the person which file they will get: MP4 goes to Instagram and every editor, WebM does not. It asks the browser each time you call it. recorder is true when the browser has MediaRecorder at all, mp4 and webm are true when it can write that format, and mime is the MIME type a recording asks for first (MP4 where possible), or '' when none works.

records.k: formats mp4 webm mime supported mediarecorder browser support 格式 mp4 webm 支援 瀏覽器支援 MIME
records.d: 告訴你這個瀏覽器能錄什麼：{ recorder, mp4, webm, mime }。
records.x: 在你要提供錄影按鈕之前用它，或是告訴使用的人會拿到哪種檔案：MP4 可以直接上傳 Instagram，也能放進所有剪輯軟體，WebM 不行。每次呼叫都會重新問一次瀏覽器。 recorder 表示瀏覽器到底有沒有 MediaRecorder，mp4 和 webm 表示能不能寫那種格式，mime 是錄影最先要求的 MIME 類型（可以的話是 MP4），都不行的話是 ''。

records.k: fps frame rate limit maximum length recfps reclimit longest take 格率 每秒幾格 長度上限 最長 recfps reclimit
records.d: The frame rate (fps) and the longest take in seconds (limit) that the loading options recfps and reclimit set.
records.x: They are there to read: OAVp5.record.limit tells a sketch how long a take can be. Writing to them changes nothing, because a take reads the options, not these two. To record at another frame rate once, pass startRecording({ fps: 60 }); to change the limit, set the reclimit option before oav-p5 loads (window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: 600 }). fps is 30 and limit is 300 unless the options say otherwise (fps is kept between 1 and 60).

records.k: fps frame rate limit maximum length recfps reclimit longest take 格率 每秒幾格 長度上限 最長 recfps reclimit
records.d: 載入選項 recfps 和 reclimit 設定的錄影格率（fps）和一支影片最長的秒數（limit）。
records.x: 它們是拿來讀的：OAVp5.record.limit 讓草圖知道一支影片最長能錄多久。對它們賦值沒有作用，因為錄影讀的是載入選項，不是這兩個值。想用別的格率錄一次，就傳 startRecording({ fps: 60 })，要改長度上限，在 oav-p5 載入之前設定 reclimit 選項（window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: 600 }）。 fps 預設是 30，limit 預設是 300，除非載入選項另外設定（fps 會被限制在 1 到 60 之間）。

records.k: last recording last take previous file info file name url 最近一支 上一次錄影 檔名 連結
records.d: The info of the last recording that was saved (the same object recordingSaved got), or null before the first one.
records.x: Handy when you did not keep info in recordingSaved(): show the last file name, or put OAVp5.record.last.url in a link. The address stays valid until a minute after the next take is saved. Replaced each time a take is saved. See recordingSaved() for its fields.

records.k: last recording last take previous file info file name url 最近一支 上一次錄影 檔名 連結
records.d: 最近一支存好的錄影的 info（跟 recordingSaved 拿到的是同一個物件），第一支之前是 null。
records.x: 當你沒有在 recordingSaved() 裡把 info 存下來的時候很方便：顯示最後一支的檔名，或把 OAVp5.record.last.url 放進連結。這個位址會一直有效，直到下一支存好之後一分鐘。 每存好一支就換成新的。欄位見 recordingSaved()。

records.k: listen subscribe event on saved on start listener off 監聽 訂閱 事件 取消監聽 錄影事件
records.d: Listens to the recording from anywhere: OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn) or on('start', fn), and it returns a function that stops listening.
records.x: recordingSaved() is a single function that you define. on() is for the cases where that does not fit: several listeners, a library, a listener you want to remove again. It is the same idea as OAVp5.drums.on() and midi.on(). An error thrown inside fn is printed and the other listeners still run. name 'start' (a take began) or 'saved' (a file is saved, like recordingSaved()). Any other name throws an error that lists the two. fn For 'start' it gets { width, height, fps, type, seconds } (seconds is 0 when no length was asked for). For 'saved' it gets the same info as recordingSaved(). A function: call it to stop listening.

records.k: listen subscribe event on saved on start listener off 監聽 訂閱 事件 取消監聽 錄影事件
records.d: 在任何地方監聽錄影：OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn) 或 on('start', fn)，並回傳一個可以取消監聽的函式。
records.x: recordingSaved() 是你定義的單一函式。on() 是給不適用的情況：好幾個監聽者、函式庫、或是想把監聽者再拿掉。概念跟 OAVp5.drums.on() 和 midi.on() 一樣。fn 裡丟出的錯誤會被印出來，其他監聽者照樣執行。 name 'start'（一支錄影開始了）或 'saved'（檔案存好了，跟 recordingSaved() 一樣）。其他的名字會丟出錯誤，並列出這兩個。 fn 'start' 拿到的是 { width, height, fps, type, seconds }（沒指定長度的話 seconds 是 0）。'saved' 拿到的是跟 recordingSaved() 一樣的 info。 一個函式，呼叫它就停止監聽。

records.k: seconds elapsed recording time timer duration clock 秒數 已錄時間 錄影時間 計時 長度
records.d: How long the running take has been going, in seconds, and the length of the last take after it.
records.x: Use it as a clock that starts with the take: const t = recordingIsOn ? OAVp5.record.seconds : 0; makes an animation that always begins at 0 in the video. It is the time since the recording began, not the time of the sketch, so it does not count the moment before startRecording(). 0 at the start, then refreshed four times a second while recording. When the take is saved it is that take's length, and the next take sets it back to 0.

records.k: seconds elapsed recording time timer duration clock 秒數 已錄時間 錄影時間 計時 長度
records.d: 正在錄的這一支已經錄了幾秒，錄完之後是那一支的長度。
records.x: 當成跟著這一支錄影一起開始的時鐘：const t = recordingIsOn ? OAVp5.record.seconds : 0; 做出來的動畫，在影片裡一定從 0 開始。它是錄影開始之後的時間，不是草圖的時間，所以不包含 startRecording() 之前的那段。 一開始是 0，錄影中每秒更新四次。檔案存好之後是那一支的長度，下一支開始的時候又歸零。

records.k: screenshot png still save image save canvas snapshot picture 截圖 png 存圖 靜態圖 快照 存畫布
records.d: Saves the canvas alone as a PNG picture (not the 🎹, not the cards) and downloads it.
records.x: It is the button 📷 in the 🎹 panel as a function. The file is named oav-20261015-183005.png (with name in the middle when you give one) and is downloaded at once; on a phone that can share files a Share button appears on a card instead. The picture has the size of the canvas in pixels, so a retina screen gives twice the width and height. p5's own saveCanvas('name', 'png') does the same thing without the card. With the loading option record=off the 📷 button is gone and startRecording() does nothing, but this function still saves the PNG (tried). o Options: canvas (the canvas to save: a , a p5 canvas or a createGraphics() buffer; the biggest p5 canvas on the page by default) and name (a word for the file name). Resolves to { name, blob, url, width, height, bytes }, or to null when there is no canvas or it cannot be read (an image from another site on it, no CORS).

records.k: screenshot png still save image save canvas snapshot picture 截圖 png 存圖 靜態圖 快照 存畫布
records.d: 把畫布本身存成 PNG 圖片（不包含 🎹 和提示卡片）並下載。
records.x: 就是 🎹 面板裡 📷 按鈕的函式版。檔名像 oav-20261015-183005.png（有給 name 的話會放在中間），馬上下載，在能分享檔案的手機上，會改成在卡片上出現「分享」按鈕。圖片的大小就是畫布的像素大小，所以視網膜螢幕的寬和高會是兩倍。p5 自己的 saveCanvas('name', 'png') 做的是同一件事，只是沒有卡片。 載入選項 record=off 的時候，📷 按鈕會消失，startRecording() 也什麼都不做，但這個函式仍然可以存 PNG（實際試過）。 o 選項：canvas（要存的畫布：、p5 畫布或 createGraphics() 的緩衝區，預設是頁面上最大的 p5 畫布）和 name（檔名裡的一個詞）。 resolve 成 { name, blob, url, width, height, bytes }，找不到畫布、或畫布讀不出來（上面有別的網站來的圖片，沒有 CORS）的時候是 null。

records.k: sources audio sources what is recorded mic in take tracks 來源 聲音來源 錄進了什麼 音軌
records.d: Which sounds the running take is hearing right now: a list of 'sound', 'drums', 'mic' and 'p5sound'; empty when no take runs.
records.x: It is what the take has connected, not whether something is audible at this moment. A source that is switched on halfway joins the list within a quarter of a second. After the take, recordingSaved() gives the final list in info.sources. A new list on every read. 'sound' is the instrument of startSound(), 'drums' the drum machine and the pads, 'mic' the microphone, 'p5sound' p5.sound 1.x.

records.k: sources audio sources what is recorded mic in take tracks 來源 聲音來源 錄進了什麼 音軌
records.d: 正在錄的這一支現在錄進了哪些聲音：由 'sound'、'drums'、'mic'、'p5sound' 組成的清單，沒在錄的時候是空的。
records.x: 它是這一支已經接上的來源，不是此刻有沒有聲音聽得到。錄到一半才打開的來源，會在四分之一秒內加進清單。錄完之後，最終的清單在 recordingSaved() 的 info.sources 裡。 每次讀都是一份新的清單。'sound' 是 startSound() 的樂器，'drums' 是鼓機和打擊墊，'mic' 是麥克風，'p5sound' 是 p5.sound 1.x。

records.k: record state status saving starting recording stage 錄影狀態 儲存中 啟動中 錄影階段
records.d: Where the recording is: 'off', 'starting', 'on' or 'saving'.
records.x: recordingIsOn is state === 'on'. Read the state when the other stages matter: a button can show "starting…" and "saving…" and refuse a new take while one is being saved. Starts as 'off'. A take goes 'starting' (the recorder is loading, the first time), 'on' (recording), 'saving' (the file is being made) and back to 'off'.

records.k: record state status saving starting recording stage 錄影狀態 儲存中 啟動中 錄影階段
records.d: 錄影現在在哪個階段：'off'、'starting'、'on' 或 'saving'。
records.x: recordingIsOn 就是 state === 'on'。其他階段有影響的時候才需要讀它：按鈕可以顯示「啟動中……」和「儲存中……」，在檔案還在存的時候不接受新的一支。 一開始是 'off'。一支錄影會依序是 'starting'（錄影程式載入中，第一次才會有）、'on'（錄影中）、'saving'（檔案製作中），然後回到 'off'。

records.k: mime m4a aac opus audio format sound file candidates mime m4a aac opus 音訊格式 聲音檔 候選
records.d: The audio MIME types the recorder tries for a sound-only file, best first: AAC in .m4a, then Opus.
records.x: AAC in an .m4a file comes first because it imports into every DAW and editor. This is the list a Recorder with audioOnly: true uses, through pickMime(). A frozen list of 5 strings: audio/mp4;codecs=mp4a.40.2, audio/webm;codecs=opus, audio/ogg;codecs=opus, audio/mp4, audio/webm.

records.k: mime m4a aac opus audio format sound file candidates mime m4a aac opus 音訊格式 聲音檔 候選
records.d: 只錄聲音的檔案時，錄影器會依序嘗試的音訊 MIME 型別，最好的在前：先是 .m4a 的 AAC，再來是 Opus。
records.x: AAC 的 .m4a 檔排第一，因為它每個 DAW 和剪輯軟體都能匯入。audioOnly: true 的 Recorder 用的就是這份清單，透過 pickMime()。 一份凍結的清單，有 5 個字串：audio/mp4;codecs=mp4a.40.2、audio/webm;codecs=opus、audio/ogg;codecs=opus、audio/mp4、audio/webm。

records.k: audio tap record sound web audio mix capture speakers tone.js p5.sound track stream 收音 錄聲音 web audio 混音 擷取 喇叭 音軌 串流
records.d: Collects the sound of your work (and, if you add it, a microphone) into one recordable track, without sending anything to the speakers.
records.x: Recording the speakers with a microphone gives you the room. Tapping the Web Audio graph gives you the instrument exactly as it was synthesized, on the same clock as the canvas. An AudioTap has two buses and two outputs. The work bus is the sound of the piece; the extra bus is for things that belong in the video but not in the sound file, such as a microphone. tap.stream and tap.tracks are work and extras together (give them to the video Recorder); tap.workStream and tap.workTracks are the work alone (for the separate audio file). Both are a single track, on purpose: Chrome records only the first audio track of a stream. The tap never routes anything to the speakers, so adding a microphone cannot feed back. To record a sketch you did not write (p5.sound, Tone.js, Sound), call captureDestination() before the work starts its sound: from then on every node that connects to a speaker destination is tapped too. An AudioContext that is running. Browsers start audio only after a click, so call tap.resume() from a click handler. Without the click the tracks exist but carry silence. context The AudioContext to mix in, usually the work's own. One is made if you leave it out; it needs Web Audio to exist. sources Things to add to the work bus at once: AudioNodes, MediaStreams or MediaStreamTracks (see add()). captureDestination Also call captureDestination() right away.

records.k: audio tap record sound web audio mix capture speakers tone.js p5.sound track stream 收音 錄聲音 web audio 混音 擷取 喇叭 音軌 串流
records.d: 把你的作品的聲音（以及你加進來的麥克風）收集成一條可以錄的音軌，不會把任何東西送到喇叭。
records.x: 用麥克風錄喇叭，錄到的是房間。接上 Web Audio 的節點圖，錄到的是樂器合成出來的原樣，而且跟畫布用同一個時鐘。AudioTap 有兩條匯流排和兩個輸出。work 匯流排是作品的聲音，extra 匯流排放的是該在影片裡、卻不該在聲音檔裡的東西，例如麥克風。tap.stream 和 tap.tracks 是 work 加 extra（交給影片的 Recorder），tap.workStream 和 tap.workTracks 只有 work（給另外存的聲音檔）。兩個都只有一條音軌，這是故意的：Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。 這個 tap 絕不會把東西送到喇叭，所以加麥克風不會產生回授。要錄不是你寫的草圖（p5.sound、Tone.js、Sound），就在作品開始出聲之前呼叫 captureDestination()：從那時起，每個接到喇叭的節點也會被接進來。 要有正在跑的 AudioContext。瀏覽器要點擊過才讓聲音開始，所以在點擊的處理函式裡呼叫 tap.resume()。沒有點擊的話，音軌雖然存在，裡面是靜音。 context 要在哪個 AudioContext 裡混音，通常是作品自己的。沒給的話會新建一個，需要瀏覽器有 Web Audio。 sources 要馬上加進作品匯流排的東西：AudioNode、MediaStream 或 MediaStreamTrack（見 add()）。 captureDestination 同時馬上呼叫 captureDestination()。

records.k: getUserMedia constraints camera resolution ideal facingMode device id getUserMedia 限制條件 鏡頭 解析度 理想值 前後鏡頭 裝置 id
records.d: Builds the getUserMedia options for a camera: it asks for 1920 by 1080 at 30 fps, but only as an ideal, never as a demand.
records.x: Size and rate are ideal, never exact: a camera that cannot do 1920 by 1080 should open at what it can, not throw in front of an audience. It is pure, so you can look at what openCamera() will ask for. The stream has no audio: a microphone is added through AudioTap. deviceId A specific camera, from listCameras(). It is asked for as exact: if it is gone, opening fails. width The width to ask for, as ideal. height The height to ask for, as ideal. fps The frame rate to ask for, as ideal. facingMode 'user' or 'environment' on a phone. Ignored when a deviceId is given. A MediaStreamConstraints: { video: { width: { ideal }, height: { ideal }, frameRate: { ideal }, deviceId?, facingMode? }, audio: false }.

records.k: getUserMedia constraints camera resolution ideal facingMode device id getUserMedia 限制條件 鏡頭 解析度 理想值 前後鏡頭 裝置 id
records.d: 做出開鏡頭用的 getUserMedia 選項：它要求 1920 乘 1080、30 fps，但只是理想值，不是硬性要求。
records.x: 尺寸和畫格率是 ideal，不是 exact：做不到 1920 乘 1080 的鏡頭應該用它做得到的規格開起來，而不是在觀眾面前丟出錯誤。它是純函式，所以你可以看 openCamera() 會要求什麼。串流裡沒有聲音：麥克風要透過 AudioTap 加。 deviceId 指定哪一個鏡頭，來自 listCameras()。用 exact 要求：如果它不見了，就會開啟失敗。 width 想要的寬，用 ideal 要求。 height 想要的高，用 ideal 要求。 fps 想要的畫格率，用 ideal 要求。 facingMode 手機上的 'user'（前鏡頭）或 'environment'（後鏡頭）。有給 deviceId 時會被忽略。 一個 MediaStreamConstraints：{ video: { width: { ideal }, height: { ideal }, frameRate: { ideal }, deviceId?, facingMode? }, audio: false }。

records.k: clean json safe serialize sanitize round typed array 整理 json 安全 序列化 清理 捨入 型別陣列
records.d: Makes a copy of a signal value that is safe to write as JSON: rounded numbers, plain arrays, no functions, nothing too deep.
records.x: The rules: numbers are rounded to 6 decimals, and NaN and infinities become null. Typed arrays become plain arrays. A bigint becomes a number. Objects and arrays are copied down to depth 4 and anything deeper becomes null. A function, symbol or undefined becomes null in an array and the key is dropped from an object. EventLog runs every value through it. v The value to clean. depth How deep we already are. Leave it out; it is used by the function calling itself. The cleaned copy.

records.k: clean json safe serialize sanitize round typed array 整理 json 安全 序列化 清理 捨入 型別陣列
records.d: 做出一份訊號值的複本，可以安全地寫成 JSON：數字捨入、陣列變普通陣列、沒有函式、也不會太深。
records.x: 規則：數字捨入到小數第 6 位，NaN 和無限大變成 null。型別陣列變成普通陣列。bigint 變成數字。物件和陣列往下複製到第 4 層，再深的變成 null。函式、symbol 和 undefined 在陣列裡變成 null，在物件裡這個鍵會被丟掉。EventLog 把每個值都經過它。 v 要整理的值。 depth 目前已經到第幾層。不用給，是函式呼叫自己的時候用的。 整理過的複本。

records.k: compositor composite camera webcam canvas layout picture in picture pip stack vertical video 合成器 合成 鏡頭 網路攝影機 畫布 版面 子母畫面 直式影片 錄影 鏡像
records.d: Draws your work and the performer's camera into one canvas of an exact size, every frame: the canvas that a Recorder records.
records.x: A performance video is two things in one picture: your work and the performer. The Compositor makes that picture. It owns a canvas (comp.canvas) of exactly the size of the file you want, whatever your window is, so a vertical 4K video from a laptop really is 4K. It is the canvas you hand to a Recorder. To show it on the page as a preview, put comp.canvas in the DOM and shrink it with CSS. comp.start() redraws every animation frame (and, because a hidden tab freezes animation frames, from a Web Worker timer too, so a recording does not freeze with the tab). comp.draw() draws one frame now: call it yourself right after your work renders if you have your own loop. comp.rects is the last layout, { work, cam } in output pixels, and comp.fps is the rate it has been drawing at. The camera is optional and never owned: setCamera(stream) shows it and setCamera(null) lets go, and you stop the tracks yourself. The camera's area can show a panel instead, anything with draw(ctx, rect, now), for example a drawing of the controller being played. The area for the camera is reserved before the camera arrives, so the picture does not jump. A WebGL work: the compositor copies its canvas in the same animation frame it was drawn in, which works in Chrome. If you see black, create the WebGL context with preserveDrawingBuffer: true, or call comp.draw() right after your render and do not call start(). Webcams usually stop at 1080p30, so a 4K stack layout enlarges the camera about 1.6 times. The…

records.k: compositor composite camera webcam canvas layout picture in picture pip stack vertical video 合成器 合成 鏡頭 網路攝影機 畫布 版面 子母畫面 直式影片 錄影 鏡像
records.d: 每個畫面把你的作品和表演者的鏡頭畫進一張尺寸精確的畫布：這張畫布就是 Recorder 要錄的那張。
records.x: 表演影片是同一個畫面裡的兩件事：你的作品和表演者。Compositor 就是做這個畫面的。它擁有一張畫布（comp.canvas），大小就是你要的檔案大小，跟你的視窗多大無關，所以在筆電上錄的直式 4K 影片真的是 4K。把這張畫布交給 Recorder。要在頁面上預覽，就把 comp.canvas 放進 DOM，再用 CSS 縮小。 comp.start() 每個動畫畫面重畫一次（而且因為被藏起來的分頁會凍結動畫畫面，所以也用 Web Worker 的計時器畫，這樣錄影不會跟著分頁一起凍住）。comp.draw() 馬上畫一個畫面：如果你有自己的迴圈，就在作品畫完之後自己呼叫它。comp.rects 是最近一次的版面，{ work, cam }，單位是輸出的像素，comp.fps 是它實際畫的頻率。 鏡頭是選用的，而且合成器不擁有它：setCamera(stream) 顯示它，setCamera(null) 放手，音軌由你自己停。鏡頭的區域也可以改放一個面板，也就是任何有 draw(ctx, rect, now) 的東西，例如一張正在彈的控制器的圖。鏡頭的區域會在鏡頭來之前就先留好，所以畫面不會跳動。 WebGL 的作品：合成器會在作品畫完的同一個動畫畫面裡複製它的畫布，在 Chrome 上這樣就行。如果看到黑的，就用 preserveDrawingBuffer: true 建立 WebGL context，或在你渲染完之後馬上呼叫 comp.draw()，並且不要呼叫 start()。 網路攝影機通常只到 1080p30，所以 4K 的 stack 版面會把鏡頭放大約 1.6 倍。上面的作品是照輸出尺寸畫的，只要作品自己的畫布至少跟它的區域一樣大，就會保持清楚。 在 p5 草圖裡用不到這個：startRecording() 會替你錄畫布和它的聲音。Compositor 是給要把作品和鏡頭一起錄的頁面用的。 size 輸出的尺寸，也就是檔案的尺寸。可以是 PRESETS 的 id（'vertical-4k'）、'1080x1920'、[w, h] 或 { w, h }。每一邊都會進位成偶數。見 resolveSize()。 layout 作品和鏡頭放在哪裡：stack、pip、side、work（見 LAYOUTS）。 layoutOptions 原封不動交給 layoutRects()：fit、camFit、camAnchor、minCam、split、pip。 getWorkCanvas 回傳你的作品的畫布，或 null。每個畫面都會問一次，因為 p5 草圖可能換掉畫布，WebGL 作品可能改變大小。合成器從來不擁有作品。 background 所有東西後面的顏色，任何畫布能用的顏色字串。 mirrorCam 把鏡頭顯示成鏡子，這是表演者習慣的樣子。要跟畫在上面的手部追蹤的 mirror 保持一樣。 maxFps 跑起來的時候最多這麼頻繁地畫。120 Hz 的螢幕不需要每秒合成 120 次。 onDraw onDraw(ctx, rects, comp)，作品和鏡頭畫好之後呼叫，用來在最上面再蓋一層。呼叫前後會保存和還原繪圖狀態。裡面出錯只會警告一次，不會中斷錄影。 canvas 畫進這張畫布，不另外做新的。它的寬高會被設成輸出的尺寸。

records.k: event log log score timestamps record events notes played signals json markers 事件記錄 記錄 樂譜 時間戳記 錄事件 彈過的音 訊號 json 標記
records.d: Keeps a timestamped list of what happened during a take, such as notes and parameter changes, on the same clock as the recording.
records.x: A video keeps the picture and the sound. The log keeps the score of the take: every note, pad hit and (throttled) hand position, in milliseconds from the moment recording started. With it a take can be re-rendered at another size, re-synced to a better audio take, or turned into MIDI later. Start it with the recorder's start time so event times line up with the video's first frame: log.start(recorder.t0). log.attach(signals) logs every signal a Signals bus publishes; pulses are always kept and continuous signals obey throttleMs. Or add events yourself with log.add(name, value). Values are cleaned into plain JSON data by cleanValue(). toJSON() gives { format: 'openav-eventlog', version: 1, startedAt, durationMs, count, events }, and EventLog.fromJSON(json) reads it back. toTake() turns the log into a MIDI take; TakeRecorder is a log that does exactly that on midi/. Properties: events is the list [{ t, name, value }] (t in ms, to a tenth), t0 the clock time of t = 0, startedAt the wall-clock time (ISO text) and durationMs is null until stop(). now The clock, in milliseconds. The default is the same clock as Recorder.t0. Pass your own in a test. filter filter(name, value, meta), returns whether to keep an event. It applies to add() too. throttleMs For continuous signals: keep at most one event per name in this many milliseconds. Pulses (note on, note off…) are never throttled.

records.k: event log log score timestamps record events notes played signals json markers 事件記錄 記錄 樂譜 時間戳記 錄事件 彈過的音 訊號 json 標記
records.d: 把一次錄影過程中發生的事，例如音符和參數變化，連同時間記成一份清單，用的是跟錄影同一個時鐘。
records.x: 影片留下的是畫面和聲音。事件記錄留下的是這次錄影的樂譜：每個音符、每一下墊子、以及（有節流的）手的位置，從開始錄的那一刻算起的毫秒數。有了它，一段錄影之後可以用別的尺寸重新渲染、跟更好的聲音檔重新對齊，或轉成 MIDI。用錄影器的開始時間來開始它，事件時間才會跟影片的第一個畫面對齊：log.start(recorder.t0)。 log.attach(signals) 會記下 Signals 匯流排發布的每個訊號。脈衝一定會留，連續的訊號則受 throttleMs 限制。也可以自己用 log.add(name, value) 加事件。值會被 cleanValue() 整理成單純的 JSON 資料。toJSON() 給 { format: 'openav-eventlog', version: 1, startedAt, durationMs, count, events }，EventLog.fromJSON(json) 能讀回來。toTake() 把記錄轉成 MIDI 的 take，TakeRecorder 就是在 midi/ 上剛好做這件事的記錄。 屬性：events 是 [{ t, name, value }] 的清單（t 是毫秒，精確到十分之一），t0 是 t = 0 的時鐘時間，startedAt 是真實時間（ISO 文字），durationMs 在 stop() 之前是 null。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒。預設跟 Recorder.t0 是同一個時鐘。測試時傳自己的。 filter filter(name, value, meta)，回傳要不要留下這個事件。add() 也適用。 throttleMs 對連續的訊號：每個名字在這麼多毫秒內最多留一個事件。脈衝（音符開、音符關…）永遠不會被節流。

records.k: extension file name mime to extension download name mp4 m4a webm 副檔名 檔名 mime 轉副檔名 下載檔名 mp4 m4a webm
records.d: Gives the file extension for a recorded MIME type: video/mp4 is 'mp4', audio/mp4 is 'm4a', anything unknown is 'bin'.
records.x: A Recorder puts this in the ext of its result. Use it for a download name: 'take.' + extFor(blob.type). mime A MIME type, with or without codecs, in any letter case. Anything that is not text counts as empty. mp4, m4a (audio/mp4), webm, ogg, mkv (video/x-matroska) or bin.

records.k: extension file name mime to extension download name mp4 m4a webm 副檔名 檔名 mime 轉副檔名 下載檔名 mp4 m4a webm
records.d: 給一個錄好的 MIME 型別該用的副檔名：video/mp4 是 'mp4'，audio/mp4 是 'm4a'，不認識的是 'bin'。
records.x: Recorder 把它放進結果的 ext。拿來取下載檔名：'take.' + extFor(blob.type)。 mime MIME 型別，有沒有 codecs 都行，大小寫不拘。不是文字的東西當作空字串。 mp4、m4a（audio/mp4）、webm、ogg、mkv（video/x-matroska）或 bin。

records.k: landmark hand tracking pose overlay coordinates camera to output skeleton 關節點 手部追蹤 姿態 疊加 座標 鏡頭座標轉輸出 骨架
records.d: Turns a point in the camera's own 0..1 coordinates, like a hand landmark, into a pixel in the output frame.
records.x: Landmarks from a hand or pose tracker come as fractions of the camera picture. To draw something on the output at the place a landmark is, you need pixels of the output, where the camera may be enlarged and cropped. framePoint() does that. It gives the same point whether or not part of the camera is cropped away, because it uses frame, the whole camera picture placed in the output. Use the same mirror in the tracker and in the compositor. camRect The cam of layoutRects(), or of compositor.rects. u Across the camera picture, 0 left to 1 right, in the displayed (mirrored if mirrorCam) orientation. v Down the camera picture, 0 top to 1 bottom. { x, y } in output pixels, or null when there is no camera (or its size is not known yet).

records.k: landmark hand tracking pose overlay coordinates camera to output skeleton 關節點 手部追蹤 姿態 疊加 座標 鏡頭座標轉輸出 骨架
records.d: 把鏡頭自己的 0..1 座標裡的一個點，像手的關節點，換成輸出畫面裡的像素。
records.x: 手部或姿態追蹤給的關節點是鏡頭畫面的比例。要在輸出上、關節點所在的位置畫東西，需要的是輸出畫面的像素，而鏡頭可能被放大和裁切。framePoint() 就是做這件事。不管鏡頭有沒有被裁掉一部分，它給的點都是對的，因為它用的是 frame，也就是整個鏡頭畫面放進輸出之後的位置。追蹤器和合成器要用同樣的 mirror。 camRect layoutRects() 的 cam，或 compositor.rects 的 cam。 u 橫跨鏡頭畫面，0 是左、1 是右，用顯示出來的方向（有 mirrorCam 就是鏡像後的）。 v 沿著鏡頭畫面往下，0 是上、1 是下。 輸出像素的 { x, y }，沒有鏡頭（或還不知道它的尺寸）就是 null。

records.k: midi file import midi smf .mid load midi parse midi file tempo midi 檔 匯入 midi smf .mid 載入 midi 解析 midi 檔 速度
records.d: Reads a Standard MIDI File into a take whose events are the signals a keyboard playing that file would publish.
records.x: It reads type 0 and type 1 files (the tracks are merged), running status, tempo changes and SMPTE time division; system exclusive messages are skipped. A file that is not a MIDI file throws a TypeError (fromMidiFile: not a MIDI file (no MThd)), and one that ends early a RangeError. Play the result into a show with TakePlayer: it drives a work like someone playing the file on a keyboard. bytes The bytes of the .mid file, for example await file.arrayBuffer(). name The name of the take. Left out, it is the track name in the file, then 'take'. families Which signal spellings to produce, as in signalsOfMidi(). The default is both, like hardware. A take. meta.bpm is the first tempo in the file (not set for SMPTE time).

records.k: midi file import midi smf .mid load midi parse midi file tempo midi 檔 匯入 midi smf .mid 載入 midi 解析 midi 檔 速度
records.d: 把標準 MIDI 檔讀成 take，裡面的事件就是鍵盤彈這個檔案時會發布的訊號。
records.x: 它讀 type 0 和 type 1 的檔案（音軌會合併）、running status、速度變化，和 SMPTE 時間單位。系統專用訊息會被略過。不是 MIDI 的檔案會丟出 TypeError（fromMidiFile: not a MIDI file (no MThd)），中途結束的檔案會丟出 RangeError。用 TakePlayer 把結果播進演出：它驅動作品的方式，就像有人在鍵盤上彈這個檔案。 bytes .mid 檔的位元組，例如 await file.arrayBuffer()。 name take 的名字。沒給的話用檔案裡的音軌名稱，再沒有就是 'take'。 families 要產生哪幾種訊號寫法，跟 signalsOfMidi() 一樣。預設兩種都有，就像硬體。 一個 take。meta.bpm 是檔案裡第一個速度（SMPTE 時間的檔案不設）。

records.k: layout rects crop cover contain letterbox pip stack side geometry 版面 矩形 裁切 滿版 黑邊 子母畫面 幾何 畫面 鏡頭區域
records.d: Works out where the work and the camera go in an output frame, in whole pixels, for one of the four layouts.
records.x: It is pure arithmetic: no DOM, no clock. The Compositor calls it whenever a size changes. A 1080 by 1920 frame with a square work and stack splits into exactly 1080 by 1080 and 1080 by 840, with no seam row. The crop of a camera is in the displayed orientation, so with the mirror on, an anchor of x: 0.2 still means "keep the left of what you see". stack puts the work across the full width at the top and the camera below. If that would leave the camera under minCam of the height (a square or landscape frame), the work gets split of the height and is letterboxed in it. side is the same turned sideways. pip fills the frame with the work and puts the camera in a corner as a rounded inset. work is the work alone. layout One of LAYOUTS. Any other name throws a TypeError. out The output size { w, h } in pixels. It must be positive, or this throws. src The sizes of the sources: { workW, workH, camW, camH }. A missing or zero value means unknown. An unknown work counts as square. With an unknown camera the camera's area is still reserved, with crop: null and frame: null, so the frame does not jump when the camera arrives. opts Options: fit ('contain' default, or 'cover', for the work), camFit ('cover' default, or 'contain'), camAnchor ({ x, y }, 0..1, default the middle: which part a cover-crop keeps, in what you see), minCam (0.2: the share of the height in stack, or of the width in side, that the camera must keep), split (0.6: the work's share when it would leave the camera less…

records.k: layout rects crop cover contain letterbox pip stack side geometry 版面 矩形 裁切 滿版 黑邊 子母畫面 幾何 畫面 鏡頭區域
records.d: 算出作品和鏡頭在輸出畫面的哪裡，單位是整數像素，支援四種版面。
records.x: 這是純算術：沒有 DOM、沒有時鐘。Compositor 在尺寸改變時就呼叫它。1080 乘 1920 的畫面放一個正方形的作品、用 stack，會剛好切成 1080 乘 1080 和 1080 乘 840，中間沒有縫。鏡頭的裁切是用顯示出來的方向表示的，所以開了鏡像之後，x: 0.2 的錨點仍然是「保留你看到的畫面的左邊」。 stack 把作品橫跨整個寬度放在上面，鏡頭在下面。如果這樣留給鏡頭的高度不到 minCam（正方形或橫式畫面），作品就只佔高度的 split，並且在裡面留黑邊。side 是同樣的做法轉九十度。pip 讓作品鋪滿畫面，把鏡頭放在角落當圓角小視窗。work 只有作品。 layout LAYOUTS 其中之一。其他名字會丟出 TypeError。 out 輸出尺寸 { w, h }，單位是像素。必須是正數，否則會丟出錯誤。 src 來源的尺寸：{ workW, workH, camW, camH }。沒給或是 0 就表示不知道。不知道尺寸的作品當作正方形。鏡頭尺寸不知道時，鏡頭的區域還是會先留好，crop: null、frame: null，所以鏡頭來的時候畫面不會跳動。 opts 選項：fit（作品，預設 'contain'，或 'cover'）、camFit（預設 'cover'，或 'contain'）、camAnchor（{ x, y }，0..1，預設在中間：滿版裁切時保留哪一部分，是你看到的畫面裡的位置）、minCam（0.2：stack 裡鏡頭至少要留的高度比例，side 裡是寬度比例）、split（0.6：留給鏡頭的比 minCam 還少時，作品佔的比例）、pip（{ corner: 'br' | 'bl' | 'tr' | 'tl', size: 0.3, margin: 0.03, radius: 0.08, aspect: 0 }：小視窗寬度佔畫面的比例、離角落的距離佔短邊的比例、圓角半徑佔小視窗短邊的比例，以及形狀，0 表示用鏡頭自己的比例）。 { layout, out, work, cam }。work 和 cam 是輸出像素的 { x, y, w, h, crop, frame, box }（全是整數），cam 還多一個 radius。crop 是來源被畫出來的那一塊（來源像素，可以有小數），整張都畫就是 null。frame 是整個來源畫面會落在哪裡，被裁掉的部分在矩形外面，疊圖需要它。box 是它被放進的區域。work 版面的 cam 是 null。

records.k: layout stack pip side picture in picture work arrangement camera position 版面 堆疊 子母畫面 並排 鏡頭位置 排版
records.d: The four layout names, in picker order: 'stack', 'pip', 'side', 'work'.
records.x: stack: the work across the full width at the top, the camera fills the rest below (for vertical video: Reels, Shorts, TikTok). pip: the work fills the frame and the camera is a rounded inset in a corner (for square frames, or a work that needs all of the frame). side: the work at full height on the left, the camera fills the right (landscape). work: the work alone. layoutRects() says exactly where everything lands, and the layout option of the Compositor takes one of these names; any other name throws. ['stack', 'pip', 'side', 'work'], a frozen-by-convention list (do not change it).

records.k: layout stack pip side picture in picture work arrangement camera position 版面 堆疊 子母畫面 並排 鏡頭位置 排版
records.d: 四種版面的名字，照選單的順序：'stack'、'pip'、'side'、'work'。
records.x: stack：作品橫跨整個寬度放在上面，鏡頭填滿下面剩下的（給直式影片：Reels、Shorts、TikTok）。pip：作品鋪滿畫面，鏡頭是角落的圓角小視窗（給正方形畫面，或需要整個畫面的作品）。side：作品佔滿左邊的整個高度，鏡頭填滿右邊（橫式）。work：只有作品。確切的位置由 layoutRects() 算出，Compositor 的 layout 選項收的就是這幾個名字，其他名字會丟出錯誤。 ['stack', 'pip', 'side', 'work']，一份約定不要修改的清單。

records.k: cameras webcam list enumerate devices video inputs device id camera picker 鏡頭清單 網路攝影機 列出裝置 影像輸入 裝置 id 選鏡頭
records.d: Lists the video inputs of this computer as { deviceId, groupId, label }.
records.x: Browsers hide the labels (and sometimes the ids) until the page has had camera permission once, so call it again after openCamera() to get the real names. Needs https or localhost: elsewhere there is no navigator.mediaDevices and the promise rejects. A promise of a list of { deviceId, groupId, label }. A device without a label is called Camera 1, Camera 2… by its position.

records.k: cameras webcam list enumerate devices video inputs device id camera picker 鏡頭清單 網路攝影機 列出裝置 影像輸入 裝置 id 選鏡頭
records.d: 列出這台電腦的影像輸入，格式是 { deviceId, groupId, label }。
records.x: 瀏覽器在頁面拿到過一次鏡頭權限之前，會隱藏名字（有時連 id 也是），所以在 openCamera() 之後再呼叫一次，才會拿到真正的名字。需要 https 或 localhost：其他地方沒有 navigator.mediaDevices，promise 會被 reject。 一個 promise，內容是 { deviceId, groupId, label } 的清單。沒有名字的裝置會依位置叫作 Camera 1、Camera 2…。

records.k: microphones audio inputs enumerate devices mic list device id microphone picker 麥克風清單 音訊輸入 列出裝置 裝置 id 選麥克風
records.d: Lists the audio inputs of this computer as { deviceId, groupId, label }.
records.x: The same as listCameras() for audio, with the same rule about labels: they are generic until the page has had microphone permission once. Pass a deviceId to AudioTap.addMicrophone() to use one. A promise of a list of { deviceId, groupId, label }. A device without a label is called Microphone 1, Microphone 2… by its position.

records.k: microphones audio inputs enumerate devices mic list device id microphone picker 麥克風清單 音訊輸入 列出裝置 裝置 id 選麥克風
records.d: 列出這台電腦的音訊輸入，格式是 { deviceId, groupId, label }。
records.x: 跟 listCameras() 一樣，只是列的是音訊，名字的規則也一樣：頁面拿到過一次麥克風權限之前，名字都是通用的。把 deviceId 交給 AudioTap.addMicrophone() 就能使用其中一個。 一個 promise，內容是 { deviceId, groupId, label } 的清單。沒有名字的裝置會依位置叫作 Microphone 1、Microphone 2…。

records.k: midi events note on cc pitch bend convert take families deduplicate midi 事件 音符開 控制器 彎音 轉換 take 寫法 去重複
records.d: Reads a take as plain MIDI events (note on and off, controllers, pitch bend), picking one naming family so nothing is counted twice.
records.x: A take made on hardware holds the same note several times, under several names. This picks one family for the notes: midi/note/ if present, else midi/ch/, else one device's midi//note/, else raw midi/virtual bytes. Controllers and pitch bend come from midi/ch/ if present, else the classic names (as channel 1), else one device's. toMidiFile() and takeStats() are built on it. take The take. A list in the shape of @openav/midi: { t, type: 'noteon', ch, note, vel }, noteoff, { t, type: 'cc', ch, cc, value }, { t, type: 'pitchbend', ch, value } (0..16383), chanat and polyat. vel and value are 0..127.

records.k: midi events note on cc pitch bend convert take families deduplicate midi 事件 音符開 控制器 彎音 轉換 take 寫法 去重複
records.d: 把一個 take 讀成單純的 MIDI 事件（音符開關、控制器、彎音），只選一種名稱寫法，所以不會重複算。
records.x: 在硬體上錄的 take，同一個音會用好幾個名字記好幾次。這裡替音符選一種寫法：有 midi/note/ 就用它，沒有就用 midi/ch/，再沒有就用某一個裝置的 midi//note/，最後是 midi/virtual 的原始位元組。控制器和彎音：有 midi/ch/ 就用，沒有就用傳統名稱（當作頻道 1），再沒有就用某一個裝置的。toMidiFile() 和 takeStats() 都是建立在它上面。 take 這個 take。 @openav/midi 的格式：{ t, type: 'noteon', ch, note, vel }、noteoff、{ t, type: 'cc', ch, cc, value }、{ t, type: 'pitchbend', ch, value }（0..16383）、chanat、polyat。vel 和 value 是 0..127。

records.k: mix merge audio tracks combine chrome first track mediastream 混音 合併 音軌 合成一條 mediastream
records.d: Mixes several audio tracks into one, because Chrome records only the first audio track of a stream.
records.x: A Recorder calls this itself when you give it more than one live audio track, and closes the mix on stop(). Call it yourself when you want the one track for something else. It makes an AudioContext, so the page needs to have had a click. For several sounds that come from Web Audio nodes, AudioTap is the better tool: it mixes them without a detour through streams. tracks The audio tracks to mix. { track, close() }: the one mixed MediaStreamTrack, and a function that closes the AudioContext that mixes it.

records.k: mix merge audio tracks combine chrome first track mediastream 混音 合併 音軌 合成一條 mediastream
records.d: 把好幾條音軌混成一條，因為 Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。
records.x: 你給 Recorder 超過一條活著的音軌時，它會自己呼叫這個，並在 stop() 時關掉混音。想把那一條音軌拿去做別的事時，才自己呼叫。它會建一個 AudioContext，所以頁面需要先被點過一次。如果聲音是來自 Web Audio 節點，用 AudioTap 比較好：它直接混，不用繞一圈串流。 tracks 要混的音軌。 { track, close() }：混好的那一條 MediaStreamTrack，以及關掉混音用的 AudioContext 的函式。

records.k: take normalize sanitize sort events midi take json clean up take 正規化 整理 排序事件 midi take json 清理
records.d: Turns anything take-shaped, or its JSON text, into a valid take: events sorted by time, bad events dropped, nothing negative.
records.x: A take is what an EventLog filtered to midi/ records, as plain data: t is milliseconds from the start, name is a signal name such as midi/note/on, value is its payload, and meta holds free fields like { bpm, device, notes }. normalizeTake() makes any input safe: events that are not objects, have no name or have a t that is not a number are dropped; t is rounded to a tenth of a millisecond and held at 0 or more; the events are sorted by t (events with equal times keep their order); name defaults to 'take'; durationMs is at least the time of the last event. A new object is returned. Every function in this package that takes a take runs it through here first, so you can pass raw data. input A take, or its JSON text. A string is parsed with JSON.parse. Anything that is not an object throws a TypeError. A new take: { v: 1, name, createdAt, durationMs, events: [{ t, name, value }], meta }.

records.k: take normalize sanitize sort events midi take json clean up take 正規化 整理 排序事件 midi take json 清理
records.d: 把任何長得像 take 的東西，或它的 JSON 文字，整理成合格的 take：事件依時間排序、壞事件丟掉、沒有負數。
records.x: take 就是過濾成 midi/ 的 EventLog 記下的東西，是單純的資料：t 是從開始算起的毫秒數，name 是訊號名稱，像 midi/note/on，value 是它的內容，meta 放自由欄位，像 { bpm, device, notes }。normalizeTake() 讓任何輸入都變安全：不是物件、沒有名字、t 不是數字的事件會被丟掉，t 捨入到十分之一毫秒並限制在 0 以上，事件依 t 排序（時間一樣的保持原來的順序），name 預設是 'take'，durationMs 至少是最後一個事件的時間。回傳的是新物件。 這個套件裡每個收 take 的函式，都會先把它送進這裡處理，所以你可以直接傳原始資料。 input 一個 take，或它的 JSON 文字。字串會用 JSON.parse 解析。不是物件的東西會丟出 TypeError。 一個新的 take：{ v: 1, name, createdAt, durationMs, events: [{ t, name, value }], meta }。

records.k: note on note off midi event key down parse note families spellings 音符開 音符關 midi 事件 按下 解析音符 寫法
records.d: Tells whether a recorded event is a key going down or up, whatever its spelling, and which note on which channel.
records.x: A hardware keyboard publishes the same note under several names, and this function knows them all: midi/note/on and midi/note/off (family legacy, with value: { note, vel, ch }), midi/ch//note/ (family channel, a number, 0 for off), midi//note/on|off (family slug:) and raw bytes on midi/virtual (family virtual, { data: [status, note, vel] }). A key-down with velocity 0 in raw bytes counts as off. A channel of 0, as the on-screen piano says, counts as channel 1. ev An event { name, value } of a take. { key, on, note, ch, family, vel }, or null if it is not a note event. key is ':', on is true for a key-down, family says which spelling it came in, vel is 0..127.

records.k: note on note off midi event key down parse note families spellings 音符開 音符關 midi 事件 按下 解析音符 寫法
records.d: 告訴你一個錄下來的事件是不是鍵按下去或放開，不管它用哪一種寫法，以及是哪個頻道的哪個音。
records.x: 硬體鍵盤會把同一個音符用好幾種名字發布，這個函式全部認得：midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off（寫法 legacy，內容是 { note, vel, ch }）、midi/ch//note/（寫法 channel，是數字，0 表示放開）、midi//note/on|off（寫法 slug:），以及 midi/virtual 上的原始位元組（寫法 virtual，{ data: [status, note, vel] }）。原始位元組裡力度是 0 的按下算放開。頻道是 0 的（螢幕鋼琴會這樣）當作頻道 1。 ev take 的一個事件 { name, value }。 { key, on, note, ch, family, vel }，不是音符事件就是 null。key 是 ':'，on 是 true 表示按下，family 說明它用哪一種寫法，vel 是 0..127。

records.k: note off release stuck notes panic matching off event 音符關 放開 卡音 對應的放開事件
records.d: Gives the events that release a sounding note, in the same spelling it was played in.
records.x: This is how a TakePlayer and a TakeRecorder make sure no note is left sounding: for legacy it is midi/note/off, for channel it is midi/ch//note/ with 0, for virtual it is a raw note-off byte triple, for a device family midi//note/off. n The result of noteOf(): { note, ch, family }. A list of { name, value } events (one, or none for an unknown family).

records.k: note off release stuck notes panic matching off event 音符關 放開 卡音 對應的放開事件
records.d: 給出能放開一個正在響的音的事件，用的是它當初被彈出來的那種寫法。
records.x: TakePlayer 和 TakeRecorder 就是這樣確保沒有音一直響著：legacy 是 midi/note/off，channel 是值為 0 的 midi/ch//note/，virtual 是原始的放開位元組，裝置寫法則是 midi//note/off。 n noteOf() 的結果：{ note, ch, family }。 { name, value } 事件的清單（一個，不認得的寫法則是空的）。

records.k: camera webcam open camera getUserMedia stream video input permission 鏡頭 網路攝影機 開啟鏡頭 串流 影像輸入 權限
records.d: Opens a camera and returns its MediaStream: ideally 1920 by 1080 at 30 fps, or whatever the camera can do.
records.x: Give the stream to Compositor.setCamera(). The caller owns the stream: stop its tracks when you are done, the compositor never does. Webcams usually top out at 1080p30, so a 4K frame enlarges the camera; the work above it stays sharp. It needs https or localhost, and the user's permission. opts The options of cameraConstraints(): { deviceId, width, height, fps, facingMode }. A promise of the stream, with one video track and no audio. It rejects with the browser's error when permission is refused or the camera is missing.

records.k: camera webcam open camera getUserMedia stream video input permission 鏡頭 網路攝影機 開啟鏡頭 串流 影像輸入 權限
records.d: 開啟鏡頭並回傳它的 MediaStream：理想是 1920 乘 1080、30 fps，不行就用鏡頭做得到的。
records.x: 把串流交給 Compositor.setCamera()。串流由呼叫的人擁有：用完要自己把音軌停掉，合成器不會做。網路攝影機通常最多到 1080p30，所以 4K 的畫面會把鏡頭放大，上面的作品仍然清楚。需要 https 或 localhost，以及使用者許可。 opts cameraConstraints() 的選項：{ deviceId, width, height, fps, facingMode }。 串流的 promise，有一條影像軌，沒有聲音。權限被拒或沒有鏡頭時會用瀏覽器的錯誤 reject。

records.k: mime supported isTypeSupported codec choose format mediarecorder mime 支援 isTypeSupported 編碼 挑格式 mediarecorder
records.d: Picks the first MIME type from a list that the browser can record, using the browser's own check.
records.x: A Recorder calls this for you. It takes the browser's check as an argument so that it is pure and can be tried with a fake one, like the examples below. isTypeSupported The browser's check, for example (m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m). Not a function gives ''. A check that throws counts as "no" for that type. audioOnly Use AUDIO_MIMES instead of VIDEO_MIMES. prefer Move this container to the front, keeping the order inside each group. candidates Your own list instead of the built-in one. The first supported type, or '' when none matches (then let MediaRecorder choose its default).

records.k: mime supported isTypeSupported codec choose format mediarecorder mime 支援 isTypeSupported 編碼 挑格式 mediarecorder
records.d: 用瀏覽器自己的檢查，從清單裡挑出第一個瀏覽器錄得了的 MIME 型別。
records.x: Recorder 會替你呼叫它。它把瀏覽器的檢查當成參數傳進來，所以是純函式，可以像下面的範例那樣用假的檢查來試。 isTypeSupported 瀏覽器的檢查函式，例如 (m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m)。給的不是函式就回傳 ''。丟出錯誤的檢查，對那個型別算「不行」。 audioOnly 用 AUDIO_MIMES 而不是 VIDEO_MIMES。 prefer 把這種容器移到最前面，兩組各自的內部順序不變。 candidates 用你自己的清單，取代內建的。 第一個支援的型別，都不符合就回傳 ''（這時就讓 MediaRecorder 用它的預設）。

records.k: preset lookup size by id find size output size 預設 查詢 用 id 找尺寸 輸出尺寸
records.d: Finds one size preset by its id: presetById('vertical-4k').
records.x: Use it to fill a size picker with PRESETS, or to read the suggested frame rate and layout of a size before you build a Compositor. id The preset id, for example 'square-1080'. The preset { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }, or null if there is no such id.

records.k: preset lookup size by id find size output size 預設 查詢 用 id 找尺寸 輸出尺寸
records.d: 用 id 找出一個尺寸預設：presetById('vertical-4k')。
records.x: 拿來為尺寸選單填上 PRESETS 的內容，或在建 Compositor 之前讀一個尺寸建議的畫格率和版面。 id 預設的 id，例如 'square-1080'。 那個預設 { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }，沒有這個 id 就是 null。

records.k: sizes presets 1080p 4k vertical landscape square resolution 9:16 reels 尺寸 預設 1080p 4k 直式 橫式 方形 解析度 9:16 輸出尺寸
records.d: The output sizes the compositor knows by name, from vertical-1080p (1080 by 1920) to landscape-4k, each with its suggested layout and frame rate.
records.x: Every side is even, because H.264 and VP9 encode 4:2:0 colour, which needs even sizes. Use an id as the size of a Compositor; presetById() looks one up. A frozen list of 11 presets. Each is { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }: group is 'vertical', 'landscape' or 'square', label and labelZh are names for a picker, layout is the layout suggested for the shape and fps is recommendedFps().

records.k: sizes presets 1080p 4k vertical landscape square resolution 9:16 reels 尺寸 預設 1080p 4k 直式 橫式 方形 解析度 9:16 輸出尺寸
records.d: 合成器認得名字的輸出尺寸，從 vertical-1080p（1080 乘 1920）到 landscape-4k，每個都附建議的版面和畫格率。
records.x: 每一邊都是偶數，因為 H.264 和 VP9 用 4:2:0 的色彩編碼，需要偶數的尺寸。可以把 id 當作 Compositor 的 size。用 presetById() 查某一個。 一份凍結的清單，有 11 個預設。每個是 { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }：group 是 'vertical'、'landscape' 或 'square'，label 和 labelZh 是給選單用的名字，layout 是這種形狀建議的版面，fps 是 recommendedFps()。

records.k: quantize snap to grid timing on the beat tempo groove clean up playing 量化 對齊格子 節奏 對拍 速度 律動 修正演奏
records.d: Snaps the key presses of a take to a rhythmic grid, so a loose performance lands on the beat.
records.x: Each key-down moves to the nearest grid line (60000 / bpm / grid milliseconds apart). The key-up of a note moves with it, so the length of every note is kept. Everything that is not a note (controllers, pitch bend) stays where it was. A note written in two spellings at the same time (midi/note/on and midi/ch/1/note/60) moves by the same amount in both. take The take. bpm The tempo.
