Left out, it is take.meta.bpm, and then 120. grid Grid steps per beat: 4 is sixteenths, 2 is eighths, 1 is quarters. strength How far to move, 0..1. 1 is all the way, 0.5 is half way to the grid, 0 changes nothing. offsetMs Shift the grid later by this many milliseconds, for a take that does not start on a beat. A new take.

records.k: quantize snap to grid timing on the beat tempo groove clean up playing 量化 對齊格子 節奏 對拍 速度 律動 修正演奏
records.d: 把一個 take 的按鍵對齊到節奏格子上，讓不太準的演奏落在拍點上。
records.x: 每次按下的鍵會移到最近的格線上（格線之間隔 60000 / bpm / grid 毫秒）。音符放開的時間跟著一起移，所以每個音的長度不變。不是音符的東西（控制器、彎音）留在原處。同一個音符用兩種寫法同時記錄的（midi/note/on 和 midi/ch/1/note/60），兩邊移動的量一樣。 take 這個 take。 bpm 速度。沒給的話用 take.meta.bpm，再沒有就是 120。 grid 每一拍幾格：4 是十六分音符，2 是八分音符，1 是四分音符。 strength 移動多少，0..1。1 是移到定位，0.5 是移一半，0 是什麼都不變。 offsetMs 把格子往後移這麼多毫秒，給不是從拍點開始的 take 用。 一個新的 take。

records.k: bitrate quality video bitrate mbps compression master 位元率 畫質 影像位元率 壓縮 母帶
records.d: A video bitrate that keeps fast generative detail clean: 0.12 bits per pixel per frame, held between 4 and 80 Mb/s.
records.x: Particles and thin lines are the first things a low bitrate smears, so this is higher than a streaming bitrate on purpose: the file is a master that will be edited and encoded again. It is the default videoBitsPerSecond of a Recorder that records a canvas. w Width in pixels. h Height in pixels. fps The frame rate. Left out, it is recommendedFps() for the size. Bits per second, rounded to 100 000. 1080 by 1920 at 60 fps is 14 900 000, 4K at 30 fps is 29 900 000.

records.k: bitrate quality video bitrate mbps compression master 位元率 畫質 影像位元率 壓縮 母帶
records.d: 能讓快速的生成式細節保持乾淨的影像位元率：每個像素每個畫面 0.12 位元，限制在 4 到 80 Mb/s。
records.x: 粒子和細線是位元率太低時最先被糊掉的東西，所以這個數字刻意比串流的位元率高：這個檔案是要再剪輯、再編碼的母帶。它是錄畫布的 Recorder 的 videoBitsPerSecond 預設值。 w 寬，單位是像素。 h 高，單位是像素。 fps 畫格率。沒給的話，用這個尺寸的 recommendedFps()。 每秒位元數，四捨五入到 100 000。1080 乘 1920、60 fps 是 14 900 000，4K、30 fps 是 29 900 000。

records.k: fps frame rate 60 30 4k performance dropped frames 畫格率 fps 每秒幾格 4k 掉格
records.d: The frame rate to record a frame size at: 60 up to about 2.6 megapixels, 30 above that.
records.x: 60 fps holds up to about 1080 by 1920 (and 1440 by 1800, 1920 by 1200). A 4K canvas at 60 means 500 million pixels a second through the compositor and the encoder, which drops frames on a laptop in the middle of a performance, and 30 is what cameras shoot 4K at anyway. Pass the result as fps to a Recorder. w Width in pixels. h Height in pixels. 60 when w × h is at most 2 600 000 pixels, otherwise 30.

records.k: fps frame rate 60 30 4k performance dropped frames 畫格率 fps 每秒幾格 4k 掉格
records.d: 一個畫面尺寸該用什麼畫格率來錄：到約 260 萬像素是 60，再大就是 30。
records.x: 60 fps 可以撐到約 1080 乘 1920（以及 1440 乘 1800、1920 乘 1200）。4K 的畫布用 60 的話，合成器和編碼器每秒要處理 5 億個像素，在筆電上表演到一半會掉格，而且相機拍 4K 本來也是 30。把結果當作 fps 交給 Recorder。 w 寬，單位是像素。 h 高，單位是像素。 w × h 不超過 2 600 000 像素是 60，否則是 30。

records.k: record recorder mediarecorder video mp4 webm canvas capture audio download blob 錄影 錄影器 影片 mp4 webm 畫布擷取 聲音 下載 blob 錄製
records.d: Records a canvas, together with the sound you give it, into one video file with one MediaRecorder, so picture and sound stay in sync.
records.x: new Recorder({ canvas, audioTracks }) then start() and, later, await stop(). The canvas track and the audio track go into the same MediaRecorder, which stamps both from one clock: nothing has to be lined up afterwards. stop() resolves, after the last chunk, with { mimeType, ext, bytes, chunks, durationMs, width, height, fps, audio, blob, error }: the blob is the file, ext the extension to give it (mp4, webm, m4a…), audio whether it has sound. Give the blob to URL.createObjectURL() for a download link. Which file you get depends on the browser: it records MP4 (H.264 and AAC) when it can, WebM otherwise. A WebM from Chrome has no duration in its header; players cope, editors may want ffmpeg -i in.webm -c copy out.webm. The file is a master to edit, so the default bitrate is high. To keep a long take out of the tab's memory, pass ondata(blob, seq) to start(): each chunk (every timeslice ms) is handed over in order, and a promise you return is awaited before the next chunk and before stop() resolves, so uploads stay ordered. With ondata the chunks are not kept and blob is null, unless you pass keep: true. To line a take up with an EventLog, start the log with recorder.t0, the performance.now() of the moment recording started. A browser with MediaRecorder (Recorder.supported tells), and a canvas or a stream, or audioOnly: true: otherwise the constructor throws a TypeError. Mixing several audio tracks makes an AudioContext, which needs the page to have had a click. A camera or…

records.k: record recorder mediarecorder video mp4 webm canvas capture audio download blob 錄影 錄影器 影片 mp4 webm 畫布擷取 聲音 下載 blob 錄製
records.d: 用一個 MediaRecorder 把一張畫布連同你給它的聲音錄成一個影片檔，所以畫面和聲音保持同步。
records.x: new Recorder({ canvas, audioTracks })，然後 start()，之後 await stop()。畫布的影像軌和聲音軌進的是同一個 MediaRecorder，它用同一個時鐘替兩者打時間戳記，所以事後不用對齊。stop() 在最後一塊資料到了之後 resolve，內容是 { mimeType, ext, bytes, chunks, durationMs, width, height, fps, audio, blob, error }：blob 就是檔案，ext 是該用的副檔名（mp4、webm、m4a…），audio 是有沒有聲音。把 blob 交給 URL.createObjectURL() 就能做下載連結。 拿到什麼檔案看瀏覽器：能錄 MP4（H.264 和 AAC）就錄 MP4，不行就錄 WebM。Chrome 錄出來的 WebM 檔頭沒有長度，播放器沒問題，剪輯軟體可能需要 ffmpeg -i in.webm -c copy out.webm。這個檔案是拿來剪輯的母帶，所以預設的位元率偏高。 要讓很長的一段錄影不佔著分頁的記憶體，就在 start() 傳 ondata(blob, seq)：每一塊資料（每隔 timeslice 毫秒）會依序交給你，你回傳的 promise 會在下一塊、以及 stop() resolve 之前被等待，所以上傳的順序不會亂。有給 ondata 的話資料塊不會保留，blob 是 null，除非你傳 keep: true。要讓一段錄影跟 EventLog 對齊，就用 recorder.t0 來開始事件記錄，它是開始錄影那一刻的 performance.now()。 需要有 MediaRecorder 的瀏覽器（Recorder.supported 會告訴你），也要有畫布或串流，或 audioOnly: true：否則建構時會丟出 TypeError。混好幾條音軌會建一個 AudioContext，頁面需要先被點過一次。串流裡有鏡頭或麥克風的話，一樣需要使用者許可。 canvas 要錄什麼，通常是 compositor.canvas。 stream 要錄的現成影像串流，用來取代畫布。 fps 畫布的擷取頻率。用 recommendedFps(w, h)：2.7K 和 4K 是 30。 audioTracks 聲音，例如 AudioTap 的 tap.tracks。給好幾條會混成一條，因為 Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。 audioOnly 只錄音軌：把聲音另外存成一個檔。這時不需要 canvas 和 stream。 videoBitsPerSecond 影像位元率。預設是依畫布尺寸和 fps 算出的 recommendedBitrate()（沒有畫布的話是 12 Mb/s）。 audioBitsPerSecond 聲音位元率。 mimeType 強制用某一個 MIME 型別。預設是瀏覽器支援的第一個 VIDEO_MIMES 或 AUDIO_MIMES，見 pickMime()。 prefer 挑 MIME 型別的時候先試這種容器。

records.k: size resolution even width height parse size normalize 尺寸 解析度 偶數 寬高 解析尺寸 正規化
records.d: Turns any way of naming a size, like 'vertical-4k', '1080x1920' or [w, h], into { w, h }, rounded up to even numbers.
records.x: It is what the Compositor uses for its size and setSize(). A size that cannot be read ('wat', a negative number, a missing side) throws a TypeError: record: unknown size "wat". Even sizes matter because H.264 and VP9 encode 4:2:0 colour. size A preset id from PRESETS, 'WxH' (also with × or ), [w, h] or { w, h }. { w, h }, whole numbers, each rounded up to the next even number.

records.k: size resolution even width height parse size normalize 尺寸 解析度 偶數 寬高 解析尺寸 正規化
records.d: 把任何寫尺寸的方式，像 'vertical-4k'、'1080x1920' 或 [w, h]，變成 { w, h }，並進位成偶數。
records.x: Compositor 的 size 和 setSize() 用的就是它。讀不懂的尺寸（'wat'、負數、少一邊）會丟出 TypeError：record: unknown size "wat"。尺寸要偶數，是因為 H.264 和 VP9 用 4:2:0 的色彩編碼。 size PRESETS 的 id、'WxH'（也可以用 × 或 ）、[w, h] 或 { w, h }。 { w, h }，整數，各自進位到下一個偶數。

records.k: midi to signals convert midi event note on cc pitch bend signal names midi 轉訊號 轉換 midi 事件 音符開 控制器 彎音 訊號名稱
records.d: Turns one MIDI event into the signal events a keyboard playing it would publish, so a file can drive a work like live playing.
records.x: It is what fromMidiFile() uses to build a take from a .mid file: each event of the file becomes the signals a keyboard would have published, so TakePlayer can play it into a show. Call it yourself when you have MIDI events from somewhere else and want them on a Signals bus. ev A MIDI event { type, ch, note?, vel?, cc?, value? }. type is noteon, noteoff, cc, pitchbend (value 0..16383), chanat or polyat; velocities and values are 0..127. families Which spellings to make: the classic names (midi/note/on, midi/cc/64, midi/bend), the per-channel ones (midi/ch/1/note/60, midi/ch/1/cc/64…), or both, as hardware does. device A device name to put in the classic note events. A list of { name, value }. Note velocity becomes 0..1 (vel and velocity for the classic spelling), controllers 0..1, pitch bend -1..1. chanat and polyat exist only in the per-channel spelling.

records.k: midi to signals convert midi event note on cc pitch bend signal names midi 轉訊號 轉換 midi 事件 音符開 控制器 彎音 訊號名稱
records.d: 把一個 MIDI 事件轉成鍵盤彈它時會發布的訊號事件，讓一個檔案能像現場演奏那樣驅動作品。
records.x: fromMidiFile() 用它把 .mid 檔做成 take：檔案裡每個事件都變成鍵盤本來會發布的訊號，這樣 TakePlayer 就能把它播進演出裡。如果你有別處來的 MIDI 事件，想放到 Signals 匯流排上，就自己呼叫它。 ev MIDI 事件 { type, ch, note?, vel?, cc?, value? }。type 是 noteon、noteoff、cc、pitchbend（value 是 0..16383）、chanat 或 polyat，力度和數值是 0..127。 families 要做哪幾種寫法：傳統名稱（midi/note/on、midi/cc/64、midi/bend）、每頻道的（midi/ch/1/note/60、midi/ch/1/cc/64…），或兩種都做，就像硬體一樣。 device 要放進傳統音符事件的裝置名稱。 { name, value } 的清單。音符力度變成 0..1（傳統寫法有 vel 和 velocity），控制器是 0..1，彎音是 -1..1。chanat 和 polyat 只有每頻道的寫法。

records.k: take version format version schema v: 1 take 版本 格式版本 結構 版本號
records.d: The version number of the take format, which is 1. Every take has v: 1.
records.x: A take is a plain object { v, name, createdAt, durationMs, events, meta }, see normalizeTake(). validateTake() complains when v is not this number, and normalizeTake() writes it. 1.

records.k: take version format version schema v: 1 take 版本 格式版本 結構 版本號
records.d: take 格式的版本號，是 1。每個 take 都有 v: 1。
records.x: take 是一個普通物件 { v, name, createdAt, durationMs, events, meta }，見 normalizeTake()。v 不是這個數字時，validateTake() 會抱怨，normalizeTake() 會把它寫進去。 版本號就是 1。

records.k: play take playback replay loop midi playback preview plays itself yield to live seek stuck notes 播放 take 播放 重播 循環 midi 播放 預覽自己演奏 讓位給現場 跳轉 卡音
records.d: Plays a take back into a bus at the right times, so the work, its sound and its chord detector cannot tell it from you playing.
records.x: Give it a bus and a take, call play(), and it publishes the take's events into the bus at their times: the same signals a keyboard would have, so a work's visuals, its sound (Sound) and its chord detector respond exactly as to your hands. That is what lets a work's preview play itself. Pass clock: 'manual' and call player.update(dt) from your loop for full control. No stuck notes, ever: the player remembers every key it pressed, in the spelling it pressed it, and the sustain pedal, and lets go of them on pause, stop, seek and every loop wrap. With yieldToLive, playing a key yourself makes the take fall silent; with resumeAfter: 8 it comes back 8 seconds after you stop. Its state is 'playing', 'paused', 'yielded' or 'stopped', and position (milliseconds), loops, playing and yielded are plain properties. signals The Signals bus to publish into. It also defines take/playing (0 or 1) and take/position (0..1). take A take or its JSON. You can load() another one later. loop Start again at the end. Off, it stops there. speed Playback speed: 0.5 is half speed. yieldToLive Fall silent when someone plays live: a key-down that the player did not send (hardware, the on-screen piano, a phone) pauses the take and releases its notes. resumeAfter Seconds without live playing before a take that gave way resumes. 0 means it stays paused. isLive isLive(name, value), what counts as live playing. The default is any key-down that did not come from the player; knobs do not count. chase When you…

records.k: play take playback replay loop midi playback preview plays itself yield to live seek stuck notes 播放 take 播放 重播 循環 midi 播放 預覽自己演奏 讓位給現場 跳轉 卡音
records.d: 把一個 take 在對的時間播回匯流排，讓作品、它的聲音和和弦偵測器分不出這是播放還是你在彈。
records.x: 給它一個匯流排和一個 take，呼叫 play()，它就會在對的時間把 take 的事件發布到匯流排上：跟鍵盤會發的訊號一樣，所以作品的畫面、它的聲音（Sound）和和弦偵測器的反應，跟面對你的雙手時完全一樣。這就是作品的預覽可以自己演奏的原因。傳 clock: 'manual' 並在你的迴圈裡呼叫 player.update(dt)，就能完全自己掌控。 絕不會卡音：播放器記得它按下的每個鍵（用它按下時的寫法）和延音踏板，並在暫停、停止、跳轉和每次循環回到開頭的時候放開它們。有 yieldToLive 的話，你自己彈一個鍵，take 就會安靜下來。有 resumeAfter: 8 的話，你停手 8 秒後它會回來。它的狀態是 'playing'、'paused'、'yielded' 或 'stopped'，position（毫秒）、loops、playing、yielded 是普通屬性。 signals 要發布訊號的 Signals 匯流排。它也會定義 take/playing（0 或 1）和 take/position（0..1）。 take 一個 take 或它的 JSON。之後可以用 load() 換別的。 loop 到結尾就從頭再來。關掉的話，就停在結尾。 speed 播放速度：0.5 是一半的速度。 yieldToLive 有人現場彈的時候就安靜下來：播放器沒送出的按鍵（硬體、螢幕鋼琴、手機）會暫停 take 並放開它的音。 resumeAfter 被讓位的 take 要等多少秒沒有現場演奏才恢復。0 表示維持暫停。 isLive isLive(name, value)，什麼算現場演奏。預設是任何不是播放器送出的按鍵。旋鈕不算。 chase seek() 的時候，把那個時間點之前每個控制器的最後一個值再送一次（延音踏板、旋鈕），讓 take 處在原本該有的狀態。 clock 誰來帶動時間：'raf'（requestAnimationFrame，頁面裡的預設）、'timer'（10 毫秒的計時器：對聲音比較準，背景分頁也會繼續只是比較慢），或 'manual'（你呼叫 update(dt) 或 tick()，沒有 requestAnimationFrame 的環境預設是這個）。 maxStepMs 一步最多往前走多久。遇到空檔（分頁凍結）的時候，take 會變慢，而不是一口氣打出一堆音。 onEvent onEvent({ t, name, value }, player)，每個事件播出時都呼叫。 onState onState(state, reason)，狀態改變時呼叫：'playing'、'paused'、'yielded' 或 'stopped'。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒。

records.k: record midi take record what you play capture performance looper midi recorder stop overdub 錄 midi take 錄下彈的東西 擷取演奏 循環錄音 midi 錄音 停止 疊錄
records.d: Records what you play: it listens to every midi/ signal on a bus from start() to stop() and gives you a take.
records.x: A TakeRecorder is an EventLog that listens to midi/ on a bus. Press record: rec.start(). Play. Press stop: const take = rec.stop(). The take is plain data, so it can be saved as JSON, turned into a .mid (toMidiFile()) or played back (TakePlayer). It has every member of EventLog (mark(), between(), toJSON()…). No stuck notes: a recorder stopped in the middle of a chord closes the keys that are still held (and a sustain pedal that is still down) in the take itself, at the stop time. The events are the signals as they were published, so a take from hardware holds both naming families (midi/note/on and midi/ch/1/note/60) and the device names, and playback publishes all of them. Pass recorder.t0 of a video Recorder to start() to line the take up with the video. signals The Signals bus to listen to. filter Which signals are the take: a pattern for the name, or filter(name, value, meta). name The name of the take. meta Free fields copied into the take: { bpm, device, notes }. The device is found from the events if you leave it out. overdub Also record what a TakePlayer is playing back right now. Off, a recorder ignores playback. throttleMs For continuous signals (knobs, aftertouch): at most one event per name in this many milliseconds. now The clock, in milliseconds.

records.k: record midi take record what you play capture performance looper midi recorder stop overdub 錄 midi take 錄下彈的東西 擷取演奏 循環錄音 midi 錄音 停止 疊錄
records.d: 錄下你彈的東西：從 start() 到 stop() 聽匯流排上每個 midi/ 訊號，然後給你一個 take。
records.x: TakeRecorder 是一個聽匯流排上 midi/ 的 EventLog。按下錄音：rec.start()。彈。按下停止：const take = rec.stop()。take 是單純的資料，所以可以存成 JSON、轉成 .mid（toMidiFile()），或播回去（TakePlayer）。EventLog 的所有成員它都有（mark()、between()、toJSON()…）。 不會有卡住的音：在彈和弦的中間停止錄影，還按著的鍵（和還踩著的延音踏板）會在停止的時間，於 take 本身裡被放開。事件就是訊號被發布時的原樣，所以從硬體錄的 take 兩種名稱寫法（midi/note/on 和 midi/ch/1/note/60）和裝置名稱都在，播放時全部發布出去。把影片 Recorder 的 recorder.t0 傳給 start()，就能讓 take 跟影片對齊。 signals 要聽的 Signals 匯流排。 filter 哪些訊號算進 take：名稱的正規表達式，或 filter(name, value, meta)。 name take 的名字。 meta 複製進 take 的自由欄位：{ bpm, device, notes }。沒給裝置的話，會從事件裡找。 overdub 連 TakePlayer 正在播放的也錄下來。關著的時候，錄影器會忽略播放的內容。 throttleMs 對連續訊號（旋鈕、觸後）：每個名字在這麼多毫秒內最多一個事件。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒。

records.k: stats statistics count notes range summary of take length 統計 音符數 音域 摘要 take 的內容 長度
records.d: Counts what is in a take: notes, events, length, the channels used, and the lowest and highest note.
records.x: Good for showing what a take is before it is played or saved. Notes are counted through midiEventsOf(), which picks one naming family, so the count is the number of keys pressed. take The take. { notes, events, durationMs, channels, low, high }. notes counts key-downs, once each even when the take holds two spellings of them. channels is a sorted list of MIDI channels. low and high are MIDI note numbers, or null for a take without notes.

records.k: stats statistics count notes range summary of take length 統計 音符數 音域 摘要 take 的內容 長度
records.d: 數出一個 take 裡有什麼：音符數、事件數、長度、用到的頻道，以及最低和最高的音。
records.x: 適合在播放或儲存一個 take 之前，顯示它是什麼。音符是透過 midiEventsOf() 數的，它只選一種名稱寫法，所以數字就是按過幾個鍵。 take 這個 take。 { notes, events, durationMs, channels, low, high }。notes 數的是按下的鍵，每個音只算一次，即使 take 裡有兩種寫法。channels 是排好序的 MIDI 頻道清單。low 和 high 是 MIDI 音符號碼，沒有音符的 take 是 null。

records.k: midi file smf .mid export save midi daw download midi standard midi file midi 檔 smf .mid 匯出 存成 midi daw 下載 midi 標準 midi 檔
records.d: Writes a take as a Standard MIDI File (type 0) that opens in any DAW.
records.x: One track holds note on and off with velocity, controllers (the sustain pedal is CC 64), pitch bend, and channel and poly aftertouch, each on its own channel; channel 10 stays the drums. The take's name becomes the track name, and a 4/4 time signature is written only so a DAW's grid looks sane. Times are kept to the millisecond whatever the tempo, so the file plays like the take. Only one naming family of the take is used, so nothing doubles (midiEventsOf()). To save it, wrap it in a Blob of type audio/midi. take The take. ppq Ticks per quarter note. bpm The tempo written in the file. Left out, it is take.meta.bpm, and then 120. The bytes of the .mid file.

records.k: midi file smf .mid export save midi daw download midi standard midi file midi 檔 smf .mid 匯出 存成 midi daw 下載 midi 標準 midi 檔
records.d: 把一個 take 寫成標準 MIDI 檔（type 0），任何 DAW 都能開。
records.x: 一條音軌裡有音符開關（含力度）、控制器（延音踏板是 CC 64）、彎音，以及頻道和單音的觸後，各自在自己的頻道。頻道 10 還是鼓。take 的名字會變成音軌名稱，另外寫了 4/4 拍的拍號，只是讓 DAW 的格線看起來正常。不管速度是多少，時間都精確到毫秒，所以檔案播出來跟 take 一樣。只會用 take 裡的一種名稱寫法，所以不會重複（midiEventsOf()）。要存檔的話，把它包成型別是 audio/midi 的 Blob。 take 這個 take。 ppq 每四分音符幾個 tick。 bpm 寫進檔案的速度。沒給的話用 take.meta.bpm，再沒有就是 120。 .mid 檔的位元組。

records.k: trim silence cut lead in start of take remove silence 修剪 靜默 剪掉 開頭 去掉空白
records.d: Cuts the silence before the first key press of a take, so the first note comes at the moment you choose.
records.x: Everything before the first key-down is cut away, but not lost: a controller value set during the silence, such as the sustain pedal or a knob, is kept and moved to the start (to t = 0 if it was before the cut), so the take still starts in the same state. If the take has no key-down at all, it is moved so its first event is at keep. take The take. keep Milliseconds of lead-in to keep before the first key-down. A new take. Everything moved earlier by the same amount, and durationMs is shorter by that amount. A take that starts at once comes back as it is.

records.k: trim silence cut lead in start of take remove silence 修剪 靜默 剪掉 開頭 去掉空白
records.d: 把一個 take 第一次按鍵之前的靜默剪掉，讓第一個音出現在你指定的時間。
records.x: 第一次按鍵之前的東西會被剪掉，但不會遺失：靜默裡設定的控制器數值，例如延音踏板或旋鈕，會保留，並移到開頭（剪掉的範圍內的會變成 t = 0），所以 take 開始時的狀態不變。如果 take 裡完全沒有按鍵，就整體移動，讓它的第一個事件落在 keep。 take 這個 take。 keep 第一次按鍵之前要保留幾毫秒的空白。 一個新的 take。所有事件都提早同樣的量，durationMs 也縮短那麼多。一開始就有音的 take 會原樣回傳。

records.k: validate check take errors lint take format problems 驗證 檢查 take 錯誤 take 格式 問題清單
records.d: Checks a take and lists everything wrong with it as readable sentences. An empty list means it is valid.
records.x: It checks: v is TAKE_VERSION, name is a string, durationMs is a number from 0 up, events is an array, each event is an object with a signal name and a t of 0 or more, the events are in time order and none is after durationMs, and meta, if present, is an object. Use it on a take you read from a file; to repair one, use normalizeTake(). take The take to check. Sentences such as v must be 1 (got 2) or events[3] is out of order (t 100 < 200). [] when valid. It never throws.

records.k: validate check take errors lint take format problems 驗證 檢查 take 錯誤 take 格式 問題清單
records.d: 檢查一個 take，把有問題的地方都列成看得懂的句子。空的清單表示沒問題。
records.x: 它檢查：v 是 TAKE_VERSION，name 是字串，durationMs 是 0 以上的數字，events 是陣列，每個事件都是有訊號 name 和 0 以上的 t 的物件，事件依時間排序而且沒有任何一個超過 durationMs，meta 如果有的話是物件。用在從檔案讀來的 take 上。要修復的話，用 normalizeTake()。 take 要檢查的 take。 像 v must be 1 (got 2) 或 events[3] is out of order (t 100 < 200) 這樣的句子。沒問題就是 []。它不會丟出錯誤。

records.k: mime mp4 webm h264 codec container video format candidates mime mp4 webm h264 編碼 容器 影片格式 候選
records.d: The video MIME types the recorder tries, best first: MP4 with H.264 and AAC, then WebM.
records.x: MP4 comes first because it opens everywhere a performance video goes next (an editor, Instagram, a phone's gallery) without a remux, and Chrome encodes H.264 in hardware. The first string asks for a profile (avc1.640033, High profile level 5.1, enough for 4K at 30 and 1080 by 1920 at 60) because Chrome says no to the generic avc1,mp4a but yes to the qualified one, so both are in the list for other browsers. Plain video/mp4 is for Safari. pickMime() walks this list. A frozen list of 6 strings: video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640033,mp4a.40.2, video/mp4;codecs=avc1,mp4a, video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus, video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus, video/webm, video/mp4.

records.k: mime mp4 webm h264 codec container video format candidates mime mp4 webm h264 編碼 容器 影片格式 候選
records.d: 錄影器會依序嘗試的影片 MIME 型別，最好的在前：先是 H.264 加 AAC 的 MP4，再來是 WebM。
records.x: MP4 排第一，因為表演影片接下來要去的地方（剪輯軟體、Instagram、手機相簿）都能直接開，不用重新封裝，而且 Chrome 用硬體編 H.264。第一個字串指定了 profile（avc1.640033，High profile level 5.1，夠 4K 30 和 1080 乘 1920 60 用），因為 Chrome 對籠統的 avc1,mp4a 回答不行、對指定 profile 的卻回答可以，所以兩個都放進清單給別的瀏覽器用。單純的 video/mp4 是給 Safari 的。pickMime() 就是走過這份清單。 一份凍結的清單，有 6 個字串：video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640033,mp4a.40.2、video/mp4;codecs=avc1,mp4a、video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus、video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus、video/webm、video/mp4。

records.k: clock midi clock sync tempo external clock follow DAW Strudel 時鐘 midi 時鐘 同步 速度 外部時鐘 跟隨 DAW
records.d: Whether an external MIDI clock (from a DAW, Strudel or a drum machine) moves drumPhase, drumBpm and the drum machine: follow or off.
records.x: With follow, an external MIDI clock (24 ticks a beat, plus start, stop and song position) is followed: drumPhase, beatPhase, drumBar, drumStep and drumBpm read it, and a drum machine that is up takes its tempo and its downbeat from it, starting and stopping with it. OAVp5.clock tells you what it hears. With nothing sending a clock, nothing changes. off ignores every clock message: OAVp5.clock.info.state stays 'none'. Use it when something on the page or the machine sends a clock you do not want the sketch to follow. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { clock: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_clock=… on the page address, then ?clock=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_clock=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything except off means follow.

records.k: clock midi clock sync tempo external clock follow DAW Strudel 時鐘 midi 時鐘 同步 速度 外部時鐘 跟隨 DAW
records.d: 外部的 MIDI 時鐘（來自 DAW、Strudel 或鼓機）要不要推動 drumPhase、drumBpm 和鼓機：follow 或 off。
records.x: 設成 follow 的時候，外部的 MIDI 時鐘（每拍 24 個 tick，加上 start、stop 和 song position）會被跟隨：drumPhase、beatPhase、drumBar、drumStep、drumBpm 讀的就是它，已經在跑的鼓機也會從它取得速度和第一拍，跟著它開始和停止。OAVp5.clock 會告訴你它聽到什麼。沒有東西送時鐘過來的時候，什麼都不會改變。 off 會忽略所有時鐘訊息：OAVp5.clock.info.state 一直是 'none'。頁面上或機器上有東西在送時鐘、而你不想讓草圖跟著它走的時候用。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { clock: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_clock=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?clock=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_clock=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 off 以外的任何值都當作 follow。

records.k: compact small panel corner box strudel panel size 精簡 小面板 角落 strudel 面板大小
records.d: Shows the 🎹 panel as a small box in the corner, a third of the window high, instead of a full-width bar: on or off.
records.x: Normally the panel opened by 🎹 is a bar across the whole window, up to half its height. With compact it is a box at most 560 pixels wide and a third of the window high, in the corner the 🎹 sits in, so the page beside it stays in view. It is the default on strudel.cc, where the code editor needs the room. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { compact: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_compact=… on the page address, then ?compact=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_compact=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only on turns it on. OAVp5.options.compact reads back as true or false.

records.k: compact small panel corner box strudel panel size 精簡 小面板 角落 strudel 面板大小
records.d: 把 🎹 面板顯示成角落的一個小方塊，高度是視窗的三分之一，而不是整條橫幅：on 或 off。
records.x: 一般來說，按 🎹 打開的面板是橫跨整個視窗的一條，最高到視窗的一半。設成 compact 就變成一個最寬 560 像素、高度是視窗三分之一的方塊，放在 🎹 所在的那個角落，旁邊的頁面還看得到。在 strudel.cc 上它是預設，因為程式編輯器需要那塊空間。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { compact: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_compact=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?compact=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_compact=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 on 會打開它。OAVp5.options.compact 讀回來是 true 或 false。

records.d: Prints [oav-p5 debug] lines in the console about clicks, the 🎹 button and loading, for finding out why the 🎹 does not respond.
records.x: Two seconds after the 🎹 is placed, a line says whether the 🎹 in the page is oav-p5's own copy and where oav-p5 loads the rest of OAV from. Every click then adds a line with the pointer position, what was clicked, and what is on top at that spot, which is how you find a page element sitting over the 🎹. It also says when the panel opens, when the page replaced the 🎹 and which name asked for the microphone. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { debug: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_debug=… on the page address, then ?debug=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_debug=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Any value except an empty one and 0 turns it on.

records.d: 在 console 印出 [oav-p5 debug] 開頭的幾行，關於點擊、🎹 按鈕和載入，用來查 🎹 為什麼沒反應。
records.x: 🎹 放上頁面兩秒之後，會印出一行說頁面上的 🎹 是不是 oav-p5 自己的那一個，以及 oav-p5 從哪裡載入 OAV 的其他部分。之後每次點擊都多一行，記下指標的位置、點到了什麼、那個位置最上面是什麼，這就是找出是哪個頁面元素蓋在 🎹 上面的方法。面板打開、頁面把 🎹 換掉、是哪個名稱去要了麥克風，它也會說。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { debug: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_debug=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?debug=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_debug=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 除了空的和 0，任何值都會打開它。

records.k: dock top bottom position move the button layout openprocessing console 停靠 上方 下方 位置 移動按鈕 版面 openprocessing console
records.d: Which edge of the window the 🎹 button and its cards sit on, bottom or top; set it and the panel starts on that edge too.
records.x: Moves the 🎹, its cards and the panel to the top or bottom edge. On openprocessing.org the default is top, because OpenProcessing's console floats over the bottom of the sketch. The drum machine's card sits below a panel docked at the top. The panel itself has two buttons for whoever is looking at it: Dock cycles bottom → top → floating (drag a floating panel by its bar), and Size cycles small → medium → large. This browser remembers the choice, and it wins over the option. When the sketch sets no dock, the panel starts at the bottom, also on openprocessing.org (from 2026-10-20: at the top it covered the sketch). The 🎹 moves out of the panel's way only when the two share an edge. Reloading the same page (Cmd+Enter on OpenProcessing) opens the panel again if it was open, and restarts drums started from its 🥁 on the same line and tempo. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { dock: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_dock=… on the page address, then ?dock=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_dock=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything except top means bottom.

records.k: dock top bottom position move the button layout openprocessing console 停靠 上方 下方 位置 移動按鈕 版面 openprocessing console
records.d: 🎹 按鈕和它的提示卡片放在視窗的哪個邊：bottom 或 top。有設定的話，面板一開始也在這個邊。
records.x: 把 🎹、它的卡片和面板移到上緣或下緣。在 openprocessing.org 上預設是 top，因為 OpenProcessing 的 console 會浮在草圖的下方。鼓機的卡片會放在固定在上緣的面板下面。 面板上有兩個按鈕給正在看的人用：「位置」依序切換下方、上方、浮動（浮動時拖曳面板上面那一列就能移動），「大小」依序切換小、中、大。這個瀏覽器會記住你的選擇，而且優先於這個選項。草圖沒有設定 dock 時，面板一開始在下方，openprocessing.org 上也一樣（2026-10-20 起，之前放在上方會蓋住草圖）。只有面板和 🎹 在同一個邊時，🎹 才會讓開。同一個頁面重新整理（OpenProcessing 按 Cmd+Enter）時，面板原本開著就會自動打開，從面板 🥁 開的鼓機也會用同一行節奏和速度再打起來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { dock: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_dock=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?dock=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_dock=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 top 以外的任何值都當作 bottom。

records.k: drum latency latency bluetooth audio delay sync picture and sound lip sync 鼓機延遲 延遲 藍牙 聲音延遲 畫面聲音同步 對嘴
records.d: How long it takes a drum hit to be heard after oav-p5 hands it to the audio clock, so pictures land with the sound: auto or milliseconds.
records.x: The drum machine hands each hit to the audio clock slightly ahead of time, and tells the sketch (drumHit(), kickDetected(), env('kick')) when you will hear it, which is the scheduled moment plus the output latency. auto uses the latency the browser reports. If the browser's figure is smaller than what your output really takes, the picture runs ahead of the sound, and giving the number yourself fixes that. The project's README names a Bluetooth speaker as the case and suggests trying 200. Only the default drum machine (drums=lookahead) uses it: the frame-driven one has nothing scheduled ahead. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { drumlatency: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_drumlatency=… on the page address, then ?drumlatency=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_drumlatency=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). A number is held between 0 and 500. Anything that is not a number means auto. OAVp5.options.drumlatency reads back in seconds (0.2 for 200).

records.k: drum latency latency bluetooth audio delay sync picture and sound lip sync 鼓機延遲 延遲 藍牙 聲音延遲 畫面聲音同步 對嘴
records.d: 鼓點從 oav-p5 交給音訊時鐘到你聽到要多久，讓畫面跟聲音同時到：auto 或毫秒數。
records.x: 鼓機把每一下鼓點稍微提前交給音訊時鐘，並在你會聽到的那一刻通知草圖（drumHit()、kickDetected()、env('kick')），那一刻就是排定的時間加上輸出的延遲。auto 用瀏覽器回報的延遲。瀏覽器回報的數字如果比你的輸出實際花的時間小，畫面就會跑在聲音前面，自己給一個數字就能解決。專案的 README 舉的例子是藍牙喇叭，並建議試試 200。 只有預設的鼓機（drums=lookahead）會用到它：逐幀推進的那一種沒有提前排程的東西。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { drumlatency: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_drumlatency=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?drumlatency=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_drumlatency=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 數字會被限制在 0 到 500 之間。不是數字的值都當作 auto。OAVp5.options.drumlatency 讀回來的單位是秒（200 讀回 0.2）。

records.k: drums clock lookahead frame timing safety net worker drum machine 鼓機時鐘 提前排程 逐幀 節拍準確 保險 worker 鼓機
records.d: How the drum machine is clocked: lookahead (hits scheduled ahead on the audio clock) or frame (moved by animation frames, 0.5's way).
records.x: With lookahead, a heartbeat in a Web Worker hands the hits to the audio clock a little ahead of time, so the beat stays steady when frames stutter or the tab is busy, and the sketch is told when each hit is heard. With frame, the machine is moved by the animation frames instead, as it was in oav-p5 0.5. It is the safety net: where the lookahead machine misbehaves, frame brings the old behaviour back, and the timing is then only as steady as the frame rate. OAVp5.drums.clock and the 🩺 check-up say which clock is running. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { drums: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_drums=… on the page address, then ?drums=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_drums=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything except frame means lookahead.

records.k: drums clock lookahead frame timing safety net worker drum machine 鼓機時鐘 提前排程 逐幀 節拍準確 保險 worker 鼓機
records.d: 鼓機用什麼來計時：lookahead（提前在音訊時鐘上排程）或 frame（跟著動畫畫面走，0.5 版的做法）。
records.x: 設成 lookahead 的時候，Web Worker 裡有一個心跳，會把鼓點提前一點交給音訊時鐘，所以畫面卡頓或分頁很忙的時候，拍子還是穩的，草圖也會在每一下鼓點被聽到的時候收到通知。設成 frame 則是回到 oav-p5 0.5 的做法，由動畫畫面推著鼓機走。這是保險：提前排程的鼓機在某個地方出狀況的時候，frame 把舊的做法找回來，這時拍子只會跟畫面更新率一樣穩。 OAVp5.drums.clock 和 🩺 體檢會告訴你現在是哪一種時鐘在跑。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { drums: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_drums=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?drums=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_drums=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 frame 以外的任何值都當作 lookahead。

records.k: hardware web midi midi permission ask for midi controller usb midi 硬體 web midi midi 權限 要 midi 控制器 usb midi
records.d: When oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI, which a real controller needs: auto at load, click when the 🎹 panel opens, or off.
records.x: With auto, oav-p5 asks for Web MIDI as soon as it loads, so a plugged-in controller plays the sketch without anyone pressing anything. The browser remembers your answer per site. With click, it asks only when the 🎹 panel is first opened. With off, it never asks by itself, and the on-screen controller and a phone still play the sketch. OAVp5.connectHardware() asks whatever the option says, and OAVp5.hardware tells you the state: 'off' until it has been asked. On strudel.cc (or a page where Strudel's own functions are present) the default is click, because Strudel's midin() asks for MIDI itself. Setting hardware yourself wins. Safari and iPad have no Web MIDI at all: when oav-p5 asks (or you call OAVp5.connectHardware()), the state there becomes 'unavailable'. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { hardware: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_hardware=… on the page address, then ?hardware=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_hardware=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only auto and click ask. Any other value acts like off.

records.k: hardware web midi midi permission ask for midi controller usb midi 硬體 web midi midi 權限 要 midi 控制器 usb midi
records.d: oav-p5 什麼時候向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（真的控制器需要它）：auto 是載入時，click 是 🎹 面板打開時，off 是不要。
records.x: 設成 auto 的時候，oav-p5 一載入就去要 Web MIDI，所以接上去的控制器不用誰按什麼就能彈草圖。瀏覽器會依網站記住你的答案。設成 click，只有第一次打開 🎹 面板時才去要。設成 off，它自己永遠不會去要，螢幕上的控制器和手機還是能彈草圖。 不管這個選項怎麼設，OAVp5.connectHardware() 都會去要，OAVp5.hardware 告訴你現在的狀態：還沒要過之前是 'off'。 在 strudel.cc（或頁面上本來就有 Strudel 自己的函式）預設是 click，因為 Strudel 的 midin() 會自己去要 MIDI。你自己設了 hardware 就以你的為準。 Safari 和 iPad 根本沒有 Web MIDI：oav-p5 去要的時候（或你呼叫 OAVp5.connectHardware()），那裡的狀態就會變成 'unavailable'。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { hardware: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_hardware=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?hardware=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_hardware=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 auto 和 click 會去要。其他的值效果跟 off 一樣。

records.k: hints cards messages quiet hide the cards exhibition warnings 提示 卡片 訊息 安靜 藏起卡片 展場 警告
records.d: Whether oav-p5 shows its explaining cards beside the 🎹 (blocked microphone, no Web MIDI, an error in your callback): on or off.
records.x: When something goes wrong, a small card beside the 🎹 says what happened, why, and what to press, in the browser's language, once per page. hints: 'off' takes the cards off the page: the console still says the same thing and OAVp5.hints still lists what was said. Use it for a finished piece that goes on a wall or into a recording. It also hides the corner oscilloscope of scope(), which is part of the same on-page help. scope=off hides only that. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { hints: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_hints=… on the page address, then ?hints=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_hints=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns the cards off. Any other value, including the text false, leaves them on.

records.k: hints cards messages quiet hide the cards exhibition warnings 提示 卡片 訊息 安靜 藏起卡片 展場 警告
records.d: oav-p5 要不要在 🎹 旁邊顯示說明的卡片（麥克風被擋、沒有 Web MIDI、你的回呼出錯）：on 或 off。
records.x: 出問題的時候，🎹 旁邊會跳出一張小卡片，用瀏覽器的語言說明發生了什麼、為什麼、要按什麼，每個頁面只說一次。hints: 'off' 讓卡片從頁面上消失：console 還是說一樣的話，OAVp5.hints 也還是列出說過的內容。做好的作品要放在展場牆上或錄影的時候用。 它也會把 scope() 的角落示波器藏起來，因為那是同一套網頁上的輔助。scope=off 只藏它。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { hints: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_hints=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?hints=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_hints=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把卡片關掉。其他任何值，包括文字 false，都讓卡片保持開著。

records.k: link room sync pages two computers relay share midi strudel 連結 房間 同步頁面 兩台電腦 中繼 分享 midi strudel
records.d: Joins a room: oav-p5 pages with the same room hear what each other's programs play, over the relay. A room name, or empty for none.
records.x: Every oav-p5 page with the same room (another tab, another computer) gets what this page's programs play into the virtual MIDI output (notes, controllers and the clock), over the phone relay, and plays it at the moment it sounds here. On the other side, OAVp5.last.source is 'link'. Nothing it receives is sent on, so two pages cannot loop. The room is also the phones' room, so one QR code plays every linked page. OAVp5.link.info tells you the room, whether it is connected and how many other pages were heard. The 🎹 grows a 🔗: green when another page is there, yellow while connecting or alone, red when the relay is gone. linkdelay adds a buffer. A network connection to the relay (relay, wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay unless you set another). Without it the 🔗 is red and nothing is shared. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { link: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_link=… on the page address, then ?link=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_link=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only letters, digits, _ and - are kept, and only the first 32 characters.

records.k: link room sync pages two computers relay share midi strudel 連結 房間 同步頁面 兩台電腦 中繼 分享 midi strudel
records.d: 加入一個房間：房間相同的 oav-p5 頁面，會透過中繼聽到彼此的程式送出的聲音。填房間名，空的就是不加入。
records.x: 房間相同的 oav-p5 頁面（另一個分頁、另一台電腦），會透過手機中繼收到這個頁面的程式送進虛擬 MIDI 輸出的東西（音符、控制器和時鐘），並在這裡聽到的那一刻播出來。收到的那一邊，OAVp5.last.source 是 'link'。收到的東西不會再往外送，所以兩個頁面不會互相繞圈。房間也是手機用的房間，所以一個 QR code 就能彈每一個連起來的頁面。 OAVp5.link.info 告訴你房間、有沒有連上、聽到幾個其他頁面。🎹 會多一個 🔗：另一個頁面在的時候是綠色，連線中或只有自己是黃色，中繼斷線是紅色。linkdelay 可以多加一段緩衝。 要能連上中繼（relay，沒另外設的話是 wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay）。連不上的話 🔗 是紅色，什麼都不會分享。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { link: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_link=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?link=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_link=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只留下字母、數字、_ 和 -，而且只取前 32 個字元。

records.k: link delay buffer network jitter late notes smooth 連結延遲 緩衝 網路抖動 晚到的音符 平順
records.d: Extra milliseconds of buffer on the notes a linked page receives, to smooth out an uneven network: 0 to 2000.
records.x: Only matters together with link: without a room nothing is received. Each note arriving from another page is played at the moment it sounded there, which already allows for the trip. linkdelay adds this much on top, so a note that took longer than usual is still on time. The price is that everything from the other page arrives that much later. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { linkdelay: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_linkdelay=… on the page address, then ?linkdelay=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_linkdelay=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Held between 0 and 2000. Anything that is not a number is 0.

records.k: link delay buffer network jitter late notes smooth 連結延遲 緩衝 網路抖動 晚到的音符 平順
records.d: 連在一起的頁面收到音符時多加的緩衝毫秒數，用來撫平不穩的網路：0 到 2000。
records.x: 只有跟 link 一起用才有意義：沒有房間就不會收到任何東西。從另一個頁面來的每個音符，會在它在那邊響起的那一刻播出，這已經把路上花的時間算進去了。linkdelay 在那之上再多加這麼多，所以走得比平常久的音符也還是準時。代價是另一個頁面來的所有東西都晚這麼多才到。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { linkdelay: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_linkdelay=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?linkdelay=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_linkdelay=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 會被限制在 0 到 2000 之間。不是數字的值就是 0。

records.k: mic option mic permission ask for the mic no mic privacy click to start 收音選項 收音權限 要不要收音 不收音 隱私 點了才開
records.d: Who may turn the microphone on: auto (the first read of micLevel and friends), click (only 🎤 or startMic()) or off (nobody).
records.x: With auto, the first time a sketch reads micLevel, bass, mid, treble or beat, oav-p5 asks the browser for the microphone. With click, reading them does nothing: the microphone starts only when someone presses 🎤 in the 🎹 panel or the sketch calls startMic(), so the permission prompt arrives when you choose. With off, nothing opens the microphone, not even startMic(), which resolves false. off is a promise to the page: a gallery piece that must never listen can say so. click is for pieces where a permission prompt out of nowhere would be rude, or where the sound only matters after an intro. The values of the microphone stay 0 while it is off. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { mic: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_mic=… on the page address, then ?mic=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_mic=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything else means auto.

records.k: mic option mic permission ask for the mic no mic privacy click to start 收音選項 收音權限 要不要收音 不收音 隱私 點了才開
records.d: 誰可以把麥克風打開：auto（第一次讀 micLevel 這些）、click（只有 🎤 或 startMic()）或 off（誰都不行）。
records.x: 設成 auto，草圖第一次讀 micLevel、bass、mid、treble 或 beat 的時候，oav-p5 就會向瀏覽器要麥克風。設成 click，讀它們不會有任何作用：只有有人在 🎹 面板按 🎤、或草圖呼叫 startMic() 時麥克風才會開，這樣權限的詢問會在你決定的時候才跳出來。設成 off，什麼都不能開麥克風，連 startMic() 也不行，它會 resolve 成 false。 off 是對頁面的一個承諾：一件絕對不能收音的展場作品可以這樣宣告。click 適合不該憑空跳出權限詢問的作品，或是聲音要等片頭之後才有意義的作品。麥克風關著的時候，它的所有值都是 0。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { mic: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_mic=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?mic=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_mic=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 其他的值都當作 auto。

records.k: opc op configurator openprocessing sliders wire controller to sliders map knobs opc op configurator openprocessing 滑桿 控制器接滑桿 對應旋鈕
records.d: Whether oav-p5 wires the controller to the variables of OP Configurator (OpenProcessing's sliders and buttons): on or off.
records.x: On OpenProcessing, OPC.slider('radius', 10) declares a variable with a slider. With opc on, oav-p5 then wires the controller to the OPC variables in order: knob 1 to the first slider, knob 2 to the second, the faders after the knobs, pad 1 to the first toggle or button. OPC's own panel moves with the knob. OAVp5.wiring() lists who drives what. off leaves OPC's variables to their own sliders. A control the sketch reads itself (knob1 in draw()) is the sketch's anyway: the slider at that place stops following it. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { opc: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_opc=… on the page address, then ?opc=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_opc=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns it off.

records.k: opc op configurator openprocessing sliders wire controller to sliders map knobs opc op configurator openprocessing 滑桿 控制器接滑桿 對應旋鈕
records.d: oav-p5 要不要把控制器接到 OP Configurator（OpenProcessing 的滑桿和按鈕）的變數上：on 或 off。
records.x: 在 OpenProcessing 上，OPC.slider('radius', 10) 宣告一個有滑桿的變數。opc 開著的時候，oav-p5 會依序把控制器接到 OPC 的變數：旋鈕 1 接第一個滑桿，旋鈕 2 接第二個，推桿接在旋鈕之後，打擊墊 1 接第一個開關或按鈕。OPC 自己的面板會跟著旋鈕動。OAVp5.wiring() 會列出誰推動什麼。 off 讓 OPC 的變數只聽自己的滑桿。草圖自己有讀的控制（draw() 裡的 knob1）本來就歸草圖：那個位置的滑桿不再跟著它動。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { opc: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_opc=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?opc=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_opc=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把它關掉。

records.k: panel open the panel hide the button exhibition mode on-screen controller piano button 面板 打開面板 藏起按鈕 展場模式 螢幕控制器 鋼琴按鈕
records.d: Whether the 🎹 panel starts shut, open, or does not exist: closed, open or off.
records.x: closed shows just the small 🎹 button, and pressing it opens the panel: the on-screen controller, the buttons for 🎤, 🔊, 🥁, ⏺, 📷, 📱 and 🩺. open opens the panel as soon as the page loads, for a workshop where everyone needs the on-screen controller at once. off removes the 🎹 button altogether, for a piece in an exhibition: there is no button and OAVp5.panel.open() does nothing. The cards that explain a problem still appear in the corner, unless hints is off too. With off everything the panel does is still there as code: startMic(), startSound(), startRecording() and the options keep working, and the console still says what goes wrong. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { panel: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_panel=… on the page address, then ?panel=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_panel=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Any value except open and off means closed.

records.k: panel open the panel hide the button exhibition mode on-screen controller piano button 面板 打開面板 藏起按鈕 展場模式 螢幕控制器 鋼琴按鈕
records.d: 🎹 面板一開始是收起來、打開，還是根本沒有：closed、open 或 off。
records.x: closed 只顯示小小的 🎹 按鈕，按下去才打開面板：螢幕上的控制器，加上 🎤、🔊、🥁、⏺、📷、📱、🩺 這些按鈕。open 在頁面一載入就打開面板，適合工作坊，每個人一開始就需要螢幕上的控制器。off 把 🎹 按鈕整個拿掉，適合展場裡的作品：沒有按鈕，OAVp5.panel.open() 也什麼都不做。說明問題的卡片還是會出現在角落，除非 hints 也設成 off。 設成 off 之後，面板能做的事還是都能用程式做：startMic()、startSound()、startRecording() 和各個選項照常運作，出問題時 console 也還是會說。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { panel: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_panel=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?panel=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_panel=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 open 和 off 以外的任何值都當作 closed。

records.k: profile controller model minilab lpd8 on-screen controller device layout 設定檔 控制器型號 minilab lpd8 螢幕控制器 設備配置
records.d: Which controller the on-screen 🎹 shows, by profile id such as akai-lpd8; by default it follows the one that is plugged in.
records.x: The on-screen controller of the 🎹 panel draws this device, and knob1, fader1 and pad1 mean the first knob, fader and pad printed on it. A sketch written with the LPD8 in mind, for instance, can ask for it with profile: 'akai-lpd8' so that whoever has no LPD8 still gets one on screen. The picker inside the panel changes it by hand. If you do not set it, the panel starts as the MiniLab 3 and then follows a real controller as soon as one that OAV has a profile for is plugged in. If you do set it, that choice stays. An id that does not exist is reported in the console with the list of known ids, and the panel shows no controller. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { profile: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_profile=… on the page address, then ?profile=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_profile=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Any id that @openav/midi has a profile for: arturia-minilab3, akai-lpd8, korg-nanokontrol2, generic-keys49 and the rest. When you set nothing, the panel follows the controller that is plugged in.

records.k: profile controller model minilab lpd8 on-screen controller device layout 設定檔 控制器型號 minilab lpd8 螢幕控制器 設備配置
records.d: 螢幕上的 🎹 顯示哪一種控制器，用設定檔 id 指定，例如 akai-lpd8。不指定的話，它跟著插上去的那一個。
records.x: 🎹 面板上的螢幕控制器會畫出這一台設備，knob1、fader1、pad1 指的就是它上面印的第一顆旋鈕、第一支推桿、第一個墊子。例如照著 LPD8 寫的草圖，可以用 profile: 'akai-lpd8' 指定它，沒有 LPD8 的人螢幕上也有一台。面板裡的選單可以手動換。 你不設的話，面板一開始是 MiniLab 3，一旦插上 OAV 有設定檔的真控制器，就改成跟著它。你設了的話，就維持你的選擇。不存在的 id 會在 console 回報，並列出已知的 id，面板也不會顯示控制器。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { profile: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_profile=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?profile=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_profile=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 @openav/midi 有設定檔的任何 id：arturia-minilab3、akai-lpd8、korg-nanokontrol2、generic-keys49 等等。你不設的話，面板跟著插上去的那一台控制器。

records.k: recfps recording frame rate fps 60 fps video smoothness 錄影畫面更新率 fps 每秒幾格 60 fps 影片流暢
records.d: The frame rate of recorded video, 1 to 60 frames a second.
records.x: How many frames a second the recorder takes from the canvas, for startRecording() and the ⏺ button. 30 suits most places Instagram and YouTube accept. 60 is smoother for fast motion and makes a bigger file. One take can ask for its own rate: startRecording({ fps: 60 }). It is read back as OAVp5.options.recfps and as OAVp5.record.fps. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { recfps: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_recfps=… on the page address, then ?recfps=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_recfps=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Rounded to a whole number and held between 1 and 60. Anything that is not a number means 30.

records.k: recfps recording frame rate fps 60 fps video smoothness 錄影畫面更新率 fps 每秒幾格 60 fps 影片流暢
records.d: 錄下的影片的畫面更新率，每秒 1 到 60 格。
records.x: 錄影時每秒從畫布取幾格，給 startRecording() 和 ⏺ 按鈕用。30 適合 Instagram 和 YouTube 接受的大多數場合。60 對快速的動作比較順，檔案也比較大。單一次錄影也可以自己指定：startRecording({ fps: 60 })。 它可以用 OAVp5.options.recfps 和 OAVp5.record.fps 讀回來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { recfps: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_recfps=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?recfps=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_recfps=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 會四捨五入成整數，並限制在 1 到 60 之間。不是數字的值就當作 30。

records.k: reclimit recording limit maximum length long recording stops by itself 錄影上限 最長時間 長時間錄影 自動停止
records.d: The longest one recording may last, in seconds: a take stops by itself there.
records.x: A long take fills the tab's memory, so every recording stops by itself at this length, saves what it has and shows a card saying so. Raise it for a long piece, record in parts, or give one take its own length: startRecording(10) stops after ten seconds, and a number above the limit is cut down to the limit. It is read back as OAVp5.options.reclimit and as OAVp5.record.limit. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_reclimit=… on the page address, then ?reclimit=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_reclimit=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). At least 1. Anything that is not a number means 300 (five minutes).

records.k: reclimit recording limit maximum length long recording stops by itself 錄影上限 最長時間 長時間錄影 自動停止
records.d: 一次錄影最長可以錄多久，單位是秒：錄到這裡就會自己停下來。
records.x: 太長的影片會把分頁的記憶體吃光，所以每次錄影都會在這個長度自己停下來，存下已經錄到的，並跳出一張卡片說明。長的作品就把它調高，或是分段錄，也可以替單次錄影指定長度：startRecording(10) 十秒後停下，超過上限的數字會被砍到上限。 它可以用 OAVp5.options.reclimit 和 OAVp5.record.limit 讀回來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_reclimit=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?reclimit=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_reclimit=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 至少是 1。不是數字的值就當作 300（五分鐘）。

records.k: record option recording no mic in recording disable recording screenshot button 錄影選項 錄影 錄影不含收音 關閉錄影 截圖按鈕
records.d: Whether recording is available and whether it includes the microphone: on, nomic or off.
records.x: With on, ⏺ and 📷 are in the 🎹 panel and startRecording() records the canvas together with the sound the sketch makes, the microphone included when it is on. nomic keeps the microphone out of the recording. With it in and no headphones, the speakers are recorded a second time through the microphone, so leave it out when you play sound out loud. off takes ⏺ and 📷 away and makes startRecording() do nothing. off is a promise to the page, like mic=off: a piece that must not be captured can say so. One take can still choose its own: startRecording({ mic: false }). Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { record: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_record=… on the page address, then ?record=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_record=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything else means on.

records.k: record option recording no mic in recording disable recording screenshot button 錄影選項 錄影 錄影不含收音 關閉錄影 截圖按鈕
records.d: 錄影能不能用、錄影要不要包含麥克風：on、nomic 或 off。
records.x: 設成 on，⏺ 和 📷 都在 🎹 面板裡，startRecording() 會把畫布和草圖發出的聲音一起錄下來，麥克風開著的話也包含在內。nomic 讓麥克風不進錄影。麥克風收進去又沒戴耳機的話，喇叭的聲音會透過麥克風被錄第二次，所以大聲放聲音的時候把它關掉。off 把 ⏺ 和 📷 拿掉，讓 startRecording() 什麼都不做。 off 跟 mic=off 一樣是對頁面的承諾：一件不能被錄下來的作品可以這樣宣告。單次錄影還是可以自己決定：startRecording({ mic: false })。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { record: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_record=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?record=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_record=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 其他的值都當作 on。

records.k: relay websocket server phone connection self-host wss 中繼 websocket 伺服器 手機連線 自己架 wss
records.d: The address of the relay that phones and link rooms talk through: a WebSocket URL.
records.x: The 📱 button shows a QR code that sends a phone to the remote page, and the phone's MIDI tab plays your sketch through this relay. link rooms use it too. The default is the project's public relay. To keep your traffic on your own machine, run the relay from a checkout of the repository with node packages/relay/server.js and point relay at ws://localhost:7458/relay. Nothing connects to it at load. It is used when you open the 📱 card (OAVp5.phone()) or set link. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { relay: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_relay=… on the page address, then ?relay=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_relay=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Used as given.

records.k: relay websocket server phone connection self-host wss 中繼 websocket 伺服器 手機連線 自己架 wss
records.d: 手機和 link 房間用來傳話的中繼的位址：一個 WebSocket 網址。
records.x: 📱 按鈕會顯示一個 QR code，讓手機打開遙控頁面，手機的 MIDI 分頁就是透過這個中繼來彈你的草圖。link 的房間也用它。預設是專案的公開中繼。想讓資料只留在自己的機器上，就從儲存庫的副本執行 node packages/relay/server.js，再把 relay 指到 ws://localhost:7458/relay。 載入的時候不會連它。要打開 📱 卡片（OAVp5.phone()）或設了 link 才會用到。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { relay: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_relay=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?relay=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_relay=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 照你給的使用。

records.k: remote page qr code phone page self-host remote 遙控頁面 qr code 手機頁面 自己架遙控
records.d: The address of the remote page that the 📱 QR code opens on a phone.
records.x: The phone's page is where the on-screen controller on the phone lives. The QR code and the link under it are this address plus the relay, the room and the MIDI tab. Change it when you host the remote page yourself, for example on a local network where the phone cannot reach the public site. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { remote: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_remote=… on the page address, then ?remote=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_remote=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Used as given, with ?relay=…&room=…&tab=midi added.

records.k: remote page qr code phone page self-host remote 遙控頁面 qr code 手機頁面 自己架遙控
records.d: 📱 的 QR code 在手機上打開的那個遙控頁面的位址。
records.x: 手機上的控制器就在那個頁面裡。QR code 和它下面的連結，是這個位址再加上中繼、房間和 MIDI 分頁。自己架遙控頁面的時候才需要改它，例如手機連不到公開網站的區域網路。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { remote: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_remote=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?remote=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_remote=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 照你給的使用，後面接上 ?relay=…&room=…&tab=midi。

records.k: room phone room channel session name qr code 房間 手機房間 頻道 場次名稱 qr code
records.d: The name of the room phones join to play this page: by default one made up per browser.
records.x: A phone and a page meet in a room on the relay. Left empty, oav-p5 picks a name like p5-k3x9a the first time and keeps it in this browser (localStorage), so the same QR code keeps working on reload. If link is set, its room is used. Set room yourself when you want a name people can type or remember, such as one per class. A phone needs only the room name to join, so pick a name people cannot guess if that matters. OAVp5.phone() returns the room in use. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { room: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_room=… on the page address, then ?room=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_room=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Left empty, a name like p5-k3x9a is made up and kept in this browser. Only letters, digits, _ and - are kept, and only the first 32 characters. If nothing is left, the room is default.

records.k: room phone room channel session name qr code 房間 手機房間 頻道 場次名稱 qr code
records.d: 手機要加入哪個房間才能彈這個頁面：預設是每個瀏覽器自己亂數取的一個。
records.x: 手機和頁面在 relay 上的一個房間碰面。留空的話，oav-p5 第一次會挑一個像 p5-k3x9a 的名字，存在這個瀏覽器裡（localStorage），所以重新整理之後同一個 QR code 還是有用。設了 link 的話，就用它的房間。想要一個大家打得出來、記得住的名字，例如一班一個，就自己設 room。 手機只需要房間名稱就能加入，所以如果這很重要，就取一個別人猜不到的名字。OAVp5.phone() 會回傳現在用的房間。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { room: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_room=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?room=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_room=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 留空的話，會自己取一個像 p5-k3x9a 的名字，存在這個瀏覽器裡。只留下字母、數字、_ 和 -，而且只取前 32 個字元。如果什麼都沒剩下，房間就叫 default。

records.k: scope option hide oscilloscope hide plot exhibition no corner plot 示波器選項 藏起示波器 藏起圖 展場 角落沒有圖
records.d: Whether scope() draws its oscilloscope in the corner of the page: on or off. hints=off turns it off too.
records.x: With off, scope() draws nothing in the corner and only returns its value, so a sketch can leave its scope() calls in and hide the plot for a show. drawTrail(), which draws on the canvas, is not affected. If the plot does not show up, check hints too: hints=off hides it as well. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { scope: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_scope=… on the page address, then ?scope=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_scope=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns it off.

records.k: scope option hide oscilloscope hide plot exhibition no corner plot 示波器選項 藏起示波器 藏起圖 展場 角落沒有圖
records.d: scope() 要不要在網頁角落畫它的示波器：on 或 off。hints=off 也會把它關掉。
records.x: 設成 off，scope() 不會在角落畫任何東西，只回傳它的值，所以演出的時候草圖可以把 scope() 留在程式裡，只是把圖藏起來。畫在畫布上的 drawTrail() 不受影響。 圖沒有出現的話，也要檢查 hints：hints=off 也會把它藏起來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { scope: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_scope=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?scope=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_scope=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把它關掉。

records.k: shim virtual midi requestMIDIAccess WebMidi.js OAV Virtual MIDI safari midi shim 虛擬 midi requestMIDIAccess WebMidi.js OAV Virtual MIDI safari midi
records.d: Whether oav-p5 replaces navigator.requestMIDIAccess so sketches with their own Web MIDI code also hear the 🎹 and phones: on or off.
records.x: With on, a sketch that calls navigator.requestMIDIAccess() itself (WebMidi.js does) gets the real ports and one more input called "OAV Virtual MIDI", which carries whatever the on-screen controller and the phone play. It also works in Safari and on iPad, where there is no Web MIDI: the sketch gets the virtual port alone, so a WebMidi.js sketch still runs there. Programs can play into its output as well (Strudel's .midi('OAV Virtual MIDI')). off leaves the browser's own requestMIDIAccess alone. Use it when a page already has its own MIDI handling that must not see an extra port. Order matters: oav-p5 has to load before the code that asks for MIDI, which is why the loader line goes first. A page that opened MIDI earlier keeps the browser's own answer, and 🩺 says so. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { shim: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_shim=… on the page address, then ?shim=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_shim=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns it off.

records.k: shim virtual midi requestMIDIAccess WebMidi.js OAV Virtual MIDI safari midi shim 虛擬 midi requestMIDIAccess WebMidi.js OAV Virtual MIDI safari midi
records.d: oav-p5 要不要取代 navigator.requestMIDIAccess，讓自己寫了 Web MIDI 程式的草圖也聽得到 🎹 和手機：on 或 off。
records.x: 設成 on，自己呼叫 navigator.requestMIDIAccess() 的草圖（WebMidi.js 就是）會拿到真的連接埠，再多一個叫 "OAV Virtual MIDI" 的輸入，螢幕控制器和手機彈的東西都從它進來。在沒有 Web MIDI 的 Safari 和 iPad 上也能用：草圖只拿到虛擬連接埠，所以 WebMidi.js 的草圖在那裡還是能跑。其他程式也可以把東西送進它的輸出（Strudel 的 .midi('OAV Virtual MIDI')）。 off 不動瀏覽器自己的 requestMIDIAccess。頁面本來就有自己的 MIDI 處理、不能多出一個連接埠的時候用。 順序很重要：oav-p5 要比要 MIDI 的程式先載入，這就是為什麼載入那一行要放在最前面。更早就開了 MIDI 的頁面會維持瀏覽器自己的答案，🩺 也會這麼說。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { shim: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_shim=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?shim=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_shim=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把它關掉。

records.k: sound option instrument piano organ play without code audio output mute 聲音選項 樂器 鋼琴 管風琴 不用寫程式就有聲音 音訊輸出 靜音
records.d: Whether notes are heard: click (only after startSound() or 🔊), off (never), or an instrument id that starts at the first click.
records.x: With click, nothing makes a sound until the sketch calls startSound() or someone presses 🔊 in the 🎹 panel. With an instrument id, every key, pad, the on-screen controller and a phone are heard from the first click on the page, with no code at all, so any MIDI sketch becomes playable by adding the option to the page address: ?oav_sound=piano. off is a promise to the page: nothing sounds, startSound() resolves false and the 🔊 button is hidden. Browsers let a page play sound only after a click, and a MIDI key is not a click, so the first sound waits for one: a card says "sound is ready but silent" until then. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { sound: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_sound=… on the page address, then ?sound=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_sound=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). An instrument id such as piano, organ, strings, harp or music-box. on and auto start the default instrument (the piano). An id that does not exist plays the default synth (synth/pad) and the console lists the ids that exist.

records.k: sound option instrument piano organ play without code audio output mute 聲音選項 樂器 鋼琴 管風琴 不用寫程式就有聲音 音訊輸出 靜音
records.d: 音符有沒有聲音：click（要呼叫 startSound() 或按 🔊 才有）、off（永遠沒有），或一個樂器 id，從第一次點擊就開始出聲。
records.x: 設成 click，要等草圖呼叫 startSound()，或有人在 🎹 面板按 🔊，才會有聲音。給一個樂器 id，每個琴鍵、打擊墊、螢幕控制器和手機，從頁面上的第一次點擊開始就都聽得到，一行程式都不用寫，所以任何 MIDI 草圖只要在網址加上 ?oav_sound=piano 就能彈。off 是對頁面的承諾：什麼都不發聲，startSound() 會 resolve 成 false，🔊 按鈕也會被藏起來。 瀏覽器要網頁被點過一下才讓它出聲，而 MIDI 的琴鍵不算點擊，所以第一個聲音要等一次點擊：在那之前會有一張卡片說「聲音準備好了，還沒響」。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { sound: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_sound=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?sound=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_sound=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 樂器 id，像是 piano、organ、strings、harp 或 music-box。on 和 auto 會啟動預設的樂器（鋼琴）。不存在的 id 會播預設的合成器（synth/pad），console 會列出存在的 id。

records.k: strudel live coding strudel.cc tidal midin strudel mode strudel 即時編碼 strudel.cc tidal midin strudel 模式
records.d: Whether oav-p5 treats the page as Strudel, the live-coding editor, and behaves politely beside it: auto, on or off.
records.x: Strudel is a live-coding editor, not a sketch, so a few things change when oav-p5 sees it: the names Strudel owns (note, velocity, beat) are left alone and one card says what to read instead, MIDI is asked for by Strudel's own midin() rather than at load (hardware becomes click), the 🎹 panel becomes the compact box, and the 🎹 sits above Strudel's side-panel buttons. oav-p5 only looks at the address and at the names on the page: nothing of Strudel is called. on forces this behaviour on any page, off forces the plain one even on strudel.cc. Settings you give yourself (hardware, compact) still win over what Strudel mode would choose. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { strudel: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_strudel=… on the page address, then ?strudel=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_strudel=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). auto means on strudel.cc, or on a page where Strudel's own functions (note() and s() with stack() or samples()) are already there. Anything else means auto.

records.k: strudel live coding strudel.cc tidal midin strudel mode strudel 即時編碼 strudel.cc tidal midin strudel 模式
records.d: oav-p5 要不要把這個頁面當成 Strudel（即時編碼編輯器），在它旁邊客氣一點：auto、on 或 off。
records.x: Strudel 是即時編碼編輯器，不是草圖，所以 oav-p5 看到它的時候有幾件事會改變：Strudel 自己擁有的名稱（note、velocity、beat）不去動，並用一張卡片說明要改讀什麼，MIDI 交給 Strudel 自己的 midin() 去要，不是載入的時候（hardware 變成 click），🎹 面板變成 compact 的小方塊，🎹 放在 Strudel 側邊按鈕的上面。oav-p5 只看網址和頁面上有哪些名稱：不會呼叫 Strudel 的任何東西。 on 讓任何頁面都用這種做法，off 讓 strudel.cc 上也用一般的做法。你自己給的設定（hardware、compact）還是比 Strudel 模式的選擇優先。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { strudel: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_strudel=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?strudel=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_strudel=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 auto 的意思是在 strudel.cc 上，或頁面上本來就有 Strudel 自己的函式（note() 和 s()，加上 stack() 或 samples()）。其他的值都當作 auto。

records.k: telemetry analytics privacy anonymous tracking opt in 遙測 分析 隱私 匿名 追蹤 選擇加入
records.d: Whether the on-screen controller may send one anonymous page-load count to the project: off or on.
records.x: In oav-p5 it is off. With on, when the 🎹 panel builds the on-screen controller, @openav/midi sends one anonymous hit per page load to the project's Google Analytics, so the project can see where its controllers end up. The @openav/midi README (section Telemetry) lists exactly what it sends: the kind of embed, the profile, the page's origin (never the path, query or title) and the version. Nothing anyone plays is sent and no cookie is set. According to that README nothing is sent from localhost, local network addresses, file:// or openaudiovisual.com itself, or when the browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { telemetry: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_telemetry=… on the page address, then ?telemetry=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_telemetry=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only on turns it on.

records.k: telemetry analytics privacy anonymous tracking opt in 遙測 分析 隱私 匿名 追蹤 選擇加入
records.d: 螢幕上的控制器可不可以把一筆匿名的頁面載入次數送給專案：off 或 on。
records.x: 在 oav-p5 裡預設是關的。設成 on，🎹 面板建立螢幕控制器的時候，@openav/midi 會把每次頁面載入的一筆匿名紀錄送到專案的 Google Analytics，讓專案知道它的控制器用在哪些地方。@openav/midi 的 README（Telemetry 那一節）列出它確切送了什麼：嵌入的種類、設定檔、頁面的來源網域（絕不含路徑、查詢字串或標題）和版本。沒有任何人彈的東西會被送出，也不會設定 cookie。 依照那份 README，從 localhost、區域網路位址、file:// 或 openaudiovisual.com 本身都不會送，瀏覽器送出「不要追蹤」或 Global Privacy Control 的時候也不會送。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { telemetry: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_telemetry=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?telemetry=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_telemetry=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 on 會打開它。

records.k: title file name recording name name the video download name 標題 檔名 錄影名稱 影片命名 下載檔名
records.d: A name that goes into the file name of recordings and images, as in oav-my-piece-20261015-183012.mp4.
records.x: Without it a recording is oav-20261015-183012.mp4. With title: 'my-piece' it is oav-my-piece-20261015-183012.mp4, so takes from several pieces sort themselves. One take can have its own name: startRecording({ name: 'take-2' }) replaces it. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { title: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_title=… on the page address, then ?title=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_title=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Spaces and the characters a file name cannot hold become -, and only the first 40 characters are used.

records.k: title file name recording name name the video download name 標題 檔名 錄影名稱 影片命名 下載檔名
records.d: 放進錄影和圖片檔名裡的名稱，例如 oav-my-piece-20261015-183012.mp4。
records.x: 沒有它的話，錄影檔名是 oav-20261015-183012.mp4。設了 title: 'my-piece'，就是 oav-my-piece-20261015-183012.mp4，好幾件作品的錄影就會自己排好。單次錄影也可以有自己的名字：startRecording({ name: 'take-2' }) 會取代它。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { title: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_title=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?title=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_title=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 空白和檔名不能用的字元會變成 -，而且只取前 40 個字元。

records.k: tone tone.js cdn offline sound self-host jsdelivr firewall tone tone.js cdn 離線聲音 自己架 jsdelivr 防火牆
records.d: Where Tone.js, the sound engine behind startSound(), is loaded from: an ES module address. Empty means jsDelivr.
records.x: Sound (startSound(), the sound option, the 🔊 button) uses Tone.js 15, which oav-p5 loads the first time sound is wanted. By default it comes from jsDelivr. Point tone at your own copy when the page is behind a school firewall or an ad blocker that stops the CDN, or when you serve everything yourself. If it cannot be loaded, a card says which host was unreachable and what to try. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { tone: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_tone=… on the page address, then ?tone=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_tone=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). The address of Tone.js version 15 as an ES module. Left empty, it is https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm, and OAVp5.options.tone reads ''.

records.k: tone tone.js cdn offline sound self-host jsdelivr firewall tone tone.js cdn 離線聲音 自己架 jsdelivr 防火牆
records.d: Tone.js（startSound() 背後的聲音引擎）從哪裡載入：一個 ES module 的位址。空的就是 jsDelivr。
records.x: 聲音（startSound()、sound 選項、🔊 按鈕）用的是 Tone.js 15，oav-p5 在第一次需要聲音的時候才載入它。預設從 jsDelivr 來。頁面在學校防火牆或擋廣告的外掛後面、CDN 被擋住，或是你自己架所有東西的時候，把 tone 指到你自己的那一份。載不到的時候，會有一張卡片說是哪個主機連不上，以及可以怎麼試。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { tone: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_tone=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?tone=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_tone=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 Tone.js 第 15 版的 ES module 位址。留空的話用 https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm，OAVp5.options.tone 讀回來是 ''。

records.k: OAVp5 midi object oavMidi namespace advanced state api object OAVp5 midi 物件 oavMidi 命名空間 進階 狀態 api 物件
records.d: The object oav-p5 hangs everything on: MIDI state, the panel, the microphone, the clock, the check-up. midi and oavMidi are the same object.
records.x: It is there as soon as oav-p5 has loaded, in setup() and draw() alike. The plain names of the p5 style (knob1, note, micLevel) are the easy way in. OAVp5 is the way in when you want more: the raw MIDI state (OAVp5.note, OAVp5.cc, OAVp5.bend, OAVp5.held, OAVp5.last), subscriptions (OAVp5.on()), a way to send bytes (OAVp5.input()), the microphone's numbers (OAVp5.mic), the external clock (OAVp5.clock), the link (OAVp5.link), the values over time (OAVp5.chop) and the check-up (OAVp5.check()). Three names, one object. OAVp5 is always there. oavMidi is always there too. midi is there unless the page already had a midi of its own, in which case it is left alone and the console says to read OAVp5 instead. OAVp5.options holds the loading options as oav-p5 read them: OAVp5.options.mic, and so on for each of the loading options (for example mic). Only the loader line. If it has not loaded, OAVp5 is not defined, and a sketch that reads it stops with "OAVp5 is not defined". midi and oavMidi are the same object under other names.

records.k: OAVp5 midi object oavMidi namespace advanced state api object OAVp5 midi 物件 oavMidi 命名空間 進階 狀態 api 物件
records.d: oav-p5 把所有東西掛在上面的那個物件：MIDI 狀態、面板、麥克風、時鐘、體檢。midi 和 oavMidi 是同一個物件。
records.x: 只要 oav-p5 載入了，它就在那裡，setup() 和 draw() 裡都一樣。p5 風格的簡單名稱（knob1、note、micLevel）是輕鬆的入口。想要更多的時候就用 OAVp5：原始的 MIDI 狀態（OAVp5.note、OAVp5.cc、OAVp5.bend、OAVp5.held、OAVp5.last）、訂閱（OAVp5.on()）、自己送位元組進去的方法（OAVp5.input()）、麥克風的數字（OAVp5.mic）、外部時鐘（OAVp5.clock）、連結（OAVp5.link）、數值隨時間變化（OAVp5.chop），還有體檢（OAVp5.check()）。 三個名字，同一個物件。OAVp5 一定在，oavMidi 也一定在。midi 則是頁面本來沒有自己的 midi 時才有，如果頁面已經有了，就不去動它，console 會說要改讀 OAVp5。OAVp5.options 放的是 oav-p5 讀到的載入選項：OAVp5.options.mic，其他每個載入選項（例如 mic）也一樣。 只需要載入那一行。如果它沒載入，OAVp5 就沒有定義，讀它的草圖會停在「OAVp5 is not defined」。 midi 和 oavMidi 是同一個物件的其他名字。

records.k: check check-up diagnose troubleshoot report screenshot why does it not work 體檢 檢查 診斷 疑難排解 報告 截圖 為什麼不能用
records.d: Runs the 🩺 check-up: the version, page, browser, microphone, MIDI, sound, drums, recording, wiring and hints, as a card to screenshot and as an object.
records.x: The same thing the 🩺 button in the panel does. When something does not work for a student, OAVp5.check() in the console (or 🩺) gives a card that says what this browser did: whether the page is in an iframe, whether the microphone is on or blocked, whether Web MIDI exists and which devices it found, the last message, the sound and drum state, whether MP4 recording works, what the controller is wired to, which of the sketch's own names stepped in the way, and which cards have appeared. It has a copy button and a link to the site's full device check. It is a snapshot taken when you call it, not a live view. Calling it again replaces the card. opts { show: false } skips the card on the page and only returns the report (the text still goes to the console). Left out, the card is shown. The report: { version, time, page, browser, microphone, midi, sound, drums, wiring, own, hints, external, recording, text }. text is the whole card as plain lines, the other fields are the same facts as data (microphone.state, midi.hardware, midi.devices …).

records.k: check check-up diagnose troubleshoot report screenshot why does it not work 體檢 檢查 診斷 疑難排解 報告 截圖 為什麼不能用
records.d: 執行 🩺 體檢：版本、頁面、瀏覽器、麥克風、MIDI、聲音、鼓機、錄影、接線和提示，做成一張可以截圖的卡片，也回傳成物件。
records.x: 跟面板裡的 🩺 按鈕做的事一樣。學生那邊有東西不能用的時候，在 console 打 OAVp5.check()（或按 🩺）就會得到一張卡片，說這個瀏覽器做了什麼：頁面是不是在 iframe 裡、麥克風開著還是被擋、有沒有 Web MIDI、找到哪些設備、最後一則訊息、聲音和鼓機的狀態、能不能錄 MP4、控制器接到哪些變數、草圖自己的哪些名稱擋住了路，還有出現過哪些卡片。卡片上有複製按鈕，也有連到網站完整裝置檢查的連結。 它是呼叫那一刻的快照，不是即時的畫面。再呼叫一次會取代那張卡片。 opts { show: false } 不顯示頁面上的卡片，只回傳報告（文字還是會印到 console）。不寫的話就顯示卡片。 報告：{ version, time, page, browser, microphone, midi, sound, drums, wiring, own, hints, external, recording, text }。text 是整張卡片的純文字，其他欄位是同樣的資訊做成的資料（microphone.state、midi.hardware、midi.devices …）。

records.k: clock midi clock external clock sync tempo follow DAW Strudel 時鐘 midi 時鐘 外部時鐘 同步 速度 跟隨 DAW Strudel
records.d: What oav-p5 hears of an external MIDI clock: its state, tempo and where it is in the bar. Nothing until another program or device starts sending one.
records.x: Some programs keep the time and everyone else follows: Strudel (midicmd("clock96, /8")), a DAW over a virtual cable, a drum machine on a MIDI cable. They send 24 clock messages per beat, plus start, continue, stop and song position. oav-p5 counts them: OAVp5.clock.info says whether a clock is running, OAVp5.clock.bpm its tempo and OAVp5.clock.phase how far through the bar and the beat it is now. When a clock is moving, drumPhase, beatPhase, drumBar, drumStep and drumBpm read it, and a drum machine that is up follows it. ?oav_clock=off turns all of that off. Clock messages are not delivered to midiMessage(): they belong to the clock. The first clock message loads the counting code (@openav/midi's MidiClock) from next to oav-p5.js, which takes a few frames. Until then the members read none, null and null. This is advanced: most sketches only read drumPhase and let it follow a clock.

records.k: clock midi clock external clock sync tempo follow DAW Strudel 時鐘 midi 時鐘 外部時鐘 同步 速度 跟隨 DAW Strudel
records.d: oav-p5 聽到的外部 MIDI 時鐘：它的狀態、速度、現在在小節的哪裡。在別的程式或設備開始送時鐘之前什麼都沒有。
records.x: 有些程式負責打拍子，其他人跟著走：Strudel（midicmd("clock96, /8")）、透過虛擬線連過來的 DAW、用 MIDI 線接的鼓機。它們每拍送 24 個時鐘訊息，加上 start、continue、stop 和 song position。oav-p5 把它們數起來：OAVp5.clock.info 說有沒有時鐘在跑，OAVp5.clock.bpm 是它的速度，OAVp5.clock.phase 是現在走到小節和拍子的哪裡。 時鐘在動的時候，drumPhase、beatPhase、drumBar、drumStep、drumBpm 讀的就是它，已經在跑的鼓機也會跟著它。?oav_clock=off 會把這些全部關掉。時鐘訊息不會交給 midiMessage()：它們屬於時鐘。 第一個時鐘訊息會從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入負責計算的程式（@openav/midi 的 MidiClock），要幾個畫面。在那之前，這些成員讀到的是 none、null、null。 這是進階用法：大多數草圖只讀 drumPhase，讓它自己去跟著時鐘。

records.k: bpm tempo beats per minute external tempo midi clock bpm bpm 速度 每分鐘幾拍 外部速度 midi 時鐘速度
records.d: The tempo of the external MIDI clock in beats a minute, or null while there is none.
records.x: The raw number, not rounded. Use it for anything that should run at the clock's tempo: OAVp5.clock.bpm / 60 is beats a second. If the drum machine follows the clock, drumBpm shows it rounded to a tenth. Fitted over the last 24 clock ticks, so it settles within a moment and does not jump with one late tick. null before two ticks have arrived or when clock=off.

records.k: bpm tempo beats per minute external tempo midi clock bpm bpm 速度 每分鐘幾拍 外部速度 midi 時鐘速度
records.d: 外部 MIDI 時鐘的速度，單位是每分鐘幾拍，沒有的時候是 null。
records.x: 原始的數字，沒有四捨五入。任何要跟著時鐘速度走的東西都可以用它：OAVp5.clock.bpm / 60 就是每秒幾拍。鼓機如果跟著時鐘，drumBpm 會顯示四捨五入到小數一位的值。 用最近 24 個時鐘 tick 擬合出來的，所以一下子就會穩定，不會因為一個晚到的 tick 就跳動。兩個 tick 到齊之前，或設了 clock=off，都是 null。
