Keys: bg (the area around the device; null leaves what is underneath), body (the faceplate; null uses the profile's face.body), ink (big text), label (control labels), dim (faceplate and section lettering), idle (a pad at rest), button, cap (knob caps), well (fader slots and strip wells), screen, screenInk, screenDim, accent (one colour for everything that moves; null keeps each control's own), glow (0 flat to 1 like the on-screen controller) and the fonts font and mono.

records.k: theme colors accent glow transparent background branding 外觀 顏色 強調色 光暈 透明背景 品牌色
records.d: ControllerCanvas 的預設外觀：背景、機身、文字、待機顏色、accent、glow 和字型。把任何子集當作 theme 選項傳入即可。
records.x: 顏色都是 CSS 顏色字串。bg: null 讓底下的影片或頁面透出來，accent: '#7ea6ff' 則讓整個面板只用一個顏色，很適合有品牌色的影片。 凍結的物件（不能修改，要用 theme 選項覆寫）。鍵有：bg（機器周圍的區域，null 表示保留底下原本的畫面）、body（面板，null 用設定檔的 face.body）、ink（大字）、label（控制項標籤）、dim（面板與區塊的文字）、idle（待機的打擊墊）、button、cap（旋鈕蓋）、well（推桿溝槽和觸控條底）、screen、screenInk、screenDim、accent（所有會動的東西用同一個顏色，null 保留各控制項自己的顏色）、glow（0 是平面，1 是跟螢幕控制器一樣的光暈），以及字型 font 和 mono。

records.k: control event event payload detail value raw signal bytes source control 事件 事件內容 detail value raw signal 位元組 來源
records.d: Builds the control event payload for one control change: id, value, raw, signal, the parsed message, its bytes and where it came from.
records.x: Always there: profile (the profile id), id, type, label, value, raw, signal, message, bytes, source and time (performance.now(), rounded). value is 0..1 (−1..1 for a bipolar wheel); a pad is its velocity while held and 0 on release; a button is 0 or 1; for keys it is that note's velocity. raw is the MIDI number (0..127, pitch bend 0..16383). signal is the name the rest of open-audiovisual uses (midi/lpd8/k1; for a key midi/minilab3/n60). message is the parsed MIDI ({ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 70, value: 53 }) and bytes the raw bytes. source is 'ui' (a finger, a mouse, set()), 'hardware' (a real port, or bytes you ingest()) or 'mirror'. Sometimes there: note and velocity (note messages, velocity 0 for a release), delta (a relative encoder: the signed steps), held (a pad or button), and pressure (a pad, when it is above 0). The control, noteon and noteoff events carry it as their detail. mc The controller the change happened on. id The control id. st Its state after the change (mc.get(id)). info What onChange gave: { source, ev, note, bytes }. The payload, plain JSON that is safe to postMessage.

records.k: control event event payload detail value raw signal bytes source control 事件 事件內容 detail value raw signal 位元組 來源
records.d: 為一次控制項變化組出 control 事件的內容：id、value、raw、signal、解析後的 message、bytes，以及它從哪裡來。
records.x: 一定會有的欄位：profile（設定檔 id）、id、type、label、value、raw、signal、message、bytes、source、time（performance.now()，取整數）。value 是 0..1（雙向彎音輪是 −1..1），打擊墊在按著時是力度、放開是 0，按鈕是 0 或 1，琴鍵則是那個音的力度。raw 是 MIDI 的號碼（0..127，彎音是 0..16383）。signal 是 open-audiovisual 其他部分用的名稱（midi/lpd8/k1，琴鍵是 midi/minilab3/n60）。message 是解析後的 MIDI（{ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 70, value: 53 }），bytes 是原始位元組。source 是 'ui'（手指、滑鼠、set()）、'hardware'（真實的埠，或你 ingest() 的位元組）或 'mirror'。 有時才有的欄位：note 和 velocity（音符訊息，放開時 velocity 為 0）、delta（相對旋鈕：有正負號的步數）、held（打擊墊或按鈕）、pressure（打擊墊，大於 0 時才有）。control、noteon、noteoff 事件把它當作 detail。 mc 發生變化的控制器。 id 控制項 id。 st 變化之後的狀態（mc.get(id)）。 info onChange 給的內容：{ source, ev, note, bytes }。 事件內容，是可以安全 postMessage 的純 JSON。

records.k: draw controller canvas video overlay record controller compositor picture in picture faceplate on canvas thumbnail 畫控制器 畫布 影片疊圖 錄製控制器 合成 子母畫面 畫布上的面板 縮圖
records.d: Draws a controller's faceplate into any 2D canvas context, every frame, at any size: the bottom of a performance video, an overlay, a thumbnail.
records.x: The on-screen controller is DOM: perfect to play, impossible to record, because a page cannot capture its own DOM into a video. This draws the same faceplate, every section where it sits on the device and in the same colours, straight into a 2D context. It is vector and drawn at the output size, so a 4K frame is as sharp as a 1080 one, and it costs a few hundred path calls a frame. @openav/record's Compositor#setPanel takes one. Call panel.draw(ctx, { x, y, w, h }) every frame, or panel.renderTo(canvas) to fill a canvas of its own. What a video needs that a screen does not: a touch has to stay visible for a few frames (30 fps is 33 ms; a staccato note can be shorter), so released keys and pads fade out instead of switching off, the control a hand just moved glows, and the keyboard follows the device's octave buttons. panel.aspect is the faceplate's width ÷ height, for reserving an area of that shape. With neither signals nor controller the panel just stays at rest. It is a silent model: it publishes nothing back to the bus. panel.dispose() stops listening to the bus or controller (a controller you passed in is left as it was). profile Profile id, short name or object. An unknown id throws ControllerCanvas: unknown profile "x". signals Follow the generic MIDI names on this bus (midi/ch//…, midi/note/on|off, midi/cc/, midi/bend): live hardware, the on-screen controller, the QWERTY piano, phones and a recorded take playing back all move the panel. Each message counts once,…

records.k: draw controller canvas video overlay record controller compositor picture in picture faceplate on canvas thumbnail 畫控制器 畫布 影片疊圖 錄製控制器 合成 子母畫面 畫布上的面板 縮圖
records.d: 把控制器的面板畫進任何 2D 畫布，每個畫面都畫，任何大小都行：演出影片的下半部、疊圖、縮圖。
records.x: 螢幕上的控制器是 DOM：很適合彈，卻沒辦法錄，因為網頁不能把自己的 DOM 錄進影片。這個類別把同一個面板直接畫進 2D 畫布，每個區塊都在機器上原本的位置，用同樣的顏色。它是向量，直接以輸出的大小繪製，所以 4K 畫面跟 1080 一樣清楚，每個畫面約花幾百次路徑呼叫。@openav/record 的 Compositor#setPanel 就是接收它。 每個畫面呼叫 panel.draw(ctx, { x, y, w, h })，或用 panel.renderTo(canvas) 畫滿一張自己的畫布。影片需要而螢幕不需要的東西：一次觸碰要在畫面上留幾格（30 fps 是 33 毫秒，很短的斷音可能比這還短），所以放開的琴鍵和打擊墊會淡出而不是直接熄掉，剛被手動過的控制項會發光，鍵盤也會跟著機器的八度按鈕移動。panel.aspect 是面板的寬除以高，可用來預留相同形狀的區域。signals 和 controller 都沒給時，面板就只是靜止不動。 它是個安靜的模型：不會往匯流排發佈任何東西。panel.dispose() 會停止聽匯流排或控制器（你傳進來的控制器不會被動到）。 profile 設定檔 id、短名稱或物件。不認得的 id 會丟出 ControllerCanvas: unknown profile "x"。 signals 跟隨這條匯流排上的通用 MIDI 名稱（midi/ch//…、midi/note/on|off、midi/cc/、midi/bend）：實際的硬體、螢幕控制器、電腦鍵盤鋼琴、手機，以及正在回放的錄音，都會讓面板動起來。硬體的一則訊息雖然用兩個名稱發佈，也只會算一次。 controller 改為跟隨這個現有的控制器，不聽匯流排：正好就是那一台，連同它學到的對應。錄音回放不會傳到它。有給的話會忽略 signals。 mapping 要套用到面板自己的控制器上的學習結果：就是實機控制器的 exportMapping()。 theme CANVAS_THEME 的任何子集：顏色、glow、字型。 notes 把按著的音大大地寫在面板下面。'auto' 是區域有空間時才寫，true 會擠出空間，false 永遠不寫。 screen 機器自己的螢幕（MiniLab 3、KeyStep）顯示最後一次碰了什麼，跟實機一樣：Knob 3 · 87、C4 · 100。 padding 面板周圍的留白，以區域短邊的比例表示。 now 淡出效果用的時鐘（毫秒），預設是 performance.now()。傳給 draw() 的 now 要用同一個時鐘。

records.k: layout geometry rect cell positions where is the knob faceplate size 版面 幾何 矩形 格子位置 旋鈕在哪 面板大小
records.d: Computes where everything goes when a profile's faceplate is drawn into a pixel rectangle: the face, every section, every control cell, and the notes strip.
records.x: The faceplate keeps its own proportions, centred in the rect. The sections are laid out the way the on-screen controller's CSS grid does (row or column flow, spans), so the canvas drawing and the DOM agree. It is pure, so it is the part to test, and the part to use when you want to draw something of your own on top of a control. profile A normalized profile (MidiController#profile). rect The area, in pixels. padding Space around the faceplate, as a share of the rect's short side (0..1). notes Reserve a strip under the faceplate for the held notes: true always, false never, 'auto' when the rect has room. u is the pixel size of one face unit. face is { x, y, w, h }. notes is the strip or null. sections is a list with id, label, the box and its grid. controls is a Map from control id to { id, type, section, x, y, w, h }. deco lists the decorations (screen, logo, lettering) in pixels.

records.k: layout geometry rect cell positions where is the knob faceplate size 版面 幾何 矩形 格子位置 旋鈕在哪 面板大小
records.d: 算出設定檔的面板畫進某個像素矩形時，每樣東西的位置：面板、每個區塊、每個控制項的格子，以及音名條。
records.x: 面板維持自己的比例，置中在矩形裡。區塊的排法跟螢幕控制器的 CSS grid 一致（橫向或直向排列、跨格），所以畫布上的繪製和 DOM 版本一致。它是純函式，適合拿來測試，也適合在你想在某個控制項上疊自己畫的東西時使用。 profile 整理過的設定檔（MidiController#profile）。 rect 區域，單位是像素。 padding 面板周圍的留白，以矩形短邊的比例表示（0..1）。 notes 在面板下面預留一條放按著的音的位置：true 一定有，false 一定沒有，'auto' 是矩形有空間時才有。 u 是一個面板單位的像素大小。face 是 { x, y, w, h }。notes 是那一條或 null。sections 是帶有 id、label、外框和 grid 的清單。controls 是從控制項 id 對到 { id, type, section, x, y, w, h } 的 Map。deco 列出以像素表示的裝飾（螢幕、標誌、文字）。

records.k: controller host events status connect hardware set output learn mount ingest 控制器主機 事件 狀態 連接硬體 設定輸出 學習 掛載 餵入訊息
records.d: The object createController() returns: one controller with its events, its playable faceplate, its hardware connection and its MIDI output.
records.x: Events, with ctl.on(name, fn) (returns an unsubscribe function): control (every knob, pad, key or button change), noteon and noteoff (the same payload, for pads, keys and note buttons), connect and disconnect ({ port, profile }: a hardware port started or stopped driving it), status, profilechange ({ profile, name }) and '', which gets (name, detail) for all of them. The control payload is the one described under controlDetail(). ready and error exist only on the element. ctl.status is { hardware, input, output, outputState }. hardware is off, asking, waiting (listening, but the device is not plugged in), connected, unavailable (the browser has no Web MIDI) or denied (permission refused). outputState is off, asking, open, missing (no port matches), unavailable or denied. ctl.profileId, ctl.controller and ctl.profile say which device is on screen; ctl.controllers, ctl.view, ctl.midi and ctl.output are the objects underneath. What a hand plays on the screen leaves through the output port as real MIDI; moves of your real hardware are not forwarded (your software already hears the device), and input with the same name as the chosen output (the loopMIDI echo) is muted. connectHardware(), setOutput() and requestMidi() are the only calls that ask the browser for MIDI. Chrome, Edge and Firefox show a permission prompt, so call them from a click when you can. Without Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) the controller still plays and fires events, and status says unavailable. profile Profile id,…

records.k: controller host events status connect hardware set output learn mount ingest 控制器主機 事件 狀態 連接硬體 設定輸出 學習 掛載 餵入訊息
records.d: createController() 回傳的物件：一台控制器，包含事件、可以彈的面板、硬體連線和 MIDI 輸出。
records.x: 事件用 ctl.on(name, fn) 訂閱（回傳取消訂閱的函式）：control（任何旋鈕、打擊墊、琴鍵、按鈕的變化）、noteon 和 noteoff（內容相同，給打擊墊、琴鍵和音符按鈕）、connect 和 disconnect（{ port, profile }：某個硬體埠開始或停止驅動它）、status、profilechange（{ profile, name }），以及 ''，所有事件都會以 (name, detail) 通知它。control 的內容見 controlDetail()。ready 和 error 只有 元素才有。 ctl.status 是 { hardware, input, output, outputState }。hardware 可能是 off、asking、waiting（在聽，但機器沒接上）、connected、unavailable（瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI）或 denied（權限被拒絕）。outputState 可能是 off、asking、open、missing（沒有符合的埠）、unavailable 或 denied。ctl.profileId、ctl.controller、ctl.profile 告訴你螢幕上是哪台機器，ctl.controllers、ctl.view、ctl.midi、ctl.output 則是底下的物件。 螢幕上的手彈出來的，會從輸出埠以真正的 MIDI 送出。真實硬體的動作不會被轉送（你的軟體本來就聽得到那台機器），名稱跟所選輸出埠相同的輸入（loopMIDI 的回音）會被靜音。 只有 connectHardware()、setOutput()、requestMidi() 會向瀏覽器要 MIDI。Chrome、Edge、Firefox 會跳出權限詢問，所以可以的話請在點擊裡呼叫。沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad）時，控制器仍然能彈、能觸發事件，status 會顯示 unavailable。 profile 設定檔 id、短名稱或物件。 profiles 選單或 follow 可以切換到的設定檔。預設是所有內建的。 signals 同時把 midi//… 發佈進演出。 sink 改由這個函式發佈（中繼），用法同 MidiController。 channel 把所有控制項移到這個 MIDI 頻道（你的機器設定在別的頻道時）。見 withChannel()。 follow 接上另一台認得的機器時，就改顯示那一台。 midi 改用這個引擎（演出的），不用頁面共用的。 requestAccess MIDIAccess 從哪裡來，用法同 Midi。給了它，控制器就會用自己的引擎。 filterOut Midi 的輸入埠過濾。任何不是預設 'IAC' 的值，也會讓控制器用自己的引擎。 storage 學到的對應存在哪裡，用法同 MidiControllers。預設是有 localStorage 就用它。 telemetry false 就不送匿名的頁面載入資料。 embedKind 這次嵌入屬於哪一種，供那筆資料用：'headless'（預設）、'element' 或 'iframe'。

records.k: faceplate on-screen controller view touch knobs and pads face stack layout accessibility learn 面板 螢幕控制器 畫面 觸控 旋鈕與打擊墊 版面 無障礙 學習
records.d: The playable on-screen faceplate of a controller: knobs, faders, pads and keys you drive with a mouse, a finger or the keyboard, repainted from the controller's state.
records.x: Two shapes, chosen from the box it lives in. face: the device as it looks, sections where they sit on the real faceplate, scaled to fit (desktop, iPad, a phone held sideways). stack: the same controls re-gridded top to bottom for a tall box (a phone held upright), as the profile's portrait says. Nothing scrolls and nothing shrinks below a thumb. Square grid devices (Launchpad) stay face. mode fixes one; 'auto' follows the box. Every control repaints from the controller's state, so a finger here and a knob on the desk look the same, and a move from hardware gets a brief glow ring so you can see your hand arrive. Touch: drag a knob (right or up raises it), drag or click a fader or strip, strike a pad (higher on the pad is softer, lower is harder), hold a button, play the keys (multi-touch works). The mouse wheel turns knobs and faders. Keyboard: Tab reaches every control except the piano keys; the arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End move knobs, faders and strips (Shift for fine steps); Space or Enter strikes pads and buttons, held while the key is held. Learn mode (setLearning(true)) turns every tap into "bind this control", and view.onLearnTap = (id) => … tells you which. A browser DOM and a container with a height. createController(…).mount(el) is the usual way to get one. container The element to fill. It needs a size: the view is 100% wide and tall, so give it a height. It can be inside a shadow root: the view's CSS goes into that root, not the page. controller The…

records.k: faceplate on-screen controller view touch knobs and pads face stack layout accessibility learn 面板 螢幕控制器 畫面 觸控 旋鈕與打擊墊 版面 無障礙 學習
records.d: 控制器在螢幕上可以彈的面板：旋鈕、推桿、打擊墊、琴鍵，可以用滑鼠、手指或鍵盤操作，畫面隨著控制器的狀態重畫。
records.x: 兩種形狀，依它所在的盒子大小決定。face：機器原本的樣子，各區塊在真實面板上的位置，縮放到剛好放進去（桌機、iPad、橫拿的手機）。stack：同樣的控制項，照設定檔的 portrait 重新由上到下排列，給高的盒子用（直拿的手機）。不會捲動，也不會縮到比手指小。方形格子的機器（Launchpad）一律維持 face。mode 可以固定其中一種，'auto' 則跟著盒子走。 每個控制項都從控制器的狀態重畫，所以螢幕上的手指和桌上的旋鈕看起來一樣，硬體動作則會有一圈短暫的光環，讓你看見自己的手「抵達」螢幕。操作：拖曳旋鈕（往右或往上是增加）、拖曳或點推桿與觸控條、敲打擊墊（敲在上半部較輕，下半部較重）、按住按鈕、彈琴鍵（支援多點觸控）。滑鼠滾輪可以轉旋鈕和推桿。 鍵盤：Tab 可以走到每個控制項（琴鍵除外），方向鍵、Page Up/Down、Home、End 移動旋鈕、推桿和觸控條（加 Shift 是微調），空白鍵或 Enter 敲打擊墊和按鈕，按著鍵就一直按著。學習模式（setLearning(true)）會讓每一次點擊都變成「綁定這個控制項」，view.onLearnTap = (id) => … 會告訴你是哪一個。 要有瀏覽器的 DOM，而且容器要有高度。平常用 createController(…).mount(el) 取得它。 container 要填滿的元素。它要有大小：畫面是 100% 寬、100% 高，所以要給高度。可以放在 shadow root 裡，畫面的 CSS 會放進那個 root，不會碰到頁面。 controller 要顯示並驅動的模型。 mode 'auto'、'face' 或 'stack'（見下）。 minTouch 控制項至少要有幾個像素大，face 才不會被換成 stack。

records.k: create controller embed controller headless controller on-screen controller react vue midi out connect hardware play controller 建立控制器 嵌入控制器 無畫面控制器 螢幕控制器 react vue midi 輸出 連接硬體 彈控制器
records.d: Makes one MIDI controller you can play, listen to, and point at hardware or a DAW, with no element and no framework: createController('akai-lpd8').
records.x: Four lines are enough: const ctl = createController('akai-lpd8'), ctl.mount(el) for the playable faceplate (optional, it works headless too), ctl.on('control', fn) to hear every knob, pad and key whether it came from the screen or the hardware, and ctl.connectHardware() to follow the real device. ctl.set(id, value) moves a control the way a hand would. Controllers on one page share one Midi engine, so the browser asks for MIDI permission once. Nothing asks until you call connectHardware(), setOutput() or requestMidi(). Pass signals to publish midi//… into a show. Like , it sends one anonymous hit per page load (which kind of embed and which device; nothing anyone plays) to the project's analytics, and nothing from localhost or the LAN. Turn it off with createController(profile, { telemetry: false }). The README's Telemetry section has the details. profile A profile id ('akai-lpd8'), a short name ('lpd8') or a profile object. For a URL, load it first with loadProfile(). An unknown id throws unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …). o Options, the same as the second argument of ControllerHost: profiles, signals, sink, channel, follow, midi, requestAccess, filterOut, storage, telemetry, embedKind. The controller. Its methods are listed under ControllerHost.

records.k: create controller embed controller headless controller on-screen controller react vue midi out connect hardware play controller 建立控制器 嵌入控制器 無畫面控制器 螢幕控制器 react vue midi 輸出 連接硬體 彈控制器
records.d: 做出一台可以彈、可以聽、可以接硬體或 DAW 的 MIDI 控制器，不需要元素也不需要框架：createController('akai-lpd8')。
records.x: 四行就夠：const ctl = createController('akai-lpd8')，ctl.mount(el) 畫出可以彈的面板（可有可無，沒有畫面也能用），ctl.on('control', fn) 聽每一個旋鈕、打擊墊、琴鍵，不論來自螢幕還是硬體，ctl.connectHardware() 跟隨真實的機器。ctl.set(id, value) 則像一隻手一樣去動某個控制項。 同一個頁面上的控制器共用一個 Midi 引擎，所以瀏覽器只會詢問一次 MIDI 權限。在你呼叫 connectHardware()、setOutput() 或 requestMidi() 之前，什麼都不會詢問。傳入 signals 就能把 midi//… 發佈進演出。 跟 一樣，每次載入頁面會對專案的分析送出一筆匿名資料（哪一種嵌入、哪一台機器，不含任何人彈的內容），從 localhost 或區域網路則不送。用 createController(profile, { telemetry: false }) 可以關掉。細節在 README 的 Telemetry 一節。 profile 設定檔 id（'akai-lpd8'）、短名稱（'lpd8'）或設定檔物件。要用網址的話，先用 loadProfile() 載入。不認得的 id 會丟出 unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)。 o 選項，跟 ControllerHost 的第二個參數一樣：profiles、signals、sink、channel、follow、midi、requestAccess、filterOut、storage、telemetry、embedKind。 控制器本身。它的方法列在 ControllerHost 底下。

records.k: register custom element name tag name customElements.define 註冊 自訂元素名稱 標籤名稱 customElements.define
records.d: Registers the controller element under another tag name (importing @openav/midi/element already registers it as oav-controller).
records.x: A tag name can be registered only once per page, so use this when oav-controller clashes with another library, or when you want two differently-named copies. The default tag registers the exported OavController class itself; any other name registers a subclass of it. tag The new tag name. It must contain a hyphen, as every custom element does. The element class registered for that tag (an already-registered tag returns what is there). null when the page has no customElements.

records.k: register custom element name tag name customElements.define 註冊 自訂元素名稱 標籤名稱 customElements.define
records.d: 把 <oav-controller> 元素註冊成另一個標籤名稱（匯入 @openav/midi/element 時已經註冊好 <oav-controller> 了）。
records.x: 一個標籤名稱在同一個頁面只能註冊一次，所以當 oav-controller 跟別的函式庫衝突，或你想要兩個不同名字的副本時，就用它。預設標籤註冊的是匯出的 OavController 類別本身，其他名稱註冊的是它的子類別。 tag 新的標籤名稱，必須包含連字號，所有自訂元素都是如此。 註冊在該標籤上的元素類別（標籤已經註冊過就回傳現有的）。頁面沒有 customElements 時回傳 null。

records.k: readout line event text knob = 0.42 caption 讀數列 事件文字 旋鈕 = 0.42 字幕
records.d: Writes the readout line for a control event payload: midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1.
records.x: This is the text shows under the faceplate. Use it for your own log or caption. A payload without a message shows only the signal and the value. d A payload from controlDetail() (or a control event's detail). null gives an empty string. The signal name, the value (two decimals, or a whole number from 100 up), then ←, the message as describeMessage() writes it and the channel.

records.k: readout line event text knob = 0.42 caption 讀數列 事件文字 旋鈕 = 0.42 字幕
records.d: 為 control 事件的內容寫出讀數列的文字：midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1。
records.x: 在面板下面顯示的就是這段文字。拿去做你自己的記錄或字幕也很方便。沒有 message 的內容只會顯示訊號和數值。 d controlDetail() 的內容（或 control 事件的 detail）。給 null 回傳空字串。 訊號名稱、數值（兩位小數，100 以上則是整數），接著是 ←、用 describeMessage() 寫的訊息，和頻道。

records.k: readout message text cc 70 readable midi 讀數列 訊息文字 cc 70 好讀的 midi
records.d: Writes one parsed MIDI message the way a person reads it: CC 70 = 53, Note 36 · vel 90, Bend 12288.
records.x: These are the shorter lines of the readout. describe() writes the longer log lines (CC ch1 #70=53). m An event from parseMessage(). null gives an empty string. CC 70 = 53, Note 36 · vel 90, Note 36 off, Bend 12288 (the raw 14-bit value), Pressure 50, Poly AT 36 = 12, Program 5; any other type gives its name.

records.k: readout message text cc 70 readable midi 讀數列 訊息文字 cc 70 好讀的 midi
records.d: 把一則解析過的 MIDI 訊息寫成人讀得懂的樣子：CC 70 = 53、Note 36 · vel 90、Bend 12288。
records.x: 這是 讀數列用的較短文字。describe() 寫的是較長的記錄文字（CC ch1 #70=53）。 m parseMessage() 的事件。給 null 回傳空字串。 CC 70 = 53、Note 36 · vel 90、Note 36 off、Bend 12288（原始的 14 位元數值）、Pressure 50、Poly AT 36 = 12、Program 5，其他類型則回傳類型名稱。

records.k: attributes query parameters iframe parameters embed options 屬性 查詢參數 iframe 參數 嵌入選項
records.d: The attributes the oav-controller element reads, which are also the query parameters of the iframe page: profile, layout, hardware, midi-out and more.
records.x: The iframe page copies every one of these from its URL onto the element. The extra parameters bg, pad, frame, origin and lang belong to the iframe page and are read by parseEmbedOptions(). What each attribute means is under OavController. A plain array, in this order. The element watches these (and lang) for changes.

records.k: attributes query parameters iframe parameters embed options 屬性 查詢參數 iframe 參數 嵌入選項
records.d: <oav-controller> 讀取的屬性，也同時是 iframe 頁面的查詢參數：profile、layout、hardware、midi-out、channel 等等。
records.x: iframe 頁面會把網址裡的這些參數逐一複製到元素上。另外的 bg、pad、frame、origin、lang 是 iframe 頁面專用的，由 parseEmbedOptions() 讀取。每個屬性的意思寫在 OavController 底下。 一個普通陣列，順序如上。元素會監看這些屬性（加上 lang）有沒有改變。

records.k: events control event noteon ready status custom events 事件 control 事件 noteon ready status 自訂事件
records.d: The nine events the oav-controller element dispatches and the iframe posts to its page, from ready and control to profilechange and error.
records.x: The iframe also posts a tenth type, values, as the answer to the get command; it is not an element event, so it is not in this list. The payloads are described under OavController and controlDetail(). A plain array, in this order. The element dispatches each as a CustomEvent that bubbles and is composed; the iframe page forwards each to window.parent with toParent().

records.k: events control event noteon ready status custom events 事件 control 事件 noteon ready status 自訂事件
records.d: <oav-controller> 會觸發、iframe 也會送給外層頁面的事件：ready、control、noteon、noteoff、connect、disconnect、status、profilechange、error。
records.x: iframe 還會送出第十種類型 values，那是對 get 指令的回答，不是元素事件，所以不在這份清單裡。各事件的內容寫在 OavController 和 controlDetail() 底下。 一個普通陣列，順序如上。元素把每一個都當成會冒泡、可穿過 shadow root 的 CustomEvent 觸發，iframe 頁面則用 toParent() 把每一個轉送給 window.parent。

records.k: layout face stack auto phone layout 版面 face stack auto 手機版面
records.d: The three layouts a controller can have: auto, face (the device as it looks) and stack (re-gridded for a tall box).
records.x: A profile can opt out of stack (stack: false); square grid devices such as the Launchpad always stay face. See preferredAspect(). A plain array. parseEmbedOptions() turns any other layout value into 'auto', and the layout command of the iframe accepts only these.

records.k: layout face stack auto phone layout 版面 face stack auto 手機版面
records.d: 控制器的三種版面：auto、face（機器原本的樣子）和 stack（為高的盒子重新排列）。
records.x: 設定檔可以不要 stack（stack: false），像 Launchpad 這種方形的格子機器永遠維持 face。見 preferredAspect()。 一個普通陣列。parseEmbedOptions() 會把其他的 layout 值變成 'auto'，iframe 的 layout 指令也只接受這三個。

records.k: midi channel channel attribute validate channel midi 頻道 channel 屬性 檢查頻道
records.d: Reads the channel attribute: a whole number from 1 to 16, or null for anything else.
records.x: A null means "keep the profile's own channels". A number makes withChannel() move every control there. v The attribute value, a number or a string. The channel, or null when it is missing, empty, not a whole number or outside 1..16.

records.k: midi channel channel attribute validate channel midi 頻道 channel 屬性 檢查頻道
records.d: 讀取 channel 屬性：1 到 16 的整數，其他任何值都是 null。
records.x: null 代表「維持設定檔本來的頻道」。有數字的話，withChannel() 會把所有控制項移到那個頻道。 v 屬性的值，數字或字串。 頻道，沒寫、空字串、不是整數或不在 1..16 時是 null。

records.k: background colour bg parameter transparent hex safe css 背景顏色 bg 參數 透明 十六進位 安全的 css
records.d: Checks the bg colour of the iframe page and returns a safe value: transparent, a hex colour, or a plain colour name; anything else is null.
records.x: The iframe page puts the result into a CSS variable, so a value that could break out of CSS (red;}body{) is refused. It does not check that a name is a real colour: any 3 to 20 letters pass, and CSS ignores the ones it does not know. v The value from the query string. 'transparent'; '#' plus 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits (the # is optional in the input, so abc becomes #abc); or 3 to 20 letters, lower-cased ('RED' becomes 'red'); otherwise null.

records.k: background colour bg parameter transparent hex safe css 背景顏色 bg 參數 透明 十六進位 安全的 css
records.d: 檢查 iframe 頁面的 bg 顏色，回傳安全的值：transparent、十六進位顏色或單純的顏色名稱，其他一律是 null。
records.x: iframe 頁面會把結果放進一個 CSS 變數，所以可能跳出 CSS 的值（red;}body{）會被拒絕。它不檢查名稱是不是真的顏色：任何 3 到 20 個字母都會通過，CSS 不認得的就會被忽略。 v 來自查詢字串的值。 'transparent'，或 '#' 加上 3、4、6 或 8 個十六進位數字（輸入裡的 # 可有可無，所以 abc 會變成 #abc），或 3 到 20 個英文字母（轉成小寫，'RED' 變成 'red'），其他是 null。

records.k: boolean attribute flag on off true false 布林屬性 旗標 開關 true false
records.d: Reads a boolean attribute: present means on, unless it says false, 0, off or no.
records.x: This is why and readout="true" both turn the readout on and readout="off" turns it off. Any other word counts as on, so readout="ask" is true. v The attribute value: null/undefined/false (absent) or a string. A bare attribute is the empty string. Absent is false; true is true; a string is true unless it is (case-insensitively, trimmed) false, 0, off or no.

records.k: boolean attribute flag on off true false 布林屬性 旗標 開關 true false
records.d: 讀取布林屬性：有寫就是開，除非內容是 false、0、off 或 no。
records.x: 所以 和 readout="true" 都會開啟讀數列，readout="off" 則會關掉。其他任何字都算開，所以 readout="ask" 也是 true。 v 屬性的值：null、undefined、false（沒寫）或字串。只寫屬性名稱時是空字串。 沒寫是 false，true 是 true，字串除了（不分大小寫、去掉空白後）false、0、off、no 之外都是 true。

records.k: hardware attribute midi-out attribute ask port name permission hardware 屬性 midi-out 屬性 ask 埠名 權限
records.d: Reads hardware and midi-out: off, ask (a button, so the permission prompt waits for a click) or on, plus which port.
records.x: Absent or false/0/off/no is off. ask is ask. on, true, yes, auto is on without a port. Any other text is on, and the text is the port name or /regex/ to look for (see findPort()): embedMode('IAC') is { mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }. v The attribute value. bare What a bare attribute (no value) means: 'on' for hardware (the default), 'ask' for midi-out, because there is no sensible default port to send to. mode is 'off', 'ask' or 'on'. port is a string only when the value names one.

records.k: hardware attribute midi-out attribute ask port name permission hardware 屬性 midi-out 屬性 ask 埠名 權限
records.d: 讀取 hardware 和 midi-out：關閉、ask（顯示按鈕，讓權限詢問等到點擊）或開啟，以及指定哪個埠。
records.x: 沒寫或是 false/0/off/no 就是關閉。ask 就是 ask。on、true、yes、auto 是開啟但不指定埠。其他任何文字都是開啟，而那段文字就是要找的埠名或 /regex/（見 findPort()）：embedMode('IAC') 是 { mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }。 v 屬性的值。 bare 只寫屬性、沒有值時的意思：hardware 是 'on'（預設），midi-out 是 'ask'，因為送出去沒有合理的預設埠。 mode 是 'off'、'ask' 或 'on'。只有值裡有指定埠時，port 才是字串。

records.k: fade ease decay video frame staccato 淡出 緩和 衰減 影片畫格 斷音
records.d: The brightness of a fading touch: 1 at the moment it happened, 0 after ms, eased so it still reads on a 30 fps frame.
records.x: ControllerCanvas fades released keys (180 ms), pads (450 ms), the glow of a touched control (650 ms), the last-touch text under the faceplate (1600 ms) and on the device screen (3200 ms) with it. A video frame is 33 ms at 30 fps, so a staccato note that was 20 ms long would be gone before the next frame without a fade. now The current time in milliseconds. at When the touch happened, on the same clock. null or undefined gives 0. ms How long the fade lasts. Not above 0 gives 0. From 1 down to 0. The curve is the square of the remaining time, so it falls quickly at first.

records.k: fade ease decay video frame staccato 淡出 緩和 衰減 影片畫格 斷音
records.d: 一次淡出中的觸碰目前有多亮：發生的那一刻是 1，經過 ms 之後是 0，並做了緩和，所以在 30 fps 的畫面上仍然看得出來。
records.x: ControllerCanvas 用它讓放開的琴鍵（180 毫秒）、打擊墊（450 毫秒）、被碰到的控制項光暈（650 毫秒）、面板下方的最後觸碰文字（1600 毫秒）和機器螢幕上的文字（3200 毫秒）淡出。30 fps 的影片一格是 33 毫秒，沒有淡出的話，20 毫秒長的斷音在下一格之前就消失了。 now 目前的時間（毫秒）。 at 觸碰發生的時間，用同一個時鐘。null 或 undefined 會得到 0。 ms 淡出持續多久。不大於 0 會得到 0。 從 1 降到 0。曲線是剩餘時間的平方，所以一開始掉得比較快。

records.k: signals to midi events dedupe each message once bus listener take playback 訊號轉 midi 事件 去重複 每則一次 匯流排監聽 回放
records.d: Listens to a Signals bus and hands you each MIDI message back exactly once, as an event, although hardware publishes it under two names.
records.x: Hardware and the on-screen controllers publish every message twice: the legacy name (midi/note/on) and then the per-channel one (midi/ch/1/note/60) in one call. The QWERTY piano and some takes publish only the legacy name. A per-channel name counts at once; a legacy name waits for a microtask and is dropped if its per-channel twin shows up first. So a relative encoder never turns twice, a legacy CC (which has no channel) never lands on the wrong channel, and order is kept. ControllerCanvas uses it. Use it yourself to turn a bus back into MIDI events, for example to drive your own visual from a recorded take. signals The bus. It needs onAny(cb). onEvent (ev) => … called with an event of parseMessage() for each message. channel The channel given to legacy CC and bend names, which carry none. defer (fn) => … that schedules the flush of legacy-only names. Default queueMicrotask; replaceable in tests. flush() delivers legacy-only messages that are still waiting. dispose() stops listening and drops them.

records.k: signals to midi events dedupe each message once bus listener take playback 訊號轉 midi 事件 去重複 每則一次 匯流排監聽 回放
records.d: 監聽 Signals 匯流排，並把每則 MIDI 訊息「剛好一次」以事件的形式還給你，雖然硬體會用兩個名稱發佈同一則訊息。
records.x: 硬體和螢幕控制器對每則訊息都會發佈兩次：先是短名稱（midi/note/on），緊接著在同一次呼叫裡是分頻道的名稱（midi/ch/1/note/60）。電腦鍵盤鋼琴和某些錄音只發佈短名稱。分頻道的名稱會立刻算數，短名稱則等一個 microtask，如果它分頻道的孿生兄弟先到了就丟掉。所以相對旋鈕不會轉兩次，沒有頻道的短名稱 CC 也不會落到錯誤的頻道，順序也會保持。 ControllerCanvas 用的就是它。想把匯流排變回 MIDI 事件時可以自己用，例如用錄下的演奏去驅動你自己的畫面。 signals 匯流排，需要有 onAny(cb)。 onEvent 每則訊息都以 parseMessage() 的事件格式呼叫 (ev) => …。 channel 指定給短名稱 CC 和彎音用的頻道，因為它們本身沒有頻道資訊。 defer 排程「只有短名稱」那批訊息的 flush 用的 (fn) => …。預設是 queueMicrotask，測試時可以換掉。 flush() 送出還在等待的「只有短名稱」訊息。dispose() 停止監聽並丟掉它們。

records.k: iframe commands control the iframe postMessage commands iframe 指令 控制 iframe postMessage 指令
records.d: The commands a page may send into an embed iframe: set, ingest, reset, profile, layout, get, press, release.
records.x: What each does: set { id, value, note?, quiet? } moves a control, press { id, velocity?, note? } and release { id, note? } hold and let go, ingest { bytes } feeds MIDI (one message or a list), reset brings everything home, profile { profile } switches the device, layout { layout } changes the layout, and get asks for every value (the iframe answers with a values message). A plain array. fromParent() ignores a message whose type is not one of these.

records.k: iframe commands control the iframe postMessage commands iframe 指令 控制 iframe postMessage 指令
records.d: 外層頁面可以送進嵌入 iframe 的指令：set、ingest、reset、profile、layout、get、press、release。
records.x: 各指令的作用：set { id, value, note?, quiet? } 移動控制項，press { id, velocity?, note? } 與 release { id, note? } 按住與放開，ingest { bytes } 餵入 MIDI（一則或一串），reset 讓所有東西回到原位，profile { profile } 切換機器，layout { layout } 改變版面，get 要求所有數值（iframe 會用一則 values 訊息回答）。 一個普通陣列。fromParent() 會忽略 type 不在這份清單裡的訊息。

records.k: postMessage listener message from iframe read embed message postMessage 監聽 來自 iframe 的訊息 讀取嵌入訊息
records.d: Page side: reads a message that came from an embed iframe, returns { type, frame, detail, v }, or null when it is not one of ours.
records.x: Other scripts and extensions post to a page all the time, so always filter. Check event.origin too when the page cares who sent it: this function checks the shape, not the sender. data The event.data of a message event. null unless data is an object with source: 'openav' and a string type.

records.k: postMessage listener message from iframe read embed message postMessage 監聽 來自 iframe 的訊息 讀取嵌入訊息
records.d: 外層頁面這一側：讀取從嵌入 iframe 來的訊息，回傳 { type, frame, detail, v }，不是我們的訊息就回傳 null。
records.x: 別的腳本和瀏覽器擴充功能隨時都在對頁面送訊息，所以一定要過濾。頁面在意是誰送的話，也要檢查 event.origin：這個函式檢查的是格式，不是寄件者。 data message 事件的 event.data。 除非 data 是帶有 source: 'openav' 和字串 type 的物件，否則回傳 null。

records.k: validate command iframe security postMessage validation ignore bad messages 驗證指令 iframe 安全 postMessage 驗證 忽略不合法訊息
records.d: Frame side: validates a command from the page and returns a clean command, or null (the message is ignored).
records.x: It is strict, because anything on the web can post to an iframe. The message needs target: 'openav' and a type from FRAME_COMMANDS. Control ids must be lower-case [a-z0-9_-]. value must be a finite number. note must be an integer 0..127 (else null). A press velocity is held to 0..1. ingest takes one message of 1 to 3 bytes whose first byte is a status byte (128 or more), or up to 256 such messages. profile takes an id or an https:// URL (not http://). layout must be in EMBED_LAYOUTS. data The event.data of a message event. A command such as { type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5, note: null, quiet: false }, or null.

records.k: validate command iframe security postMessage validation ignore bad messages 驗證指令 iframe 安全 postMessage 驗證 忽略不合法訊息
records.d: iframe 這一側：驗證外層頁面送來的指令，回傳整理乾淨的指令，不合格就回傳 null（訊息被忽略）。
records.x: 它很嚴格，因為網路上任何東西都能對 iframe 送訊息。訊息必須有 target: 'openav'，type 要在 FRAME_COMMANDS 裡。控制項 id 必須是小寫的 [a-z0-9_-]。value 必須是有限的數字。note 必須是 0..127 的整數（否則是 null）。press 的力度會限制在 0..1。ingest 接受一則 1 到 3 個位元組、第一個位元組是狀態位元組（128 以上）的訊息，或最多 256 則這樣的訊息。profile 接受 id 或 https:// 網址（不接受 http://）。layout 必須在 EMBED_LAYOUTS 裡。 data message 事件的 event.data。 像 { type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5, note: null, quiet: false } 這樣的指令，或 null。

records.k: piano keys keyboard layout white keys black keys draw keyboard 琴鍵 鍵盤版面 白鍵 黑鍵 畫鍵盤
records.d: Computes the rectangles of piano keys from one note to another inside a rect: white keys side by side, black keys over the seams at 60% of the height.
records.x: A range never starts on a black key: a black key with no white key before it is left out, the way the on-screen keyboard does. White keys share the width equally, so 48 to 72 is 15 white keys and 10 black ones. from The first MIDI note. to The last MIDI note. rect The area the keys fill. One item per key, the white keys first and then the black ones (the draw order, so the black keys end up on top).

records.k: piano keys keyboard layout white keys black keys draw keyboard 琴鍵 鍵盤版面 白鍵 黑鍵 畫鍵盤
records.d: 算出從某個音到另一個音的琴鍵在矩形裡的位置：白鍵並排，黑鍵蓋在縫上，高度是 60%。
records.x: 音域不會從黑鍵開始：前面沒有白鍵的黑鍵會被省略，螢幕上的鍵盤也是這樣。白鍵平分寬度，所以 48 到 72 是 15 個白鍵加 10 個黑鍵。 from 第一個 MIDI 音符。 to 最後一個 MIDI 音符。 rect 琴鍵要填滿的區域。 每個琴鍵一項，先是白鍵再是黑鍵（也就是繪製順序，這樣黑鍵會疊在上面）。

records.k: octave shift oct+ keyboard window follow octave 八度移位 oct+ 鍵盤視窗 跟著八度
records.d: Tells which note a drawn keyboard should start at after a note outside its printed range arrives, so it follows the device's octave buttons.
records.x: A keyboard control catches notes outside its printed range, because the device's Oct+/Oct− buttons shift what the keys send. When one arrives, the drawing moves and stays there, as the device does. A 48 to 72 MiniLab with Oct+ pressed (a note of 76) shows 60 to 84. A range narrower than an octave just moves to reach the note. from The first note of the printed range. to The last note of the printed range. base The first note shown now. note A note that just went down. The new first note: base when the note fits, otherwise base moved by the fewest octaves that reach it, held to the MIDI range.

records.k: octave shift oct+ keyboard window follow octave 八度移位 oct+ 鍵盤視窗 跟著八度
records.d: 一個超出印刷音域的音符到來之後，算出畫出來的鍵盤該從哪個音開始，這樣它就能跟著機器的八度按鈕走。
records.x: 琴鍵控制項會接住超出印刷音域的音，因為機器的 Oct+/Oct− 按鈕會改變琴鍵送出的音。這種音到來時，畫面會移動並停在那裡，就像實機一樣。48 到 72 的 MiniLab 按下 Oct+（音符 76）後，畫面會顯示 60 到 84。窄於一個八度的音域，則是直接移動到夠到那個音為止。 from 印刷音域的第一個音。 to 印刷音域的最後一個音。 base 目前顯示的第一個音。 note 剛剛按下的音。 新的第一個音：音符放得進去就回傳 base，否則是把 base 移動剛好夠的最少八度，並限制在 MIDI 範圍內。

records.k: note name midi note C4 middle C convert 音名 midi 音符 C4 中央 C 轉換
records.d: Turns a MIDI note number into its name with the octave, middle C being C4: midiNoteName(60) is 'C4', midiNoteName(61) is 'C#4'.
records.x: This is the on-screen keyboard's convention. Some software (Ableton Live, Yamaha) calls 60 "C3": the number is the same, only the octave label differs. In a p5 sketch, noteName() does the same and also writes flats when you ask. n A MIDI note number, 0..127. Sharps only ('C#4', never 'Db4'). 0 is 'C-1' and 127 is 'G9'.

records.k: note name midi note C4 middle C convert 音名 midi 音符 C4 中央 C 轉換
records.d: 把 MIDI 音符號碼轉成帶八度的音名，中央 C 是 C4：midiNoteName(60) 是 'C4'，midiNoteName(61) 是 'C#4'。
records.x: 這是螢幕鍵盤採用的寫法。有些軟體（Ableton Live、Yamaha）把 60 叫做「C3」：號碼是一樣的，只有八度的標示不同。在 p5 草圖裡，noteName() 做同樣的事，而且需要時可以寫成降記號。 n MIDI 音符號碼，0..127。 只用升記號（'C#4'，不會是 'Db4'）。0 是 'C-1'，127 是 'G9'。

records.k: panel dock controller panel device picker learn button monitor drawer 面板 停靠 控制器面板 機器選單 學習按鈕 監看 抽屜
records.d: Mounts a controller panel: a toolbar (device picker, hardware status, port picker, Learn, last message) above a playable faceplate, docked at the bottom or full size.
records.x: The bar shows which device is on screen (the picker switches it), a chip saying whether a hardware port drives it, a port picker when hardware is attached, a Learn button (click a control, then move the one on the hardware; a second button resets the mapping), and a tiny monitor that prints the last message, so you see the hardware talking before you see what it moves. Plugging in a known device switches the picker and the faceplate. The labels on the toolbar (Learn, Reset, the hardware chip) are written in Chinese only, whatever the page language is. has an English and a Chinese toolbar; this panel is the one the lab and the phone tab use. parent The element to add the panel to. In full mode the panel is position: absolute; inset: 0, so give parent a position (relative) and a size. mcs The manager that holds the devices and the hardware. mode 'full' fills parent. 'dock' is a drawer fixed to the bottom of the window, 40% of the window height by default, with a grip to drag its height (remembered in localStorage). open Whether it starts open. A closed dock builds its view only when opened. id An element id for the panel. onToggle (open) => … called when the panel opens or closes. closeButton Show a ✕ button. The default is on in dock mode only. profiles Limit the device picker to these profile ids. contained Dock inside parent (absolute) instead of the window (fixed). el is the panel element, view the ControllerView (once it exists), isOpen a boolean. open(), close() and…

records.k: panel dock controller panel device picker learn button monitor drawer 面板 停靠 控制器面板 機器選單 學習按鈕 監看 抽屜
records.d: 掛上一個控制器面板：上面一條工具列，有機器選單、硬體狀態、埠選單、學習按鈕和最後一則訊息的監看，下面是可以彈的面板，可以停靠在底部或填滿。
records.x: 工具列顯示螢幕上是哪台機器（可以用選單切換）、一個說明有沒有硬體埠在驅動它的標籤、接了硬體時的埠選單、學習按鈕（點一個控制項，再動硬體上對應的那一個，另一個按鈕可以還原對應），以及一個小監看視窗印出最後一則訊息，讓你在看到它推動什麼之前，先看到硬體在說話。接上認得的機器時，選單和面板都會跟著切換。 工具列上的文字是中文（學習、還原、硬體 …），不隨頁面語言改變。 的工具列有英文和中文版，這個面板則是實驗室和手機分頁在用的那個。 parent 要加進面板的元素。full 模式的面板是 position: absolute; inset: 0，所以 parent 要設 position（relative）並有大小。 mcs 管理裝置與硬體的管理器。 mode 'full' 填滿 parent。'dock' 是固定在視窗底部的抽屜，預設佔視窗高度的 40%，有把手可以拖曳調整高度（記在 localStorage）。 open 一開始是否打開。關著的停靠面板要到打開時才建立畫面。 id 面板的元素 id。 onToggle 面板打開或關閉時呼叫 (open) => …。 closeButton 是否顯示 ✕ 按鈕。預設只有 dock 模式會顯示。 profiles 把機器選單限制在這些設定檔 id。 contained 停靠在 parent 裡面（absolute），不是停靠在視窗（fixed）。 el 是面板元素，view 是 ControllerView（建立之後才有），isOpen 是布林值。open()、close()、toggle() 回傳同一個物件，close() 還會放開按著的音。

records.k: oav-controller custom element web component embed controller html tag attributes midi-out hardware shadow dom oav-controller 自訂元素 web component 嵌入控制器 html 標籤 屬性 midi-out 硬體 shadow dom
records.d: The oav-controller custom element: a playable MIDI controller you paste into any page with one line, with no import map and no build.
records.x: Load @openav/midi/element (https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/midi/element.js) once and write . Importing the file registers the tag by itself. It is a shadow-DOM element, so the page's CSS cannot bend it and it cannot bend the page. It plays with a mouse, a finger, a pen and the keyboard, with or without Web MIDI: on Safari and iPad it still plays and fires events, and only the hardware and MIDI-out parts say they are unavailable. Attributes, each also a property of the same name (midi-out is el.midiOut): profile (an id, a short name or a URL to a profile JSON; default arturia-minilab3), layout (auto, face as it looks, stack re-gridded for a tall box), hardware (off by default; bare or on follows the real device, ask shows a button so the permission prompt waits for a click, or a port name or /regex/), midi-out (off by default; bare or ask lets the visitor pick, or a port name, substring or /regex/ such as IAC or loopMIDI), channel (1 to 16: move every control to that channel), picker, readout (the last message under the faceplate), learn (a Learn button), follow (show whatever known device is plugged in), theme (dark or light: the toolbar only, the device stays the device), telemetry (off sends no anonymous hit) and lang (the toolbar language: zh… is Chinese, anything else English; it reads the nearest lang on the page). Events are CustomEvents that bubble and cross the shadow root, so el.addEventListener('control', e => e.detail) works anywhere above it: ready {…

records.k: oav-controller custom element web component embed controller html tag attributes midi-out hardware shadow dom oav-controller 自訂元素 web component 嵌入控制器 html 標籤 屬性 midi-out 硬體 shadow dom
records.d: <oav-controller> 自訂元素：用一行就能貼進任何頁面的、可以彈的 MIDI 控制器，不需要 import map，也不需要建置。
records.x: 載入一次 @openav/midi/element（https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/midi/element.js），然後寫 。匯入這個檔案時會自動註冊標籤。它是 shadow DOM 元素，所以頁面的 CSS 影響不到它，它也不會影響頁面。滑鼠、手指、觸控筆和鍵盤都能彈，有沒有 Web MIDI 都行：在 Safari 和 iPad 上仍然能彈、能觸發事件，只有硬體和 MIDI 輸出的部分會說「不能用」。 屬性，每一個也是同名的屬性（property）（midi-out 對應 el.midiOut）：profile（id、短名稱，或指向設定檔 JSON 的網址，預設 arturia-minilab3）、layout（auto，face 是原本的樣子，stack 是為高的盒子重新排列）、hardware（預設關閉，只寫屬性或 on 是跟隨真實機器，ask 會顯示按鈕，讓權限詢問等到點擊才跳出，也可以寫埠名或 /regex/）、midi-out（預設關閉，只寫屬性或 ask 讓訪客自己挑，也可以寫埠名、子字串或 /regex/，例如 IAC、loopMIDI）、channel（1 到 16：把所有控制項移到那個頻道）、picker、readout（面板下面顯示最後一則訊息）、learn（學習按鈕）、follow（接上哪台認得的機器就顯示哪一台）、theme（dark 或 light：只影響工具列，機器還是機器的樣子）、telemetry（off 就不送匿名資料）和 lang（工具列語言：zh… 是中文，其他是英文，會讀頁面上最近的 lang）。 事件是會冒泡、也會穿過 shadow root 的 CustomEvent，所以在它上面任何一層用 el.addEventListener('control', e => e.detail) 都收得到：ready { profile, name, controls }、control（見 controlDetail()）、noteon、noteoff、connect、disconnect、status、profilechange 和 error { message }。EMBED_EVENTS 列出了它們。方法有：set()、get()、values()、reset()、press()、release()、ingest()、send()、on()、connectHardware()、disconnectHardware()、setOutput()、toggleLearn()。 它的寬度填滿容器，高度則跟著面板走（手機上會用比較高的直排），除非你自己設高度。CSS 變數：--oav-bg、--oav-fg、--oav-accent、--oav-line、--oav-font，以及 --oav-ratio（寬除以高）。可用的 part：::part(toolbar)、::part(body)、::part(readout)。 要等控制器建好：await el.ready（會以元素本身完成的 promise），或是監聽 ready 事件。在那之前，set()、press()、release()、ingest() 會回傳 null 並在主控台印出一次警告，get() 也回傳 null。除非用了 hardware、midi-out 或學習，否則它不會要 MIDI 權限。 只能放 iframe 的地方，同一個元素也放在…

records.k: css panel style dock style css 面板樣式 停靠樣式
records.d: The stylesheet text of the controller panel (mountMidiPanel), as a string.
records.x: Advanced: it is exported for pages that want to read or override the rules. You never need it to mount a panel. CSS for the .mcp… classes. mountMidiPanel() injects it by itself, once per document (a in the head).

records.k: css panel style dock style css 面板樣式 停靠樣式
records.d: 控制器面板（mountMidiPanel）的樣式表文字，是一個字串。
records.x: 進階用途：匯出給想讀或覆寫規則的頁面。掛上面板時完全用不到它。 .mcp… 那些 class 的 CSS。mountMidiPanel() 會自己注入，每個文件一次（放在 head 的 ）。

records.k: embed options query string attributes to options iframe params defaults 嵌入選項 查詢字串 屬性轉選項 iframe 參數 預設值
records.d: Reads the options of one embed from an element, a query string, an object or a getter function, and returns them cleaned up with defaults.
records.x: It is the one place that decides what the attributes and the iframe's query string mean, so the element and the iframe always agree. Defaults: profile is arturia-minilab3, layout auto, theme dark, hardware and midiOut off (so embedding never asks for MIDI permission), the booleans false, telemetry true, and channel, bg, frame, origin, lang are null. Rules worth knowing: an unknown layout becomes auto; theme is light or dark; midi-out may also be written midiout or midiOut, and alone it means ask; frame may also be written id and is cut to 64 characters; origin is kept only as https://host or http://host with no path (anything else, such as javascript:, becomes null), lang is cut to 16 characters, and bg goes through embedColor(). src Where the options live: an element (read with getAttribute), a URLSearchParams (the iframe page passes its own), a plain object { profile: 'lpd8' }, or a function (name) => value | null. { profile, layout, hardware, midiOut, channel, learn, picker, readout, follow, telemetry, theme, bg, frame, origin, lang }. hardware and midiOut are { mode, port } as in embedMode().

records.k: embed options query string attributes to options iframe params defaults 嵌入選項 查詢字串 屬性轉選項 iframe 參數 預設值
records.d: 從元素、查詢字串、物件或取值函式讀出一個嵌入的選項，整理過並補上預設值後回傳。
records.x: 元素和 iframe 的查詢字串各代表什麼意思，都由它一個地方決定，所以兩邊一定一致。預設值：profile 是 arturia-minilab3，layout 是 auto，theme 是 dark，hardware 和 midiOut 是關閉（所以嵌入不會要 MIDI 權限），布林值都是 false，telemetry 是 true，channel、bg、frame、origin、lang 是 null。 值得知道的規則：不認得的 layout 變成 auto。theme 只有 light 或 dark。midi-out 也可以寫成 midiout 或 midiOut，單獨寫表示 ask。frame 也可以寫成 id，並且截成 64 個字元。origin 只接受沒有路徑的 https://host 或 http://host（其他的，像 javascript:，會變成 null）。lang 截成 16 個字元。bg 會經過 embedColor()。 src 選項放在哪裡：元素（用 getAttribute 讀）、URLSearchParams（iframe 頁面傳自己的）、普通物件 { profile: 'lpd8' }，或是函式 (name) => value | null。 { profile, layout, hardware, midiOut, channel, learn, picker, readout, follow, telemetry, theme, bg, frame, origin, lang }。hardware 和 midiOut 的格式是 embedMode() 那樣的 { mode, port }。

records.k: postMessage openav message source iframe protocol postMessage openav 訊息來源 iframe 協定
records.d: The word that marks a message as an open-audiovisual embed message: 'openav', sent as source by the iframe and as target by the page.
records.x: toParent() and toFrame() write it for you, and fromFrame() and fromParent() check it. A constant. A message from the iframe has source: 'openav', and a command to the iframe has target: 'openav'. Anything else is ignored on both sides.

records.k: postMessage openav message source iframe protocol postMessage openav 訊息來源 iframe 協定
records.d: 標記一則訊息屬於 open-audiovisual 嵌入的字：'openav'，iframe 送出時放在 source，外層頁面送進去時放在 target。
records.x: toParent() 和 toFrame() 會替你寫入，fromFrame() 和 fromParent() 負責檢查。 常數。iframe 送出的訊息有 source: 'openav'，送進 iframe 的指令有 target: 'openav'。兩邊都會忽略其他任何訊息。

records.k: protocol version message format version 協定版本 訊息格式版本
records.d: The version of the iframe message format, 1, written as v in every message.
records.x: Messages from toParent() and toFrame() carry it as v: 1. A constant, so a page can tell when the format changes. fromFrame() gives v back (1 when a message lacks it).

records.k: protocol version message format version 協定版本 訊息格式版本
records.d: iframe 訊息格式的版本，1，會寫成每則訊息裡的 v。
records.x: toParent() 和 toFrame() 的訊息都會帶著 v: 1。 常數，讓頁面在格式改變時能分辨。fromFrame() 會把 v 還給你（訊息沒有時是 1）。

records.k: aspect ratio height from width responsive phone layout size 寬高比 由寬度算高度 響應式 手機版面 大小
records.d: Works out the width ÷ height a controller wants in a box of a given width: its faceplate when every control stays finger-sized, a taller stack otherwise.
records.x: uses it to set its height, so a controller sizes itself from its width. In auto, the faceplate's own proportions are used while the smallest control stays at least minTouch pixels at that width; otherwise it becomes a stack, about 0.8 to 1.5 times as tall as it is wide depending on how many bands the profile's portrait has. Square grid devices (the Launchpad, stack: false) always keep their face. profile A normalized profile (face, sections, portrait, stack). width The box width in pixels. layout 'auto', 'face' or 'stack'. minTouch The smallest control size in pixels that still counts as finger-sized. mode is 'face' or 'stack', and aspect is the width ÷ height to give the box.

records.k: aspect ratio height from width responsive phone layout size 寬高比 由寬度算高度 響應式 手機版面 大小
records.d: 算出控制器在某個寬度的盒子裡想要的寬高比：每個控制項都夠手指按的話用面板本身的比例，否則用比較高的直排。
records.x: 用它來決定自己的高度，所以控制器會依寬度自己決定大小。在 auto 下，只要在那個寬度時最小的控制項仍有至少 minTouch 像素，就用面板本身的比例，否則改成直排，高度大約是寬度的 0.8 到 1.5 倍，視設定檔 portrait 有幾條而定。方形格子的機器（Launchpad，stack: false）永遠維持 face。 profile 整理過的設定檔（face、sections、portrait、stack）。 width 盒子的寬度（像素）。 layout 'auto'、'face' 或 'stack'。 minTouch 還算夠手指按的最小控制項尺寸（像素）。 mode 是 'face' 或 'stack'，aspect 是要給盒子的寬高比。

records.k: rest position home reset controls default value 休息位置 歸位 重設控制項 預設值
records.d: Says where a control rests: knobs and faders at their default (0), bipolar wheels at the centre, pads, buttons and keys at 0.
records.x: reset() on ControllerHost uses it to bring every control home. An endless encoder has no real position, so only its drawn position goes to the middle and no MIDI is sent for it. c A control definition from a normalized profile. 0 for keys, pads, buttons and bipolar controls; otherwise the control's def, else 0.5 for an endless encoder and 0 for the rest.

records.k: rest position home reset controls default value 休息位置 歸位 重設控制項 預設值
records.d: 說明控制項休息時在哪裡：旋鈕和推桿在預設值（0），雙向彎音輪在中心，打擊墊、按鈕和琴鍵在 0。
records.x: ControllerHost 的 reset() 用它讓每個控制項回到原位。無限旋鈕沒有真正的位置，所以只有畫面上的位置會回到中間，而且不會送出 MIDI。 c 整理過的設定檔中的控制項定義。 琴鍵、打擊墊、按鈕和雙向控制項是 0。其他用控制項的 def，沒有的話無限旋鈕是 0.5，其餘是 0。

records.k: set control move a knob press a pad simulate hand send value 設定控制項 轉旋鈕 按打擊墊 模擬手 送出數值
records.d: Moves one control the way a hand would, whatever its type, and returns the MIDI bytes it sent: setControl(mc, 'k1', 0.5).
records.x: What value means depends on the type. Knob, fader, wheel, strip and encoder: 0..1 (−1..1 for a bipolar one). Pad and momentary button: above 0 presses (with that velocity, held to 1) and 0 releases. Toggle button: 0.5 or more is on. Keys: value is the velocity, above 0 presses that note and 0 releases it. This is what set() on ControllerHost and call. mc The controller. id The control id. An unknown id throws has no control "x" (controls: …). value The value (below). Anything that is not a finite number throws set("id"): value must be a number. note For a keys control: which note. The default is the first key of its range. source 'ui' (default) publishes and reaches MIDI out. 'mirror' moves only the faceplate (two-way binding). The bytes sent, or null when nothing changed (for example releasing a pad that is not held).

Post to the frame's real origin, not , when you can. type The command: one of FRAME_COMMANDS. args The command's fields ({ id, value } for set). Copied through JSON. A message ready for iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(msg, origin).

records.d: Frame side: builds the message the iframe posts to its page for an event: { source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }.
records.x: The iframe page calls parent.postMessage(toParent(name, detail, { frame }), target) for every event, where target is the ?origin= parameter or . With ?origin=https://your.site the frame posts only to that origin and accepts commands only from it. type The event name (see EMBED_EVENTS), or values. detail The event payload. It is copied through JSON, so the message is always postMessage-safe (undefined becomes null). frame A name for this iframe (the ?frame= parameter), echoed in every message so a page with several frames can tell them apart. The message { source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }.

records.d: iframe 這一側：為一個事件組出 iframe 要送給外層頁面的訊息：{ source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }。
records.x: iframe 頁面對每個事件都呼叫 parent.postMessage(toParent(name, detail, { frame }), target)，target 是 ?origin= 參數，沒有就是 。加上 ?origin=https://your.site 之後，frame 只會送給那個來源，也只接受從它來的指令。 type 事件名稱（見 EMBED_EVENTS），或 values。 detail 事件內容。會經過 JSON 複製，所以訊息一定能安全地 postMessage（undefined 變成 null）。 frame 這個 iframe 的名字（?frame= 參數），每則訊息都會帶著，這樣頁面上有好幾個 frame 時才分得出來。 訊息物件 { source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }。
