records.k: piano keyboard on-screen keys qwerty press release glissando touch virtual piano 鋼琴 鍵盤 螢幕鋼琴 琴鍵 電腦鍵盤 按下 放開 滑音 觸控
records.d: An on-screen piano you can play with the mouse, a finger or the computer keyboard, that calls a function for every note.
records.x: new KeysPiano(el, { onNote }) builds the keys inside el. Whatever plays a key (a click or a touch on it, sweeping across the keys with the button held, the computer keyboard, or your own call to press()) ends up in onNote(note, vel01, on): on is true for a key going down and false for one coming up, and vel01 is 0..1 (0 on the way up). The black and white pattern follows the real pitch, so a piano can start on any note. A key that is already down ignores a second press(). The computer keyboard is off until you set piano.captureEnabled = true, and it is up to you to pass the page's keydown and keyup events to handleKeyDown(e) and handleKeyUp(e) (see PIANO_KEYMAP for which letter is which note). mountKeys() does all of that for you. handleKeyDown(e) returns true when the piano used the event, and then you should call e.preventDefault(). While capturing, every letter a–z counts as used, even those that play no note, so a stray letter cannot trigger a hotkey; digits, space and the arrows pass through. Held keys with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt are never used. container The element the keys are built in. It gets the class oav-keys and is emptied first. opts Options: base (lowest key, default 48), octaves (default 2), semitones (the number of keys, default octaves × 12 + 1), velocity (0..127 for the mouse and the computer keyboard, default 100), onNote(note, vel01, on), onOctave(base), fill (size the keys in percent of the container, so it can be any width), keyWidth (px per white key when…

records.k: piano keyboard on-screen keys qwerty press release glissando touch virtual piano 鋼琴 鍵盤 螢幕鋼琴 琴鍵 電腦鍵盤 按下 放開 滑音 觸控
records.d: 一架螢幕上的鋼琴，可以用滑鼠、手指或電腦鍵盤彈，每彈一個音就呼叫你的函式。
records.x: new KeysPiano(el, { onNote }) 在 el 裡蓋出琴鍵。不管是誰彈了一個鍵（在上面點一下或觸碰、按著按鈕滑過琴鍵、電腦鍵盤，或你自己呼叫 press()），最後都會進到 onNote(note, vel01, on)：on 是 true 表示鍵按下去，false 表示放開，vel01 是 0..1（放開時是 0）。黑白鍵的排法照真正的音高走，所以鋼琴可以從任何一個音開始。已經按著的鍵再 press() 會被忽略。 電腦鍵盤一開始是關的，要自己設 piano.captureEnabled = true，並且由你把頁面的 keydown 和 keyup 事件交給 handleKeyDown(e) 和 handleKeyUp(e)（哪個字母是哪個音見 PIANO_KEYMAP）。mountKeys() 把這些全部替你做了。 鋼琴用掉這個事件的時候，handleKeyDown(e) 會回傳 true，那時你要呼叫 e.preventDefault()。在擷取鍵盤的時候，每個字母 a–z 都算被用掉，連不發音的也是，這樣打錯的字母不會觸發快捷鍵。數字、空白鍵、方向鍵會放行。有按著 Ctrl、Cmd、Alt 的組合鍵永遠不算。 container 要把琴鍵蓋在裡面的元素。它會得到 oav-keys 這個 class，並且先被清空。 opts 選項：base（最低的鍵，預設 48）、octaves（預設 2）、semitones（鍵的數量，預設 octaves × 12 + 1）、velocity（滑鼠和電腦鍵盤的力道，0..127，預設 100）、onNote(note, vel01, on)、onOctave(base)、fill（琴鍵用容器的百分比算大小，所以可以是任何寬度）、keyWidth（不 fill 的時候每個白鍵幾像素，預設 27）、minBase（24）和 maxBase（84），也就是八度鍵能移動 base 的範圍。

records.k: piano keyboard keys qwerty on-screen piano midi/note/on simulate virtual keyboard play 鋼琴 鍵盤 琴鍵 螢幕鋼琴 電腦鍵盤 模擬演奏 虛擬鍵盤 彈琴
records.d: Puts a playable piano on the page in one call, with a keyboard switch and a self-playing performer, and publishes every note as midi/note/on and midi/note/off.
records.x: mountKeys() is the whole keyboard department in one line: a KeysPiano you can play with the mouse, a finger or the computer keyboard, and a SimPlayer that plays by itself. Above the piano are two checkboxes, both off to begin with: keyboard (the QWERTY keys play, Z and X move an octave, Shift plays harder) and simulate performance. Everything is published as the standard midi/note/on and midi/note/off, the same names a real MIDI keyboard uses, so a world, a sound engine or a chord detector cannot tell a QWERTY performance from hardware. Call keys.update(dt) once per frame, or the simulated performer does not move. A page with a DOM. The keyboard checkbox must be ticked before the computer keyboard plays, on purpose: while it is on, every letter key is taken by the piano, so hotkeys on letters stop working. A key listener goes on window until dispose(). In a p5 sketch you do not need this: the 🎹 panel of oav-p5 is a piano like this one, and notePressed() hears it. mountKeys() is for a page that has no oav-p5. container The element to put the piano in. It gets a small bar of checkboxes and the piano under it. dispose() empties it again. signals The Signals bus to publish into. Every key down is midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 0 } (vel 0..1) and every key up midi/note/off { note, ch: 0 }. Without a bus the piano still works and calls chord. chord Anything with noteOn(note, vel01) and noteOff(note), usually a chord detector from @openav/chord, to be fed every note directly. base…

records.k: piano keyboard keys qwerty on-screen piano midi/note/on simulate virtual keyboard play 鋼琴 鍵盤 琴鍵 螢幕鋼琴 電腦鍵盤 模擬演奏 虛擬鍵盤 彈琴
records.d: 一個呼叫就在頁面上放一架可以彈的鋼琴，附電腦鍵盤開關和會自己演奏的演奏者，並把每個音發布成 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off。
records.x: mountKeys() 一行就把整個鍵盤部門裝好：一架可以用滑鼠、手指或電腦鍵盤彈的 KeysPiano，加上一個會自己彈的 SimPlayer。鋼琴上面有兩個勾選框，一開始都沒勾：keyboard（QWERTY 鍵能彈，Z 和 X 換八度，Shift 彈得比較重）和 simulate performance。 所有東西都發布成標準的 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off，跟真的 MIDI 鍵盤用同樣的名字，所以世界、聲音引擎或和弦偵測器分不出 QWERTY 演奏和硬體的差別。每個畫面要呼叫一次 keys.update(dt)，不然模擬演奏者不會動。 需要有 DOM 的頁面。要先勾「keyboard」電腦鍵盤才會彈，這是故意的：勾著的時候所有字母鍵都被鋼琴吃掉，字母的快捷鍵就不能用。window 上的按鍵監聽會一直在，直到 dispose()。 在 p5 草圖裡用不到這個：oav-p5 的 🎹 面板就是一架這樣的鋼琴，notePressed() 聽得到它。mountKeys() 是給沒有 oav-p5 的頁面用的。 container 要放鋼琴的元素。裡面會有一條小小的勾選列，和它底下的鋼琴。dispose() 會再把它清空。 signals 要發布訊號的 Signals 匯流排。每個按下去的鍵是 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 0 }（vel 是 0..1），每個放開的鍵是 midi/note/off { note, ch: 0 }。沒給匯流排的話鋼琴照樣能彈，也會呼叫 chord。 chord 任何有 noteOn(note, vel01) 和 noteOff(note) 的東西，通常是 @openav/chord 的和弦偵測器，每個音都會直接餵給它。 base 最低那個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼（48 是 C3）。模擬演奏者彈的是它高一個八度的地方。 octaves 鋼琴有幾個八度。鍵數是 octaves × 12 + 1，所以兩個八度會結束在一個 C。 sim 要不要顯示「simulate performance」勾選框。不管有沒有顯示，演奏者都在：用程式 keys.sim.toggle(true) 就能開始。 capture 要不要顯示「keyboard」勾選框，讓電腦鍵盤能彈這架鋼琴。給 false 就沒有勾選框，captureBox 是 null。你還是可以自己設 keys.piano.captureEnabled = true。 { piano, sim, update(dt), dispose(), captureBox }：KeysPiano、SimPlayer、每個畫面要呼叫的函式（參數是距離上一次過了幾秒，它帶動演奏者）、把一切拆掉的函式，以及「keyboard」勾選框（或 null）。

records.k: keymap qwerty computer keyboard letters mapping daw a s d f 鍵盤對應 電腦鍵盤 字母 對應表 qwerty 彈琴
records.d: Which computer-keyboard letter plays which note: a is the base note, w a semitone higher, s two.
records.x: The layout the music software calls the DAW standard: the A S D F G H J K L ; row is the white keys and the W E T Y U O P row above it is the black keys, placed where they sit on a piano. With a piano that starts on C (base 48, 60…) it reads C, C♯, D, D♯, E, F, F♯, G, G♯, A, A♯, B, C, C♯, D, D♯, E. The keys are lowercase letters; KeysPiano.handleKeyDown(e) lowercases the key first. Z and X are not in the map: they move the octave. { a: 0, w: 1, s: 2, e: 3, d: 4, f: 5, t: 6, g: 7, y: 8, h: 9, u: 10, j: 11, k: 12, o: 13, l: 14, p: 15, ';': 16 }: key to semitones above the piano's base.

records.k: keymap qwerty computer keyboard letters mapping daw a s d f 鍵盤對應 電腦鍵盤 字母 對應表 qwerty 彈琴
records.d: 電腦鍵盤的哪個字母彈哪個音：a 是最低音，w 高一個半音，s 高兩個半音。
records.x: 這是音樂軟體稱為 DAW 標準的排法：A S D F G H J K L ; 這一排是白鍵，上面一排 W E T Y U O P 是黑鍵，位置就跟鋼琴上一樣。鋼琴從 C 開始（base 是 48、60…）的話，從左到右是 C、C♯、D、D♯、E、F、F♯、G、G♯、A、A♯、B、C、C♯、D、D♯、E。鍵是小寫字母。KeysPiano.handleKeyDown(e) 會先把鍵轉成小寫。Z 和 X 不在這張表裡：它們是換八度。 { a: 0, w: 1, s: 2, e: 3, d: 4, f: 5, t: 6, g: 7, y: 8, h: 9, u: 10, j: 11, k: 12, o: 13, l: 14, p: 15, ';': 16 }：鍵對應到比鋼琴的 base 高幾個半音。

records.k: simulate simulated performer auto play demo noodle random notes bot generative 模擬演奏 自動演奏 示範 隨手彈 隨機音符 演奏者
records.d: A hands-free performer: it presses and releases notes on its own, in a scale, so a demo can play itself.
records.x: It plays like someone noodling. Every gesture it picks at random: mostly a step up or down the scale, sometimes a leap, now and then a triad stacked in the scale, and real rests. Notes last 0.18 to 0.68 seconds (a triad twice as long), the next gesture comes 0.22 to 0.77 seconds later (a rest lasts 0.6 to 2 seconds), all at the default density of 1, and the notes are kept between 36 and 96. Because it presses and releases through your own two functions, whatever listens downstream cannot tell it from a person. It starts off. Call toggle(true) and then update(dt) once per frame with the seconds since the last frame; it does nothing while it is off. toggle(false) releases every note it is holding, so none sticks. The notes are random (it uses Math.random, there is no seed). press press(note, vel01): called when a note starts, with its MIDI number and a velocity between 0.45 and 0.85. Usually the press of a KeysPiano, so the keys light up. release release(note): called when the note ends. base The MIDI note the scale starts on. scale The notes it may play, as semitones above base. The default is a pentatonic scale, which sounds fine whatever happens. density How busy it is. The gaps between notes are divided by it, so 2 plays about twice as often.

records.k: simulate simulated performer auto play demo noodle random notes bot generative 模擬演奏 自動演奏 示範 隨手彈 隨機音符 演奏者
records.d: 一個不用手的演奏者：它自己在音階裡按下和放開音符，讓示範可以自己演奏。
records.x: 它彈起來像有人隨手彈。每個動作都是隨機挑的：大多是在音階上往上或往下一步，有時跳一個音程，偶爾彈一個疊在音階上的三和弦，也有真正的休止。每個音持續 0.18 到 0.68 秒（三和弦長兩倍），下一個動作在 0.22 到 0.77 秒之後（休止 0.6 到 2 秒），這些都是 density 為預設的 1 時的數字，音符被限制在 36 到 96。因為它是透過你的兩個函式按下和放開，下游的東西分不出它跟真人的差別。 它一開始是關的。呼叫 toggle(true)，然後每個畫面用距離上一個畫面過了幾秒呼叫 update(dt)。關著的時候它什麼都不做。toggle(false) 會放開它按著的所有音，不會有音卡住。音是隨機的（用的是 Math.random，沒有 seed）。 press press(note, vel01)：一個音開始時呼叫，帶著 MIDI 號碼和 0.45 到 0.85 之間的力道。通常是 KeysPiano 的 press，這樣琴鍵會亮。 release release(note)：這個音結束時呼叫。 base 音階從哪個 MIDI 音符開始。 scale 它可以彈的音，用比 base 高幾個半音來表示。預設是五聲音階，怎麼彈都不會難聽。 density 多忙。音和音之間的間隔會除以它，所以 2 大約是兩倍密。

records.k: bone basis rotation leapjs orthonormal bone basis matrix 骨頭基底 旋轉 leapjs 正交 骨頭 基底矩陣
records.d: An advanced helper: the orthonormal basis [x, y, z] of a bone, rebuilt from two joints and the palm normal the way LeapJS expects.
records.x: The sensor gives joints, not rotations, but LeapJS sketches read a rotation basis for every bone, so V6Converter uses this to fill in bases. You only need it if you write your own converter. prev The joint at the base of the bone, [x, y, z] in millimetres. next The joint at the tip end of the bone. palmNormal The palm normal; -palmNormal becomes the "back of the hand" axis (y). left true for a left hand: the x axis is negated, so the determinant is negative, which is how LeapJS tells left from right. Three rows [x, y, z], each a unit vector rounded to 3 decimals. z runs from the tip back to the base (LeapJS's Bone.direction() is -z).

records.k: bone basis rotation leapjs orthonormal bone basis matrix 骨頭基底 旋轉 leapjs 正交 骨頭 基底矩陣
records.d: 進階用的輔助函式：用兩個關節和掌心法線重建一根骨頭的正交基底 [x, y, z]，做法符合 LeapJS 的期待。
records.x: 感測器給的是關節，不是旋轉，但 LeapJS 的草圖會對每根骨頭讀一個旋轉基底，所以 V6Converter 用它來填 bases。只有自己寫轉換器的時候才會需要它。 prev 骨頭根部的關節 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐。 next 骨頭前端的關節。 palmNormal 掌心法線，-palmNormal 會成為「手背」那一軸（y）。 left 左手就傳 true：x 軸會反向，行列式變成負的，LeapJS 就是靠這個分辨左右手。 三列 [x, y, z]，各是四捨五入到小數三位的單位向量。z 從前端指回根部（LeapJS 的 Bone.direction() 是 -z）。

records.k: port 6437 default port bridge port 連接埠 6437 預設連接埠 橋接連接埠
records.d: The Leap bridge's default port: 6437, the port the original Leap service used, so old leap.js sketches find it unchanged.
records.x: The default of startBridge({ port }) and of --port. The environment variable LEAP_BRIDGE_PORT changes it for the command line. This is the port of the Leap bridge; the out-bridge has its own (DEFAULT_PORT of @openav/out, 6450).

records.k: port 6437 default port bridge port 連接埠 6437 預設連接埠 橋接連接埠
records.d: Leap 橋接程式預設的連接埠：6437，是原本的 Leap 服務用的連接埠，舊的 leap.js 草圖不用改就找得到。
records.x: startBridge({ port }) 和 --port 的預設值。環境變數 LEAP_BRIDGE_PORT 可以改命令列用的值。這是 Leap 橋接程式的連接埠。輸出橋接有自己的（@openav/out 的 DEFAULT_PORT，6450）。

records.k: default url bridge address ws://127.0.0.1:6437 websocket url 6437 預設網址 橋接位址 ws://127.0.0.1:6437 websocket 位址 6437
records.d: The default address LeapInput connects to: ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json, the bridge on this machine speaking the LeapJS protocol.
records.x: Port 6437 is the port the original Leap service used, so old leap.js sketches find the bridge without changing anything. …/raw on the same port serves the raw lines instead. In a show, ?leap=ws://host:port/v6.json in the page address points a page at another bridge, and ?leap=sim starts the simulator.

records.k: default url bridge address ws://127.0.0.1:6437 websocket url 6437 預設網址 橋接位址 ws://127.0.0.1:6437 websocket 位址 6437
records.d: LeapInput 預設連的位址：ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json，也就是這台機器上、講 LeapJS 通訊協定的橋接程式。
records.x: 6437 是原本的 Leap 服務用的連接埠，所以舊的 leap.js 草圖不用改任何東西就找得到橋接程式。同一個連接埠的 …/raw 提供的是原始行格式。在演出裡，網址加上 ?leap=ws://host:port/v6.json 可以讓頁面改連別的橋接程式，?leap=sim 則會啟動模擬器。

records.k: device event device attached streaming no device no service status 裝置事件 裝置接上 串流 沒有裝置 沒有服務 狀態
records.d: A LeapJS device event telling the client whether a device is attached and streaming, plus our own service flag.
records.x: LeapJS (protocol 5 and up) turns it into deviceAttached, deviceStreaming and streamingStarted. The bridge sends one on connect and on every status change. LeapInput maps it to its status: no service is 'no-service', a service without a device is 'no-device', and a streaming device is 'tracking'. device The device id, or null for no device. service Whether the tracking service is running. LeapJS ignores this; LeapInput uses it to tell "no tracking service" from "no device". { event: { type: 'deviceEvent', state: { attached, streaming, id, type: 'Peripheral', service } } }; id is 'none' without a device.

records.k: device event device attached streaming no device no service status 裝置事件 裝置接上 串流 沒有裝置 沒有服務 狀態
records.d: 一則 LeapJS 裝置事件，告訴用戶端裝置有沒有接上、有沒有在串流，另外附上我們自己加的 service 旗標。
records.x: LeapJS（通訊協定 5 以上）會把它轉成 deviceAttached、deviceStreaming 和 streamingStarted。橋接程式在連線時，以及每次狀態改變時都會送一則。LeapInput 把它對應成自己的狀態：沒有服務是 'no-service'，有服務沒裝置是 'no-device'，裝置在串流就是 'tracking'。 device 裝置 id，沒有裝置就是 null。 service 追蹤服務有沒有在跑。LeapJS 會忽略它。LeapInput 用它區分「沒有追蹤服務」和「沒有裝置」。 { event: { type: 'deviceEvent', state: { attached, streaming, id, type: 'Peripheral', service } } }，沒有裝置時 id 是 'none'。

records.k: fingers finger names thumb index middle ring pinky fingertip 手指 手指名稱 拇指 食指 中指 無名指 小指 指尖
records.d: The five finger names in order, thumb index middle ring pinky: the order of hand.fingers and the names in the fingertip signals.
records.x: hand.fingers[0] is the thumb and hand.fingers[4] the pinky, so FINGERS[i] names hand.fingers[i]. The fingertip signals are leap/hand///x|y|z with these names, for example leap/hand/right/index/y.

records.k: fingers finger names thumb index middle ring pinky fingertip 手指 手指名稱 拇指 食指 中指 無名指 小指 指尖
records.d: 依序排好的五個手指名稱 thumb index middle ring pinky：hand.fingers 的順序，也是指尖訊號用的名字。
records.x: hand.fingers[0] 是拇指，hand.fingers[4] 是小指，所以 FINGERS[i] 就是 hand.fingers[i] 的名字。指尖訊號是 leap/hand///x|y|z，用的就是這些名字，例如 leap/hand/right/index/y。

records.k: pitch yaw roll angles hand rotation orientation radians palm normal 俯仰 偏航 翻滾 角度 手的旋轉 方向 弧度 掌心法線
records.d: Turns a hand's direction and palm normal into { pitch, yaw, roll } in radians, with the LeapJS conventions.
records.x: A flat hand, palm down, fingers away from you, is { pitch: 0, yaw: 0, roll: 0 }. The three angles are the leap/hand//pitch|yaw|roll signals, which LeapInput computes with this function from each hand. When the fingers point straight up there is no yaw or roll to measure, and the function answers π (3.14) for them. Expect that at the top of a gesture, and do not map those two signals when the hand is vertical. direction The direction the fingers point, [x, y, z] (a unit vector). normal The palm normal [x, y, z], pointing out of the palm (down when the palm faces the sensor). { pitch, yaw, roll }, each −π..π: pitch is the fingers tipping up, yaw turning toward +x (the right), roll the palm turning over.

records.k: pitch yaw roll angles hand rotation orientation radians palm normal 俯仰 偏航 翻滾 角度 手的旋轉 方向 弧度 掌心法線
records.d: 把手的方向和掌心法線轉成以弧度計的 { pitch, yaw, roll }，沿用 LeapJS 的慣例。
records.x: 手平放、掌心朝下、手指朝向遠離你的方向，就是 { pitch: 0, yaw: 0, roll: 0 }。這三個角度就是 leap/hand//pitch|yaw|roll 這幾個訊號，LeapInput 對每隻手都是用這個函式算出來的。 手指正對著天花板的時候，沒有 yaw 或 roll 可量，函式會回答 π（3.14）。手勢做到最高的時候會遇到，手垂直時請不要去映射那兩個訊號。 direction 手指指的方向 [x, y, z]（單位向量）。 normal 掌心法線 [x, y, z]，從手掌往外指（掌心朝向感測器時是向下）。 { pitch, yaw, roll }，各自在 −π..π：pitch 是手指往上翹，yaw 是轉向 +x（右邊），roll 是手掌翻轉。

records.k: bones skeleton draw hand joints hand lines 骨頭 骨架 畫手 關節 手的線條
records.d: The bones to draw for a hand, as pairs of points: each finger's joints in turn, the line across the knuckles, and the forearm.
records.x: It only lists the pairs; you choose how to draw them. LeapInput.skeleton() calls it for you. Use it directly when you draw with p5, three.js or your own projection. hand A hand from handsOf() or leap.hands. An array of [pointA, pointB] pairs, each point [x, y, z] in millimetres. A hand with five 5-joint fingers, a wrist and an elbow gives 25.

records.k: bones skeleton draw hand joints hand lines 骨頭 骨架 畫手 關節 手的線條
records.d: 一隻手要畫的骨頭，用成對的點表示：每根手指的關節依序相連、橫過指節的那條線，以及前臂。
records.x: 它只列出成對的點，怎麼畫由你決定。LeapInput.skeleton() 會替你呼叫它。用 p5、three.js 或自己的投影來畫的時候，就直接用它。 hand 來自 handsOf() 或 leap.hands 的一隻手。 [pointA, pointB] 成對的陣列，每個點是 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐。一隻有五根各 5 個關節的手指、手腕和手肘的手，會得到 25 條。

records.k: gesture gestures pinch grab fist hysteresis schmitt trigger start end both hands 手勢 捏合 握拳 遲滯 施密特觸發 開始結束 雙手
records.d: Turns pinch and grab strengths into clean start and end events, per hand plus a both-hands pinch, using hysteresis so a wobbling value fires once.
records.x: A pinch strength hovers around any single threshold while the fingers are "almost touching", and one threshold then fires start, end, start, end sixty times a second. So every gesture is a trigger with two thresholds: it starts above on and only ends below off. The defaults are a pinch starting above 0.86 and ending below 0.5, a both-hands pinch entering when both hands are above 0.8 and leaving when either drops below 0.5, and a grab (fist) above 0.8 and below 0.5. A hand that disappears ends all of its gestures. LeapInput already runs one (leap.gestures) and turns its events into the leap/…/pinch-start pulses. Use HandGestures on its own when you have hands from somewhere else. thresholds Overrides for the defaults in THRESHOLDS: { pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }. Keys you leave out keep their defaults.

records.k: gesture gestures pinch grab fist hysteresis schmitt trigger start end both hands 手勢 捏合 握拳 遲滯 施密特觸發 開始結束 雙手
records.d: 把捏合和握拳的力度變成乾淨的開始與結束事件，每隻手各一組，另外還有雙手捏合，用遲滯處理，所以抖動的值只會觸發一次。
records.x: 手指「快要碰到」的時候，捏合力度會在任何單一門檻附近晃來晃去，只有一個門檻的話，就會每秒六十次地開始、結束、開始、結束。所以每個手勢都有兩個門檻：高過 on 才開始，低於 off 才結束。預設值是：捏合高於 0.86 開始、低於 0.5 結束。雙手捏合在兩隻手都高於 0.8 時進入，任何一隻低於 0.5 就離開。握拳高於 0.8 開始、低於 0.5 結束。手消失的時候，它所有的手勢都會結束。 LeapInput 已經內建一個（leap.gestures），並把它的事件變成 leap/…/pinch-start 這些脈衝。你的手資料如果是從別的地方來，才需要單獨使用 HandGestures。 thresholds 覆寫 THRESHOLDS 的預設值：{ pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }。沒寫的鍵維持預設。

records.k: hands of parse hands hand shape fingers joints v6 frame raw frame convert 解析手 手的形狀 手指 關節 v6 影格 原始影格
records.d: Reads either wire format (raw line or LeapJS v6 frame) into the one hand shape the rest of the package uses; anything else gives [].
records.x: This is the hand shape worlds draw from (leap.hands). A raw frame carries the fingers inline; a v6 frame carries them as pointables joined to their hand by handId, and handsOf() does that join. Both give the same hand, so code written against leap.hands does not care which URL the bridge was reached on. msg A parsed message: a raw frame (t: 'f') or a v6 frame (with hands and pointables). The hands, each { id, side: 'left' | 'right', confidence, pinch, grab, palm, velocity, normal, direction, width, fingers, extended, elbow, wrist, timeVisible }. Positions are in millimetres; fingers is 5 arrays of joints (the last is the tip), extended 5 booleans.

records.k: hands of parse hands hand shape fingers joints v6 frame raw frame convert 解析手 手的形狀 手指 關節 v6 影格 原始影格
records.d: 把兩種傳輸格式（原始行或 LeapJS v6 影格）都讀成套件其他部分共用的同一種手的形狀，其他任何東西都回傳 []。
records.x: 這就是世界用來畫手的形狀（leap.hands）。原始影格把手指放在手的裡面。v6 影格把手指放成 pointables，用 handId 接到它們的手，handsOf() 負責做這個合併。兩者給出同一隻手，所以針對 leap.hands 寫的程式不在乎橋接程式是從哪個網址連的。 msg 一則解析好的訊息：原始影格（t: 'f'）或 v6 影格（有 hands 和 pointables）。 手的陣列，每隻是 { id, side: 'left' | 'right', confidence, pinch, grab, palm, velocity, normal, direction, width, fingers, extended, elbow, wrist, timeVisible }。位置單位是公釐。fingers 是 5 個關節陣列（最後一個是指尖），extended 是 5 個布林值。

records.k: hysteresis schmitt trigger threshold debounce flicker start end 遲滯 施密特觸發 門檻 防抖動 閃爍
records.d: One Schmitt trigger: update(v) says 'start' when the value rises above on, and 'end' only when it falls below off.
records.x: The gap between on and off is what stops a value that hovers near one threshold from flickering. Each call to update() returns 'start' (it just became active), 'end' (it just stopped) or null (nothing changed). A missing or NaN value while active counts as an end, so a lost sensor lets go. active tells you whether it is on now. on The level the value must rise above to start. off The level the value must fall below to end. It must be lower than on, or the constructor throws "Hysteresis: off must be below on".

records.k: hysteresis schmitt trigger threshold debounce flicker start end 遲滯 施密特觸發 門檻 防抖動 閃爍
records.d: 一個施密特觸發器：數值升到 on 以上，update(v) 回報 'start'，要降到 off 以下才會回報 'end'。
records.x: on 和 off 之間的空隙，就是讓在某個門檻附近徘徊的數值不會閃爍的原因。每次呼叫 update() 會回傳 'start'（剛變成啟動）、'end'（剛停止）或 null（沒有變化）。啟動中遇到缺值或 NaN 會當作結束，所以感測器掉了就會放開。active 告訴你它現在是不是開著。 on 數值要高過它才會開始。 off 數值要低於它才會結束。必須比 on 低，否則建構函式會丟出 "Hysteresis: off must be below on"。

records.k: interaction box tracking volume box center size millimetres 互動範圍盒 追蹤範圍 範圍盒 中心 尺寸 公釐
records.d: The classic Leap interaction box, { center: [0, 200, 0], size: [235.247, 235.247, 147.751] } in millimetres, that positions are normalised against.
records.x: A frozen object: the centre sits 200 mm above the sensor, and the box measures 235.247 mm along x, 235.247 mm along y and 147.751 mm along z (the sensor's own axes: x across, y up, z toward the player). normalizePoint() maps it to 0..1, and the console panel draws it as an outline so you can see when a hand leaves it. Pass your own box to new LeapInput({ box }) to change where 0 and 1 are.

records.k: interaction box tracking volume box center size millimetres 互動範圍盒 追蹤範圍 範圍盒 中心 尺寸 公釐
records.d: 經典的 Leap 互動範圍盒，{ center: [0, 200, 0], size: [235.247, 235.247, 147.751] }，單位是公釐，位置就是對它做正規化。
records.x: 一個凍結的物件：中心在感測器上方 200 公釐，三個軸的尺寸是感測器自己的座標軸：x 是 235 公釐、y 是 235 公釐、z 是 148 公釐。normalizePoint() 把它對應到 0..1，主控台面板把它畫成外框，這樣你就看得到手什麼時候離開。要改 0 和 1 在哪裡，就傳自己的盒子給 new LeapInput({ box })。

records.k: leap leap motion ultraleap hand tracking hands pinch grab fist palm fingertip bridge gesture simulate leap leap motion 手部追蹤 手 捏合 握拳 掌心 指尖 橋接 手勢 模擬
records.d: Reads Leap Motion hands from the local bridge and publishes them as leap/ signals, plus the joints (leap.hands) for drawing the hand itself.
records.x: Browsers cannot talk to the Leap Motion sensor directly, so a small program on the same machine, the bridge (startBridge(), ws://127.0.0.1:6437), reads it and serves the hands over a WebSocket. LeapInput connects to that bridge and does one job: it turns hands into normalised signals and never touches params or worlds. In a show, createShow({ modules: { leap: true } }) builds one and returns it as show.leap; the console's L1 panel shows which link is missing. It publishes, for each side (left, right): leap/hand//present (0 or 1), x, y, z (the palm in the interaction box, 0..1, y up, z toward the player), pinch and grab (0..1), roll, pitch, yaw (−π..π radians), speed (0..1, 1 = 1 m/s), and /x|y|z for the five fingertips. Shared: leap/status (0 no bridge, 1 bridge but no tracking service, 2 service but no device, 3 tracking), leap/hands (0..2) and leap/both/distance (palm to palm, 1 = 40 cm). The full list with its ranges is what leapSignals() returns. Gestures are pulses with a payload { side, x, y, z, strength }: leap/hand//pinch-start|pinch-end and grab-start|grab-end, and leap/both/pinch-start|pinch-end (payload { x, y, z, distance } at the midpoint). They use hysteresis, so a pinch hovering near the threshold fires once and not sixty times a second (see HandGestures). A hand that leaves the view lets go: its present, pinch, grab and speed go to 0 and its gestures end. For continuous control, map a signal to a param ({ source: 'leap/hand/right/y', target: 'energy' }) so…

records.k: leap leap motion ultraleap hand tracking hands pinch grab fist palm fingertip bridge gesture simulate leap leap motion 手部追蹤 手 捏合 握拳 掌心 指尖 橋接 手勢 模擬
records.d: 從本機的橋接程式讀取 Leap Motion 的手，發布成 leap/ 訊號，並在 leap.hands 提供關節資料，讓你把手本身畫出來。
records.x: 瀏覽器沒辦法直接跟 Leap Motion 感測器溝通，所以同一台機器上有個小程式，也就是橋接程式（startBridge()，ws://127.0.0.1:6437），負責讀取它，再用 WebSocket 把手送出來。LeapInput 連到那個橋接程式，只做一件事：把手變成正規化的訊號，絕不碰參數或世界。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { leap: true } }) 會建好一個，用 show.leap 回傳。主控台的 L1 面板會告訴你哪一段連線不通。 每一邊（left、right）它會發布：leap/hand//present（0 或 1）、x、y、z（掌心在互動範圍盒裡的位置，0..1，y 向上，z 朝向玩家）、pinch 和 grab（0..1）、roll、pitch、yaw（−π..π 弧度）、speed（0..1，1 = 每秒 1 公尺），還有五個指尖的 /x|y|z。共用的有：leap/status（0 沒有橋接、1 有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、2 服務在但沒有裝置、3 追蹤中）、leap/hands（0..2）和 leap/both/distance（兩掌之間的距離，1 = 40 公分）。完整的清單和範圍就是 leapSignals() 的回傳值。 手勢是帶有 { side, x, y, z, strength } 的脈衝：leap/hand//pinch-start|pinch-end 和 grab-start|grab-end，以及 leap/both/pinch-start|pinch-end（內容是中點的 { x, y, z, distance }）。它們有遲滯，所以在門檻附近徘徊的捏合只會觸發一次，不會一秒鐘觸發六十次（見 HandGestures）。手離開畫面就會放開：它的 present、pinch、grab 和 speed 歸零，手勢也跟著結束。 連續控制請把訊號映射到參數（{ source: 'leap/hand/right/y', target: 'energy' }），這樣時間軸、旋鈕和手就可以互換。leap.hands（以公釐計的關節）只用來把手本身畫出來。 要接真的手：橋接程式必須在跑（node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs，或加 --mock 得到會動的假手），而且你要呼叫 connect()。第一個影格到達之前不會發布任何東西。沒有感測器也沒有橋接程式：用 ingest() 餵手給它，或呼叫 simulate() 把滑鼠變成手。 可以讀的欄位：status（'idle'、'connecting'、'bridge'、'no-service'、'no-device'、'tracking'、'simulated'、'closed'）、hands（陣列，每隻手有 id、side、palm、fingers（5 × 5 個關節）、pinch、grab、velocity、normal、direction ……，單位是公釐）、frame（最近收到的原始訊息）、frames、fps、device、serviceVersion、gestures 和 box。 模擬器在跑的時候，手由它掌管：橋接程式來的真實影格會被忽略，橋接程式的狀態會被記住，等模擬器停止再恢復。 訊號是正規化的（y = 1 代表向上）。leap.hands 和 LeapJS 的影格則保留感測器自己的公釐單位，+z 朝向玩家。 橋接程式怎麼溝通、各種格式和疑難排解表，都在套件的…

records.k: leap signals signal list leap/hand define signals declarations leap 訊號 訊號清單 宣告訊號 訊號名稱
records.d: The list of every signal LeapInput publishes, with its range, as [[name, meta], …], ready to hand to signals.define().
records.x: new LeapInput({ signals }) already declares all of these, so you rarely call this yourself. It is useful when you want the list: to build a signal picker, to check that a route's source exists, or to declare the signals before the sensor is connected. The names it returns are the vocabulary of the Signals reference for Leap. fingers Include the fingertip signals. false leaves out the 30 of them. The pairs [name, meta]: 63 with fingers, 33 without. Each meta has source: 'leap', and min and max (the roll, pitch and yaw ones in radians, −π..π) or kind: 'pulse'.

records.k: leap signals signal list leap/hand define signals declarations leap 訊號 訊號清單 宣告訊號 訊號名稱
records.d: LeapInput 發布的所有訊號清單，連同範圍，格式是 [[name, meta], …]，可以直接交給 signals.define()。
records.x: new LeapInput({ signals }) 已經把這些全部宣告好了，所以很少需要自己呼叫。想要這份清單的時候它就很有用：做訊號選單、檢查某條路由的來源存不存在、或在感測器還沒接上之前先宣告訊號。它回傳的名稱就是訊號參考裡 Leap 的那一批詞彙。 fingers 要不要包含指尖訊號。false 會少掉那 30 個。 [name, meta] 的成對清單：有指尖是 63 個，沒有是 33 個。每個 meta 都有 source: 'leap'，以及 min 和 max（roll、pitch、yaw 是弧度，−π..π），脈衝則是 kind: 'pulse'。

records.k: mock fake hands test frame demo hands no sensor leap simulation mock frame 假手 模擬 測試影格 沒有感測器 示範用的手 mock
records.d: One frame of made-up, animated hands at time t: a right hand circling and pinching every 3 seconds, a left hand rising, falling and slowly making a fist.
records.x: This is the bridge's --mock stream and the way to try Leap code without a sensor. The right hand pinches for about a second out of every 3, the left hand pinches once every 12 seconds, and at those moments (for example second 8) both are pinched, so the both-hands pinch fires too. The left fist comes and goes slowly. The output goes through exactly the same conversion and publishing as a real Leap Motion Controller. t Time in seconds. The result depends only on t, so it is the same every time. id The frame number written into the frame. hands How many hands: 2 (right and left), 1 (the right only) or 0. A frame in the raw line format: { t: 'f', id, fps: 60, hands: [hand, …] }, the right hand (side: 'R') first. Feed it to LeapInput.ingest() or handsOf().

records.k: mock fake hands test frame demo hands no sensor leap simulation mock frame 假手 模擬 測試影格 沒有感測器 示範用的手 mock
records.d: 時間 t 的一個影格的假手，會動：右手繞圈、每 3 秒捏合一次，左手升降，並且慢慢握拳。
records.x: 這就是橋接程式 --mock 模式送出的串流，也是沒有感測器時試 Leap 程式的辦法。右手每 3 秒有大約 1 秒在捏合，左手每 12 秒捏合一次，兩者重疊的時刻（例如第 8 秒），兩隻手同時捏合，所以雙手捏合也會觸發。左手的拳頭則慢慢地出現又消失。輸出走的轉換與發布路徑，跟真正的 Leap Motion Controller 完全一樣。 t 時間，單位是秒。結果只跟 t 有關，所以每次都一樣。 id 寫進影格裡的影格編號。 hands 手的數量：2（右手和左手）、1（只有右手）或 0。 原始行格式的影格：{ t: 'f', id, fps: 60, hands: [hand, …] }，右手（side: 'R'）在前面。可以餵給 LeapInput.ingest() 或 handsOf()。

records.k: mock hand fake hand hand model test hand pinch grab palm position 假手 手的模型 測試用的手 捏合 握拳 掌心位置
records.d: Builds one made-up hand, with all five fingers and the arm, from a palm position plus pinch, grab, roll, yaw and pitch.
records.x: It places a plausible hand in space: palm, knuckles, fingers curled by grab, thumb and index meeting as pinch goes to 1, wrist and elbow. LeapInput.simulate() builds its hands from the mouse with it, and mockFrame() with the animated ones. Use it to put a hand exactly where a test needs it. id The hand's id. side 'R' for a right hand, 'L' for a left. palm The palm position [x, y, z] in millimetres (+x right, +y up, +z toward the player). pinch Thumb to index, 0..1. At 1 the two fingertips meet. grab How closed the fist is, 0..1. roll Radians; positive rolls toward the thumb side. yaw Radians; positive turns the fingers toward +x. pitch Radians; positive tips the fingers up. vel Palm velocity in millimetres per second. conf Tracking confidence, 0..1. width Palm width in millimetres. A hand in the raw line format: { id, side, conf, pinch, grab, palm, vel, n, dir, w, f, ext, arm }, where f is 5 fingers × 5 joints (thumb to pinky; the last joint of each is the tip). Wrap hands in { t: 'f', id, fps, hands: [...] } to make a frame.

records.k: mock hand fake hand hand model test hand pinch grab palm position 假手 手的模型 測試用的手 捏合 握拳 掌心位置
records.d: 用掌心位置加上捏合、握拳、roll、yaw、pitch，做出一隻假手，五根手指和手臂都有。
records.x: 它在空間裡放一隻合理的手：掌心、指節、隨 grab 彎起來的手指、pinch 到 1 時碰在一起的拇指和食指、手腕和手肘。LeapInput.simulate() 用它把滑鼠變成手，mockFrame() 用它做出會動的手。需要把手剛好放在某個位置來測試時，就用它。 id 這隻手的 id。 side 右手用 'R'，左手用 'L'。 palm 掌心位置 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐（+x 向右、+y 向上、+z 朝向玩家）。 pinch 拇指到食指，0..1。到 1 的時候兩個指尖碰在一起。 grab 拳頭握得多緊，0..1。 roll 弧度，正值是往拇指那一側翻。 yaw 弧度，正值是讓手指轉向 +x。 pitch 弧度，正值是讓手指往上翹。 vel 掌心速度，單位是公釐每秒。 conf 追蹤的信心程度，0..1。 width 手掌寬度，單位是公釐。 原始行格式的手：{ id, side, conf, pinch, grab, palm, vel, n, dir, w, f, ext, arm }，其中 f 是 5 根手指 × 5 個關節（從拇指到小指，每根的最後一個關節是指尖）。把手包進 { t: 'f', id, fps, hands: [...] } 就成了一個影格。

records.k: leap panel status panel skeleton hands view simulate button leap status leap 面板 狀態面板 骨架 手的畫面 模擬按鈕 leap 狀態
records.d: Mounts a small panel that shows whether the Leap is alive (bridge, service, device, hands) and draws what it sees, with a button to simulate hands.
records.x: One status line says which link is the broken one, in order: no bridge, bridge but no tracking service, service but no device, tracking (with the number of hands and the frame rate). Under it, a small front view draws the interaction box (a hand outside it is visibly outside, its signals sitting clamped at the edge) and the hand skeletons. It redraws only on frames and status changes, so nothing runs while the sensor is idle. In a show you do not call it: the console's L1 · Input panel mounts it when you declare modules: { leap: true }. el Where to put the panel. leap The LeapInput to show. width The width of the drawing in CSS pixels; the height follows (about 0.62 of the width). simulate Show the "simulate" button (mouse and touch become hands). simTarget What the simulator listens on. Defaults to leap.simTarget, then the window. { el, render(), destroy() }: the panel's root element, a function that redraws it, and one that removes it and unsubscribes.

records.k: leap panel status panel skeleton hands view simulate button leap status leap 面板 狀態面板 骨架 手的畫面 模擬按鈕 leap 狀態
records.d: 掛上一個小面板，顯示 Leap 有沒有活著（橋接、服務、裝置、手）並畫出它看到的東西，還有一個模擬手的按鈕。
records.x: 一行狀態列會告訴你是哪一段連線壞了，依序是：沒有橋接、有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、有服務但沒有裝置、追蹤中（附上手的數量和影格率）。下面是個小小的正視圖，畫出互動範圍盒（手在盒子外面一眼就看得出來，它的訊號會被夾在邊緣）和手的骨架。它只在有影格或狀態改變時重畫，感測器閒置時什麼都不會跑。 在演出裡不用自己呼叫：宣告 modules: { leap: true } 之後，主控台的 L1 · Input 面板會掛上它。 el 面板要放在哪個元素裡。 leap 要顯示的 LeapInput。 width 繪圖區的寬度（CSS 像素），高度跟著決定（約為寬度的 0.62 倍）。 simulate 要不要顯示「simulate」按鈕（滑鼠和觸控變成手）。 simTarget 模擬器監聽哪個目標。預設是 leap.simTarget，再不然是 window。 { el, render(), destroy() }：面板的根元素、重畫它的函式，以及移除它並取消訂閱的函式。

records.k: normalize interaction box millimetres 0..1 clamp palm position scale hand 正規化 互動範圍盒 公釐 0..1 夾住 掌心位置
records.d: Maps a point in millimetres to 0..1 inside the interaction box, clamped by default: the same normalisation the leap/ signals use.
records.x: The classic box is centred 200 mm above the sensor and about 235 × 235 × 148 mm (INTERACTION_BOX). A palm at the centre reads [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]; a palm far outside it reads 0 or 1 on that axis, which is why the signals "sit clamped at the edge" when a hand leaves the box. Pass clamp = false when you want to know how far outside it is. p The point [x, y, z] in millimetres. box The box { center, size } in millimetres. clamp Hold each value to 0..1. false lets a point outside the box go beyond. [x, y, z], each (p − center) / size + 0.5: 0.5 is the centre of the box, x grows to the right, y upward, z toward the player.

records.k: normalize interaction box millimetres 0..1 clamp palm position scale hand 正規化 互動範圍盒 公釐 0..1 夾住 掌心位置
records.d: 把一個以公釐計的點，換算成互動範圍盒裡的 0..1，預設會夾住：leap/ 訊號用的就是這個正規化。
records.x: 經典的盒子中心在感測器上方 200 公釐，大小約 235 × 235 × 148 公釐（INTERACTION_BOX）。掌心在中心讀到 [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]，掌心遠在盒子外面，那個軸就讀到 0 或 1，這就是手離開盒子時訊號會「夾在邊緣」的原因。想知道超出多遠，就傳 clamp = false。 p 點 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐。 box 範圍盒 { center, size }，單位是公釐。 clamp 把每個值限制在 0..1。false 的話，盒子外面的點可以超出範圍。 [x, y, z]，每個都是 (p − center) / size + 0.5：0.5 是盒子的中心，x 往右增加、y 往上增加、z 朝向玩家。

records.k: palm basis rotation leapjs hand.r orthonormal 掌心基底 旋轉 leapjs hand.r 正交
records.d: An advanced helper: the orthonormal basis [x, y, z] of the palm, from its direction and normal, in the rows LeapJS reads as hand.r.
records.x: Like boneBasis(), it exists so that the LeapJS frames V6Converter writes have a r that hand.rotationAngle() can use. Worlds that draw hands read leap.hands and handAngles() instead. direction The direction the fingers point. normal The palm normal. left true for a left hand: x is negated. Three rows [x, y, z] (x sideways, y the back of the hand, z toward the wrist), rounded to 3 decimals.

records.k: palm basis rotation leapjs hand.r orthonormal 掌心基底 旋轉 leapjs hand.r 正交
records.d: 進階用的輔助函式：由手的方向和法線算出掌心的正交基底 [x, y, z]，列的排法就是 LeapJS 當作 hand.r 來讀的那種。
records.x: 和 boneBasis() 一樣，它的存在是為了讓 V6Converter 寫出的 LeapJS 影格有 hand.rotationAngle() 能用的 r。要畫手的世界讀的是 leap.hands 和 handAngles()。 direction 手指指的方向。 normal 掌心法線。 left 左手傳 true：x 會反向。 三列 [x, y, z]（x 是橫向、y 是手背、z 朝向手腕），四捨五入到小數三位。

records.k: protocol version leapjs version v6 version 6 通訊協定版本 leapjs 版本 v6 版本 6
records.d: The highest LeapJS protocol version we speak: 6. LeapJS 1.1.1 and earlier throw "unrecognized version" above that.
records.x: v6Header() never reports more than this, and the bridge answers /v7.json as version 6. It is the default of the version argument there.

records.k: protocol version leapjs version v6 version 6 通訊協定版本 leapjs 版本 v6 版本 6
records.d: 我們支援的 LeapJS 通訊協定最高版本：6。LeapJS 1.1.1 和更早的版本遇到更高的版本會丟出 "unrecognized version"。
records.x: v6Header() 不會回報比這更高的版本，橋接程式也把 /v7.json 當成版本 6 回應。它是那裡 version 參數的預設值。

records.k: protocol path v6.json protocol version bridge endpoint 通訊協定路徑 v6.json 通訊協定版本 橋接端點
records.d: Which protocol version a /vN.json path asks for, as a number, or null when the path is not one.
records.x: The bridge uses it to decide whether a WebSocket upgrade is a LeapJS client at all: /v6.json yes, /raw is handled separately, anything else is refused with a 404. pathname The URL path, such as '/v6.json'. The number in /v.json, or null. It does not clip to 6: /v7.json gives 7 (the bridge then answers it as version 6).

records.d: /vN.json 這種路徑要求的是哪個通訊協定版本，回傳數字，路徑不是這種格式就回傳 null。
records.x: 橋接程式用它判斷一個 WebSocket 升級請求是不是 LeapJS 的用戶端：/v6.json 是，/raw 另外處理，其他的一律回 404 拒絕。 pathname 網址的路徑，例如 '/v6.json'。 /v.json 裡的數字，或 null。它不會截到 6：/v7.json 得到 7（橋接程式再以版本 6 回應）。

records.x: startBridge({ port: 7457 }) throws "port 7457 belongs to The Last Input" immediately, so the bridge can never take the port the monitor listens on (node packages/monitor/server.js). The out-bridge refuses the same one.

records.x: startBridge({ port: 7457 }) 會立刻丟出 "port 7457 belongs to The Last Input"，所以橋接程式絕不會占走後台監看監聽的連接埠（node packages/monitor/server.js）。輸出橋接也一樣拒絕這一個。

records.k: leap bridge bridge server websocket server node 6437 mock leap-bridge ultraleap service leap 橋接 橋接程式 伺服器 websocket 伺服器 node 6437 假手 ultraleap 服務
records.d: Starts the Leap bridge on this machine: a loopback WebSocket and HTTP server that serves the sensor's hands to every page (Node only).
records.x: This is what node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs runs (add --mock for made-up hands, --port, --hz, --bin, --quiet). It serves ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json (the LeapJS protocol, which every 2014 to 2021 browser sketch speaks), ws://…/raw (the raw lines), the same lines as server-sent events on GET /raw and /hands, and GET /health (source, service, device, fps, hands, clients). Any page origin may read it, as the original Leap service allowed. Call it from your own Node program when you want the bridge inside it, for example in a test. startBridge() throws at once for port 7457 (it belongs to The Last Input and the monitor) and for a non-loopback host; a port already in use rejects the returned promise with a message that suggests curl http://127.0.0.1:6437/health. Node 22 or later, and for real hands the Ultraleap Hand Tracking service plus Xcode's clang to build the reader on first start. With mock: true neither is needed. port The port to listen on, DEFAULT_PORT unless you say otherwise. 0 picks any free one. The ports in RESERVED_PORTS (7457) are refused. host The address to bind. Only loopback (127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost) is allowed: hand data never leaves the machine. mock true serves two animated made-up hands (mockFrame()) instead of reading a sensor. hz The most frames per second sent to each client (held to 1..120). A slow client skips frames; it never queues them. bin The path to the leap-stream reader program. By default the bridge compiles its C reader on…

records.k: leap bridge bridge server websocket server node 6437 mock leap-bridge ultraleap service leap 橋接 橋接程式 伺服器 websocket 伺服器 node 6437 假手 ultraleap 服務
records.d: 在這台機器上啟動 Leap 橋接程式：一個只綁 loopback 的 WebSocket 與 HTTP 伺服器，把感測器的手送給每一個頁面（只能在 Node 執行）。
records.x: node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs 執行的就是它（加 --mock 得到假手，另有 --port、--hz、--bin、--quiet）。它提供 ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json（LeapJS 通訊協定，2014 到 2021 年所有的瀏覽器草圖講的都是它）、ws://…/raw（原始行）、GET /raw 和 /hands 上以 server-sent events 送的同樣內容，以及 GET /health（來源、服務、裝置、fps、手、用戶端）。任何頁面來源都可以讀取，跟原本的 Leap 服務一樣。 想把橋接程式放進你自己的 Node 程式裡（例如測試）時，就自己呼叫它。連接埠是 7457（那是 The Last Input 和後台監看用的）或 host 不是 loopback，startBridge() 會立刻丟出錯誤。連接埠已被占用，回傳的 promise 會被拒絕，訊息會建議你執行 curl http://127.0.0.1:6437/health。 Node 22 以上，要接真的手，還需要 Ultraleap Hand Tracking 服務，以及第一次啟動時用來編譯讀取程式的 Xcode clang。mock: true 的話兩者都不需要。 port 要監聽的連接埠，沒特別指定就是 DEFAULT_PORT。0 表示隨便挑一個空的。RESERVED_PORTS 裡的連接埠（7457）會被拒絕。 host 要綁定的位址。只允許 loopback（127.0.0.1、::1、localhost）：手的資料絕不會離開這台機器。 mock true 的話，送出兩隻會動的假手（mockFrame()），不讀感測器。 hz 每個用戶端每秒最多收到幾個影格（限制在 1..120）。慢的用戶端會跳過影格，不會排隊。 bin leap-stream 讀取程式的路徑。預設是橋接程式第一次啟動時編譯它的 C 讀取程式（需要 Xcode 命令列工具）並快取起來。 log 每一件值得知道的事（用戶端進出、狀態改變）都會以一行文字呼叫它。 開始監聽之後才完成，結果是 { port, state, health(), close() }：實際的連接埠（port: 0 時有用）、即時狀態、回傳 /health 物件的函式，以及停止一切並回傳 Promise 的函式。

records.d: The four levels of the leap/status signal by name: off 0, bridge 1, service 2, tracking 3.
records.x: A frozen object { off: 0, bridge: 1, service: 2, tracking: 3 }: 0 no bridge, 1 the bridge is there but the tracking service is not, 2 the service is there but no device, 3 tracking. Use it to read the signal without magic numbers: signals.get('leap/status') === STATUS.tracking. Note it is the number published as leap/status; leap.status is a different thing, a string ('tracking', 'no-device' …), and the simulator counts as 3. The code in LeapInput writes the numbers itself and does not read this object, so STATUS is a convenience for your own code. The strings map as: tracking and simulated to 3, no-device to 2, bridge and no-service to 1, the rest to 0.

records.d: leap/status 訊號的四個等級，用名字表示：off 0、bridge 1、service 2、tracking 3。
records.x: 一個凍結的物件 { off: 0, bridge: 1, service: 2, tracking: 3 }：0 沒有橋接、1 有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、2 有服務但沒有裝置、3 追蹤中。讀訊號時可以不用神祕數字：signals.get('leap/status') === STATUS.tracking。注意，發布成 leap/status 的是這個數字。leap.status 是另一回事，它是字串（'tracking'、'no-device' ……），而模擬器算 3。 LeapInput 裡的程式是自己寫入數字，並不讀這個物件，所以 STATUS 只是方便你自己的程式用。字串的對應是：tracking 和 simulated 是 3，no-device 是 2，bridge 和 no-service 是 1，其餘是 0。

records.k: v6 leapjs convert protocol frame converter raw to v6 legacy leap sketches v6 leapjs 轉換 通訊協定 影格轉換 舊版 leap 草圖
records.d: Converts raw hand lines into LeapJS v6 frames, keeping the little state the protocol needs: time visible, smoothed positions and fingertip velocities.
records.x: Every browser sketch written for the old Leap service (LeapJS, 2014 to 2021) speaks the v6 protocol, so the bridge serves it on /v6.json. This class does the conversion: one converter per stream. It is stateful where the protocol is: a hand's timeVisible grows while it stays in view and starts over when it leaves, stabilized… positions are a light low-pass, and tipVelocity is a finite difference between two frames. LeapC gives joints, not bone rotations, so the bone bases are rebuilt from the joints and the palm normal (boneBasis()). Gestures are not synthesised: gestures is always []. box The interaction box written into every frame's interactionBox. smoothing 0..1: how strongly stabilizedPalmPosition and stabilizedTipPosition lag behind (0 follows exactly, close to 1 barely moves).

records.k: v6 leapjs convert protocol frame converter raw to v6 legacy leap sketches v6 leapjs 轉換 通訊協定 影格轉換 舊版 leap 草圖
records.d: 把原始的手資料行轉成 LeapJS v6 影格，並保存通訊協定需要的少量狀態：可見時間、平滑過的位置和指尖速度。
records.x: 所有為舊版 Leap 服務寫的瀏覽器草圖（LeapJS，2014 到 2021 年）講的都是 v6 通訊協定，所以橋接程式在 /v6.json 提供這個格式。這個類別負責轉換：一條串流用一個轉換器。它在通訊協定要求有狀態的地方才有狀態：手在畫面裡時 timeVisible 會增加，離開再回來就重新開始，stabilized… 位置是輕微的低通濾波，tipVelocity 是兩個影格之間的差分。 LeapC 給的是關節，不是骨頭的旋轉，所以骨頭的基底是從關節和掌心法線重建的（boneBasis()）。手勢不會被合成：gestures 永遠是 []。 box 寫進每個影格 interactionBox 的互動範圍盒。 smoothing 0..1：stabilizedPalmPosition 和 stabilizedTipPosition 落後的程度（0 完全跟隨，接近 1 幾乎不動）。

records.x: The bridge sends this (plus bridge: 'open-audiovisual') as soon as a client connects to /v6.json, and LeapInput turns it into the status 'bridge'. Held to 1..6. { serviceVersion: String, version: Number }.

records.d: LeapJS v6 連線的第一則訊息：{ serviceVersion, version }，version 被限制在 1..6，因為 LeapJS 超過 6 會丟出錯誤。
records.x: 用戶端一連到 /v6.json，橋接程式就會送出這則訊息（外加 bridge: 'open-audiovisual'），LeapInput 收到後會把狀態變成 'bridge'。要求 7 會得到 6。 serviceVersion 要回報的追蹤服務版本，例如 '5.20.0'。 version 用戶端要求的通訊協定版本。限制在 1..6。 物件 { serviceVersion: String, version: Number }。

records.d: Tracks up to two hands from the camera with 21 landmarks each and publishes palm position and thumb-to-finger pinch distances as hand/ signals.
records.x: The fine-control tracker: each hand gives two precise continuous controllers, thumb to index and thumb to middle finger, so two hands are four controllers you can pinch. The distances are normalised by the size of your palm (wrist to the base of the middle finger), so moving toward or away from the camera does not change a pinch: stage-robust. It runs on the device with MediaPipe Tasks Vision and downloads nothing until enable(). In a show, createShow({ modules: { hands: true } }) builds one (show.hands) and the L1 panel gets a 🖐 hands button. For each of left and right it publishes hand//present (0 or 1), hand//x and /y (the palm, 0..1; y flipped so 1 is raised), hand//pinch/index and hand//pinch/middle (0..1, 0 = touching, 1 = wide open) and hand//spread (index fingertip to little fingertip, 0..1). A side with no hand in view gets present 0 and keeps its other values. Note that these names do not start with pose/, and are different from the body tracker's. A pinch is a distance, so for "pinch closes" use a route with invert: { source: 'hand/right/pinch/index', target: 'tightness', invert: true, smooth: 0.1 }. If you want pinch start and end as events, LeapInput's gestures do that; HandTracker only gives the continuous distances. Call await hands.enable(): it loads the MediaPipe library from jsDelivr and the hand model from Google's model storage (so it needs the network), asks for the camera (https or localhost, and the user must allow it) and starts the loop. Until then…

records.d: 用鏡頭追蹤最多兩隻手，每隻 21 個關節點，把掌心位置和拇指到手指的捏合距離發布成 hand/ 訊號。
records.x: 精細控制的追蹤器：每隻手提供兩個精確的連續控制，拇指到食指、拇指到中指，所以兩隻手就是四個可以捏的控制。距離會依你的手掌大小（手腕到中指根部）正規化，所以靠近或遠離鏡頭不會改變捏合的值，在舞台上很穩。它在裝置上用 MediaPipe Tasks Vision 執行，在 enable() 之前不會下載任何東西。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { hands: true } }) 會建好一個（show.hands），L1 面板會多出一個 🖐 hands 按鈕。 left 和 right 各自會發布 hand//present（0 或 1）、hand//x 和 /y（掌心，0..1，y 翻轉過，所以 1 是舉高）、hand//pinch/index 和 hand//pinch/middle（0..1，0 = 碰在一起，1 = 張得最開），以及 hand//spread（食指指尖到小指指尖，0..1）。畫面裡沒有手的那一邊，present 會是 0，其他的值維持不變。請注意，這些名稱不是 pose/ 開頭，跟身體追蹤器的不一樣。 捏合是一個距離，所以想要「捏緊的時候變大」，就在路由裡用 invert：{ source: 'hand/right/pinch/index', target: 'tightness', invert: true, smooth: 0.1 }。如果你要把捏合的開始和結束當成事件，LeapInput 的手勢就是做這個的。HandTracker 只提供連續的距離。 要呼叫 await hands.enable()：它會從 jsDelivr 載入 MediaPipe 函式庫、從 Google 的模型儲存空間載入手的模型（所以需要網路）、向瀏覽器要鏡頭（https 或 localhost，使用者也要允許），然後啟動迴圈。在那之前，訊號都停在起始值。 可以讀的欄位：hands（[{ handed: 'left' | 'right', lm }]，lm 是 21 個關節點 { x, y, z }，在鏡頭影像裡，y 向下、沒有左右翻轉）、running、mirror、video。 用到的關節點編號：手腕 0、拇指指尖 4、食指指尖 8、中指指尖 12、小指指尖 20、中指根部 9（掌心位置，也是計算大小的參考）。 signals 要發布進去的 Signals 登錄表。沒有的話，追蹤器照樣會跑、也會更新 hands，只是不發布任何訊號。 mirror 把鏡頭當成鏡子：x 會左右翻轉，MediaPipe 給的左手、右手標籤也會對調，讓訊號跟身體對得上。

records.d: Tracks one body from the camera and publishes wrist positions, wrist speed, hand spread, height and lean as pose/ signals.
records.x: This is the body tracker: one person, 33 landmarks (the BlazePose set), run by MediaPipe Tasks Vision on the device. No video leaves the machine, and nothing is downloaded until you call enable(). For fine finger control use HandTracker instead. In a show, createShow({ modules: { pose: true } }) builds one and the console's L1 panel gets a 🕺 body button that calls enable(); it is show.pose. Signals, all normalised, with y flipped so that 1 means raised and 0 means the bottom of the frame (performance meaning beats pixel meaning): pose/present (0 or 1: someone is visible), pose/hand/left/x and /y, pose/hand/right/x and /y (wrist positions, 0..1), pose/hand/left/v and pose/hand/right/v (wrist speed, 0..1, clamped), pose/hands/spread (distance between the wrists, 0..1), pose/height (nose height, 0..1: crouching to standing) and pose/lean (shoulder-line tilt, −1..1). When nobody is in view only pose/present goes to 0; the others keep their last values. Map these to params ({ source: 'pose/hand/right/y', target: 'energy', smooth: 0.1 }) so a raised hand does what a knob would. The detection runs on every animation frame while running. Call await pose.enable(): it loads the MediaPipe library from jsDelivr and the model from Google's model storage (so it needs the network), asks the browser for the camera (the page needs https or localhost, and the user must allow it), and starts the loop. records.d: 用鏡頭追蹤一個人的身體，把手腕的位置、手腕速度、雙手距離、身高位置和傾斜，發布成 pose/ 訊號。
records.x: 這是身體追蹤器：一個人、33 個關節點（BlazePose 那一套），在裝置上由 MediaPipe Tasks Vision 執行。影像不會離開這台機器，在你呼叫 enable() 之前也不會下載任何東西。要精細控制手指的話，改用 HandTracker。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { pose: true } }) 會建好一個，主控台的 L1 面板會多出一個 🕺 body 按鈕來呼叫 enable()，它就是 show.pose。 訊號全都是正規化的，y 翻轉過，所以 1 是舉高、0 是畫面底部（演出的意義比像素的意義重要）：pose/present（0 或 1：看得到人）、pose/hand/left/x 和 /y、pose/hand/right/x 和 /y（手腕位置，0..1）、pose/hand/left/v 和 pose/hand/right/v（手腕速度，0..1，超過會被夾住）、pose/hands/spread（兩個手腕的距離，0..1）、pose/height（鼻子的高度，0..1：蹲下到站直）和 pose/lean（肩線的傾斜，−1..1）。畫面裡沒人的時候，只有 pose/present 會變成 0，其他的維持最後的值。 把它們映射到參數（{ source: 'pose/hand/right/y', target: 'energy', smooth: 0.1 }），舉起的手就能做旋鈕做的事。偵測在 running 期間每個動畫畫面都會跑。 要呼叫 await pose.enable()：它會從 jsDelivr 載入 MediaPipe 函式庫、從 Google 的模型儲存空間載入模型（所以需要網路）、向瀏覽器要鏡頭（網頁要在 https 或 localhost 底下，使用者也要允許），然後啟動迴圈。在那之前，所有訊號都停在起始值。 可以讀的欄位：landmarks（最新的 33 個原始點 { x, y, z, visibility }，x、y 是鏡頭影像裡的 0..1，y 向下、沒有左右翻轉，看不到人就是 null）、running、mirror、video。 關節點編號（BlazePose）：鼻子 0、肩膀 11 和 12、手腕 15 和 16、髖部 23 和 24。 模型是 MediaPipe 的「lite」姿態偵測器，跑在 GPU 上，一次只追蹤一個姿態。畫面裡有兩個人的話，只會追蹤其中一個。 signals 要發布進去的 Signals 登錄表。沒有的話，追蹤器照樣會跑、也會更新 landmarks，只是不發布任何訊號。 mirror 把鏡頭當成鏡子：x 會左右翻轉，所以往觀看者的右邊移動，x 就變大。對表演者很自然。false 則保留鏡頭本身的左右。

records.k: chord chord detection consonance dissonance triad cluster major minor harmony notes midi gesture window 和弦 和弦偵測 協和度 不協和 三和弦 音叢 大調 小調 和聲 音符 手勢窗口
records.d: Groups notes struck close together into one gesture and analyses it: chord type, consonance, triad and cluster flags, published as chord/ signals.
records.x: This is not a music-theory library. It is a performance semantics layer: raw notes in, one analysed event per gesture out, with features that are made to drive a work. A single note is a seed, a chord a colony, a consonant chord a flourish, a dissonant one decay; rename them for your own piece. In a show, createShow({ modules: { chord: true } }) builds one ({ chord: { window: 120 } } tunes it) and connects it to midi/note/on and midi/note/off, so a MIDI keyboard, the on-screen piano and phones all feed it. Each closed gesture publishes chord/consonance (−1..1), chord/count (0..10), chord/root (the lowest note) and the pulse chord/event, whose payload is the whole analysis: { notes, count, root, vel, pcs, consonance, isConsonant, isDissonant, isTriad, thirdsFraction, dissonanceLevel, chordType }. chordType is one of single, major, minor, sus2, sus4, dim, aug, maj7, min7, dom7, halfdim7, maj9, min9, dom9, six, min6, cluster (a very dissonant pile) or chord (anything else). Inversions resolve to the root-position name. consonance is the average of an interval weight for every pair of notes (an octave or fifth is high, a semitone or tritone is negative). isConsonant is consonance > 0.25 and isDissonant is consonance < −0.15, both only for two notes or more. dissonanceLevel is 0 for none, 1 for mild (a storm warning: foreshadow it) and 2 for severe (three or more notes that are a true cluster: commit to the decay). isTriad is true for major, minor, sus2, sus4, dim and aug, and…

records.k: chord chord detection consonance dissonance triad cluster major minor harmony notes midi gesture window 和弦 和弦偵測 協和度 不協和 三和弦 音叢 大調 小調 和聲 音符 手勢窗口
records.d: 把幾乎同時按下的音歸成一個手勢並分析它：和弦類型、協和度、三和弦與音叢的旗標，發布成 chord/ 訊號。
records.x: 它管的是演出語意，不是樂理：原始的音進去，每個手勢出來一個分析過的事件，特徵都是為了驅動作品而設計的。單一個音是種子，和弦是一群生物，協和的和弦是繁盛，不協和的和弦是衰敗。你可以替自己的作品換掉這些名字。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { chord: true } }) 會建好一個（{ chord: { window: 120 } } 可以調整）並接上 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off，所以 MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的鋼琴和手機都能餵它。 每個收尾的手勢會發布 chord/consonance（−1..1）、chord/count（0..10）、chord/root（最低音）和脈衝 chord/event，脈衝的內容就是整份分析：{ notes, count, root, vel, pcs, consonance, isConsonant, isDissonant, isTriad, thirdsFraction, dissonanceLevel, chordType }。chordType 是 single、major、minor、sus2、sus4、dim、aug、maj7、min7、dom7、halfdim7、maj9、min9、dom9、six、min6、cluster（非常不協和的一堆音）或 chord（其他任何和弦）之一。轉位會被還原成原位和弦的名稱。 consonance 是每一對音的音程權重的平均（八度或五度很高，半音或三全音是負的）。isConsonant 是 consonance > 0.25，isDissonant 是 consonance < −0.15，都只在兩個音以上才成立。dissonanceLevel 0 是沒有，1 是輕微（風暴警報：預告它），2 是嚴重（三個音以上的真正音叢：直接進入衰敗）。isTriad 在 major、minor、sus2、sus4、dim、aug 時為真，thirdsFraction 是相鄰兩個音剛好相差 3 或 4 個半音的比例，這樣就分得出「真正疊起來的三度」和「幾個協和的音」。 用 noteOn(note, vel)（和 noteOff(note)）餵它，或讓 createShow 從 midi/note/on|off 餵。要等到最後一個 noteOn 之後 window 毫秒才會發布，所以結果是非同步的。analyze() 是例外：它立刻回傳，也不需要任何前置動作。 呼叫 analyze() 時音要由低到高：root 就是第一個音，偵測器會替你排序，但直接呼叫就不會。 像 [60, 62] 這樣的大二度，類型會是 cluster（沒有範本符合，而且協和度低於 −0.3），不過它的 dissonanceLevel 只有 1。要到 2 至少得有三個音。 手勢窗口不知道還按著的音：已經按著的一個音，不會跟你後來彈的兩個音湊成一個和弦。 window 最後一個 noteOn 之後等幾毫秒，就把這個手勢收尾並分析。彼此相隔不到這個時間按下的音，算同一個和弦。 onChord 每次一個手勢收尾，就以分析結果物件呼叫一次。 signals 要把 chord/ 發布進去的 Signals 登錄表。訊號在建立偵測器時就宣告好了。

records.k: osc open sound control touchdesigner max reaper spat udp bridge send flush output lighting osc open sound control touchdesigner max reaper 空間化 udp 橋接 送出 輸出 燈光
records.d: Sends OSC messages from the browser to TouchDesigner, Max, Reaper or a spatialiser, batched once per frame, through a small local bridge.
records.x: A browser cannot send UDP, so OscOut posts batches of messages to a ~100-line Node program, packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js, which sends them on as OSC packets. Start it with node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js 7456 192.168.1.50 3456 (HTTP port, target host, UDP port; the defaults are 7456 127.0.0.1 3456). Then send(address, args) as often as you like and flush() once per frame: only the latest message per address survives a frame, because a position stream does not need its in-between values. Numbers go out as OSC floats (what Spat, Reaper and TouchDesigner expect), and anything else as a string. createShow() does not create an OscOut: make one, call enable(), flush it from onFrame, and if you like hand it to the worlds as show.stage.io.osc and to the Layers panel as show.app.osc (which then shows the OSC rate). The bridge must be running, and you must await osc.enable() first: it probes GET /health and answers false if nobody is there. Until it succeeds flush() just throws the queue away. On a public https page, Chrome asks permission before the page may reach 127.0.0.1. Fields and hooks: enabled, udp (the target the bridge reported), onStatus = (ok, info) => {} and onMsg = (address, args) => {} (high frequency: use sparingly). If the bridge disappears, the first failed flush calls onStatus(false, 'bridge lost'), and after more than 30 failed flushes in a row enabled turns false by itself, with no further message. Call enable() again to resume. The messages of a…

records.k: osc open sound control touchdesigner max reaper spat udp bridge send flush output lighting osc open sound control touchdesigner max reaper 空間化 udp 橋接 送出 輸出 燈光
records.d: 把 OSC 訊息從瀏覽器送到 TouchDesigner、Max、Reaper 或空間化軟體，每個畫面打包一批，透過一個本機的小橋接程式。
records.x: 瀏覽器沒辦法送 UDP，所以 OscOut 把一批一批的訊息用 POST 送給一支大約一百行的 Node 程式 packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js，由它再當成 OSC 封包送出去。用 node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js 7456 192.168.1.50 3456 啟動它（HTTP 連接埠、目標主機、UDP 連接埠，預設是 7456 127.0.0.1 3456）。然後想送多少次都可以 send(address, args)，每個畫面 flush() 一次：每個畫面裡，每個位址只有最後一則訊息會送出去，因為位置的串流不需要中間的值。 數字會當成 OSC 浮點數送出（Spat、Reaper 和 TouchDesigner 期待的格式），其他東西一律當成字串。createShow() 不會建立 OscOut：你自己建一個、呼叫 enable()，在 onFrame 裡 flush，想要的話再用 show.stage.io.osc 交給世界，用 show.app.osc 交給 Layers 面板（面板就會顯示 OSC 的訊息率）。 橋接程式必須在跑，而且你要先 await osc.enable()：它會探測 GET /health，沒有人在就回答 false。在成功之前，flush() 只會把佇列丟掉。在公開的 https 頁面上，Chrome 會在頁面連到 127.0.0.1 之前先詢問權限。 欄位與掛鉤：enabled、udp（橋接程式回報的目的地）、onStatus = (ok, info) => {} 和 onMsg = (address, args) => {}（頻率很高，請節制使用）。 橋接程式消失的話，第一次失敗的 flush 會呼叫 onStatus(false, 'bridge lost')，連續失敗超過 30 次之後，enabled 會自己變成 false，不再有任何訊息。想恢復就再呼叫一次 enable()。失敗那次 flush 的訊息會遺失。 每個數字都會當成 32 位元浮點數送出，整數也一樣（橋接程式檔案開頭的註解提到整數，但它的程式碼只會寫浮點數）。接收端如果需要整數，請在那邊轉換。 url OSC 橋接程式的位址（它的 HTTP 連接埠，不是 UDP 的目的地）。

records.k: timeout watchdog 500 ms safe value timeoutMs 逾時 看門狗 500 毫秒 安全值 timeoutMs
records.d: The watchdog time when the config does not say: 500 milliseconds without a value, and a channel is put on its safe value.
records.x: It is the default of timeoutMs in the bridge config (the minimum allowed is 20). OutClient re-sends held values every third of whatever the bridge reports, so a still slider is not mistaken for a dead page. Lower it for hardware that must stop quickly, but keep it above the slowest frame your page may have.

records.k: timeout watchdog 500 ms safe value timeoutMs 逾時 看門狗 500 毫秒 安全值 timeoutMs
records.d: 設定檔沒寫的時候，看門狗的時間：500 毫秒沒有收到值，頻道就會被放到它的安全值。
records.x: 這是橋接設定裡 timeoutMs 的預設值（允許的最小值是 20）。OutClient 每隔橋接程式回報的時間的三分之一就重送目前的值，所以停著不動的滑桿不會被誤認為當掉的頁面。需要硬體很快停下來的話可以調低它，但要比你的頁面可能出現的最慢畫面更長。

records.k: glob wildcard pattern match channel match regular expression light/* 萬用字元 樣式 比對 頻道比對 正規表示式 light/*
records.d: Turns a channel glob like light/ into the regular expression the bridge matches channel names with: only is special, and it crosses slashes.
records.x: The match of a channel rule and the keys of safe in the bridge config are globs, and this is how both are read. Remember that also crosses slashes: light/ fits light/0/r, and alone fits every channel. glob The pattern. matches any run of characters, slashes included. Everything else, including ., ? and +, matches itself. An anchored expression: globToRegExp('light/') is /^light\/.$/.

records.k: glob wildcard pattern match channel match regular expression light/* 萬用字元 樣式 比對 頻道比對 正規表示式 light/*
records.d: 把像 light/ 這樣的頻道萬用字元，轉成橋接程式用來比對頻道名稱的正規表示式：只有 有特殊意義，而且它可以跨過斜線。
records.x: 橋接設定裡，頻道規則的 match 和 safe 的鍵都是萬用字元，兩者都是用它來解讀。請記得 也能跨過斜線：light/ 符合 light/0/r，只寫 就符合每一個頻道。 glob 樣式。 符合任何一串字元，包含斜線。其他一切，包括 .、? 和 +，都只符合它自己。 一個固定頭尾的正規表示式：globToRegExp('light/') 是 /^light\/.$/。

records.x: A thin helper around fs.readFileSync and JSON.parse. A missing file or invalid JSON throws one error that names the file (its text is written in Chinese in the code). The command line uses it for --config out.json; in your own program you may just as well pass an object to startBridge({ config }). file The path of the JSON file, such as out.json (copy packages/out/bridge/out.example.json to start). The parsed config, unchecked: startBridge() is what validates it.

records.k: out output hardware wled led strip motor serial dmx ddp channel watchdog bridge websocket lights set 輸出 硬體 wled 燈條 馬達 序列埠 ddp 頻道 看門狗 橋接 websocket 燈光
records.d: The page side of the out-bridge: set(channel, value) sends a number to a named hardware channel, at most once per frame, and keeps the connection alive.
records.x: Hardware needs a number, and a page has a number: out.set('light/0/r', 0.8). The channel name is yours (a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /, up to 128 characters) and the bridge (startBridge()) decides from its config where that channel goes: a WLED strip, a serial motor board, an OSC address. Values are plain numbers; the convention is 0..1. Several set() calls on one channel inside one frame leave as one value, the last. In a lab work lab.out is this class. It keeps the connection alive on its own: it reconnects with a growing delay (250 ms doubling up to 5 s), resends everything it knows after a reconnect (a restarted bridge has forgotten it all), and while the socket is open it re-sends the held values every timeoutMs / 3 of the bridge's watchdog, so a slider that stands still is not mistaken for a frozen page. If the page really freezes, that heartbeat stops and the bridge puts the hardware on its safe values. Call connect() (the bridge must be running: node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json), or simulate() for no hardware at all. set() before the socket is open is not lost: it waits in last and goes out on open. Fields to read: status ('closed', 'connecting', 'open', 'sim'), last ({ channel: last value given to set() }, also in simulate mode), sent (values actually put on the wire: less than the number of set() calls because of coalescing) and bridge (the bridge's last status message). On the wire a single value is { "type": "set", "ch", "v" } and several are {…

records.k: out output hardware wled led strip motor serial dmx ddp channel watchdog bridge websocket lights set 輸出 硬體 wled 燈條 馬達 序列埠 ddp 頻道 看門狗 橋接 websocket 燈光
records.d: 輸出橋接程式在頁面這一側的部分：set(channel, value) 把一個數字送到有名字的硬體頻道，每個畫面最多送一次，並且維持連線。
records.x: 硬體需要的是數字，而頁面有數字：out.set('light/0/r', 0.8)。頻道名稱由你決定（a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /，最長 128 個字元），這個頻道要送去哪裡，由橋接程式（startBridge()）依它的設定決定：WLED 燈條、序列埠馬達板、OSC 位址。值就是普通的數字，慣例是 0..1。同一個畫面裡對同一個頻道呼叫好幾次 set()，只會送出最後一個值。在實驗室的作品裡，lab.out 就是這個類別。 它自己會維持連線：用愈來愈長的間隔重連（250 毫秒起，加倍到 5 秒），重連之後把它知道的值全部重送一遍（重新啟動的橋接程式什麼都忘了），而且在 socket 開著的時候，每隔橋接程式的看門狗時間的三分之一就重送一次目前的值，所以停著不動的滑桿不會被誤認為當掉的頁面。如果頁面真的凍結，這個心跳就會停，橋接程式就讓硬體回到安全值。 要呼叫 connect()（橋接程式必須在跑：node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json），或呼叫 simulate() 完全不接硬體。在 socket 開啟之前呼叫 set() 不會遺失：它會先放在 last，等開啟之後送出。 可以讀的欄位：status（'closed'、'connecting'、'open'、'sim'）、last（{ 頻道: 最後給 set() 的值 }，模擬模式下也有）、sent（真正送上線路的值：因為合併，會比 set() 呼叫次數少），以及 bridge（橋接程式最近的狀態訊息）。 在線路上，單一個值是 { "type": "set", "ch", "v" }，多個值是 { "type": "batch", "items": [{ "ch", "v" }, …] }，前面先有一則 { "type": "hello", "id" }。 在公開的 https 頁面上，Chrome 會在頁面連到 127.0.0.1 之前詢問權限，被拒絕的話，狀態會一直停在 'connecting'。 url 橋接程式的 WebSocket 位址。預設是 OUT_DEFAULT_URL，也就是 ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out。 id 這個頁面的名字（作品的 id），會在 "hello" 訊息裡送給橋接程式，並顯示在它的紀錄裡。 WebSocket 要用的 WebSocket 建構函式。預設是全域的那個（Node 22 也有）。傳你自己的，就能在沒有網路的情況下測試。 schedule 一個在下一個畫面執行一次回呼的函式。預設是 requestAnimationFrame（分頁被藏起來或沒有 requestAnimationFrame 時，改用 16 毫秒的計時器）。 maxBackoffMs 重新連線之間最長的等待時間，單位是毫秒。 minBackoffMs 重新連線之間第一次的等待時間。每次加倍，直到 maxBackoffMs。
