records.k: out bridge bridge wled ddp serial osc sink watchdog safe value hardware config channels node server 輸出橋接 橋接程式 wled ddp 序列埠 osc 看門狗 安全值 硬體 設定檔 頻道 node 伺服器
records.d: Starts the out-bridge: a loopback WebSocket server that routes channel values from the page to hardware sinks, with a watchdog that falls back to safe values (Node only).
records.x: This is what node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json runs (also --port, --no-watchdog, --quiet; the environment variable OUT_BRIDGE_PORT). It serves ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out, which understands { type: 'hello', id }, { type: 'set', ch, v }, { type: 'batch', items } and { type: 'status' }, and answers with { type: 'status', … }; GET /health reports the sinks, the channel count, the clients and the time since the last value. Channel names are a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . / up to 128 characters, values must be finite numbers, and there is room for 4096 channels. The config routes channels: channels is a list of { match, sink, … } and the first rule whose match glob fits the channel name takes it ( means anything, slashes included); a channel no rule fits is counted and dropped. The sinks are log (stdout), udp-json (UDP, {"ch","v"}), osc (UDP, address "/" + channel, one float32), ddp (WLED over UDP 4048: light//r|g|b, 0..1, pixel index from 0, up to 10000 pixels) and serial (a device path, ch value lines or JSON, latest value only). safe maps a channel glob to its safe value, timeoutMs (default 500, at least 20) is the watchdog time, and allowOrigins lists the page origins that may connect (without it any page on this machine can). The watchdog: a channel that has a safe value and gets no new value for timeoutMs is sent its safe value once (a new value re-arms it). When the last client disconnects, every channel the bridge has seen that has a safe value gets it at once,…

records.k: out bridge bridge wled ddp serial osc sink watchdog safe value hardware config channels node server 輸出橋接 橋接程式 wled ddp 序列埠 osc 看門狗 安全值 硬體 設定檔 頻道 node 伺服器
records.d: 啟動輸出橋接程式：一個只綁 loopback 的 WebSocket 伺服器，把頁面傳來的頻道值導向硬體輸出，並有看門狗在頁面沒聲音時退回安全值（只能在 Node 執行）。
records.x: node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json 執行的就是它（另有 --port、--no-watchdog、--quiet，以及環境變數 OUT_BRIDGE_PORT）。它提供 ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out，聽得懂 { type: 'hello', id }、{ type: 'set', ch, v }、{ type: 'batch', items } 和 { type: 'status' }，並以 { type: 'status', … } 回應。GET /health 回報輸出、頻道數、用戶端和距離上一個值的時間。頻道名稱是 a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /，最長 128 個字元，值必須是有限數，最多容納 4096 個頻道。 設定檔負責把頻道導向各處：channels 是 { match, sink, … } 的清單，第一條 match 萬用字元符合頻道名稱的規則就接手它（ 代表任何東西，包含斜線）。沒有規則符合的頻道會被計數然後丟掉。輸出（sink）有 log（標準輸出）、udp-json（UDP，{"ch","v"}）、osc（UDP，位址是 "/" + 頻道，一個 float32）、ddp（用 UDP 4048 控制 WLED：light//r|g|b，0..1，像素索引從 0 開始，最多 10000 個像素）和 serial（裝置路徑，ch value 的行或 JSON，只送最新的值）。safe 把頻道萬用字元對應到它的安全值，timeoutMs（預設 500，至少 20）是看門狗的時間，allowOrigins 列出允許連線的頁面來源（沒寫的話，這台機器上的任何頁面都能連）。 看門狗：有安全值的頻道，如果 timeoutMs 內沒有收到新的值，就會被送出一次安全值（新的值進來會重新啟動它）。最後一個用戶端斷線的時候，橋接程式見過的每個有安全值的頻道會立刻得到它的安全值，正常關閉時也一樣。它不涵蓋橋接程式從沒聽過的頻道，也不涵蓋被 SIGKILL 殺掉的橋接程式。 連接埠是 7457（那是 The Last Input 和後台監看用的）、host 不是 loopback、設定有問題（沒有 channels、不認得的 sink、safe 的值不是數字、timeoutMs 小於 20），它都會立刻丟出錯誤。連接埠已被占用，回傳的 promise 會被拒絕。 Node 22 以上。各個輸出需要它要連的對象：ddp 要有 WLED 裝置，serial 要有裝置檔，osc 要有人在聽。 橋接程式丟出的、以及回傳給頁面的錯誤訊息，在程式碼裡是用中文寫的，所以不管頁面是什麼語言，頁面上看到的可能是中文。 port 要監聽的連接埠，沒特別指定就是 DEFAULT_PORT。0 表示隨便挑一個空的。RESERVED_PORTS 裡的連接埠（7457）會被拒絕。 host 要綁定的位址。只允許 loopback。 config 路由設定：{ channels: [{ match, sink, … }], safe: { glob: value }, timeoutMs, allowOrigins }（見說明）。null 的話，所有頻道都送到 log 輸出。loadConfig(file) 可以從 JSON 檔讀取。 watchdog false 會關掉看門狗：永遠不送安全值（測試用它來證明做事的是看門狗）。 log…

records.k: learn wizard wizard map knobs in order learn bind midi learn skip back stop 精靈 依序綁定 learn 學習 綁定 旋鈕 略過 上一個
records.d: Binds a list of params one after another: it arms learn for the first, you turn a knob, it binds it and arms the next. Skip, back and stop steer it.
records.x: Binding twelve params one by one with the learn chip means twelve clicks and twelve guesses about what to touch next. The wizard walks the list for you: start() arms learn for keys[0], wizard.current says which param it is waiting for ('Turn a knob for: hue (1/12)'), you move a control, it is bound and the next one is armed. At the end learn is disarmed. The console's 🎛 map knobs in order button is this class. It is pure logic on top of the mapper, with no screen of its own. Learn only ever adds routes, so running the wizard twice puts a second control on a param instead of losing the first. While it runs, it owns learn mode: call sync() every frame so that a click on some other learn chip cannot leave it waiting for nothing. Fields to read: active, done (the run reached the end), index, total, order, and added ([{ key, source }], what was bound in this run). While it runs the wizard wraps the mapper's onLearn and puts yours back when it ends, so your own onLearn keeps being called. mapper The Mapper to bind through. keys The param keys to bind, in order, or a function that returns them (it is called when start() runs). onChange Called with the wizard whenever what a banner would show changes: the current param, the position, finished or not.

records.k: learn wizard wizard map knobs in order learn bind midi learn skip back stop 精靈 依序綁定 learn 學習 綁定 旋鈕 略過 上一個
records.d: 依序綁定一整串參數：先替第一個備好 learn，你轉一個旋鈕，它就綁上去，再備好下一個。skip、back、stop 可以操控它。
records.x: 用 learn 標籤一個一個綁十二個參數，就是點十二次，還要猜十二次下一個該碰哪裡。精靈替你走完整份清單：start() 替 keys[0] 備好 learn，wizard.current 告訴你它在等哪個參數（「Turn a knob for: hue (1/12)」），你動一個控制項，它就綁上去，然後備好下一個。全部結束後，learn 會解除。主控台的 🎛 map knobs in order 按鈕就是這個類別。 它是建在映射上面的純邏輯，沒有自己的畫面。learn 只會新增路由，所以跑兩次精靈，是替參數多加一個控制項，不會弄丟第一個。它在跑的時候擁有 learn 模式：請每個畫面呼叫 sync()，這樣有人點了別的 learn 標籤，也不會讓它空等。 可以讀的欄位：active、done（這一輪走到了最後）、index、total、order，以及 added（[{ key, source }]，這一輪綁了什麼）。 精靈在跑的時候會包住映射的 onLearn，結束時再還給你，所以你自己的 onLearn 照樣會被呼叫。 mapper 要透過它綁定的 Mapper。 keys 要綁定的參數 key，依序排列。也可以是回傳它們的函式（在 start() 執行時呼叫）。 onChange 只要橫幅會顯示的內容改變（目前的參數、位置、有沒有結束），就以這個精靈本身呼叫。

records.k: load map ?map= fetch map map url import from url share mapping load mapping file 載入映射 ?map= 抓映射檔 從網址匯入 分享映射 映射網址
records.d: Fetches a map file from an address (what ?map= calls) and puts it on the mapper; it never throws and never blocks the show.
records.x: Fetches the address with credentials: 'omit', and importMap()s the text. Any failure (refused address, no fetch, the server answered 404, offline, a site that blocks cross-origin reads, a timeout, a file that is not a map) lands in the report and in mapper.report, where the console shows it, and the routes stay as they were. It is async, so createShow() does not wait for it and the show starts regardless. A map on another site must be served with CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: ); raw GitHub files and gists are. In a show you rarely call it: open the page with ?map=, or pass map: 'maps/a.json' to createShow(). mapper The Mapper to import into. value The address of the map file, checked by parseMapUrl() first. base The page address that relative addresses resolve against. fetchImpl The function that does the request. Replace it to test without a network. timeoutMs Give up after this many milliseconds. The report: what mapper.importMap() returned (source: 'url', address, added, skipped …), or { ok: false, source: 'url', address, error }. The same report is kept in mapper.report.

records.k: load map ?map= fetch map map url import from url share mapping load mapping file 載入映射 ?map= 抓映射檔 從網址匯入 分享映射 映射網址
records.d: 從一個網址抓映射檔（?map= 呼叫的就是它）並放到映射上，絕不丟出例外，也不會卡住演出。
records.x: 用 credentials: 'omit' 去抓這個網址，再把文字交給 importMap()。任何失敗（網址被拒絕、沒有 fetch、伺服器回 404、離線、擋住跨來源讀取的網站、逾時、檔案不是映射檔）都會寫進報告和 mapper.report，主控台會顯示出來，路由維持原樣。它是非同步的，所以 createShow() 不會等它，演出照常開始。 別的網站上的映射檔必須用 CORS 提供（Access-Control-Allow-Origin: ），raw GitHub 檔案和 gist 都可以。做演出的時候很少直接呼叫它：開頁面時加上 ?map=，或在 createShow() 傳 map: 'maps/a.json' 就行了。 mapper 要匯入的 Mapper。 value 映射檔的網址，會先經過 parseMapUrl() 檢查。 base 相對網址據以解析的頁面網址。 fetchImpl 真正發出請求的函式。換掉它，就能在沒有網路的情況下測試。 timeoutMs 超過這麼多毫秒就放棄。 報告：mapper.importMap() 的回傳值（source: 'url'、address、added、skipped ……），或 { ok: false, source: 'url', address, error }。同一份報告也存在 mapper.report。

records.k: map format openav.map map file format json 映射檔 格式 openav.map json
records.d: The text "openav.map": the value of format in every map file. A file with another format is refused.
records.x: A map file is JSON with "format": "openav.map", a version, a world name and a list of routes. parseMap() refuses anything whose format is not this string, so you cannot import some other tool's JSON by accident. The one exception is a bare array (what mapper.toJSON() returns), which is read as version 0.

records.k: map format openav.map map file format json 映射檔 格式 openav.map json
records.d: 文字 "openav.map"：每個映射檔裡 format 的值。格式不同的檔案會被拒絕。
records.x: 映射檔是 JSON，裡面有 "format": "openav.map"、version、world 名稱和一份 routes 清單。parseMap() 會拒絕 format 不是這個字串的東西，所以不會誤把別的工具的 JSON 匯進來。唯一的例外是單純的陣列（mapper.toJSON() 回傳的那種），會被當成版本 0 來讀。

records.k: map size limit 256 KB max routes map file 映射檔大小 上限 256 KB 路由數量
records.d: The longest map text parseMap() will read: 262144, which is 256 KB. Longer text is refused without being parsed.
records.x: The limit is compared with the length of the text (characters), before any parsing, so a huge file cannot freeze the page. A map with more than 500 routes is refused as well, whatever its size.

records.k: map size limit 256 KB max routes map file 映射檔大小 上限 256 KB 路由數量
records.d: parseMap() 願意讀的映射文字長度上限：262144，也就是 256 KB。更長的文字不會解析，直接拒絕。
records.x: 這個上限是拿文字的長度（字元數）來比，在任何解析之前就比，所以很大的檔案不會讓頁面卡住。路由超過 500 條的映射檔也會被拒絕，不管大小。

records.k: map version version map file compatibility 映射檔版本 版本 相容
records.d: The newest map file version this build reads and writes: 1. A file with a higher version is refused with a message.
records.x: serializeMap() writes this number and parseMap() accepts any version from 1 up to it. A newer file gets the message "this build of OAV reads up to version 1. Update OAV or re-export it." A file with no valid version is refused too. Only a bare array of routes counts as version 0.

records.k: map version version map file compatibility 映射檔版本 版本 相容
records.d: 這個版本能讀也能寫的映射檔最新版本：1。版本更高的檔案會被拒絕並給出訊息。
records.x: serializeMap() 寫入這個數字，parseMap() 接受從 1 到它之間的任何版本。更新的檔案會得到這句訊息：this build of OAV reads up to version 1. Update OAV or re-export it. 沒有合法 version 的檔案也會被拒絕。只有單純的路由陣列會被當成版本 0。

records.k: mapper mapping route routes learn midi learn curve smooth invert window inMin outMin source target bind connect signal to param 映射 路由 接線 綁定 曲線 平滑 反轉 輸入窗 學習 訊號接參數 覆寫
records.d: Connects signals to params: it holds a list of routes (a window, a curve, smoothing) and writes the matching param whenever a signal arrives.
records.x: The mapper is the only component that connects signals to params, and everything it knows is a list of routes, plain objects. mapper.addRoute({ source: 'midi/cc/74', target: 'bloom' }) makes the param bloom follow the signal midi/cc/74. One signal may drive several params, one param may listen to several signals (the last writer wins), and learn adds routes, it never replaces them. In a show, createShow() builds one, loads the saved routes (or adds the ones you declared in routes) and returns it as show.mapper. A route needs only source and target; addRoute() fills in the rest and returns the stored route: When a signal arrives, each enabled route with that source does five things in order: take the window ((value - inMin) / (inMax - inMin), clamped to 0..1), invert if asked, apply the curve, scale into outMin..outMax, and write. With smooth: 0 the param is overridden at once. With smooth > 0 the result becomes a target that update(dt) glides toward: after smooth seconds the param has covered about 63% of the way. If the target param is a pulse param, the route fires it instead: on every event of a pulse signal, or when a continuous source rises past 0.5. Learn is generalised MIDI-learn: mapper.learn('bloom'), then move something. The first signal that moves by at least 5% of its declared range (a knob, a hand, a phone tilt), or the first pulse that fires (a key, a pad), becomes the source of a new route with the default settings. Calling learn('bloom') again cancels it.…

records.k: mapper mapping route routes learn midi learn curve smooth invert window inMin outMin source target bind connect signal to param 映射 路由 接線 綁定 曲線 平滑 反轉 輸入窗 學習 訊號接參數 覆寫
records.d: 把訊號接到參數：它手上有一份路由清單（輸入窗、曲線、平滑），每當訊號到來，就寫入對應的參數。
records.x: 映射是唯一把訊號接到參數的元件，它知道的一切就是一份路由清單，每條路由是個普通物件。mapper.addRoute({ source: 'midi/cc/74', target: 'bloom' }) 讓參數 bloom 跟著訊號 midi/cc/74 走。一個訊號可以驅動好幾個參數，一個參數也可以聽好幾個訊號（最後寫入的算數），learn 只會新增路由，不會取代。在演出裡，createShow() 會建好一個，載入存起來的路由（或加入你在 routes 宣告的），用 show.mapper 回傳。 一條路由只需要 source 和 target，其餘由 addRoute() 補上，並回傳存下來的路由： 訊號到來的時候，每一條啟用中、source 相符的路由會依序做五件事：取輸入窗（(value - inMin) / (inMax - inMin)，限制在 0..1）、需要的話反轉、套用曲線、縮放到 outMin..outMax、然後寫入。smooth: 0 時參數立刻被覆寫。smooth > 0 時，結果變成一個目標值，由 update(dt) 慢慢滑過去：經過 smooth 秒，參數走完大約 63% 的距離。如果目標是脈衝參數，路由改成觸發它：脈衝訊號每來一次就觸發，連續訊號則是往上越過 0.5 的那一刻觸發。 Learn 是通用版的 MIDI-learn：呼叫 mapper.learn('bloom')，然後動一個東西。第一個移動超過其宣告範圍 5% 的訊號（旋鈕、手、手機傾斜），或第一個觸發的脈衝（按鍵、打擊墊），就會成為一條使用預設值的新路由的來源。再呼叫一次 learn('bloom') 就取消。因為任何脈衝都會立刻被綁定，learn 之前請先把鼓機停掉。 先建好訊號和參數，再建映射。平滑的路由（smooth > 0）只會在 update(dt) 裡寫入參數，所以每個畫面都要呼叫 mapper.update(dt)（createShow() 會做）。 路由把參數寫成覆寫值，而覆寫是黏住的：映射的訊號一動，時間軸就不再驅動那個參數，直到你呼叫 params.clearOverride(key)。 平滑的路由只要訊號來過一次，之後每個畫面都會繼續寫入它最後的目標值，所以就算 clearOverride、甚至用 enabled = false 靜音，參數仍然是被覆寫的。要把參數還給時間軸，請移除那條路由。 在 createShow() 裡，路由加進去的時間比聲音引擎登記 sound/ 參數還早，所以接到 sound/cutoff 的路由要明確寫上 outMin: 100, outMax: 8000。 更多內容與存檔規則：映射。 signals 要監聽的 Signals 登錄表。映射一建立就訂閱所有訊號，所以路由一加進去就生效。 params 要寫入的 Params。路由會把目標參數寫成覆寫值。 profile 這個映射在 localStorage 儲存路由時用的名字（openav.map.），也是匯出的映射檔裡的 world 名稱。createShow() 用的是世界的名字。 onChange 路由改變或匯入報告改變的時候呼叫，不帶參數（讓介面重畫用）。 onLearn learn 模式綁定了一個訊號的時候，以 onLearn(route, signalName) 呼叫。

records.k: parse map read map validate map import map map file json check map 讀取映射 解析映射 檢查映射 匯入映射 映射檔 驗證
records.d: Reads and cleans a map file (JSON text or a parsed value) without touching any mapper; it never throws.
records.x: Use it to validate a file before you import it, or to show what is inside one. It refuses, with a plain-language error, text that is not JSON, text longer than MAP_MAX_BYTES, an object whose format is not MAP_FORMAT, a missing or newer version, no routes list, and more than 500 routes. What it accepts is cleaned: a route without a string signal and param is dropped (and counted in dropped), unknown keys disappear, numbers must be finite, an unknown curve becomes 'linear', smooth is held to 0..60 seconds, and only invert: true inverts. A route is on unless it says enabled: false. input The JSON text of a map file, an already parsed map object, or a bare array of routes (version 0). { ok: true, version, world, routes, dropped } or { ok: false, error }. Each route is { signal, param, curve, inMin, inMax, outMin?, outMax?, smooth, invert, enabled }; dropped counts the entries that were not routes.

records.k: parse map read map validate map import map map file json check map 讀取映射 解析映射 檢查映射 匯入映射 映射檔 驗證
records.d: 讀取並整理一份映射檔（JSON 文字或已解析的值），不會動到任何映射，也絕不丟出例外。
records.x: 用它在匯入之前檢查檔案，或看看檔案裡有什麼。下列情形它會用白話的 error 拒絕：文字不是 JSON、文字比 MAP_MAX_BYTES 長、物件的 format 不是 MAP_FORMAT、version 缺少或比較新、沒有 routes 清單，以及超過 500 條路由。 接受的內容都會被整理過：沒有字串 signal 和 param 的路由會被丟掉（並算進 dropped），不認得的欄位會消失，數字必須有限，不認得的 curve 變成 'linear'，smooth 限制在 0 到 60 秒，只有 invert: true 才會反轉。路由除非寫了 enabled: false，否則是開著的。 input 映射檔的 JSON 文字、已經解析好的映射物件，或單純的路由陣列（版本 0）。 { ok: true, version, world, routes, dropped } 或 { ok: false, error }。每條路由是 { signal, param, curve, inMin, inMax, outMin?, outMax?, smooth, invert, enabled }。dropped 是不算路由而被丟掉的項目數。

records.k: map url ?map= url check https same origin cors load map from address 映射網址 ?map= 網址檢查 https 同源 從網址載入
records.d: Decides whether a ?map= address may be fetched: same origin, or an absolute https URL, and nothing else.
records.x: A map file named in the page address is somebody else's data, so the rules are strict. Accepted: an address on the same origin as base (any scheme, so plain http://localhost works for a page served from there), or an absolute https: address. Refused: an empty address, one longer than 2048 characters, one that is not a URL, one carrying a user name or password, http: to another host, and data:, javascript:, file:, blob: and every other scheme. loadMapUrl() runs this check before it fetches anything. value The address as typed: absolute, or relative to base. base The page address that relative addresses resolve against, and that "same origin" is judged by. Usually location.href. { ok: true, url } with the resolved address, or { ok: false, error }.

records.k: map url ?map= url check https same origin cors load map from address 映射網址 ?map= 網址檢查 https 同源 從網址載入
records.d: 判斷一個 ?map= 的網址能不能去抓：同源的，或絕對的 https 網址，其他一律不行。
records.x: 網址列上指定的映射檔是別人的資料，所以規則很嚴。接受：跟 base 同源的網址（任何通訊協定，所以從 http://localhost 提供的頁面用 http://localhost 也行），或絕對的 https: 網址。拒絕：空網址、超過 2048 個字元、不是網址、帶有帳號或密碼、指向別的主機的 http:，以及 data:、javascript:、file:、blob: 和其他所有通訊協定。loadMapUrl() 在抓任何東西之前都會先跑這個檢查。 value 輸入的網址：絕對網址，或相對於 base 的網址。 base 相對網址據以解析、「同源」據以判斷的頁面網址。通常是 location.href。 { ok: true, url }（解析後的網址），或 { ok: false, error }。

records.k: serialize map export map save map map file json export routes 匯出映射 儲存映射 映射檔 序列化 json 匯出路由
records.d: Builds the portable map file object from a list of routes: { format, version, world, exported, routes }.
records.x: Routes in a map file are named by signal and param, never by id, so the file can travel between worlds. mapper.exportMap() calls this for you; use serializeMap() directly when you build routes by hand or want a fixed date. Missing inMin/inMax become 0 and 1, missing curve is 'linear', and the output range is 0..1 unless the route has outMin/outMax. routes Routes in the mapper's own shape (what mapper.toJSON() returns: source, target, inMin, outMax …). world The world name written into the file. Importing into another world drops the output ranges. now The time written as exported (an ISO string). Pass a fixed date to get the same file twice. { format: 'openav.map', version: 1, world, exported, routes: [{ signal, param, curve, range: { in: [inMin, inMax], out: [outMin, outMax] }, smooth, invert }] }. A muted route also carries enabled: false.

records.k: serialize map export map save map map file json export routes 匯出映射 儲存映射 映射檔 序列化 json 匯出路由
records.d: 把一份路由清單做成可攜的映射檔物件：{ format, version, world, exported, routes }。
records.x: 映射檔裡的路由是用訊號和參數的名字來指，不用 id，所以檔案可以在不同世界之間搬運。mapper.exportMap() 會替你呼叫它。自己手寫路由、或想要固定日期時，才需要直接用 serializeMap()。沒寫的 inMin/inMax 會變成 0 和 1，沒寫的 curve 是 'linear'，沒有 outMin/outMax 的話輸出範圍是 0..1。 routes 映射本身格式的路由（mapper.toJSON() 回傳的那種：source、target、inMin、outMax ……）。 world 寫進檔案的世界名稱。匯入到別的世界時，輸出範圍會被丟掉。 now 寫成 exported 的時間（ISO 字串）。傳一個固定的日期，就能得到兩次相同的檔案。 { format: 'openav.map', version: 1, world, exported, routes: [{ signal, param, curve, range: { in: [inMin, inMax], out: [outMin, outMax] }, smooth, invert }] }。被靜音的路由會多一個 enabled: false。

records.k: bus event emitter events on emit off publish subscribe pubsub listener 事件 發射器 匯流排 訂閱 發布 監聽 回呼
records.d: A minimal event emitter: on(event, cb), emit(event, payload), off(event, cb). No wildcards, no async.
records.x: new Bus() is a tiny publish and subscribe helper for your own code: subscribe to an event name with on(), fire it with emit(), and every callback gets the one payload you pass. Callbacks run in the order they subscribed, synchronously, inside emit(). It is not the thing shows talk through. Inputs and worlds talk through Signals (named values with a range) and Params; nothing else in the framework uses a Bus, and createShow() does not create one.

records.k: bus event emitter events on emit off publish subscribe pubsub listener 事件 發射器 匯流排 訂閱 發布 監聽 回呼
records.d: 最陽春的事件發射器：on(event, cb)、emit(event, payload)、off(event, cb)。沒有萬用字元，也不是非同步。
records.x: new Bus() 是給你自己的程式用的小型發布與訂閱工具：用 on() 訂閱一個事件名稱，用 emit() 觸發，每個函式都會收到你傳的那一個內容。函式依訂閱順序同步執行，都在 emit() 裡面跑完。 演出裡各部分溝通靠的不是它。輸入和世界是透過 Signals（有範圍的具名值）和 Params 溝通，框架裡沒有別的東西用到 Bus，createShow() 也不會建立一個。

records.k: loop frame clock requestAnimationFrame raf dt delta time fps tick hidden tab animation 迴圈 畫面 時鐘 影格 更新率 fps 動畫 分頁 背景 時間差
records.d: The frame clock: calls your function every animation frame with the seconds since the last one, and keeps ticking when the tab is hidden.
records.x: new Loop((dt) => { … }).start() runs your function once per requestAnimationFrame, with dt in seconds. It is the one clock a show has: the timeline advances, mapped signals settle, the world draws and the backstage feed is sent from inside it, in the order the architecture page lists. createShow() builds and starts one for you and returns it as show.loop. Browsers freeze requestAnimationFrame in a hidden tab, but a performance must not stop because someone switched windows. So while the loop runs, a Web Worker beats every 33 ms; whenever no animation frame has arrived for 50 ms, the loop steps itself. A hidden tab therefore ticks at roughly 15 frames a second with a normal-sized dt, and show time stays real time. Where the page forbids workers (a strict content security policy) that fallback is simply absent. loop.fps is the frame rate, rounded, refreshed about every half second (the very first value comes from the first frame alone); it is 0 before the first frame. loop.running says whether it is going. Call start(): nothing ticks until you do. It needs a browser (requestAnimationFrame, performance); in Node there is no clock to run it. Do not read the real clock inside a world: take time from dt (or from the timeline), so a show at 30 fps and one at 144 fps do the same thing. onFrame Called as onFrame(dt, now): dt is the seconds since the previous frame (never more than maxDt), now the time in milliseconds. An error thrown inside is caught and logged as [loop]; the clock…

records.k: loop frame clock requestAnimationFrame raf dt delta time fps tick hidden tab animation 迴圈 畫面 時鐘 影格 更新率 fps 動畫 分頁 背景 時間差
records.d: 畫面的時鐘：每個動畫畫面呼叫你的函式一次，並告訴你距離上一次過了幾秒，分頁被藏起來時它也繼續跳。
records.x: new Loop((dt) => { … }).start() 每個 requestAnimationFrame 呼叫你的函式一次，dt 的單位是秒。這是一場演出唯一的時鐘：時間軸往前走、映射的訊號安頓下來、世界繪圖、後台資料送出，都在它裡面做，順序見架構頁。createShow() 會替你建好並啟動一個，用 show.loop 回傳。 瀏覽器會在分頁被藏起來的時候凍結 requestAnimationFrame，但演出不能因為有人切換視窗就停下來。所以迴圈在跑的時候，會有一個 Web Worker 每 33 毫秒跳一下。只要 50 毫秒內沒有收到動畫畫面，迴圈就自己往前走一步。被藏起來的分頁因此大約每秒 15 個畫面，dt 大小正常，演出時間仍是真實時間。如果頁面禁止 Worker（嚴格的內容安全政策），這個備援就不存在。 loop.fps 是四捨五入後的影格率，大約每半秒更新一次（第一個值只由第一個畫面算出來），在第一個畫面之前是 0。loop.running 告訴你它有沒有在跑。 要呼叫 start()，在那之前什麼都不會跳。它需要瀏覽器（requestAnimationFrame、performance），在 Node 裡沒有時鐘可以讓它跑。 不要在世界裡讀真實時間，時間請從 dt（或時間軸）來，這樣 30 fps 和 144 fps 的演出才會做一樣的事。 onFrame 以 onFrame(dt, now) 呼叫：dt 是距離上一個畫面的秒數（不會超過 maxDt），now 是以毫秒計的時間。裡面丟出的錯誤會被接住、記成 [loop]，時鐘繼續跑。 maxDt 你拿到的 dt 最大值，單位是秒。卡頓（長時間的記憶體回收、被拖動的視窗）會被截成這個值，世界不用處理一秒鐘的跳動。

records.k: param params parameter schema override resolve clamp step pulse param slider min max def 參數 覆寫 解析 滑桿 範圍 預設值 步進 脈衝參數 宣告
records.d: The values a world listens to: a list of declared params, each resolved every frame from the timeline, unless a hand, a knob or a route has overridden it.
records.x: A param is the way a world takes continuous control: { key: 'bloom', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }. The world never asks who set it. Every frame each param resolves to one number: the override if there is one, otherwise the base value (usually the Timeline's automation at the current time), otherwise def. resolve() does exactly that and hands the world a { key: value } object. An override is sticky. After params.override('bloom', 0.8) (what a slider, a MIDI knob or a mapped route does) the timeline stops moving bloom until clearOverride('bloom'). That matches the stage: when a person grabs a control, the score gives way. Overrides are clamped into min..max and snapped to step when they are written. A param with pulse: true is a trigger, not a level: nobody reads a value from it. Fire it with firePulse(key) (a pad, a route from a pulse signal, a console button) and listen with onPulse(key, cb). In a show, createShow() builds one Params and registers every world's schema into it with add(), then returns it as show.params. step snaps with ordinary floating-point arithmetic: with step: 0.1, an override of 0.3 reads back as 0.30000000000000004. On a timeline a stepped param also holds each keyframe instead of interpolating. resolve() does not clamp the base value, only overrides are clamped when written. Keep your automation inside min..max. The fields a world may declare (label, options, surface, group …) are listed in Writing a world. schema The param declarations: { key, label?,…

records.k: param params parameter schema override resolve clamp step pulse param slider min max def 參數 覆寫 解析 滑桿 範圍 預設值 步進 脈衝參數 宣告
records.d: 世界所聽的那些值：一份宣告好的參數清單，每個參數每個畫面都解析成一個數字，除非有手、旋鈕或路由把它蓋掉。
records.x: 參數是世界取得連續控制的方式：{ key: 'bloom', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }。世界從來不問是誰設定的。每個畫面，每個參數都會解析成一個數字：有覆寫值（override）就用覆寫值，否則用基準值（通常是 Timeline 在目前時間的自動化曲線），再不然就用 def。resolve() 做的就是這件事，把 { key: value } 物件交給世界。 覆寫是黏住的。params.override('bloom', 0.8) 之後（滑桿、MIDI 旋鈕或映射的路由做的就是這個），時間軸就不再動 bloom，直到你呼叫 clearOverride('bloom')。這跟舞台上的情形一樣：有人抓住控制的時候，樂譜讓路。覆寫值在寫入的時候就會被夾進 min..max，並對齊 step。 pulse: true 的參數是觸發器，不是水準值：沒有人從它讀值。用 firePulse(key) 觸發它（打擊墊、脈衝訊號的路由、主控台的按鈕），用 onPulse(key, cb) 聽它。 在演出裡，createShow() 會建好一個 Params，用 add() 把每個世界的 schema 登記進去，再用 show.params 回傳。 step 用一般的浮點數運算對齊：step: 0.1 時，覆寫值 0.3 讀回來是 0.30000000000000004。在時間軸上，有 step 的參數還會停在每個關鍵影格，而不是做內插。 resolve() 不會夾基準值，只有覆寫值在寫入時會被夾住。自動化曲線請自己保持在 min..max 之內。 世界可以宣告的欄位（label、options、surface、group ……）列在寫一個世界。 schema 參數的宣告：{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group? }。key 一定要有。min、max、def 給出範圍，以及沒人設定時的值。這個陣列是直接拿來用，不會複製。

records.k: signal signals registry define set pulse event continuous publish subscribe normalized input osc 訊號 信號 登錄表 輸入 脈衝 事件 連續 發布 訂閱 正規化 範圍
records.d: The registry every input writes into and everything else reads from: named values that are either a level (continuous) or an event (pulse).
records.x: new Signals() makes an empty registry. In a show you rarely build it yourself: createShow() creates one and returns it as show.signals. A signal is a name plus a value. Input packages publish with set() and pulse(); everything else reads with get() and norm(), or subscribes with on() and onAny(). There are two kinds. A continuous signal (the default) always holds a current value, usually between 0 and 1: a knob, the loudness of the room, the height of a wrist. A pulse signal (kind: 'pulse') is an event: its value is the payload of the last firing and it is null until the first one: a key struck, a kick heard, a pinch started. Read a level whenever you like; subscribe to an event with on(). Names are paths with the source first: midi/cc/74, audio/rms, pose/hand/right/y, breath/pressure. Declare a signal with its range before you publish it: signals.define('breath/pressure', { min: 0, max: 1 }). set() on a name nobody declared defines it on the spot as a continuous signal from 0 to 1, so declare first whenever your numbers are in degrees, MIDI notes or any other range. A knob, a raised hand and a chord are equal citizens here. Whoever reads a signal (the Mapper, a world that listens for events, the monitor) does not know and does not care what produced it. signals.meta is a Map of name → declaration and signals.values a Map of name → last value. Read them if you must; write through define() and set() so subscribers hear about it. A subscriber that throws is caught and logged…

records.k: signal signals registry define set pulse event continuous publish subscribe normalized input osc 訊號 信號 登錄表 輸入 脈衝 事件 連續 發布 訂閱 正規化 範圍
records.d: 所有輸入都寫進去、其他東西都從這裡讀的登錄表：一個個有名字的值，不是持續的數值（continuous），就是一次性的事件（pulse）。
records.x: new Signals() 會做出一個空的登錄表。做演出的時候通常不用自己建：createShow() 會建好一個，用 show.signals 回傳給你。一個訊號就是一個名字加一個值。輸入套件用 set() 和 pulse() 發布。其他東西用 get() 和 norm() 讀，或用 on() 和 onAny() 訂閱。 訊號分兩種。連續（continuous，預設）的訊號隨時都有一個目前的值，通常在 0 到 1 之間：旋鈕的位置、房間的音量、手腕的高度。脈衝（pulse，寫成 kind: 'pulse'）是事件：它的值是最近一次觸發帶的內容，在第一次觸發之前是 null：按下一個鍵、聽到一下大鼓、開始一次捏合。水準值想讀就讀。事件用 on() 訂閱。 名字是「來源在前」的路徑：midi/cc/74、audio/rms、pose/hand/right/y、breath/pressure。發布之前先用範圍宣告它：signals.define('breath/pressure', { min: 0, max: 1 })。對一個沒人宣告過的名字呼叫 set()，會當場把它宣告成 0 到 1 的連續訊號，所以你的數字如果是角度、MIDI 音符號碼或別的範圍，請先宣告。 旋鈕、舉起的手、一個和弦，在這裡地位相同。讀訊號的一方（Mapper、聽事件的世界、後台監看）不知道也不在乎是什麼產生它。 signals.meta 是「名字 → 宣告」的 Map，signals.values 是「名字 → 最近的值」的 Map。需要的話可以讀，要寫請透過 define() 和 set()，訂閱者才聽得到。 訂閱者丟出錯誤會被接住、記成 [signals] ，其他訂閱者照常執行，set() 也不會丟錯。 每個內建套件發布的訊號名稱，都列在訊號參考。

records.k: createShow show assembly factory one call setup modules world routes timeline console window.openav boot start createShow 演出 組裝 一個呼叫 設定 模組 世界 路由 時間軸 控台 window.openav 啟動
records.d: Builds a whole show around a world in one call: signals, params, stage, timeline, mapper, the modules you switch on, the console, the backstage feed and the frame loop.
records.x: Every example is a world plus one createShow() call. It builds the Signals registry, the Params, the Stage with your world, the Timeline, the Mapper (with your routes), the inputs and outputs you declare in modules, the director's desk (mountConsole()), the backstage feed (MonitorFeed) and the frame Loop, starts the loop, and hands you every part. Nothing is hidden: show.signals, show.params, show.timeline, show.mapper, show.stage and the rest are the very objects the frame loop runs. When the framework grows a module, every show can have it just by declaring it. The modules keys: midi (on by default, false turns it off, { controllers: true } or { controllers: { profile, profiles, open } } docks an on-screen MIDI controller), keys (the on-screen piano, QWERTY and the simulated performer: on by default, false turns them off, { base, octaves, sim, capture } tunes them), drums (true or { engine, autoEnableEngine }), audio (any truthy value: the microphone analyser, started from the 🎤 button), chord (true or { window }: a ChordDetector wired to every played note), hands (true: HandTracker), pose (true: PoseTracker), leap (true or { url, simulate, fingers, box }: LeapInput; ?leap=sim or ?leap=ws://… in the address overrides), remote (true or { room, … }: phones as controllers) and sound (true, an instrument id such as 'piano', or { instrument, remember, picker, engine }: instruments in the page, loaded only when declared). Parts that fetch things load lazily, so a show that…

records.k: createShow show assembly factory one call setup modules world routes timeline console window.openav boot start createShow 演出 組裝 一個呼叫 設定 模組 世界 路由 時間軸 控台 window.openav 啟動
records.d: 一個呼叫就替世界組好整場演出：訊號、參數、舞台、時間軸、映射、你開啟的模組、控台、後台資料和影格迴圈。
records.x: 每個範例都是一個世界加上一次 createShow() 呼叫。它建好 Signals 登錄表、Params、放著你的世界的 Stage、Timeline、Mapper（帶著你的 routes）、你在 modules 宣告的輸入與輸出、導演控台（mountConsole()）、後台資料（MonitorFeed）和影格 Loop，啟動迴圈，再把每個部分交給你。什麼都沒有藏起來：show.signals、show.params、show.timeline、show.mapper、show.stage 這些，就是影格迴圈實際在跑的那些物件。框架多了一個模組的時候，每場演出只要宣告就能用上。 modules 的鍵：midi（預設開啟，false 關掉，{ controllers: true } 或 { controllers: { profile, profiles, open } } 會在舞台上停靠一個螢幕上的 MIDI 控制器）、keys（螢幕鋼琴、電腦鍵盤和模擬演奏者：預設開啟，false 關掉，{ base, octaves, sim, capture } 可調整）、drums（true 或 { engine, autoEnableEngine }）、audio（任何真值：麥克風分析器，從 🎤 按鈕啟動）、chord（true 或 { window }：接上每個被彈奏的音的 ChordDetector）、hands（true：HandTracker）、pose（true：PoseTracker）、leap（true 或 { url, simulate, fingers, box }：LeapInput，網址上的 ?leap=sim 或 ?leap=ws://… 可以覆寫）、remote（true 或 { room, … }：把手機當控制器）和 sound（true、像 'piano' 這樣的樂器 id，或 { instrument, remember, picker, engine }：頁面內的樂器，宣告了才會載入）。需要下載東西的部分都是延遲載入，所以沒宣告的演出不會付出任何代價。 頁面外殼只固定一次，所以每場演出都一樣。沒有 mount 的話，頁面的 body 會變成兩欄的格線：舞台，以及放著鋼琴和控台的 340 像素側邊面板（直立的手機則是舞台在上、面板在下：見 isStacked()）。每個畫面依這個順序做事： 要 await 它：它是非同步的，因為要等世界的 init()（和延遲載入的模組）完成。它需要一個頁面（document、location、localStorage），還要有能解析它所匯入的每個 @openav/ 套件的 import map 或打包工具（可以複製 examples/01-hello-particles/index.html 裡的那份）。瀏覽器要等點擊之後才會啟動聲音，所以聲音和麥克風要從控台的按鈕啟動。 映射每 3 秒把路由存在 profile 名稱底下，所以學來的或改過的路由，重新載入之後還在，而且會贏過你在程式裡改過的宣告（同一個 source → target 組合會保留存起來的曲線和平滑）。profile: false 讓路由每次載入都來自程式，但映射之後仍然會用世界的名字存檔。要從頭開始，執行 localStorage.removeItem('openav.map.')。 路由加進去的時間比聲音引擎登記 sound/ 參數還早，所以宣告接到 sound/cutoff 的路由要明確寫上 outMin:…

records.k: stacked layout responsive phone layout portrait breakpoint layout rule 820 堆疊版面 響應式 手機版面 直式 斷點 版面規則 820
records.d: Whether a window of this size gets the stacked layout (stage on top, panel below): upright and no wider than 820 pixels.
records.x: The shell of createShow() has one layout rule: wide windows get the stage and a 340 px side panel next to each other, and an upright phone or small tablet gets the stage on top and the panel below it, scrolling. The rule is the media query STACK_QUERY, and isStacked() is the very same decision as a plain function, so a test (or your own layout code) can use it without a browser. A phone on its side is never taller than wide, so it stays in the wide layout. width The window width in pixels. height The window height in pixels. true when width width.

records.k: canvas 2d canvas createCanvas fit resize device pixel ratio retina dpr renderer helper 畫布 2d 畫布 createCanvas 調整大小 縮放 裝置像素比 retina 繪圖小幫手
records.d: Makes a 2D canvas that fills its container and keeps its size in step with it, at up to 2 times the device pixel ratio.
records.x: A convenience for worlds that draw with the 2D canvas API; a world may use it or ignore it. The canvas is display: block and as big as the container. fit() sets its pixel size to the container size times the device pixel ratio (never more than 2) and scales the context so you keep drawing in CSS pixels. Call fit() at the top of render(): it only does work when the size changed, and it returns { w, h } to draw with. A ResizeObserver also calls it when the container is resized. Call dispose() in the world's dispose(): it stops the observer and removes the canvas. If the container has no height (an empty in normal flow is 0 pixels tall), the canvas is 0 × 0 and nothing shows. Give the container a size, or use it inside a Stage, whose layer fills the stage. container The element to put the canvas in (a world's container, usually). alpha Whether the canvas may be transparent. The default false is faster and gives an opaque canvas. { canvas, ctx, fit, dispose }: the , its 2D context, fit() and dispose(). fit() returns { w, h }, the container size in CSS pixels.

records.k: stage world worlds lifecycle init update render dispose activate register frame renderer 舞台 世界 生命週期 初始化 更新 繪製 釋放 啟用 登記 影格 繪圖器
records.d: Runs one world at a time: registers worlds and their params, switches between them, and each frame resolves the params and calls the world's update and render.
records.x: A world is any system with this shape, and every method is optional: The stage owns the lifecycle and the param aggregation and deliberately not a renderer: draw with a 2D canvas, p5, three.js, SVG, the DOM, whatever you like. The shell never knows the work: switching works means swapping the world and its data, and the shell stays. A world takes continuous control from state (the params) and may subscribe to signals for discrete events (a note struck, a chord resolved). If it reads signals.get('midi/cc/74') inside update(), it works with your controller today, but the timeline, a hand or another controller can no longer drive it. In a show, createShow() builds the stage from its world and worlds options and returns it as show.stage. Register your worlds, then await stage.activate(name) once; until a world is active, frame() returns null and does nothing. Then call stage.frame(dt, baseState) every frame (a show's loop does). Check the name before you activate: activate('nope') disposes the current world first and only then rejects, and the stage keeps pointing at the disposed world (active and activeName do not change), so the next frame() still calls its update() and render(). Fields to read: active (the active world object), activeName, worlds (a Map of name → world), container, layer (the element worlds are placed in) and io ({ signals, ...io }, what update receives; add handles later with stage.io.osc = osc). An exception in init() is not caught: activate() rejects.…

records.k: stage world worlds lifecycle init update render dispose activate register frame renderer 舞台 世界 生命週期 初始化 更新 繪製 釋放 啟用 登記 影格 繪圖器
records.d: 一次執行一個世界：登記世界和它們的參數、在世界之間切換，並在每個畫面解析參數、呼叫世界的 update 和 render。
records.x: 世界就是任何符合這個形狀的系統，每個方法都是選填的： 舞台負責生命週期和參數的彙整，而刻意不負責繪圖：用 2D 畫布、p5、three.js、SVG、DOM，隨你高興。外殼永遠不知道作品是什麼：換作品就是換掉世界和它的資料，外殼不動。 世界從 state（參數）取得連續控制，可以訂閱 signals 來接離散事件（按下一個音、一個和弦解決）。如果它在 update() 裡讀 signals.get('midi/cc/74')，今天用你的控制器是行的，但時間軸、手或別的控制器就再也驅動不了它。在演出裡，createShow() 依 world 和 worlds 選項建好舞台，用 show.stage 回傳。 先登記你的世界，再 await stage.activate(name) 一次。在有世界啟用之前，frame() 會回傳 null，什麼都不做。之後每個畫面呼叫 stage.frame(dt, baseState)（演出的迴圈會做）。 啟用之前請先確認名字：activate('nope') 會先讓目前的世界 dispose，之後才被拒絕，而舞台仍然指著那個已經 dispose 的世界（active 和 activeName 沒有改變），所以下一次 frame() 還是會呼叫它的 update() 和 render()。 可以讀的欄位：active（目前啟用的世界物件）、activeName、worlds（名字對應世界的 Map）、container、layer（世界被放進去的元素），以及 io（{ signals, ...io }，也就是 update 收到的東西，之後可以用 stage.io.osc = osc 補上把手）。 init() 裡的例外不會被接住：activate() 會被拒絕。update() 和 render() 裡的例外會被接住。世界必須在 dispose() 裡釋放它拿走的東西（GPU 物件、DOM、訂閱），因為世界是可以現場切換的。 container 世界要畫進去的元素。如果它原本是 static，會被改成 position: relative。舞台會在裡面加一個自己的圖層，所以你放在容器裡的覆蓋物（提示、開始按鈕）在切換世界的時候不會被清掉。 params 世界的 schema 要併進去、也是 frame() 要解析的 Params。 signals 交給每個世界的 Signals 登錄表，讓世界可以訂閱事件。 io 給世界的 update(dt, state, io) 用的額外輸出把手，例如 { midi, osc }。signals 一定在裡面。

records.k: webtoe touchdesigner node patch iframe world ext dataflow patch world postMessage webtoe touchdesigner 節點圖 iframe 世界 ext 資料流 世界 postMessage
records.d: Turns a WebToe node patch into a world: the patch runs in an iframe and every changed param is posted into it.
records.x: WebToe is the sister project: a web-native, node-based dataflow engine that speaks TouchDesigner. webtoeWorld() embeds its app in an iframe that fills the stage (with allow="camera; microphone"), and each frame it posts the resolved params into the iframe as { type: 'webtoe:ext', values }. Inside the patch, any parameter written as ext('name', fallback) follows the value called name, and uses fallback until one arrives. The contract stays pure: the world reads params and never inputs. Which knob, hand or timeline drives speed is the mapper's business, as for any world. To send less, the world posts only when at least one value differs from the last post. The page must be able to load the WebToe app in an iframe (the network, by default https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/), and the patch file must be reachable by the app. The world does its work when it is activated, so use it with createShow({ world }), or stage.register() and stage.activate(). The message goes to the iframe with the target origin , so any page the iframe happens to be showing receives the values. If you point app at a site you do not trust, it can read your params. name The world's name: what Stage registers it under and what you pass to stage.activate(). Give each patch its own. app The WebToe app to embed in the iframe. Change it to run your own copy of the app. project The address of a .webtoe.json patch file. It is handed to the app as ?project=, and the app fetches it, so the file's server must allow…

records.d: 把一份 WebToe 節點圖變成世界：節點圖在 iframe 裡執行，每個改變的參數都會被送進去。
records.x: WebToe 是姊妹專案：一個網頁原生、以節點為基礎的資料流引擎，講的是 TouchDesigner 的語言。webtoeWorld() 把它的應用程式嵌進一個填滿舞台的 iframe（帶著 allow="camera; microphone"），每個畫面把解析後的參數用 { type: 'webtoe:ext', values } 送進 iframe。節點圖裡，任何寫成 ext('name', fallback) 的參數，都會跟著名為 name 的值走，在值抵達之前用 fallback。 約定維持純粹：世界讀的是參數，從不讀輸入。是哪個旋鈕、手或時間軸在驅動 speed，是映射的事，跟任何世界一樣。為了少送一點，世界只在至少有一個值跟上一次送出的不同時才會送。 頁面必須能把 WebToe 應用程式載進 iframe（要有網路，預設是 https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/），節點圖檔案也要讓應用程式抓得到。世界在被啟用的時候才開始做事，所以請搭配 createShow({ world })，或 stage.register() 加 stage.activate() 使用。 訊息是用目標來源 送給 iframe，所以 iframe 當時顯示的任何頁面都收得到這些值。如果你把 app 指向你不信任的網站，它就能讀到你的參數。 name 世界的名字：Stage 用它來登記，stage.activate() 也是傳它。每份節點圖請取自己的名字。 app 要嵌進 iframe 的 WebToe 應用程式。改它就能跑你自己那一份。 project .webtoe.json 節點圖檔案的網址。它會用 ?project= 交給應用程式，由應用程式去抓，所以檔案所在的伺服器必須允許應用程式的來源（CORS）。請寫成絕對網址，例如 new URL('./garden.webtoe.json', location.href).href。 params 世界的參數 schema：[{ key, min, max, def }, …]。這些 key 就是節點圖用 ext('name', fallback) 讀取的名稱。 extra extra(state, out)，每個畫面呼叫：把衍生的值加進 out（狀態的複本），節點圖也讀得到，例如 out.hueRad = state.hue Math.PI / 180。 一個世界 { name, params, init, update, render, dispose }，可以交給 createShow({ world }) 或 stage.register()。

records.d: Attaches the room relay to a Node http.Server: WebSocket clients that connect to path are put in rooms and routed by role. Returns { hub, close() }.
records.x: This is the server half, in Node, with no dependencies (the WebSocket codec is in the package). node serve.js already does it for you at /relay. To use it in your own server: attachRelay(server) before or after server.listen(). Clients connect to ws://host/relay?role=controller|runner|monitor&room=&id=: a bad role becomes controller, a bad room name becomes default, and the id is cut to 64 characters. Who may talk to whom: a controller's signal and batch go to the runner and the monitors; a runner's go to the monitors only; a runner's feedback and config go to the controllers and monitors; a monitor says nothing. A config is kept per key and replayed to controllers that join later, and the room forgets it when its runner leaves. Rooms never hear each other. A message over 256 KB is ignored and a frame over 1 MB closes the connection. There is no authentication: anyone who can reach the server and knows a room name can join as a controller. Use a closed network, or a room name nobody will guess. A Node program, imported from @openav/relay/server (a different entry point from @openav/relay, which is the browser side). Standalone: node packages/relay/server.js [port] (default 7458; /health answers with the room names; RELAY_HOST=127.0.0.1 binds to localhost behind a reverse proxy). server A Node http.Server (or anything with the same upgrade event, such as an https server). The relay listens for its upgrade events. path The URL path clients connect to. Any other path is…

records.k: relay server websocket server http server rooms node attach serve.js heartbeat hub 中繼伺服器 websocket 伺服器 http 伺服器 房間 node 掛上 serve.js 心跳 hub
records.d: 把房間中繼掛到 Node 的 http.Server 上：連到 path 的 WebSocket 用戶端會被放進房間，並依身分轉送訊息。回傳 { hub, close() }。
records.x: 這是伺服器那一半，跑在 Node 裡，沒有任何相依套件（WebSocket 編解碼器就在套件裡）。node serve.js 已經在 /relay 替你做好了。要用在你自己的伺服器上：在 server.listen() 之前或之後呼叫 attachRelay(server) 都行。用戶端連到 ws://host/relay?role=controller|runner|monitor&room=&id=：身分不合格會變成 controller，房間名不合格會變成 default，id 會被截成 64 個字元。 誰能對誰說話：控制端的 signal 和 batch 送給演出端和監看端。演出端的只送給監看端。演出端的 feedback 和 config 送給控制端和監看端。監看端什麼都不能說。config 依 key 留著，重播給之後才加入的控制端，演出端離開時房間就忘掉它。房間之間互相聽不到。超過 256 KB 的訊息會被忽略，超過 1 MB 的 frame 會讓連線關閉。 沒有任何身分驗證：任何連得到伺服器、又知道房間名稱的人，都能以控制端身分加入。請用封閉的網路，或一個沒人猜得到的房間名稱。 一支 Node 程式，從 @openav/relay/server 匯入（它跟 @openav/relay 是不同的進入點，後者是瀏覽器端）。單獨執行：node packages/relay/server.js [port]（預設 7458，/health 會回傳房間名稱，用 RELAY_HOST=127.0.0.1 可以綁在 localhost，後面接反向代理）。 server Node 的 http.Server（或任何有同樣 upgrade 事件的東西，例如 https 伺服器）。中繼會聽它的 upgrade 事件。 path 用戶端要連的網址路徑。其他路徑一律拒絕。 log (line) => {}，用戶端加入時以 + controller ab12 @main 這樣的一行呼叫，離開時是 - controller ab12 @main。預設什麼都不說。 heartbeatMs 多久對每個用戶端 ping 一次，單位毫秒。到下一次 ping 還沒回應的用戶端會被移除，所以斷線的手機會在一到兩個週期內消失。 hub 是 RoomHub（hub.rooms 是房間的 Map，hub.counts(room) 回傳 { controllers, runners, monitors }）。close() 把所有連線中的用戶端斷開，不會關掉你的伺服器。

records.k: bind signals connect relay to signals phone/any runner show receive phone onSignal 綁定訊號 接中繼 phone/any 演出端 接收手機 onSignal
records.d: Connects a runner's RelayClient to a Signals registry: every signal a phone sends is filed there, plus a phone/any/… copy. Returns an undo function.
records.x: Call it once on the show page, after making the runner's client: bindSignals(show, signals). It sets client.onSignal so that each signal that arrives goes through fileSignal(), and a phone signal is filed twice, under its own name (phone/ab12/tilt/x) and under the alias (phone/any/tilt/x). Routes written at author time use the alias. A callback that was already in client.onSignal keeps running after the filing, so you can still watch the raw messages. client The runner's client (any object with an onSignal field works). signals The registry to fill (from @openav/core). alias The word used in the copy, phone//…. null or an empty string turns the copy off. meta Replace signalMeta with your own declarations, as in fileSignal(). Call it to unbind: client.onSignal goes back to what it was before.

records.k: bind signals connect relay to signals phone/any runner show receive phone onSignal 綁定訊號 接中繼 phone/any 演出端 接收手機 onSignal
records.d: 把演出端的 RelayClient 接到 Signals：手機送來的每個訊號都歸進去，並多一份 phone/any/… 的複本。回傳一個復原函式。
records.x: 在演出頁面上，做好演出端的用戶端之後呼叫一次：bindSignals(show, signals)。它會設定 client.onSignal，讓每個收到的訊號都經過 fileSignal()，手機訊號會歸兩份：自己的名稱（phone/ab12/tilt/x）和別名（phone/any/tilt/x）。寫作品時寫的路由用的是別名。 client.onSignal 裡原本就有的回呼，會在歸檔之後繼續執行，所以你還是看得到原始訊息。 client 演出端的用戶端（任何有 onSignal 欄位的物件都行）。 signals 要填的註冊表（來自 @openav/core）。 alias 複本用的字，phone//…。null 或空字串表示不做複本。 meta 像 fileSignal() 一樣，用你自己的宣告取代 signalMeta。 呼叫它就解除綁定：client.onSignal 回到綁定之前的樣子。

records.k: device id phone id localStorage identity unique id random id 裝置 id 手機 id localStorage 識別 隨機 id
records.d: The short random id of this browser, kept in localStorage, that names this phone in its signals, as in phone/ab12/tilt/x.
records.x: The first call makes an id and stores it under key; later calls read it back. RelayClient uses it as its default id, so a phone keeps the same name across reloads and its signals stay phone//…. If localStorage is blocked (some private windows), nothing can be stored and every call makes a new id. key The localStorage key. The default is the one the lab uses, so /control and /remote on one phone count as one device. A short id of about five letters and digits, such as k3x9a. The same one on every call, in the same browser.

records.k: device id phone id localStorage identity unique id random id 裝置 id 手機 id localStorage 識別 隨機 id
records.d: 這個瀏覽器的隨機短 id，存在 localStorage 裡，用來在訊號名稱裡稱呼這支手機，例如 phone/ab12/tilt/x。
records.x: 第一次呼叫會做一個 id 並存在 key 底下，之後的呼叫就把它讀回來。RelayClient 把它當作預設的 id，所以手機重新載入之後名字不變，訊號也一直是 phone//…。 如果 localStorage 被擋掉（有些無痕視窗），就存不下來，每次呼叫都會做一個新的 id。 key localStorage 的 key。預設是實驗室用的那一個，所以同一支手機上的 /control 和 /remote 算是同一個裝置。 大約五個字母和數字的短 id，例如 k3x9a。同一個瀏覽器裡，每次呼叫都一樣。

records.k: file signal receive declare signals incoming pulse set wire format 歸檔訊號 接收 宣告 signals 收到的訊號 脈衝 設值 傳輸格式
records.d: Files one incoming signal into a Signals registry: declares the name the first time, fills in the velocity, then sets it or pulses it.
records.x: This is the receiving half of the wire format, and every receiver files a message the same way through it: bindSignals() for a show that has a relay, localSensors() for a show on a phone, and a host that runs its own socket. In order: if the registry has never heard the name, declare it with what signalMeta() says (a pulse is never mistaken for a knob, and meters get their range); fill in the missing velocity spelling with normalizeValue(); then signals.pulse(name, value) for a pulse or signals.set(name, value) for the rest. signals The registry to file it in (from @openav/core). name The signal name. It must be a non-empty string of at most 128 characters, or nothing is filed. value The payload. pulse True when the message was sent as an event. A name that signalMeta() knows to be a pulse (or was declared as one) is a pulse either way. meta Replace signalMeta with your own (name, { pulse }) => metadata | null, to declare names the relay does not know. source A label stored in the declared metadata (signals.meta.get(name).source), such as 'relay' or 'local'. true when it was filed, false for a bad name.

records.k: file signal receive declare signals incoming pulse set wire format 歸檔訊號 接收 宣告 signals 收到的訊號 脈衝 設值 傳輸格式
records.d: 把一個收到的訊號歸進 Signals：第一次聽到名稱就先宣告，補上力度，再設值或觸發脈衝。
records.x: 這是傳輸格式的接收那一半，每個接收端都靠它用同樣的方式歸檔訊息：有中繼的演出用 bindSignals()，跑在手機上的演出用 localSensors()，自己開 socket 的主機也一樣。順序是：註冊表沒聽過這個名稱的話，就照 signalMeta() 的說法宣告（脈衝不會被當成旋鈕，音量表也拿得到範圍），用 normalizeValue() 補上缺的力度寫法，然後脈衝就 signals.pulse(name, value)，其他就 signals.set(name, value)。 signals 要歸進去的註冊表（來自 @openav/core）。 name 訊號名稱。必須是非空字串，最長 128 個字元，否則什麼都不歸。 value 訊號的內容。 pulse 訊息是當作事件送來的話為 true。名稱若是 signalMeta() 認得的脈衝（或之前就宣告成脈衝），不管這一項是什麼，都當作脈衝。 meta 用你自己的 (name, { pulse }) => 資料 | null 取代 signalMeta，用來宣告中繼不認得的名稱。 source 存進宣告資料裡的標籤（signals.meta.get(name).source），例如 'relay' 或 'local'。 歸好了是 true，名稱不合格是 false。

records.k: velocity vel note on midi 127 normalize touchosc keyboard 力度 vel velocity 音符 midi 正規化 鍵盤
records.d: Fills in the missing velocity spelling of a note message: vel (0..1) or velocity (1..127). Every other message passes through unchanged.
records.x: @openav/midi publishes vel as 0..1, a hardware keyboard talks in velocity 1..127, and senders (an old phone page, a TouchOSC bridge, a sequencer) give one or the other. A sketch is written against one spelling, so the receiving end fills in the other: velocity becomes vel = velocity / 127, and vel becomes velocity = Math.round(vel 127). You rarely call it yourself: fileSignal() does it for every message it files. name The signal name. Only midi/note/on, midi/note/off and the same with a device in the middle (midi//note/on) are touched. value The payload. Only an object with vel or velocity is changed (a copy, never the original). The payload with both vel and velocity. If both were there already, the same object comes back untouched.

records.k: velocity vel note on midi 127 normalize touchosc keyboard 力度 vel velocity 音符 midi 正規化 鍵盤
records.d: 補上音符訊息缺的那一種力度寫法：vel（0..1）或 velocity（1..127）。其他訊息原樣通過。
records.x: @openav/midi 發布的 vel 是 0..1，硬體鍵盤說的是 1..127 的 velocity，而送訊號的人（舊的手機頁面、TouchOSC 橋接、編曲軟體）只會給其中一種。草圖通常只照一種寫法寫，所以接收端把另一種補上：velocity 會變成 vel = velocity / 127，vel 會變成 velocity = Math.round(vel 127)。 通常不用自己呼叫：fileSignal() 歸檔每一則訊息時都會做這件事。 name 訊號名稱。只有 midi/note/on、midi/note/off，以及中間多一個裝置名的寫法（midi//note/on）會被處理。 value 訊號的內容。只有帶 vel 或 velocity 的物件會被改（改的是複本，不動原件）。 同時帶 vel 和 velocity 的內容。兩個本來就都有的話，原物件原樣傳回。

records.k: relay websocket room phone controller runner monitor client connect send signal feedback config reconnect latency 中繼 websocket 房間 手機 控制端 演出端 監看端 連線 傳送訊號 回饋 設定 重連 延遲
records.d: The browser end of the room relay: sends signals to the other pages in a room and receives theirs, as a phone (controller), the show (runner) or a backstage monitor.
records.x: Make one client per page, give it a role and a room, and call connect(). A phone calls phone.set('phone/me/tilt/x', 0.3) for values that change continuously and phone.send('midi/note/on', { note: 60 }, true) for events. The show passes its client to bindSignals(), and every phone signal lands in its Signals. The relay itself is attachRelay() on a Node server. Continuous values are cheap on purpose: set() only stores the value (and does nothing if it is the same as the last), then every 1 / batchHz seconds the changed ones leave in one batch, and every resendMs all of them leave again. Events are the opposite: send() leaves at once and is never batched or repeated, because a note-on delivered twice is a bug. It looks after the connection itself. When the socket closes it reconnects after 0.5 s, then 1 s, 2 s, 4 s and every 5 s, until you call close(). A ping goes out every 2 s and the answer becomes latency in milliseconds. status is 'connecting', 'open' or 'closed', and peers is how many controllers, runners and monitors the room has. A relay server for it to reach, such as node serve.js (it hosts one at /relay) or node packages/relay/server.js. Until the socket is open, set() keeps the latest values and sends them when it opens, but send(), feedback() and config() messages are dropped, not queued. Public fields: role, room, id, url, batchHz, resendMs, the callbacks, status, latency (milliseconds, null until the first pong), peers and sent (how many messages have gone out).…

records.k: relay websocket room phone controller runner monitor client connect send signal feedback config reconnect latency 中繼 websocket 房間 手機 控制端 演出端 監看端 連線 傳送訊號 回饋 設定 重連 延遲
records.d: 房間中繼的瀏覽器端：把訊號送給同一個房間裡的其他頁面，也接收它們的訊號，身分可以是手機（controller）、演出本身（runner）或後台監看（monitor）。
records.x: 每個頁面做一個用戶端，給它身分和房間，然後呼叫 connect()。手機用 phone.set('phone/me/tilt/x', 0.3) 送連續變化的數值，用 phone.send('midi/note/on', { note: 60 }, true) 送事件。演出端把自己的用戶端交給 bindSignals()，每個手機訊號就會進到它的 Signals。中繼本身是 Node 伺服器上的 attachRelay()。 連續的數值刻意做得很省：set() 只是把值存起來（跟上一次一樣就什麼都不做），之後每 1 / batchHz 秒，有變動的值打包成一則 batch 送出，每 resendMs 毫秒，全部的值再送一遍。事件則相反：send() 馬上送出，不打包也不重送，因為一個 note-on 收到兩次就是錯。 連線它自己照顧。socket 關掉之後，它會在 0.5 秒、1 秒、2 秒、4 秒，之後每 5 秒重連一次，直到你呼叫 close()。每 2 秒送一個 ping，回應的時間差就是 latency（毫秒）。status 是 'connecting'、'open' 或 'closed'，peers 是房間裡有幾個 controllers、runners、monitors。 要有一台中繼伺服器可以連，例如 node serve.js（它在 /relay 架了一個）或 node packages/relay/server.js。socket 還沒打開之前，set() 會記住最新的值，打開時送出，但 send()、feedback()、config() 的訊息會直接丟掉，不會排隊。 公開的欄位有 role、room、id、url、batchHz、resendMs、各個回呼、status、latency（毫秒，第一個 pong 回來之前是 null）、peers 和 sent（已經送出幾則訊息）。 重連之後，演出端要再送一次 config()：用戶端不會記得它。mountRemoteHost() 會替你做這件事。 role 這個頁面的身分。控制端（controller，也就是手機）把訊號送給演出端和監看端。演出端（runner，也就是演出本身）聽得到控制端，也能把 feedback 和 config 送回去。監看端（monitor）只聽不說。伺服器遇到其他字一律當成 controller。 room 房間名稱。不同房間的頁面彼此聽不到。1 到 32 個字元，只能用 A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -，其他的伺服器會換成 default。 id 這個裝置的 id，也就是 phone//… 裡的 。預設是 deviceId()，存在 localStorage 裡。伺服器只留前 64 個字元。 url 完整的 WebSocket 位址，查詢字串要自己帶好：wss://host/relay?role=controller&room=main&id=ab12。它不會再補任何東西。不給的話，用頁面網址裡的 ?relay=ws://…，再沒有就用頁面自己的 /relay（https 頁面用 wss:），並自動補上 role、room、id。 batchHz 每秒把你 set() 的數值送出幾次，打包成一則 batch 訊息。 resendMs 每隔這麼多毫秒，把存起來的每一個值再送一次，不只是有變動的。晚進來的手機、重新載入的演出頁面，就靠這個趕上現況。 onStatus (client) => {}，連線打開或關閉、pong 帶來新的…

records.k: signal meta range min max pulse declare unit signal names phone signals 訊號資料 範圍 最小最大 脈衝 宣告 單位 訊號名稱 手機訊號
records.d: What the relay knows about a signal name: its range and unit, or that it is a pulse. Returns null for names it does not know.
records.x: A Signals registry needs to know a name's range before a meter can scale it or a mapping can tell a knob from an event. fileSignal() calls this the first time it hears a name. What it knows: phone//tilt/ is −1..1, accel/ is −20..20 m/s², rot/ is −360..360 °/s, orient/ is 0..360 °, touch/count is 0..10, knock is a pulse, and every other phone/… name (touch, light) is 0..1. surface/… names are 0..1 (…/raw and …/delta are unscaled, {}). midi/note/on, midi/note/off, midi/virtual and the hit, on, off, last names of a controller are pulses, and midi/cc/ is 0..1. name A signal name such as phone/ab12/tilt/x, surface/main/hue or midi/note/on. pulse Pass { pulse: true } when the message was sent as an event: the answer is then always { kind: 'pulse' }. Metadata for signals.define(): { min, max, unit? }, { kind: 'pulse' }, or {} for raw values. null when the name is not one it knows.

records.k: signal meta range min max pulse declare unit signal names phone signals 訊號資料 範圍 最小最大 脈衝 宣告 單位 訊號名稱 手機訊號
records.d: 中繼對一個訊號名稱知道什麼：它的範圍和單位，或者它是脈衝。不認得的名稱回傳 null。
records.x: Signals 要先知道一個名稱的範圍，音量表才能縮放、映射才分得出旋鈕和事件。fileSignal() 第一次聽到一個名稱就會呼叫它。它認得的有：phone//tilt/ 是 −1..1，accel/ 是 −20..20 m/s²，rot/ 是 −360..360 °/s，orient/ 是 0..360 °，touch/count 是 0..10，knock 是脈衝，其他的 phone/… 名稱（觸控、光線）是 0..1。surface/… 的名稱是 0..1（…/raw 和 …/delta 沒有縮放，回傳 {}）。midi/note/on、midi/note/off、midi/virtual，以及控制器的 hit、on、off、last 名稱是脈衝，midi/cc/ 是 0..1。 name 訊號名稱，例如 phone/ab12/tilt/x、surface/main/hue 或 midi/note/on。 pulse 訊息是當作事件送來的話，傳 { pulse: true }：答案一律是 { kind: 'pulse' }。 給 signals.define() 用的資料：{ min, max, unit? }、{ kind: 'pulse' }，原始值則是 {}。名稱不在它認得的範圍內時是 null。

records.k: touch pad multi-touch fingers pointer events touch/x touch/count xy pad phone 觸控板 多點觸控 手指 pointer 事件 touch/x touch/count xy 板 手機
records.d: Makes an element a multi-touch pad: each finger publishes touch/x, touch/y and touch/down (0..1 inside the element), and touch/count says how many are down.
records.x: The first finger down is slot 0 and publishes touch/x, touch/y, touch/down; the second is slot 1 and publishes touch/1/x, touch/1/y, touch/1/down, and so on. A slot is given back when its finger lifts, so the lowest free number is used next. x runs 0 at the left edge to 1 at the right, y runs 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom, both held inside the element and rounded to 4 decimals. touch/down is 1 or 0, and touch/count is the number of fingers down. It publishes touch/down 0 and touch/count 0 at once, so a receiver knows the pad is there before anyone touches it. It uses pointer events, so a mouse works too (one finger). The sense tab uses this on its touch pad, with io writing to a RelayClient under phone//. pad The element to listen on. Give it touch-action: none in CSS, or the browser may take a drag for a scroll and cancel the touch. io Where the values go, as for PhoneSensors: only set is used, and the names have no phone// in front. onMove (slot, x, y, down) => {}, when a finger touches and each time it moves. x and y are 0..1 and down is true. Use it to draw the finger. onEnd (slot) => {}, when a finger lifts or the touch is cancelled.

records.k: touch pad multi-touch fingers pointer events touch/x touch/count xy pad phone 觸控板 多點觸控 手指 pointer 事件 touch/x touch/count xy 板 手機
records.d: 把一個元素變成多點觸控板：每根手指發布 touch/x、touch/y 和 touch/down（在元素裡的 0..1），touch/count 是現在按著幾根。
records.x: 第一根按下去的手指是 slot 0，發布 touch/x、touch/y、touch/down。第二根是 slot 1，發布 touch/1/x、touch/1/y、touch/1/down，以此類推。手指離開就把 slot 還回去，下一根會用最小的空號。x 從左邊緣的 0 到右邊緣的 1，y 從上緣的 0 到下緣的 1，都限制在元素裡面，並四捨五入到小數點後 4 位。touch/down 是 1 或 0，touch/count 是按著的手指數。 它一接上去就先發布 touch/down 0 和 touch/count 0，所以接收端在還沒有人碰之前就知道觸控板存在。它用的是 pointer 事件，所以滑鼠也能用（算一根手指）。 感測 分頁的觸控板用的就是它，io 寫進 RelayClient，名稱加上 phone//。 pad 要監聽的元素。在 CSS 裡給它 touch-action: none，不然瀏覽器可能把拖曳當成捲動，把觸碰取消掉。 io 數值要送去哪裡，跟 PhoneSensors 一樣：只用到 set，名稱前面沒有 phone//。 onMove (slot, x, y, down) => {}，手指按下去和每次移動的時候呼叫。x、y 是 0..1，down 是 true。拿來畫手指的位置。 onEnd (slot) => {}，手指離開或觸碰被取消的時候呼叫。

records.k: local sensors phone as the show no relay phone/local tilt motion show on a phone 本機感測器 手機當演出 不用中繼 phone/local 傾斜 動作 演出跑在手機上
records.d: For a show page that runs on the phone itself: the phone's own sensors go straight into a Signals as phone/local/…, with a phone/any/… copy.
records.x: A remote phone reaches the show through a relay. When the show page is open on the phone itself, there is no one to relay to, so this reads the sensors in place. records.d: The show side of the phone remote: joins the relay as the runner, files phone signals, builds the control panel from the params and echoes values back.
records.x: createShow({ modules: { remote: true } }) calls this for you, so the world never has to know about phones. Calling it yourself does five things: it makes a RelayClient as the room's runner; files every phone signal into signals with bindSignals() (so phone/any/… always holds the latest phone); builds the layout from surface, world.surface or autoSurface() of the params; adds the surface/… → param routes to the mapper; and, when you call host.frame(dt, state) every frame, sends the resolved param values back about feedbackHz times a second so the phones' faders follow the timeline. Making the host does not connect it: call host.connect() when you want the socket. On every (re)connection it publishes the layout as relay config surface, so a phone that joins later gets the right panel. host.layout, host.routes and host.bindings are there to look at straight away, and host.dispose() closes the socket. A relay for connect() to reach: node serve.js hosts one at /relay, a static site uses the public relay (see pickRelay()), or pass url. Building the host needs none of that. signals The registry that phone signals are filed in. params The world's params. Its schema is what the control surface is built from. mapper The mapper that gets the surface/… → param routes (a route it already has is not added twice). world The world: its params are used when params.schema is empty, its name becomes the layout's title, and its surface (a hand-written layout) is used instead of a generated…

records.k: phone sensors tilt accelerometer gyroscope deviceorientation devicemotion knock shake light sensor ios permission motion 手機感測器 傾斜 加速度 陀螺儀 動作感測 敲擊 搖晃 光線 ios 權限 動作
records.d: Turns a phone's tilt, acceleration, rotation, knocks and front-camera light into named signals, in screen axes, and hands them to the io you give it.
records.x: This is the phone half of the sense tab, with no page in it: make one with an io, call start() from a tap, and signals flow. From the phone's own events it produces tilt/x and tilt/y (−1..1, which is ±45° from the resting pose, x to the right and y toward you, in screen axes, so a phone turned sideways still reports "tilt right is +x"), orient/alpha|beta|gamma (degrees), accel/x|y|z (m/s², gravity included), rot/alpha|beta|gamma (degrees per second), knock (a pulse { strength, delta, t }) and, if you turn the camera on, light (0..1). A knock is a jolt: when the acceleration vector changes by more than threshold (10 m/s² by default) between two motion samples, and at least 130 ms after the last knock, io.send('knock', { strength, delta, t }, true) fires. delta is the size of the change, and strength runs from 0.15 just over the threshold up to 1. The phone also vibrates for 10 ms where it can. Hold the phone how you want to play it and call calibrate() to make that pose the zero of the tilt. For the show page itself running on a phone, localSensors() wraps this class and files straight into a Signals. Call start() from a tap or click, not on page load. iOS asks for motion permission only inside a user gesture, and it only gives motion sensors to pages on https://; touch and keys work over plain http://. start() always resolves true: look at denied for a refusal. If no sensor data arrives within 2.5 s, hooks.notify says so (a desktop, or an iPhone page on http).…

records.d: 把手機的傾斜、加速度、旋轉、敲擊和前鏡頭的光線，換成有名字的訊號（用螢幕座標軸），交給你給它的 io。
records.x: 這是 感測 分頁在手機這一半的邏輯，裡面不含頁面：給它一個 io，在使用者點一下時呼叫 start()，訊號就開始流動。它用手機自己的事件產生 tilt/x 和 tilt/y（−1..1，也就是離靜止姿勢 ±45°，x 向右、y 朝向你，用的是螢幕座標軸，所以手機橫著拿也還是「往右傾是 +x」）、orient/alpha|beta|gamma（度）、accel/x|y|z（m/s²，含重力）、rot/alpha|beta|gamma（每秒幾度）、knock（脈衝 { strength, delta, t }），打開鏡頭的話還有 light（0..1）。 敲擊就是猛地一震：兩筆動作樣本之間，加速度向量的變化超過 threshold（預設 10 m/s²），而且距離上次敲擊至少 130 毫秒，就會觸發 io.send('knock', { strength, delta, t }, true)。delta 是變化的大小，strength 從剛過門檻的 0.15 到 1。手機能震動的話也會震 10 毫秒。把手機拿成你想演奏的姿勢，呼叫 calibrate()，就把那個姿勢當成傾斜的零點。 演出頁面本身就跑在手機上的話，用 localSensors()，它包住這個類別，直接把訊號歸進 Signals。 要在點擊或觸碰時才呼叫 start()，不是載入頁面時。iOS 只在使用者手勢裡才會問動作權限，而且只把動作感測器開放給 https:// 的頁面，觸控和琴鍵在一般的 http:// 就能用。start() 一律回傳 true，被拒絕要看 denied。2.5 秒內沒有任何感測資料進來的話，hooks.notify 會說明（桌機，或 http 的 iPhone 頁面）。setCamera(true) 在 iOS 上同樣要手勢和 HTTPS。 公開的欄位有 io、hooks、started、gotSensor（收過任何感測資料就是 true）、denied（iOS 說不行，要到「設定」裡改才會變）、rest 和 deg（傾斜，單位度）、threshold（敲擊門檻，10）和 COOLDOWN（130 毫秒）。 io 訊號要送去哪裡。set 收連續的訊號，send 收敲擊（pulse 為 true）。名稱前面沒有 phone//，是 tilt/x、accel/z 這樣。後面可以接加了前綴的 RelayClient，或是 Signals。 hooks 選用的回呼。onKnock(strength) 在每次敲擊之後呼叫，onSample(name, value) 每個連續樣本都呼叫（拿來畫讀數），notify(message) 收一行問題說明，例如權限被拒絕。訊息是中文寫的。

records.k: auto arrange pack grid first fit layout algorithm place widgets no overlap 自動排列 打包 格線 第一個放得下 排版演算法 擺放元件 不重疊
records.d: Packs widgets into a grid first-fit, row by row, and never overlaps; fixed placements are kept and block their cells. Returns the placements and the rows used.
records.x: Each item takes the first free spot found by scanning left to right, then top to bottom: what a person does laying out a controller. The grid grows downward as far as it must, so rows is a result, not a limit. resolvePage() uses it for widgets without a position and for the automatic reflow. An item with no w (or a w that is not a number) never finds a spot and the function never returns. Give every item a w and an h; DEFAULT_SIZE has the natural size of each widget type. items What to place, in order. Every item needs a numeric w and h in cells, at least 1. A w wider than the grid is cut to cols. cols How many columns the grid has. fixed Placements that are already decided. They come first in the result and the other items go around them. placements is a list of { id, x, y, w, h } (the fixed ones first), rows is how many rows they fill.

records.k: auto arrange pack grid first fit layout algorithm place widgets no overlap 自動排列 打包 格線 第一個放得下 排版演算法 擺放元件 不重疊
records.d: 把元件依序排進格線，一列一列找第一個放得下的位置，絕不重疊，fixed 的位置會保留，並擋住它們的格子。回傳各元件的位置和用掉的列數。
records.x: 每個項目都從左到右、再從上到下找第一個空位放進去：就是人在排控制器時的做法。格線需要多長就往下長多長，所以 rows 是結果，不是上限。resolvePage() 用它來排沒有位置的元件，也用在自動重排。 沒有 w（或 w 不是數字）的項目永遠找不到位置，函式也就永遠不會結束。每個項目都要給 w 和 h。DEFAULT_SIZE 有每種元件類型的預設大小。 items 要擺的東西，依序排。每一項都要有數字的 w 和 h（單位是格，至少 1）。w 比格線寬的話會被截成 cols。 cols 格線有幾欄。 fixed 已經決定的位置。它們會排在結果的最前面，其他項目繞著它們擺。 placements 是 { id, x, y, w, h } 的清單（固定的排前面），rows 是它們佔了幾列。

records.k: auto surface params to panel generate layout control panel from params routes bindings xy pairs meters phone panel 自動面板 參數變面板 產生版面 依參數建立面板 路由 綁定 xy 配對 音量表 手機面板
records.d: Turns a world's params into a control panel: a layout, the routes that drive the params, and the bindings for echoing values back.
records.x: This is how a world that declares what it can be performed with gets a phone panel for free: const { layout, routes, bindings } = autoSurface(world.params), then routes.forEach((r) => mapper.addRoute(r)) and new Surface(el, { layout, sink }). Each param becomes the widget widgetTypeFor() picks. Each group of params gets its own page (a param without a group goes on main), long groups continue on main2, main3 …, and a pair from pairs becomes one XY pad with two routes, …/x and …/y. Widget ids are the param keys (anything outside A–Z a–z 0–9 _ - becomes _), colours go round cyan, amber, magenta, lime, violet, coral, and a radio's options come from the param or are the numbers. A pulse param gets no binding, since there is no value to show. The routes already scale the normalized signal to the param's min and max. A world that comes with its own layout uses routesFromLayout() instead. params The param declarations: { key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group?, options?, surface? }. surface: { type, color, label } on a param overrides the choice. perPage How much fits on a page, counted in weights: a fader or a meter weighs 1, an XY pad 4, anything else 2. The default 8 is eight faders, four knobs or two XY pads. A page that scrolls is a page that fails, so a full page starts the next. style Faders or knobs for the continuous params. 'auto' picks faders up to six, knobs beyond. pairs Pairs of param keys to drive with one XY pad: [['cx', 'cy']]. The first key is x and the…

records.k: auto surface params to panel generate layout control panel from params routes bindings xy pairs meters phone panel 自動面板 參數變面板 產生版面 依參數建立面板 路由 綁定 xy 配對 音量表 手機面板
records.d: 把世界的參數變成控制面板：一份版面、驅動參數的路由，以及把數值回送用的綁定。
records.x: 一個宣告了「可以拿什麼來演奏」的世界，就這樣免費得到手機面板：const { layout, routes, bindings } = autoSurface(world.params)，再 routes.forEach((r) => mapper.addRoute(r)) 和 new Surface(el, { layout, sink })。每個參數變成 widgetTypeFor() 挑的元件。每個 group 各有一頁（沒有 group 的參數放在 main），太長的群組接著放到 main2、main3 …，pairs 裡的一對會變成一塊有兩條路由（…/x 和 …/y）的 XY 板。 元件的 id 就是參數鍵（A–Z a–z 0–9 _ - 以外的字元會變成 _），顏色依序輪流用 cyan、amber、magenta、lime、violet、coral，radio 的 options 來自參數，沒有就用數字。脈衝參數沒有 binding，因為沒有值可以顯示。路由已經把正規化的訊號換算成參數的 min 和 max。自己帶版面的世界，改用 routesFromLayout()。 params 參數宣告：{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group?, options?, surface? }。參數上的 surface: { type, color, label } 可以蓋過自動的選擇。 perPage 一頁放得下多少，以權重計算：推桿或音量表算 1，XY 板算 4，其他都算 2。預設的 8 就是八支推桿、四個旋鈕或兩塊 XY 板。要捲動的頁面就是失敗的頁面，所以滿了就開下一頁。 style 連續參數用推桿還是旋鈕。'auto' 六個以內用推桿，超過就用旋鈕。 pairs 要用同一塊 XY 板驅動的參數鍵配對：[['cx', 'cy']]。第一個鍵是 x，第二個是 y。 meters 另外要顯示成唯讀音量表的參數鍵，放在一頁叫 Meters 的頁面。 smooth 連續路由的平滑秒數，用來遮住 30 Hz 網路造成的階梯感（拉鍊雜訊）。脈衝、開關和單選不會被平滑。 title 版面的標題。 layout 是給 Surface 用的版面 JSON。routes 是映射器路由的清單 { source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }，從 surface// 到各個參數。bindings 是給 feedbackFor() 用的 { param, name, page, widget, min, max, readonly? }。

records.d: True when the page can ask for fullscreen: the browser has requestFullscreen (or the WebKit one). The code treats iPhone Safari as not having it.
records.x: Use it to decide whether to show a fullscreen button: if (canFullscreen()) button.hidden = false. It only checks that the function exists; whether a request succeeds is up to the browser, which wants it to come from a tap (toggleFullscreen()). true or false. false without a document.

records.k: fullscreen can fullscreen requestFullscreen full screen button ios safari 全螢幕 能不能全螢幕 requestFullscreen 全螢幕按鈕 ios safari
records.d: 頁面可以要求全螢幕的時候是 true：瀏覽器有 requestFullscreen（或 WebKit 版的）。程式碼把 iPhone 的 Safari 當成沒有。
records.x: 用來決定要不要顯示全螢幕按鈕：if (canFullscreen()) button.hidden = false。它只檢查那個函式存不存在。要求會不會成功由瀏覽器決定，瀏覽器要求它必須來自一次點擊（toggleFullscreen()）。 true 或 false。沒有 document 的話是 false。

records.d: The seven colour names a widget's color may be: cyan, amber, magenta, lime, violet, coral, white.
records.x: { id: 'hue', type: 'knob', color: 'amber' } makes the widget's fill, its value readout and its pressed outline amber. A widget without a colour uses --oav-accent of THEME_VARS. autoSurface() hands out the first six in turn (white is left for you). A name that is not in the list gets no colour of its own and falls back to the accent; validateLayout() does not check it. ['cyan', 'amber', 'magenta', 'lime', 'violet', 'coral', 'white'].

records.d: 元件的 color 可以用的七個顏色名稱：cyan、amber、magenta、lime、violet、coral、white。
records.x: { id: 'hue', type: 'knob', color: 'amber' } 會讓元件的填色、數值讀數和按下時的描邊都變成琥珀色。沒有顏色的元件用 THEME_VARS 的 --oav-accent。autoSurface() 會輪流發前六個（white 留給你用）。不在清單裡的名稱沒有自己的顏色，會退回強調色。validateLayout() 不檢查它。 七個字串：['cyan', 'amber', 'magenta', 'lime', 'violet', 'coral', 'white']。
