records.d: The natural size of each widget type, in grid cells, as { w, h }: a layout only has to give x, y, w, h when it cares.
records.x: A widget without a w or h takes the size of its type, held to the number of columns of the grid. autoArrange() and resolvePage() use it, and so does autoSurface() when it counts how many widgets fit on a page. A type it does not know counts as 2×2. Fourteen keys, one per type: fader 1×4, knob 2×2, encoder 2×2, button 2×1, toggle 2×1, xy 4×4, bank 4×4, radio 4×1, pads 4×4, keyboard 8×4, number 2×1, text 4×1, label 2×1, meter 1×4 (width × height).

records.k: default size widget size grid cells width height w h 預設大小 元件大小 格 寬高 w h
records.d: 每種元件類型在格線上的預設大小，格式是 { w, h }（以格為單位）：版面只有在在意的時候才需要寫 x、y、w、h。
records.x: 沒寫 w 或 h 的元件，會用它的類型的大小，並限制在格線的欄數以內。autoArrange() 和 resolvePage() 會用到它，autoSurface() 計算一頁放得下幾個元件的時候也是。不認得的類型當作 2×2。 十四個鍵，每種類型一個：fader 1×4、knob 2×2、encoder 2×2、button 2×1、toggle 2×1、xy 4×4、bank 4×4、radio 4×1、pads 4×4、keyboard 8×4、number 2×1、text 4×1、label 2×1、meter 1×4（寬 × 高）。

records.k: feedback echo values fader follows bindings normalize send back to phone 回饋 回送數值 推桿跟著動 綁定 正規化 送回手機
records.d: Turns the resolved param state into the normalized values the phone's widgets should show right now: [{ name, value }].
records.x: It is pure and cheap, so the show calls it about ten times a second and sends each result to the phones with relay.feedback(name, value); host.frame() of mountRemoteHost() does exactly that. On the phone, Surface's feedback() moves the widget, so a fader follows the timeline and other controllers. state The resolved param values, such as params.resolve(…): { hue: 90, size: 5.5 }. bindings The bindings that autoSurface() returned. One entry per binding that has a number in state: name is the widget's signal, value is the param scaled to 0..1 and held in range. A param that is missing, not a number, or with min equal to max is skipped.

records.k: feedback echo values fader follows bindings normalize send back to phone 回饋 回送數值 推桿跟著動 綁定 正規化 送回手機
records.d: 把算好的參數狀態，換成手機上的元件現在該顯示的正規化數值：[{ name, value }]。
records.x: 它是純函式、成本很低，所以演出端大約每秒呼叫十次，並用 relay.feedback(name, value) 把每一項送給手機，mountRemoteHost() 的 host.frame() 做的就是這件事。在手機上，Surface 的 feedback() 會移動元件，所以推桿會跟著時間軸和其他控制器動。 state 算好的參數值，例如 params.resolve(…) 的結果：{ hue: 90, size: 5.5 }。 bindings autoSurface() 回傳的 bindings。 state 裡有數字的每個 binding 各一項：name 是元件的訊號，value 是縮放到 0..1 並限制在範圍內的參數值。缺少、不是數字、或 min 等於 max 的參數會跳過。

records.k: grid orientation portrait landscape cols rows grid shape 格線方向 直向 橫向 欄 列 格線形狀
records.d: Says whether a grid { cols, rows } is 'landscape' (at least as many columns as rows) or 'portrait'.
records.x: resolvePage() compares it with the orientation of the screen: a base grid of 8 by 4 is used as it is on a landscape screen and reflowed on a portrait one. g The grid. 'landscape' when g.cols >= g.rows, else 'portrait'.

records.k: grid orientation portrait landscape cols rows grid shape 格線方向 直向 橫向 欄 列 格線形狀
records.d: 判斷格線 { cols, rows } 是 'landscape'（欄數不少於列數）還是 'portrait'。
records.x: resolvePage() 會拿它跟螢幕的方向比：8 乘 4 的基本格線在橫向螢幕上直接用，在直向螢幕上就重排。 g 格線。 g.cols >= g.rows 是 'landscape'，否則是 'portrait'。

records.k: haptic vibrate vibration navigator.vibrate buzz feedback android 觸覺回饋 震動 振動 navigator.vibrate 嗡嗡 回饋 android
records.d: Vibrates the phone for ms milliseconds where the browser can (Android Chrome); silent everywhere else, and enabled false turns it off.
records.x: It calls navigator.vibrate(ms) when that exists and swallows any error. Browsers without it, such as Safari on iPhone, simply do nothing, and Chrome only vibrates after the person has touched the page. Surface calls it for buttons, toggles and radios, and its haptics: false option turns that off. ms How long to vibrate, in milliseconds. A button press in the surface uses 10 to 14. enabled Pass false to do nothing: a page can offer a "haptics" switch and hand it here.

records.k: haptic vibrate vibration navigator.vibrate buzz feedback android 觸覺回饋 震動 振動 navigator.vibrate 嗡嗡 回饋 android
records.d: 瀏覽器做得到的地方（Android 的 Chrome）讓手機震動 ms 毫秒，其他地方什麼都不會發生，enabled 為 false 就關掉。
records.x: 它在 navigator.vibrate(ms) 存在的時候呼叫它，並吞掉任何錯誤。沒有它的瀏覽器，例如 iPhone 上的 Safari，就單純什麼都不做，而 Chrome 要等使用者碰過頁面之後才會震動。Surface 會在按鈕、開關和單選時呼叫它，它的 haptics: false 選項可以把這個關掉。 ms 震動多久，單位毫秒。面板裡按一下按鈕用的是 10 到 14。 enabled 傳 false 就什麼都不做：頁面可以提供一個「觸覺回饋」開關，把它的值交給這裡。

records.k: inject theme stylesheet css style tag theme skin oav-accent 注入主題 樣式表 css style 標籤 主題 換皮膚 oav-accent
records.d: Writes the surface's stylesheet into the page, once: the 15 theme variables on :root and the rules for every widget. Safe to call again.
records.x: Surface and mountRemote() call it for you, so you need it only when you build a widget by yourself, or when you want the variables (var(--oav-accent)) for your own elements. It adds one to the head, and does nothing if that already exists, or if there is no document. To change the look, set a variable after that: document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--oav-accent', '#ff5fb3').

records.k: inject theme stylesheet css style tag theme skin oav-accent 注入主題 樣式表 css style 標籤 主題 換皮膚 oav-accent
records.d: 把面板的樣式表寫進頁面，只寫一次：:root 上的 15 個主題變數，以及每個元件的樣式規則。重複呼叫也沒問題。
records.x: Surface 和 mountRemote() 會替你呼叫它，所以只有自己建立 元件 的時候，或想在自己的元素上用這些變數（var(--oav-accent)）的時候才需要它。它會在 head 裡加一個 ，這個已經存在、或根本沒有 document 的話，就什麼都不做。要改外觀，在那之後設變數：document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--oav-accent', '#ff5fb3')。

records.k: wake lock keep awake screen on no sleep dim phone screen navigator.wakeLock 喚醒鎖 保持亮著 螢幕常亮 不休眠 變暗 手機螢幕 navigator.wakeLock
records.d: Asks the browser to keep the screen on (a screen wake lock) and asks again when the tab comes back. Returns { release() }.
records.x: A phone that is a controller dims and locks within a minute unless something holds the screen on. keepAwake() requests navigator.wakeLock.request('screen') right away if the page is visible. The operating system drops the lock whenever the page is hidden, so it asks again each time the page becomes visible. It is best effort and silent: a browser with no wake lock, or one that says no, just means the screen may still dim, and it never throws. A page that is visible, on https or localhost (the wake lock only exists on secure pages). mountRemote() calls it for you. release() stops asking and lets go of the lock.

records.k: wake lock keep awake screen on no sleep dim phone screen navigator.wakeLock 喚醒鎖 保持亮著 螢幕常亮 不休眠 變暗 手機螢幕 navigator.wakeLock
records.d: 請瀏覽器讓螢幕保持亮著（螢幕喚醒鎖），分頁回來時再要求一次。回傳 { release() }。
records.x: 當控制器用的手機，一分鐘內就會暗掉、鎖定，除非有東西讓螢幕保持亮著。如果頁面看得到，keepAwake() 馬上要求 navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')。頁面一被藏起來，作業系統就會放掉這把鎖，所以每次頁面再變成可見，它都會再要求一次。它是盡力而為、而且不出聲：瀏覽器沒有喚醒鎖、或回答不行的話，就只是螢幕可能還是會暗掉，它絕不會丟出錯誤。 頁面要看得到，而且在 https 或 localhost 底下（喚醒鎖只存在於安全的頁面）。mountRemote() 會替你呼叫它。 release() 停止再要求，並放掉喚醒鎖。

records.k: lock viewport no scroll no zoom pinch zoom overscroll ios instrument panel user-scalable 鎖定視窗 不捲動 不縮放 雙指縮放 橡皮筋 ios 儀器面板 user-scalable
records.d: Makes a page behave like an instrument panel instead of a web page: no scrolling, no pinch zoom, no rubber-banding. Returns a function that undoes most of it.
records.x: It sets to width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover (making the tag if there is none) and adds a style that gives html and body no margin, the full height, overflow: hidden, overscroll-behavior: none and touch-action: none. iOS ignores user-scalable=no, so it also cancels gesturestart and gesturechange (pinch zoom) and the default of every touchmove, except one that starts in an input or textarea, so a text box still works. This is for a page that is a control panel, such as mountRemote(), which calls it. Do not call it on a page that has to scroll. Without a document (in Node) it returns a function that does nothing. Call it to remove the stylesheet and the listeners. The viewport stays as it was set.

records.k: lock viewport no scroll no zoom pinch zoom overscroll ios instrument panel user-scalable 鎖定視窗 不捲動 不縮放 雙指縮放 橡皮筋 ios 儀器面板 user-scalable
records.d: 讓頁面像儀器面板，而不是網頁：不能捲動、不能雙指縮放、不會有橡皮筋回彈。回傳一個函式，可以復原其中大部分。
records.x: 它把 設成 width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover（沒有這個標籤就先做一個），並加一段樣式，讓 html 和 body 沒有邊界、高度填滿、overflow: hidden、overscroll-behavior: none、touch-action: none。iOS 會忽略 user-scalable=no，所以它也取消 gesturestart 和 gesturechange（雙指縮放），以及每個 touchmove 的預設行為，只有從 input 或 textarea 開始的例外，所以文字框還是能用。 這是給整個頁面就是控制面板的情況用的，例如 mountRemote() 就會呼叫它。要捲動的頁面不要呼叫它。沒有 document（在 Node 裡）的話，它回傳一個什麼都不做的函式。 呼叫它會移除樣式表和監聽。viewport 的 維持設好的樣子，不會還原。

records.k: normalize defaults fill in layout ids grid default copy 正規化 預設值 補齊 版面 id 預設格線 複本
records.d: Returns a copy of a layout with the defaults filled in: ids, titles, grids and the version. The input is not changed.
records.x: A page without an id becomes page1, page2 …; without a title it gets its id (or Page 1); without a grid it gets { cols: 8, rows: 6 }. A widget without an id becomes its type and its position in the list, fader1; an id already used on the page gets _ added until it is unique. Every other field is kept as it is. Surface normalizes the layout it is given, and so do signalNames() and the show side of the remote. The default grid has 6 rows. autoSurface() writes its own grids of 8 by 4, so this default only matters for layouts that leave the grid out. raw The layout JSON. undefined or an object without pages gives a layout with no pages. { version: 1, title, pages } with every page and widget complete.

records.k: normalize defaults fill in layout ids grid default copy 正規化 預設值 補齊 版面 id 預設格線 複本
records.d: 回傳一份補上預設值的版面複本：id、標題、格線和版本。原本的輸入不會被改動。
records.x: 沒有 id 的頁面會變成 page1、page2 …，沒有 title 就用它的 id（或 Page 1），沒有 grid 就是 { cols: 8, rows: 6 }。沒有 id 的元件會變成「類型加在清單中的位置」，像 fader1。在同一頁已經用過的 id 會一直加上 _ 直到不重複。其他欄位原樣保留。Surface 會把拿到的版面正規化，signalNames() 和遙控的演出端也一樣。 預設格線是 6 列。autoSurface() 自己寫的格線是 8 乘 4，所以這個預設值只對沒寫格線的版面有意義。 raw 版面 JSON。undefined 或沒有 pages 的物件，會得到沒有任何頁面的版面。 { version: 1, title, pages }，每個頁面和元件的欄位都補齊了。

records.k: orientation portrait landscape width height aspect phone rotation 方向 直向 橫向 寬高 長寬比 手機轉向
records.d: Says whether a box is 'landscape' or 'portrait' from its width and height; a square counts as landscape.
records.x: Surface calls it with the size of its container, not the size of the screen, so a panel in a half-width pane can be portrait while the phone is landscape. Use gridOrientation() for the shape of a grid. w The width, in any unit. h The height, in the same unit. 'landscape' when w >= h, else 'portrait'.

records.k: orientation portrait landscape width height aspect phone rotation 方向 直向 橫向 寬高 長寬比 手機轉向
records.d: 從寬和高判斷一個框是 'landscape'（橫向）還是 'portrait'（直向），正方形算橫向。
records.x: Surface 傳給它的是容器的大小，不是螢幕的大小，所以放在半寬窗格裡的面板可以是直向，而手機本身是橫向。要判斷格線的形狀，用 gridOrientation()。 w 寬，什麼單位都可以。 h 高，單位跟寬一樣。 w >= h 是 'landscape'，否則是 'portrait'。

records.k: keyboard piano keys octaves stacked rows two rows key width phone piano layout of keys 鍵盤 琴鍵 八度 上下兩排 兩排 琴鍵寬度 手機鋼琴 琴鍵排列
records.d: Decides how many piano keys, in how many rows, fit a box: one wide row, or two stacked rows when the box is tall, so keys stay a playable size.
records.x: A piano is two and a half metres wide and a phone held upright is six centimetres, so shrinking the keys makes a toy. Instead the keyboard changes shape with its box. A wide box gets one row with as many octaves as fit at minKeyPx or wider. A tall box gets two rows, the upper one continuing the pitch range where the lower stops, within reach of a thumb. The rows end on E or B and the next one starts on the next white key, so no black key is left alone at the seam. Notes stop at 127. The keyboard widget of Surface calls this every time its box changes size. width The width of the box, in pixels. height The height of the box, in pixels. base The MIDI note of the lowest key. 48 is C3 (C4 is 60). minKeyPx The narrowest a white key may be, in pixels. At least 3 white keys are kept. maxWhites The most white keys in a row. Two stacked rows are limited to 14 each. stackBelow Stack into two rows when width ÷ height is below this. forceRows 1 or 2 to decide yourself; 0 lets the shape of the box decide. stacked is true for two rows, whites the white keys in a row, keyPx the width of a white key. rows is a list of { base, semitones, whites }, the top row first (the higher notes), the way two keyboards are read: base is the MIDI note of the first key and semitones how many notes the row spans.

records.k: keyboard piano keys octaves stacked rows two rows key width phone piano layout of keys 鍵盤 琴鍵 八度 上下兩排 兩排 琴鍵寬度 手機鋼琴 琴鍵排列
records.d: 決定一個框裡放得下多少琴鍵、排成幾列：框很寬就一排，框很高就上下兩排，讓琴鍵維持好彈的大小。
records.x: 一台鋼琴有兩公尺半寬，直拿的手機只有六公分，把琴鍵縮小只會變成玩具。所以改成讓鍵盤隨著框的形狀變形。很寬的框得到一排，放得下幾個八度就放幾個（白鍵不窄於 minKeyPx）。很高的框得到兩排，上排接著下排停下來的地方往高音延伸，拇指搆得到。每一排都結束在 E 或 B，下一排從下一個白鍵開始，所以接縫處不會留下孤單的黑鍵。音符最高到 127。Surface 的 keyboard 元件在框的大小改變時，每次都會呼叫它。 width 框的寬，單位像素。 height 框的高，單位像素。 base 最低音那個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼。48 是 C3（C4 是 60）。 minKeyPx 白鍵最窄可以多寬，單位像素。至少會保留 3 個白鍵。 maxWhites 一排最多幾個白鍵。上下兩排的話，每排最多 14 個。 stackBelow 寬 ÷ 高低於這個值就改成上下兩排。 forceRows 1 或 2 自己決定，0 由框的形狀決定。 stacked 為 true 就是兩排，whites 是每排的白鍵數，keyPx 是白鍵的寬度。rows 是 { base, semitones, whites } 的清單，上面那一排在最前面（音比較高），就像兩層鍵盤的讀法：base 是第一個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼，semitones 是那一排涵蓋幾個半音。

records.k: resolve page orientation portrait landscape reflow responsive grid placements rotate phone 解析頁面 方向 直向 橫向 重排 響應式 格線 位置 轉手機
records.d: Works out where every widget of one page goes for one orientation: the grid and a cell for each widget, and which rule produced it.
records.x: A phone gets turned, so a layout has to survive it. The rules, in order: 1. If the page has a portrait or landscape entry for this orientation, use its grid and its place ({ widgetId: { x, y, w, h } }); widgets it does not mention keep their own position, or are packed into free cells (source is 'explicit'). 2. Else, if the base grid has the right shape (more columns than rows is landscape) and every widget has an x and a y, use the base ('base'). 3. Else reflow: the same widgets in reading order, packed again into half the columns (portrait, at least 2) or twice as many (landscape, up to 16), with a lone last row stretched to the edge by stretchRows() ('reflow'). Rows are a count, not pixels, so the result always fills the screen and nothing scrolls. A widget without w and h takes the size of its type from DEFAULT_SIZE. Surface calls this for every page each time the orientation changes. page One page of a layout: { grid, widgets, portrait?, landscape? }. orientation Which way the screen is held. grid is { cols, rows }, placements a list of { id, x, y, w, h }, source is 'explicit', 'base' or 'reflow'.

records.k: resolve page orientation portrait landscape reflow responsive grid placements rotate phone 解析頁面 方向 直向 橫向 重排 響應式 格線 位置 轉手機
records.d: 算出某一頁在某個方向下每個元件要放哪裡：格線，以及每個元件的格子，還有是哪一條規則排出來的。
records.x: 手機會被轉來轉去，所以版面一定要撐得住。規則依序是：1. 頁面針對這個方向有 portrait 或 landscape 的項目，就用它的 grid 和 place（{ 元件 id: { x, y, w, h } }）。它沒提到的元件保留自己的位置，或被打包進空的格子（source 是 'explicit'）。2. 否則，基本格線的形狀對（欄數多於列數是橫向）、而且每個元件都有 x 和 y，就用基本格線（'base'）。3. 否則重排：同樣的元件依閱讀順序，重新打包進一半的欄數（直向，至少 2 欄）或兩倍的欄數（橫向，最多 16 欄），最後孤零零的一列由 stretchRows() 拉到邊緣（'reflow'）。 列數是個數，不是像素，所以結果永遠填滿螢幕，不會捲動。沒有 w 和 h 的元件，會用 DEFAULT_SIZE 裡它的類型的大小。每次方向改變，Surface 都會對每一頁呼叫它。 page 版面中的一頁：{ grid, widgets, portrait?, landscape? }。 orientation 螢幕怎麼拿。 grid 是 { cols, rows }，placements 是 { id, x, y, w, h } 的清單，source 是 'explicit'、'base' 或 'reflow'。

records.k: routes from layout target hand-written layout widget target mapper routes xy target bank target 由版面產生路由 target 手寫版面 元件 target 映射器路由 xy target bank target
records.d: Writes the mapper routes for a hand-written layout: every widget that names a param in target gets a route from its signal to that param.
records.x: Give a widget a target and the layout file is enough to perform a world. target is a param key, or an array for the widgets with several signals: an xy sends x to the first and y to the second, a bank sends channel i to the i-th. Every other widget uses its first (or only) target. The routes already scale the 0..1 signal to the param's min and max. mountRemoteHost() uses this for a layout from world.surface or from its surface option. layout The layout JSON, whose widgets may have a target. params The param declarations. A target that is not among them is skipped without a warning. smooth Seconds of smoothing on continuous routes. A widget's own smooth wins. Pulse params and button, toggle and radio widgets are never smoothed. Routes in the same shape autoSurface() makes: { source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }, with curve taken from the widget (linear if it has none).

records.k: routes from layout target hand-written layout widget target mapper routes xy target bank target 由版面產生路由 target 手寫版面 元件 target 映射器路由 xy target bank target
records.d: 替手寫的版面產生映射器路由：每個用 target 指定參數的元件，都會得到一條從它的訊號到那個參數的路由。
records.x: 給元件一個 target，光靠版面檔案就能演奏一個世界。target 是參數鍵，訊號不只一個的元件可以給陣列：xy 把 x 送給第一個、y 送給第二個，bank 把第 i 個頻道送給第 i 個。其他元件都用第一個（或唯一的）target。路由已經把 0..1 的訊號換算成參數的 min 和 max。mountRemoteHost() 遇到來自 world.surface 或 surface 選項的版面，就是用它。 layout 版面 JSON，裡面的元件可以有 target。 params 參數宣告。target 不在裡面的話，會不吭一聲地跳過。 smooth 連續路由的平滑秒數。元件自己的 smooth 優先。脈衝參數，以及 button、toggle、radio 元件不會被平滑。 格式跟 autoSurface() 做出來的一樣的路由：{ source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }，curve 取自元件（沒有就是 linear）。

records.k: signal names list signals layout signals outputs what does it publish 訊號名稱 列出訊號 版面訊號 輸出 會發布什麼
records.d: Lists every signal name a layout can publish, so a mapping screen, a doc or a test can show them without touching the panel.
records.x: It follows the table in WIDGET_TYPES: an XY pad gives /x, /y, /down; a bank gives /1 to /count; pads give /hit and /0 to /; an encoder gives its name and /delta; a keyboard gives midi/note/on, midi/note/off, midi/cc/64 and midi/virtual; a label or a meter gives nothing. The …/raw names that a widget with a range also sends are not in the list. layout The layout JSON (it is normalized first). Unique names such as surface/main/hue, surface/main/pad/x, midi/note/on, in page and widget order.

records.k: signal names list signals layout signals outputs what does it publish 訊號名稱 列出訊號 版面訊號 輸出 會發布什麼
records.d: 列出一份版面能發布的每一個訊號名稱，讓映射畫面、文件或測試不用碰面板就能列出它們。
records.x: 它依照 WIDGET_TYPES 裡的表：XY 板給 /x、/y、/down，bank 給 /1 到 /count，pads 給 /hit 和 /0 到 /，encoder 給它自己的名稱和 /delta，keyboard 給 midi/note/on、midi/note/off、midi/cc/64 和 midi/virtual，label 和 meter 什麼都不給。有範圍的元件另外送的 …/raw 名稱不在清單裡。 layout 版面 JSON（會先正規化）。 不重複的名稱，像 surface/main/hue、surface/main/pad/x、midi/note/on，依頁面和元件的順序。

records.k: sink signals same page local surface no relay write signals sink 訊號 同一頁 本機面板 不用中繼 寫入訊號
records.d: Makes a sink for a Surface that writes straight into a Signals registry: for a panel on the same page as the show, with no phone and no relay.
records.x: A name it has not met is declared first: { kind: 'pulse' } when info.pulse is set, otherwise { min: 0, max: 1 }. Then a pulse fires with signals.pulse() and anything else is signals.set(). So a route in the mapper, { source: 'surface/main/hue', target: 'hue' }, works whether the finger is on this page or on a phone. It does no scaling: the …/raw signal that a widget with a range sends is filed like any other name, with the range 0..1 it was declared with, so ignore those or give them their own declaration. signals The registry to write into (from @openav/core). A (name, value, info) => {} to pass as Surface's sink.

records.k: sink signals same page local surface no relay write signals sink 訊號 同一頁 本機面板 不用中繼 寫入訊號
records.d: 做一個給 Surface 用的 sink，直接寫進 Signals：給跟演出在同一頁上的面板用，不需要手機，也不需要中繼。
records.x: 還沒見過的名稱會先宣告：info.pulse 有設的話是 { kind: 'pulse' }，不然是 { min: 0, max: 1 }。然後脈衝用 signals.pulse() 觸發，其他都是 signals.set()。所以映射器裡的路由 { source: 'surface/main/hue', target: 'hue' }，不論手指在這個頁面上還是在手機上，都能運作。 它不做任何縮放：有範圍的元件送出的 …/raw 訊號，會跟其他名稱一樣歸檔，宣告的範圍是 0..1，所以請忽略它們，或自己另外宣告。 signals 要寫進去的註冊表（來自 @openav/core）。 一個 (name, value, info) => {}，傳給 Surface 的 sink。

records.k: stretch last row fill row lonely widget reflow grid 拉長 最後一列 填滿一列 孤單的元件 重排 格線
records.d: Stretches a last row that stops short to the edge of the grid: five faders in four columns leave one lonely fader, and this makes it four columns wide.
records.x: A row is stretched only when it is safe: its widgets are all the same height, side by side with no gaps from the left edge, and nothing else sits to their right. The extra columns are dealt out one at a time from left to right, so a short row of three in four columns gives the first widget two columns. A row that does not qualify is left alone, and nothing ever overlaps. resolvePage() calls it at the end of a reflow. Advanced. You rarely call it yourself. placements Placements, for example from autoArrange(). Not changed: copies come back. cols How many columns the grid has. The placements, with the short rows widened.

records.k: stretch last row fill row lonely widget reflow grid 拉長 最後一列 填滿一列 孤單的元件 重排 格線
records.d: 把停在半途的最後一列拉到格線邊緣：四欄裡放五支推桿會剩下一支孤零零的，這個函式把它拉成四欄寬。
records.x: 只有安全的時候才會拉長一列：它的元件高度都一樣、從左邊緣開始一個接一個沒有空隙、右邊也沒有別的東西。多出來的欄數從左到右一欄一欄分下去，所以四欄裡只有三個元件的短列，第一個元件會拿到兩欄。不符合條件的列就不動，也絕不會重疊。resolvePage() 在重排的最後會呼叫它。 進階用法。通常不用自己呼叫。 placements 位置清單，例如來自 autoArrange()。不會被改動，回傳的是複本。 cols 格線有幾欄。 位置清單，短的列已經加寬。

records.k: surface control surface touchosc widgets fader knob xy pad pads layout phone controller panel touch feedback 控制面板 touchosc 元件 推桿 旋鈕 xy 板 打擊墊 版面 手機控制器 面板 觸控 回饋
records.d: A TouchOSC-style control panel: draws the pages and widgets of a layout in a container, and sends each touch out as a named signal.
records.x: Pass new Surface(container, { layout, sink }) and a panel appears: faders, knobs, an XY pad, pads, a keyboard, whatever the layout names, each with its live number. Widgets are dumb on purpose. Fingers go in, named normalized signals come out of sink, and the surface never knows what the work is. Run it on the show page with signalSink(), or on a phone with a sink that sends to the relay: the same layout works for both. A world's params can grow the whole layout by themselves with autoSurface(). The grid always fills the container and nothing scrolls. When the container is turned, the page is laid out again for the new orientation by resolvePage(): a portrait or landscape variant in the layout if there is one, else the base grid, else the same widgets packed again into half or double the columns. Touching a widget outlines it in its colour, and a double-tap on a fader or knob returns it to its default. Runner to widget goes the other way: feedback(name, value) moves a fader to follow the timeline, or fills a meter. A widget under a finger ignores feedback while it is touched and for about half a second after, so it does not fight the hand (a button only while it is held). A browser page (it builds DOM) and a container with a size. The panel injects its look once with injectTheme(). Nothing else to start: it works on the first touch. On a phone page, lockViewport() stops the page from scrolling and zooming under the fingers. Public fields: layout (the normalized layout),…

records.k: surface control surface touchosc widgets fader knob xy pad pads layout phone controller panel touch feedback 控制面板 touchosc 元件 推桿 旋鈕 xy 板 打擊墊 版面 手機控制器 面板 觸控 回饋
records.d: 像 TouchOSC 的控制面板：把版面裡的頁面和元件畫在容器裡，每一次觸碰都變成一個有名字的訊號送出去。
records.x: 呼叫 new Surface(container, { layout, sink })，面板就出現了：推桿、旋鈕、XY 板、打擊墊、琴鍵，版面裡寫什麼就有什麼，每個都顯示即時的數字。元件刻意做得很笨：手指進去，有名字的正規化訊號從 sink 出來，面板完全不知道作品是什麼。在演出頁面上搭配 signalSink() 用，或在手機上搭配送去中繼的 sink 用：同一份版面兩邊都行。世界的參數也能用 autoSurface() 自己長出整份版面。 格線一定填滿容器，不會有任何捲動。容器轉向的時候，頁面會由 resolvePage() 依新的方向重新排：版面裡有 portrait 或 landscape 的版本就用它，沒有就用基本格線，再不行就把同樣的元件重新擺進一半或兩倍的欄數。碰到元件時，它會用自己的顏色描邊，在推桿或旋鈕上連點兩下就回到預設值。 從演出端到元件是另一條路：feedback(name, value) 讓推桿跟著時間軸動，或把音量表填起來。手指碰著的元件，在被碰著的時候和放開後大約半秒內，會忽略 feedback，不跟手搶（按鈕則只有按住的時候）。 要有瀏覽器頁面（它會建立 DOM），而且容器要有大小。面板會用 injectTheme() 把它的外觀注入一次。不用另外啟動：第一次觸碰就能用。在手機頁面上，用 lockViewport() 讓頁面不會在手指底下捲動或縮放。 公開的欄位有 layout（正規化之後的版面）、root（面板的元素）、orientation、pageId、widgets（"page/id" 對應元件的 Map）、sink、haptics。 建構函式在檢查版面之前就把面板加進容器了，所以版面在那裡丟出錯誤的話，會留下一個空的面板。版面來自檔案或使用者的話，請先跑 validateLayout()。 container 面板要放的地方。面板是 position: absolute，會填滿它，所以容器要有定位（position: relative）和大小，不然面板就沒有大小。 layout 版面 JSON（見 validateLayout()）：頁面、格線、元件。版面有問題會丟出錯誤，列出每一個問題。 sink (name, value, info) => {}，每一次觸碰產生訊號都會呼叫。name 像 surface/main/hue，value 是正規化的 0..1（事件是 info.pulse，文字框則是字串）。元件的範圍不是 0..1 的時候，info.raw 帶著沒縮放的值，接著還會再呼叫一次，名稱是 …/raw。signalSink() 會寫進 Signals，手機上則傳一個呼叫 relay.set 的函式。 haptics 在按下按鈕、切換開關、選了單選項目、雙擊重設的時候讓手機震一下，瀏覽器做得到的話（Android Chrome）。false 就關掉。 tabs 版面有一頁以上的時候，顯示分頁列。false 就隱藏，改用 setPage() 切換。 orientation 強制指定方向。不給的話，它跟著容器的形狀走（寬大於高是橫向），容器改變它也會跟著改。 onPage (pageId) => {}，換頁的時候呼叫，一開始也會用第一頁呼叫一次。

records.k: theme css variables custom properties skin colors accent dark touch size re-skin 主題 css 變數 自訂屬性 換皮膚 顏色 強調色 深色 觸碰尺寸
records.d: The look of every control as 15 CSS custom properties on :root (--oav-bg, --oav-accent …): override them to re-skin the whole surface.
records.x: The design is a set of rules rather than decoration, because a controller is used in the dark, fast and half-looking: dark cards on near-black, the only saturated thing on screen is a value, every touch target at least 44 px (--oav-touch-min), the number you are changing always visible, and a pressed widget outlines itself in its colour. Everything is a CSS variable, so a work re-skins the surface by overriding a few of them, never by editing widget code. injectTheme() writes these values into the page once. Override after that, on document.documentElement or in your own stylesheet, with a rule that comes later on :root. Property name to its default value: --oav-bg #0a0c11, --oav-surface #141922, --oav-surface-2 #1b2230, --oav-line #283044, --oav-text #e8ecf5, --oav-dim #8691a8, --oav-accent #7ea6ff, --oav-ok #3ddc84, --oav-warn #f5a524, --oav-bad #e5484d, --oav-radius 14px, --oav-gap 8px, --oav-touch-min 44px, --oav-font (the system font) and --oav-mono (a monospace font).

records.k: theme css variables custom properties skin colors accent dark touch size re-skin 主題 css 變數 自訂屬性 換皮膚 顏色 強調色 深色 觸碰尺寸
records.d: 每個控制元件的外觀，收成 :root 上的 15 個 CSS 自訂屬性（--oav-bg、--oav-accent …）：覆寫它們就能替整個面板換皮膚。
records.x: 設計是一組規則，不是裝飾，因為控制器是在黑暗中、很快、只用眼角餘光看的：近黑底上的深色卡片、畫面上唯一飽和的東西是數值、每個觸碰目標至少 44 像素（--oav-touch-min）、正在調的數字一定看得到、被按住的元件用自己的顏色描邊。所有東西都是 CSS 變數，所以作品只要覆寫其中幾個就能換皮膚，不必改元件的程式碼。 injectTheme() 會把這些值寫進頁面一次。要覆寫的話，在那之後，對 document.documentElement 設，或在你自己的樣式表裡用排在後面的 :root 規則。 屬性名稱對應它的預設值：--oav-bg #0a0c11、--oav-surface #141922、--oav-surface-2 #1b2230、--oav-line #283044、--oav-text #e8ecf5、--oav-dim #8691a8、--oav-accent #7ea6ff、--oav-ok #3ddc84、--oav-warn #f5a524、--oav-bad #e5484d、--oav-radius 14px、--oav-gap 8px、--oav-touch-min 44px、--oav-font（系統字型）和 --oav-mono（等寬字型）。

records.k: fullscreen toggle fullscreen full screen exit fullscreen button 全螢幕 切換全螢幕 離開全螢幕 按鈕
records.d: Enters fullscreen if the page is not in it, and leaves it if it is. Call it from a tap, because browsers refuse otherwise.
records.x: It asks for the whole page (document.documentElement) with the browser's navigation bar hidden, and quietly does nothing on a browser without fullscreen (see canFullscreen()). The phone app puts it on a ⛶ button in the status bar. A user gesture: call it from a click or pointerdown handler. Called on page load it is refused by the browser.

records.k: fullscreen toggle fullscreen full screen exit fullscreen button 全螢幕 切換全螢幕 離開全螢幕 按鈕
records.d: 頁面不在全螢幕就進入，已經在就離開。要在點擊裡呼叫，不然瀏覽器會拒絕。
records.x: 它要求整個頁面（document.documentElement）進入全螢幕，並把瀏覽器的導覽列藏起來，瀏覽器沒有全螢幕功能（見 canFullscreen()）的話就安靜地什麼都不做。手機 app 把它放在狀態列的 ⛶ 按鈕上。 需要使用者手勢：在 click 或 pointerdown 的處理函式裡呼叫。在頁面載入時呼叫，瀏覽器會拒絕。

records.k: validate layout check layout errors problems lint layout json 驗證 版面 檢查版面 錯誤 問題 版面 json
records.d: Checks a layout and returns a list of readable problems; an empty list means it is fine.
records.x: It looks for: no object, or no non-empty pages array (it stops there); a page without an id, with a duplicate id or an id outside A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -; a widget whose type is not in WIDGET_TYPES, without an id, with a duplicate id on its page or an id outside those characters (the id becomes part of a signal name); and a min equal to its max. It reports every problem it finds, not only the first. It does not look at positions, grids or targets: a widget that overlaps another, or a target that is not a param, is not a problem here. records.d: Streams snapshots of the running show to the backstage relay over a WebSocket, at most hz times a second, and quietly keeps trying when there is no relay.
records.x: A show without a backstage is a rehearsal. Run the relay on the machine that serves the show (node packages/monitor/server.js, port 7457, which also serves the backstage page at / and GET /health), and a stage manager's phone or laptop on the same network opens http://:7457/ to see the clock, the scene, the world, the frame rate, the overrides and every signal and param live, with a red "stage feed lost" banner when the stage stops sending for 4 seconds. The show page joins as ?role=stage; every other socket is a monitor. createShow() already creates and connects one, so you only build a MonitorFeed for a show you assembled by hand. It is made to cost nothing when left on: with no relay it reconnects with a growing delay (about 5 seconds, growing by 1.6 each time up to 30), though the browser logs each refused connection, and that message is expected. frame() throttles itself, so call it every frame with a snapshot (see snapshotOf()). Call connect() once (a show does), then frame(snapshot) every frame. frame() does nothing while connected is false. The relay must be reachable from the page: on an https page the browser blocks ws:// (mixed content), so give a wss:// address explicitly. Fields to read and set: url (with ?role=stage appended, or null), hz, connected, ws, and the hook onStatus = (ok) => {}. records.d: Builds the usual snapshot of a show from its parts: clock, scene, world, frame rate, resolved params, overrides and every signal.
records.x: The data that MonitorFeed.frame() sends and the backstage page draws. Each part is optional and read with a safe fallback, so a hand-assembled show can pass only what it has. records.k: check mesh watertight manifold volume weight grams overhang wall thickness print bed 3d print report mesh quality 檢查網格 水密 流形 體積 重量 公克 懸空 壁厚 列印床 3d 列印 報告 網格品質
records.d: Measures a triangle mesh for 3D printing: closed or not, volume, mass, overhang, thinnest wall, fit on the bed, with a plain warning for each problem.
records.x: Pure and synchronous, with no DOM. Duplicate vertices are merged first (within 1e-6 of the bounding-box diagonal), because without that every un-indexed mesh (three.js toNonIndexed(), an STL, any triangle soup) reads as open. In the report: triangles (after merging; a face that collapses is dropped), bbox as { min, max, size } in mm, volume in mm³ (always positive; a mesh wound inside out is measured the right way round), watertight (every edge used by exactly two faces, in opposite directions) with the counts openEdges, nonManifoldEdges and inconsistentEdges behind it, and grams: { PETG, PLA }, the weight of the volume as solid plastic (1.27 and 1.24 g/cm³). overhang is { angle, area, ratio }: the area (mm²) of faces that look down steeper than angle allows, and its share of the whole surface. Faces that rest on the lowest 0.2 mm (the bed) do not count. minWall is { value, min, median, samples } or null: rays are shot into the part from sampled faces, and value is the 5th percentile of the thicknesses found, which is how thin most of the wall is. min is the single thinnest sample, which on a part with holes drilled at an angle is a knife edge and says little about the wall, so it has its own milder note. warnings is a list of one sentence each, in Chinese: not watertight (with the three counts), overhang above overhangWarn, a wall thinner than minWall, a knife edge thinner than half of it, and a size beyond bed. An empty list means nothing to report. fab.check(x) is…

records.k: check mesh watertight manifold volume weight grams overhang wall thickness print bed 3d print report mesh quality 檢查網格 水密 流形 體積 重量 公克 懸空 壁厚 列印床 3d 列印 報告 網格品質
records.d: 替三角形網格量 3D 列印要看的數字：封不封閉、體積、重量、懸空、最薄的壁、放不放得進列印床，每個問題有一句白話警告。
records.x: 純函式、同步，不碰 DOM。重複的頂點會先合併（距離在包圍盒對角線的 1e-6 以內），因為不這樣做，每個沒有索引的網格（three.js 的 toNonIndexed()、STL、任何三角形湯）都會被看成有開口。報告裡有：triangles（合併之後的數量，塌掉的面會被丟掉）、bbox（{ min, max, size }，單位毫米）、volume（單位 mm³，一定是正的，繞法反了的網格也會用正確的方向去量）、watertight（每條邊剛好被兩個面用到、而且方向相反），背後是 openEdges、nonManifoldEdges、inconsistentEdges 三個計數，還有 grams：{ PETG, PLA }，把體積當成實心塑膠算出的重量（1.27 和 1.24 g/cm³）。 overhang 是 { angle, area, ratio }：朝下的程度超過 angle 容許範圍的面的面積（mm²），以及它佔整個表面的比例。貼在最低 0.2 毫米內（也就是貼在床上）的面不算。minWall 是 { value, min, median, samples } 或 null：從取樣的面朝零件裡面射線，value 是量到的厚度的第 5 百分位，也就是大部分壁有多薄。min 是單一最薄的樣本，在有斜著鑽孔的零件上，它會是刀口，對壁厚說不了什麼，所以另外有比較溫和的提示。 warnings 是一串警告，每項一句話：網格不水密（附三個計數）、懸空超過 overhangWarn、壁比 minWall 薄、刀口比它的一半還薄、尺寸超出 bed。清單是空的就表示沒有要回報的事。fab.check(x) 就是 checkMesh(meshOf(x), opts)。 grams 是實心零件的重量：它不知道填充率或外殼層數，所以切片列印出來的會比較輕。 input 網格 { vertices, triangles, units? }：vertices 是 x, y, z, x, y, z … 的 Float32Array 或 Float64Array，triangles 是每個面三個頂點編號的 Uint32Array，從外面看逆時針，Z 向上，單位毫米。要從別的東西得到網格，用 meshOf()。 opts angle（45）：懸空角度，單位度。minWall（1.2）：允許的最薄壁，單位毫米。bed（[320, 320, 325]）：列印床的大小，單位毫米。wallSamples（2000）：量壁厚時取樣的面數，少一點比較快。overhangWarn（0.15）：懸空面積佔多少比例才警告。weld（true）：先把重複的頂點合併，false 就跳過。 { units, triangles, bbox, volume, watertight, openEdges, nonManifoldEdges, inconsistentEdges, overhang, minWall, grams, warnings }。見說明。

records.d: Exports a shape as STL, OBJ, GLB, STEP or DXF and resolves to { bytes, mime, ext, report }: the same as fab.export(), without the Fab class.
records.x: stl, obj and glb come from the mesh: toStlBytes(), toObjText(), toGlbBytes(). step and dxf come straight from the smlibwasm kernel (toStep, toDxf) and are refused for anything that is not a kernel shape, because a mesh has no curved surfaces to write; an error says so. A kernel solid's glb uses the kernel's toGlb when it has one. The report is made on the way, so a file and its check always agree. x The shape: anything meshOf() accepts, and for step a smlibwasm Part, for dxf a smlibwasm Shape or Sketch. fmt 'stl', 'obj', 'step', 'dxf' or 'glb', in any case. 'stp' means step and 'gltf' means glb. Another word throws an Error that lists the formats. opts The options of meshOf() (scale, tessellator) and of checkMesh() (angle, minWall, bed …), and name, the object name of an OBJ file. kernel { smlib: () => Promise }, where to get the smlibwasm module for step, dxf, and the glb of a Part. fab.export() passes its own. bytes is a Uint8Array, mime is from MIME, ext is the extension without the dot ('step' even if you asked for 'stp'), and report is the checkMesh() report of the mesh (for step and dxf it can be null when the shape cannot be meshed, such as a 2D sketch).

records.d: Checks a shape for 3D printing and exports it as STL, OBJ, GLB, STEP or DXF; takes a mesh, a three.js object or a smlibwasm solid.
records.x: Make one Fab and hand it whatever you made: fab.check(x) returns a manufacturability report (is it closed, how much material, how much overhang, how thin is the thinnest wall, how many grams), and await fab.export(x, 'stl') returns the file as bytes. x can be a plain triangle mesh { vertices, triangles }, a three.js Mesh, Object3D or BufferGeometry (recognised by its shape, three.js is never imported), or a smlibwasm Part or Shape. meshOf() says exactly what is accepted. Formats: stl, obj and glb work for any input; step only for a smlibwasm Part, and dxf only for a smlibwasm Shape or Sketch, because a mesh has no curved-surface information. The CAD kernels are not bundled: the first time one is needed, fab.smlib() or fab.manifold() imports it from a URL (unpkg by default) and remembers it. fab.save() writes the file through fab.saver if you set one (the lab's dev server does), and otherwise as a browser download. Zero runtime dependencies: nothing is fetched until you ask for a kernel. Nothing for meshes and three.js objects. A smlibwasm Part has to be tessellated by the kernel: call await fab.smlib() once before the synchronous check(), or use checkAsync(), meshOfAsync() and export(), which load it for you. Loading needs a network, or urls / window.LAB.vendor pointing somewhere that has the kernel. Public fields: opts and saver (set it to async (bytes, info) => ({ file, … }); it starts as null). The file name for save() is name, else the id from context(), else fab. opts…

records.x: This is what meshOf() uses for a kernel's tessellation result, whichever way the kernel spells it. It throws an Error (in Chinese) when m is empty or has no positions. It does not check that the faces point outward or that the mesh is closed: that is checkMesh(). m An object with the points under positions, vertices, points or position, and the faces under indices, triangles, faces, index or triVerts. Points may be flat numbers, nested arrays ([[x, y, z], …]) or objects ({ x, y, z }). Without faces, every three points are one triangle. m.units is kept (default 'mm'). scale Multiplies every position, for example millimetres per unit. { vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }.

records.d: Reads a binary STL file back into a triangle mesh: every face has its own three vertices, in 32-bit floats.
records.x: It reads what toStlBytes() writes, or any binary STL: the normals and the two attribute bytes are skipped, and the result is a triangle soup. Give it to checkMesh(), which merges the vertices itself, or to weldMesh(). The text (ASCII) form of STL, which starts with solid, is not supported and would read as garbage. bytes The contents of a binary STL file. records.d: Imports a CAD kernel (smlibwasm or manifold-3d) from the first URL that works, and resolves to the ready module.
records.x: The kernels are not bundled, because open-audiovisual has no dependencies and no build step: the first time a page needs one, it is imported from a URL. The order is candidateUrls(): opts.urls[kind], then window.LAB.vendor[kind], then unpkg (DEFAULT_URLS). If every URL fails it rejects with an Error (in Chinese) that names each URL and why it failed. It does not remember anything: fab.smlib() and fab.manifold() keep the promise for you, so call those unless you want to manage it yourself. A network, or urls pointing at a place that serves the kernel (the lab uses window.LAB.vendor), or an importer that returns one. kind Which kernel: 'smlib' for smlibwasm (solid modelling, STEP and DXF) or 'manifold' for manifold-3d (fast mesh booleans). opts urls: { smlib, manifold }, a URL or a list of URLs for each kernel. importer: async (url) => module, to use instead of the dynamic import(). The smlibwasm module as it came, or the manifold-3d module with its WebAssembly started (setup() called).

records.k: mesh of convert to mesh three.js BufferGeometry Object3D tessellate triangle mesh y up z up scale 轉成網格 three.js BufferGeometry Object3D 切網格 三角形網格 y 向上 z 向上 縮放
records.d: Turns whatever you made into a triangle mesh { vertices, triangles, units }: a mesh, a three.js object, a mesh-like object or a smlibwasm shape.
records.x: Everything is recognised by its shape and nothing is imported, so three.js and smlibwasm are never loaded for you. A three.js object has its matrixWorld applied (a mirrored object keeps its faces facing outward), indexed or not, and Y up is turned into Z up as (x, y, z) → (x, −z, y), then everything is multiplied by scale. A missing input, or something it cannot read, throws an Error whose message (in Chinese) says what to do. It is synchronous, so it cannot wait for a kernel: a smlibwasm solid without opts.tessellator throws a message that tells you to load the kernel first, and a tessellate() that returns a promise throws too. Use meshOfAsync() for those. x The thing to convert. Accepted, tried in this order: a mesh { vertices, triangles } (returned as it is); a three.js Mesh, Object3D (every visible mesh below it) or BufferGeometry; anything with a tessellate() method; an object with positions / vertices / points and, optionally, indices / triangles / faces / index; a smlibwasm solid or shape (given opts.tessellator). opts scale: millimetres per unit for a three.js or mesh-like input (default 1). A mesh { vertices, triangles } is never scaled. tessellator(shape): a function that turns a smlibwasm shape into a mesh (the Fab class passes the kernel's once it is loaded). tessellate: an argument passed on to the shape's own tessellate(). { vertices, triangles, units }: counter-clockwise faces seen from outside, Z up, millimetres.

records.k: mesh of convert to mesh three.js BufferGeometry Object3D tessellate triangle mesh y up z up scale 轉成網格 three.js BufferGeometry Object3D 切網格 三角形網格 y 向上 z 向上 縮放
records.d: 把你做的東西變成三角形網格 { vertices, triangles, units }：網格、three.js 物件、像網格的物件，或 smlibwasm 的形狀。
records.x: 每種東西都靠形狀辨認，什麼都不 import，所以 three.js 和 smlibwasm 絕對不會被替你載入。three.js 物件會套用它的 matrixWorld（鏡射的物件仍會讓面朝外），有沒有索引都行，Y 向上會換成 Z 向上，換法是 (x, y, z) → (x, −z, y)，然後全部乘上 scale。沒有給輸入、或它讀不懂的東西，會丟出 Error，訊息（中文）會說明該怎麼辦。 它是同步的，所以不能等核心：沒有 opts.tessellator 的 smlibwasm 實體會丟出一則叫你先載入核心的訊息，tessellate() 回傳 promise 也會丟出錯誤。這些情況請用 meshOfAsync()。 x 要轉換的東西。接受的類型，依這個順序比對：網格 { vertices, triangles }（原樣傳回），three.js 的 Mesh、Object3D（底下每個看得見的網格）或 BufferGeometry，任何有 tessellate() 方法的東西，有 positions／vertices／points，以及可有可無的 indices／triangles／faces／index 的物件，smlibwasm 的實體或形狀（要給 opts.tessellator）。 opts scale：three.js 或像網格的輸入，每個單位多少毫米（預設 1）。{ vertices, triangles } 的網格不會被縮放。tessellator(shape)：把 smlibwasm 形狀變成網格的函式（Fab 類別在核心載入後會傳入核心的那個）。tessellate：傳給形狀自己的 tessellate() 的參數。 { vertices, triangles, units }：從外面看逆時針的面，Z 向上，單位毫米。

records.k: async mesh tessellate smlibwasm promise kernel load on demand worker 非同步網格 切網格 smlibwasm promise 核心 需要時載入 worker
records.d: Like meshOf(), but it waits for a tessellate() that returns a promise, and can load the smlibwasm kernel to tessellate a solid.
records.x: Use it where the conversion may have to wait: a shape whose tessellate() is asynchronous, or a smlibwasm Part when the kernel is not loaded yet. With opts.kernel.smlib it awaits the module and uses its tessellate(part); an error says so if the module has none. Everything else is passed on to meshOf(). fab.meshOfAsync() fills in kernel for you. x The thing to convert; see meshOf(). opts The options of meshOf(), and kernel: { smlib: () => Promise }, where to get the smlibwasm module from when a solid has to be tessellated and no tessellator was given. The same mesh meshOf() would give.

records.k: async mesh tessellate smlibwasm promise kernel load on demand worker 非同步網格 切網格 smlibwasm promise 核心 需要時載入 worker
records.d: 跟 meshOf() 一樣，但它會等回傳 promise 的 tessellate()，也能載入 smlibwasm 核心來切實體。
records.x: 轉換可能得等的時候用它：tessellate() 是非同步的形狀，或核心還沒載入的 smlibwasm Part。有給 opts.kernel.smlib 的話，它會等模組載好，用它的 tessellate(part)。模組沒有這個函式的話會丟出說明的錯誤。其他東西都交給 meshOf()。fab.meshOfAsync() 會替你填好 kernel。 x 要轉換的東西，見 meshOf()。 opts meshOf() 的選項，另外有 kernel：{ smlib: () => Promise }，遇到實體要切、又沒給 tessellator 時，從哪裡拿 smlibwasm 模組。 跟 meshOf() 會給的一樣的網格。

records.k: mime media type content type blob type model/stl gltf-binary mime 媒體類型 content type blob 類型 model/stl gltf-binary
records.d: The media type of each export format: MIME.stl is 'model/stl', and obj, step, dxf and glb the same way.
records.x: For the type of a Blob or the Content-Type of an upload when you handle the bytes yourself: new Blob([bytes], { type: MIME.stl }). exportAs() already puts the right one in its result. { stl: 'model/stl', obj: 'model/obj', step: 'model/step', dxf: 'image/vnd.dxf', glb: 'model/gltf-binary' }. Its keys are the formats exportAs() accepts.

records.k: mime media type content type blob type model/stl gltf-binary mime 媒體類型 content type blob 類型 model/stl gltf-binary
records.d: 每種輸出格式的媒體類型：MIME.stl 是 'model/stl'，obj、step、dxf、glb 也一樣。
records.x: 自己處理位元組的時候，拿來當 Blob 的 type 或上傳的 Content-Type：new Blob([bytes], { type: MIME.stl })。exportAs() 的結果裡已經附上正確的那一個。 { stl: 'model/stl', obj: 'model/obj', step: 'model/step', dxf: 'image/vnd.dxf', glb: 'model/gltf-binary' }。它的鍵就是 exportAs() 接受的格式。

records.k: glb gltf export glb binary gltf 3d viewer web 3d write glb glb gltf 輸出 glb 二進位 gltf 3d 檢視器 網頁 3d 寫出 glb
records.d: Writes a triangle mesh as a minimal binary glTF (.glb): one mesh with welded positions and indices, in millimetres.
records.x: Vertices are welded first with weldMesh(). The file has POSITION and indices only: no normals, no materials, no colours, so a viewer shades it flat or works the normals out itself. The positions stay in millimetres and Z up, and asset.extras says { units: 'mm', up: 'Z' }. glTF itself assumes Y up, so a viewer that does not read the extras shows the part lying on its side. await fab.export(part, 'glb') of a smlibwasm Part uses the kernel's own toGlb when it has one, and this function otherwise. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }, in millimetres. A glTF 2.0 binary: the glTF header, one JSON chunk, one binary chunk with 32-bit float positions and 32-bit indices. The length is a multiple of 4.

records.k: glb gltf export glb binary gltf 3d viewer web 3d write glb glb gltf 輸出 glb 二進位 gltf 3d 檢視器 網頁 3d 寫出 glb
records.d: 把三角形網格寫成最精簡的二進位 glTF（.glb）：一個網格，位置已合併並帶索引，單位毫米。
records.x: 頂點會先用 weldMesh() 合併。檔案裡只有 POSITION 和索引：沒有法線、材質、顏色，所以檢視器會用平面著色，或自己算法線。位置維持毫米、Z 向上，asset.extras 寫著 { units: 'mm', up: 'Z' }。glTF 本身假設 Y 向上，所以不讀 extras 的檢視器會把零件顯示成躺在側面。 smlibwasm 的 Part 用 await fab.export(part, 'glb') 的話，核心有自己的 toGlb 就用它，沒有才用這個函式。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }，單位毫米。 glTF 2.0 二進位檔：glTF 檔頭、一個 JSON 區塊、一個放 32 位元浮點數位置和 32 位元索引的二進位區塊。長度是 4 的倍數。

records.k: obj wavefront export obj text mesh write obj obj wavefront 輸出 obj 文字網格 寫出 obj
records.d: Writes a triangle mesh as OBJ text: welded vertices (v x y z), then faces (f a b c), one object, in millimetres.
records.x: Vertices are welded first with weldMesh(), so a triangle soup comes out with shared vertices and a small file. There are no normals, no texture coordinates and no materials. await fab.export(x, 'obj', { name }) is the same thing with the conversions done for you. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }, in millimetres. name The object name on the o line. Spaces become underscores. The text: a comment line, o , one v line per welded vertex (6 decimals at most) and one f line per face, vertex numbers counting from 1.

records.k: obj wavefront export obj text mesh write obj obj wavefront 輸出 obj 文字網格 寫出 obj
records.d: 把三角形網格寫成 OBJ 文字：先合併頂點（v x y z），再寫面（f a b c），一個物件，單位毫米。
records.x: 頂點會先用 weldMesh() 合併，所以三角形湯寫出來有共用的頂點，檔案也小。沒有法線、沒有貼圖座標、沒有材質。await fab.export(x, 'obj', { name }) 是同一件事，並且替你做了轉換。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }，單位毫米。 name o 那一行的物件名稱。空格會變成底線。 文字內容：一行註解、o 、每個合併後的頂點一行 v（最多 6 位小數）、每個面一行 f，頂點編號從 1 開始。

records.k: stl binary stl export stl 3d print file slicer write stl bytes stl 二進位 stl 輸出 stl 3d 列印檔 切片軟體 寫出 stl 位元組
records.d: Writes a triangle mesh as a binary STL file: 84 + 50 bytes per face, with a normal worked out for every face.
records.x: Every face becomes its own 50 bytes: STL has no shared vertices. The normal comes from the order of the corners (right-hand rule), so counter-clockwise faces seen from outside give outward normals. Positions are written as they are, as float32: nothing is converted to millimetres, so give it a mesh that is already in mm. await fab.export(x, 'stl') is the same thing with the conversions and the check done for you. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }, in millimetres. The file: an 80-byte header (the text open-audiovisual fab STL (mm)), the face count as a little-endian 32-bit integer, then per face the normal and three corners as 32-bit floats and two zero bytes.

records.k: stl binary stl export stl 3d print file slicer write stl bytes stl 二進位 stl 輸出 stl 3d 列印檔 切片軟體 寫出 stl 位元組
records.d: 把三角形網格寫成二進位 STL 檔：84 位元組加上每個面 50 位元組，每個面的法線都會算出來。
records.x: 每個面各自佔 50 位元組：STL 沒有共用頂點。法線是從角的順序（右手定則）算出來的，所以從外面看逆時針的面，法線就朝外。位置原樣寫成 float32，不會換算成毫米，所以請給它已經是毫米的網格。await fab.export(x, 'stl') 是同一件事，並且替你做了轉換和檢查。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }，單位毫米。 檔案內容：80 位元組的檔頭（文字 open-audiovisual fab STL (mm)）、面數（小端序的 32 位元整數），然後每個面是法線和三個角（32 位元浮點數）加上兩個零位元組。

records.k: weld merge vertices triangle soup dedupe shared vertices tolerance stl 合併頂點 焊接 三角形湯 去重複 共用頂點 容差 stl
records.d: Merges vertices that sit closer together than a tolerance and drops the faces that collapse; returns a new mesh with shared vertices.
records.x: A triangle soup, where every face has three vertices of its own (what an STL file or three.js toNonIndexed() gives), has no neighbours as far as topology goes: every edge looks open. Welding gives the faces shared vertices, so checkMesh() can see that they join. checkMesh(), toObjText() and toGlbBytes() call it themselves; toStlBytes() does not need it. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }. It is not changed. tolerance Vertices closer than this (in each of x, y and z) become one, in the mesh's units. Left out: 1e-6 times the diagonal of the bounding box. { vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units } with each position once, and no face that has two corners on the same vertex.

records.k: weld merge vertices triangle soup dedupe shared vertices tolerance stl 合併頂點 焊接 三角形湯 去重複 共用頂點 容差 stl
records.d: 把靠得比容差還近的頂點合併，並丟掉塌掉的面，回傳一個頂點有共用的新網格。
records.x: 三角形湯，也就是每個面都有自己的三個頂點（STL 檔或 three.js 的 toNonIndexed() 給的就是這樣），在拓撲上沒有鄰居：每條邊都看起來是開的。合併頂點讓面共用頂點，checkMesh() 才看得出它們是接在一起的。checkMesh()、toObjText() 和 toGlbBytes() 會自己呼叫它，toStlBytes() 用不到。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }。不會被改動。 tolerance 距離（x、y、z 各自）小於這個值的頂點會變成一個，單位跟網格一樣。不給的話是包圍盒對角線的 1e-6 倍。 { vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }，每個位置只出現一次，也沒有任何一個面有兩個角落在同一個頂點上。

records.k: list examples examples works mcp tool agent what exists donor 列出範例 範例 作品 mcp 工具 代理 有哪些 範本
records.d: Lists the example works of this checkout: for each one its folder, its page title and the first comment line of its main.js.
records.x: The first call an agent makes in an unfamiliar checkout: what works already exist, so it can pick a donor for scaffold_world. It takes no input: send "arguments": {}. The server running: node packages/mcp/server.js, which Claude Code starts from the .mcp.json of the repository (server name openav). Other clients need the same command and args in their MCP settings. An MCP client sends initialize once before the first call. Over stdio every message is one line of JSON: the request bodies on this page are spread over several lines to be read, and a client writes them on one line for you. [{ dir, title, summary }], one per folder in examples/, as JSON text. dir is like examples/01-hello-particles, title is the of its index.html, summary is the first line of its main.js that starts with // (the slashes taken off). A file that is missing gives an empty string.

records.k: list examples examples works mcp tool agent what exists donor 列出範例 範例 作品 mcp 工具 代理 有哪些 範本
records.d: 列出這份檔案庫裡的範例作品：每個範例的資料夾、頁面標題，以及它的 main.js 第一行註解。
records.x: 代理進到陌生的檔案庫時的第一個呼叫：已經有哪些作品，這樣它才能替 scaffold_world 挑一個範本。它不需要任何輸入：送 "arguments": {}。 伺服器要在跑：node packages/mcp/server.js，Claude Code 會依儲存庫的 .mcp.json 啟動它（伺服器名稱 openav）。其他用戶端要在自己的 MCP 設定裡寫同樣的 command 和 args。MCP 用戶端在第一次呼叫之前會先送一次 initialize。透過 stdio 時每則訊息是一行 JSON：這一頁的請求內容為了好讀而分成好幾行，用戶端會替你把它們寫成一行。 [{ dir, title, summary }]，examples/ 底下每個資料夾一項，格式是 JSON 文字。dir 像 examples/01-hello-particles，title 是它的 index.html 的 ，summary 是它的 main.js 第一行以 // 開頭的內容（去掉斜線）。缺檔就給空字串。

records.k: read doc documentation handbook AGENTS.md readme architecture writing a world mcp tool agent briefing 讀文件 文件 手冊 AGENTS.md readme 架構 寫一個世界 mcp 工具 代理簡介
records.d: Returns the text of one framework document: the agent briefing, a handbook chapter or the README, chosen by name.
records.x: Input: doc (required), one of architecture, writing-a-world, signals, show-control, score, roadmap, agents, readme, introduction, getting-started, concepts, inputs, mapping, controllers, remote, packages, agents-guide, troubleshooting, lab-integration. The tool's own description tells an agent to start with agents (the conventions and the two unbreakable rules), then writing-a-world. Most names are docs/.md. Two are not, and they are easy to mix up: agents is AGENTS.md at the root of the repository (the briefing), agents-guide is docs/agents.md (the handbook chapter), and readme is README.md. A name that is not in the list, or no doc at all, is an error with a plain Node message (The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined), not a list of the valid names. A client that follows the input schema cannot send one: the schema has the names as an enum. The Markdown of the file, as it is on disk, in one text item: not JSON. The whole file comes back, which can be tens of kilobytes.

records.k: run checks run tests node --test ci test suite verify green mcp tool 跑檢查 跑測試 node --test ci 測試 驗證 全綠 mcp 工具
records.d: Runs the framework's whole test suite (node --test on every file in tests/), the same gate CI uses, and says whether it passed.
records.x: No input: send "arguments": {}. An agent calls it after every change to know whether the repository is still green. It runs node --test over every tests/.test.js of the checkout the server lives in, waits for it to finish and gives up after 60 seconds. At the time of writing, in the checkout this was written from, the whole suite takes about 50 seconds and prints about 3.6 MB of report, while the tool reads at most 1 MiB of it. Past that the child process is stopped, and the tool answers { ok: false, output } with only the failing lines found in that first megabyte, even if every test passes. Until that changes, do not read ok: false with an empty output as a failing test: run node --test tests/.test.js in a terminal. When the run finishes cleanly: { pass, fail, ok } (numbers from the report, and ok true only when fail is 0), as JSON text. Otherwise { ok: false, output }, where output holds the lines of the report that say not ok or give the totals.

records.x: Input, all required: maker (such as Arturia), model (such as MiniLab 3) and controls, a list of { type, count, from? } that describes the faceplate, for example [{"type":"knob","count":8},{"type":"pad","count":8},{"type":"keys","count":25,"from":48}]. type is one of knob, encoder, fader, pad, button, keys, wheel, strip; count is a whole number from 1 to 128; from is the lowest note of a keys section (default 48). Knobs, faders and strips get consecutive CC numbers from 20, pads get notes from 36 (skipping a keys range), buttons get momentary CCs, encoders get relative CCs, the first wheel is a pitch bend and any further wheel falls back to a CC. The id comes from maker and model (acme-pad-pro-16), short is the model without hyphens, and match.ports is a pattern made of the model's words. Wrong input is an error with the reason: no maker or model, controls empty or not a list, an unknown type, a count outside 1..128, keys outside notes 0..127, or more controls than there are CC numbers (about 108) or pad notes. After that the agent sources every number from the maker's MIDI chart, runs validate_profile, and saves the file in packages/midi/profiles/; next_steps lists these. { profile, problems, unverified, next_steps } as JSON text, plus warnings when the id or short name collides with a shipped…

records.d: Checks a controller profile with validateProfile() and against the shipped ones: same id, same short name, or port patterns that claim the same device.
records.x: Input: profile (required), the profile as an object or as a JSON string. A string that is not valid JSON does not raise an error: the answer is { ok: false, problems: ['not valid JSON: …'], conflicts: [] }. The checks cover the id and short name (lower-case, and short must not be one of the reserved generic names), a name and a kind (device or generic), a source for every device profile, the port regular expressions, the faceplate size, every control (a known type and message, cc or note in 0..127, two controls never on the same message, an encoder's relative mode) and that every control is shown on the faceplate. The conflicts are what the validator cannot see by itself: id and short are taken by a shipped profile (the short becomes the signal namespace midi//…), and port means a regular expression in match.ports is identical to a shipped one or matches its name, so the framework could not tell the two devices apart when one is plugged in. A profile for a new device passes when ok is true; a clone of a shipped one comes back with all three kinds. { ok, problems, conflicts } as JSON text. problems is a list of sentences from validateProfile() (controls[0] (a): cc must be 0..127). conflicts is a list of { with, kind, detail }: with is the shipped profile, kind is 'id', 'short' or 'port'. ok is true only when both are empty.
